en: The crew had to abandon the sinking ship.
She danced with wild abandon.
Never abandon your principles for temporary gain.
cn: 船员不得不弃离沉船。
她纵情狂舞。
切勿为一时利益放弃原则。

definitions.definition: 不规则的（如生物学特征）

en: The abnormal weather patterns caused crop failures.
His abnormal behavior raised concerns among his friends.
The test results showed abnormal cell growth.
cn: 反常的天气模式导致农作物歉收。
他的异常行为引发了朋友们的担忧。
检测结果显示细胞生长异常。

en: The government plans to abolish outdated tax laws.
Slavery was abolished in the 19th century.
New technology may abolish manual labor in this field.
cn: 政府计划废除过时的税法。
奴隶制在19世纪被废除。
新技术可能彻底消除该领域的手工劳动。

en: The debate on abortion laws continues to divide the country.
The project was an abortion due to lack of funding.
She wrote a book about her experience with abortion.
cn: 关于堕胎法的辩论仍使国家分裂。
该项目因资金不足而夭折。
她写了一本关于自己流产经历的书。

en: The meeting came to an abrupt end when the fire alarm rang.
His abrupt manner made the guests uncomfortable.
The road ended in an abrupt drop to the valley below.
cn: 火警响起时，会议突然中断。
他唐突的举止让客人们感到不适。
道路尽头是陡降至山谷的悬崖。

en: His absence from the meeting was noted by everyone.
The absence of evidence made the case difficult to solve.
She stared out the window, lost in absence of mind.
cn: 他缺席会议的情况被所有人注意到了。
证据的缺乏使得案件难以解决。
她望着窗外，心不在焉。

en: Plants absorb sunlight to produce energy.
She was so absorbed in the book that she missed her stop.
The sponge quickly absorbed the spilled water.
cn: 植物吸收阳光以产生能量。
她全神贯注地读书，以至于坐过了站。
海绵迅速吸干了洒出的水。

en: The concept of love is too abstract to define easily.
She wrote an abstract of her research paper.
Scientists abstract data from experiments to form theories.
cn: “爱”的概念过于抽象，难以简单定义。
她为研究论文撰写了摘要。
科学家从实验中提取数据以形成理论。

en: The idea that pigs can fly is utterly absurd.
His absurd behavior made everyone laugh.
It's absurd to expect a toddler to solve complex math problems.
cn: 猪会飞的想法荒谬至极。
他荒诞的行为逗笑了所有人。
指望幼儿解决复杂数学题是荒唐的。

en: The garden was filled with an abundance of flowers.
Silicon Valley thrives due to an abundance of tech talent.
Her writing reflects an abundance of creativity.
cn: 花园里开满了繁茂的花朵。
硅谷因大量科技人才而蓬勃发展。
她的作品展现了充沛的创造力。

en: The region is abundant in natural resources.
She has an abundant imagination.
The harvest was abundant this year.
cn: 该地区自然资源丰富。
她拥有丰富的想象力。
今年收成丰盈。

en: The politician was accused of abusing his power for personal gain.
Verbal abuse can have long-lasting psychological effects.
The system is designed to prevent the abuse of sensitive data.
cn: 这位政治家被指控滥用职权谋取私利。
言语辱骂可能造成长期心理伤害。
该系统旨在防止敏感数据被滥用。

en: She pursued an academic career in physics.
The debate was too academic for practical applications.
Many academics attended the international conference.
cn: 她从事物理学学术研究。
这场辩论过于理论化，缺乏实际应用价值。
许多学者出席了这场国际会议。

en: The car can accelerate from 0 to 60 mph in 6 seconds.
Climate change is accelerating at an alarming rate.
The new policy aims to accelerate economic recovery.
cn: 这辆车可在6秒内从0加速至60英里/小时。
气候变化正以惊人速度加剧。
新政策旨在加速经济复苏。

en: Her acceptance of the award moved the audience.
The bank confirmed the acceptance of the draft.
Cultural acceptance requires open-mindedness.
cn: 她接受奖项的举动感动了在场观众。
银行确认了汇票的承兑。
文化包容需要开放的心态。

definitions.definition: 进入；使用权；接触的机会

en: The building has wheelchair access.
Students need a password to access the online library.
She was denied access to the confidential files.
cn: 这座大楼设有轮椅通道。
学生需密码才能访问在线图书馆。
她被拒绝接触机密文件。

definitions.definition: 附件；配件（如服装配饰或电子设备附加部件）

en: She bought a matching handbag as an accessory for her dress.
The suspect was charged as an accessory to the crime.
The camera comes with several accessory lenses.
cn: 她买了一个搭配的手包作为裙子的配饰。
该嫌疑人被指控为犯罪从犯。
这款相机附带多个辅助镜头。

en: She broke her leg in a car accident.
The discovery was made by accident.
Accidents will happen in any workplace.
cn: 她在车祸中摔断了腿。
这一发现是偶然获得的。
任何工作场所都可能发生意外。

definitions.definition: 容纳；提供住宿；适应；调解

en: The hotel can accommodate up to 500 guests.
She accommodated her schedule to meet the deadline.
The lens accommodates to focus on near objects.
cn: 这家酒店可容纳多达500名客人。
她调整了日程以适应截止时间。
晶状体调节以聚焦近处物体。

definitions.definition: 住所，住宿（提供居住的空间或服务）
适应，调节（行为或生理上的调整）

en: The hotel offers luxury accommodation for business travelers.
The lens of the eye changes shape for accommodation to near objects.
Cultural accommodation is essential for immigrants in a new country.
cn: 酒店为商务旅客提供豪华住宿。
眼睛的晶状体通过变形调节以看清近处物体。
文化适应对移民在新国家的生活至关重要。

en: She worked hard to accomplish her mission.
The team accomplished the project ahead of schedule.
His dedication accomplished a remarkable transformation.
cn: 她努力完成了自己的任务。
团队提前完成了项目。
他的投入实现了显著的转变。

definitions.definition: 给予（权力、地位等）；使一致

en: The two nations signed a peace accord after years of conflict.
Her actions do not accord with her words.
The committee accorded him the highest honor for his contributions.
cn: 两国在多年冲突后签署了和平协议。
她的言行不一。
委员会因他的贡献授予他最高荣誉。

en: The project was completed in accordance with the client's specifications.
His actions were not in accordance with company policy.
The judge ruled in accordance with the law.
cn: 该项目按照客户的要求完成。
他的行为不符合公司政策。
法官依法作出了裁决。

en: She checked her bank account online.
Can you account for the missing funds?
His account of the accident was detailed.
cn: 她在网上查看了银行账户。
你能解释资金缺失的原因吗？
他对事故的描述非常详细。

definitions.definition: 积累，堆积（指逐渐增加数量或规模）
累积，积聚（指自然或被动增长）

en: Dust tends to accumulate in unused rooms.
He accumulated a fortune through wise investments.
Stress can accumulate if not managed properly.
cn: 灰尘容易在无人使用的房间里堆积。
他通过明智的投资积累了财富。
压力若不妥善处理会不断累积。

en: The scientist needs accurate data to validate the theory.
This watch is accurate to within one second per year.
Her accurate description helped the police identify the suspect.
cn: 科学家需要准确的数据来验证理论。
这块手表的年误差在一秒以内。
她精确的描述帮助警方锁定了嫌疑人。

en: She accused him of stealing her ideas.
The report accuses the government of ignoring climate change.
He was wrongly accused of the crime.
cn: 她指控他窃取她的创意。
报告指责政府忽视气候变化。
他被错误地指控犯下该罪。

en: She was accustomed to waking up early.
His accustomed cheerfulness vanished under stress.
The team is accustomed to working under tight deadlines.
cn: 她习惯了早起。
他惯常的乐观在压力下消失了。
这个团队习惯了在紧迫的期限内工作。

definitions.definition: （通过努力获得的）成绩或奖励

en: Winning the award was her greatest achievement.
The project’s achievement surprised everyone.
His academic achievements earned him a scholarship.
cn: 获得该奖项是她最大的成就。
该项目的完成令所有人惊讶。
他的学术成绩为他赢得了奖学金。

en: The lemon juice tastes strongly acidic.
Sulfuric acid is highly corrosive.
His acid remarks hurt her feelings.
cn: 柠檬汁尝起来非常酸。
硫酸具有强腐蚀性。
他尖刻的言论伤了她的感情。

definitions.definition: 对（某人）表示感谢或认可

en: She refused to acknowledge her mistake.
Please acknowledge receipt of this email.
The award acknowledges his contributions to science.
cn: 她拒绝承认错误。
请确认收到本邮件。
该奖项是对他科学贡献的认可。

en: She took time to acquaint herself with the new software.
The guide will acquaint you with the local customs.
Let me acquaint you with the facts before you decide.
cn: 她花时间熟悉新软件。
导游会让你了解当地习俗。
在你决定前，我先让你了解事实。

en: She's an old acquaintance from college.
I have some acquaintance with French literature.
He nodded to me as a mere acquaintance.
cn: 她是大学时代的一个旧相识。
我对法国文学略有了解。
他向我点头示意，仅维持泛泛之交的礼节。

definitions.definition: 获得，取得（通过努力或自然过程）

en: She acquired fluency in French after living in Paris for five years.
The museum acquired a rare painting from the 17th century.
Bad habits are easier to acquire than to discard.
cn: 她在巴黎居住五年后习得了流利的法语。
博物馆获得了一幅17世纪的稀有画作。
坏习惯比好习惯更容易养成。

en: The enzyme helps to activate the digestion process.
Press this button to activate the emergency alarm.
Sunlight activates the photosynthesis in plants.
cn: 这种酶有助于激活消化过程。
按下此按钮可启动紧急警报。
阳光激活植物的光合作用。

definitions.definition: 尖锐的；剧烈的（疼痛、疾病等）

en: She felt an acute pain in her chest.
Dogs have an acute sense of smell.
The triangle has two acute angles.
cn: 她感到胸口一阵剧痛。
狗拥有敏锐的嗅觉。
这个三角形有两个锐角。

en: The novel was adapted into a popular film.
It takes time to adapt to a new culture.
The species adapted to survive in extreme heat.
cn: 这部小说被改编成了一部热门电影。
适应新文化需要时间。
该物种通过适应在极端高温中存活。

definitions.definition: 瘾君子；对某事入迷的人

en: He became a drug addict after years of substance abuse.
She is addicted to scrolling through social media.
The novel was so gripping that it addicted readers to its plot.
cn: 他因长期滥用药物而成瘾。
她对刷社交媒体上瘾。
这本小说情节引人入胜，令读者沉迷其中。

en: The teacher wrote the addition problem on the board.
The new wing is a recent addition to the museum.
Fresh herbs are a great addition to any dish.
cn: 老师在黑板上写下了这道加法题。
新侧厅是博物馆最近扩建的部分。
新鲜香草是任何菜肴的绝佳点缀。

en: The hotel charges an additional fee for late check-out.
She provided additional evidence to support her claim.
Additional resources will be allocated to the project next month.
cn: 酒店对延迟退房收取额外费用。
她提供了更多证据来支持她的主张。
下个月将为该项目分配更多资源。

en: The hotel provided adequate facilities for the conference.
His performance was adequate but not outstanding.
Ensure your diet includes adequate nutrients.
cn: 酒店为会议提供了足够的设施。
他的表现尚可，但并不出色。
确保饮食中含有充足的营养。

en: The stamp failed to adhere to the envelope.
She adheres strictly to her vegan principles.
The paint adheres best to a clean, dry surface.
cn: 邮票未能粘在信封上。
她严格遵循纯素主义原则。
油漆在干净干燥的表面上附着力最佳。

en: The hotel is adjacent to the train station.
Their ideas are adjacent in the conceptual framework.
The adjacent rooms share a common wall.
cn: 酒店紧邻火车站。
他们的理念在概念框架中是相邻的。
相邻的房间共用一堵墙。

en: The two gardens adjoin at the hedge.
Our office adjoins the train station.
The theory adjoins several disciplines.
cn: 两座花园在树篱处相连。
我们的办公室紧邻火车站。
这一理论与多个学科领域相关联。

en: She adjusted the mirror to see the road clearly.
It took him weeks to adjust to the new climate.
The mechanic adjusted the engine for better performance.
cn: 她调整后视镜以看清道路。
他花了数周才适应新气候。
机械师调试引擎以提升性能。

definitions.definition: 管理，行政（尤指政府或企业的运作）

en: The school administration introduced a new policy on campus safety.
The Obama administration focused on healthcare reform.
Efficient administration is key to a company's success.
cn: 学校管理层出台了一项新的校园安全政策。
奥巴马政府曾专注于医疗改革。
高效的管理是企业成功的关键。

definitions.definition: 准许进入（某场所或组织）

en: She refused to admit her mistake.
This ticket admits two people to the museum.
The rules admit of no exceptions.
cn: 她拒绝承认错误。
这张票允许两人进入博物馆。
这些规则不容许任何例外。

definitions.definition: 青少年（指13至19岁之间的人）

en: Adolescents often experience rapid physical changes.
Her adolescent curiosity led her to explore diverse fields.
The book addresses common struggles of adolescent mental health.
cn: 青少年常经历身体的快速变化。
她青春期的好奇心驱使她探索不同领域。
这本书探讨青少年心理健康的常见问题。

en: They decided to adopt a child from overseas.
The company plans to adopt new AI technologies.
The committee adopted the proposal unanimously.
cn: 他们决定从海外收养一个孩子。
该公司计划采用新的人工智能技术。
委员会一致通过了该提案。

en: She adores her grandfather and visits him every weekend.
The little girl adores chocolate and would eat it every day if allowed.
Fans adore the singer for her authenticity and powerful voice.
cn: 她非常敬爱祖父，每周都去看望他。
小女孩酷爱巧克力，如果允许的话她每天都会吃。
歌迷因这位歌手的真实与有力嗓音而崇拜她。

en: Her fluency in three languages gave her an advantage in the job interview.
The team took full advantage of their opponent's weak defense.
He missed three match points but finally won on his fourth advantage.
cn: 她在求职面试中因精通三种语言而占据优势。
该队充分利用了对手薄弱的防守。
他浪费了三个赛点，最终在第四个局点时获胜。

en: The expedition faced adverse weather conditions.
His adverse reaction to the medicine surprised the doctor.
The policy had an adverse impact on small businesses.
cn: 探险队遭遇了恶劣天气。
他对药物的不良反应让医生感到意外。
该政策对小企业产生了负面影响。

en: She advocates for environmental protection.
He works as a human rights advocate.
The lawyer advocated the client’s innocence.
cn: 她倡导环境保护。
他是一名人权倡导者。
律师为当事人的清白辩护。

en: The aerial view of the city was breathtaking.
She adjusted the TV aerial to get a better signal.
Aerial roots help some plants absorb moisture from the air.
cn: 这座城市鸟瞰景象令人叹为观止。
她调整了电视天线以获得更好的信号。
气生根帮助某些植物从空气中吸收水分。

definitions.definition: 美学的；审美的；具有艺术美感的

en: The design prioritizes aesthetic appeal over functionality.
Her aesthetic is influenced by minimalist architecture.
The film’s aesthetic combines surrealism and realism.
cn: 设计优先考虑美学吸引力而非功能性。
她的审美观受极简主义建筑影响。
这部电影的美学融合了超现实主义与现实主义。

definitions.definition: 喜爱，感情（对人或物的温柔情感）
疾病，病状（古义或医学语境）

en: She has a deep affection for her childhood home.
His affection was evident in the small gifts he gave.
The patient showed signs of pulmonary affection.
cn: 她对童年故居怀有深厚的感情。
他赠送的小礼物显露出他的爱意。
患者表现出肺部病变的迹象。

en: The university is affiliated with several research institutes.
She works as an affiliate marketer for global brands.
The two companies decided to affiliate to expand their market share.
cn: 这所大学与多家研究机构有隶属关系。
她为国际品牌从事联盟营销工作。
两家公司决定联合以扩大市场份额。

en: She affirmed her commitment to the project.
The witness affirmed the accuracy of his statement in court.
The data affirms our hypothesis.
cn: 她确认了对该项目的承诺。
证人在法庭上宣誓声明其证词准确。
数据证实了我们的假设。

en: The region is afflicted by drought every summer.
She was afflicted with guilt after the accident.
Diseases that afflict the elderly require specialized care.
cn: 该地区每年夏季都遭受干旱的折磨。
事故后她深陷内疚的痛苦中。
折磨老年人的疾病需要专业护理。

en: The aggregate score of the team was impressive.
We need to aggregate data from multiple sources.
Sand is an aggregate of small rock particles.
cn: 球队的总分令人印象深刻。
我们需要汇总来自多个来源的数据。
沙子是小岩石颗粒的集合体。

en: His aggressive attitude often leads to conflicts.
She took an aggressive approach to solving the problem.
The company launched an aggressive marketing campaign.
cn: 他好斗的态度常引发冲突。
她以积极主动的方式解决问题。
公司发起了一场强势的营销活动。

definitions.definition: 极度痛苦（身体或精神上的）

en: She screamed in agony as the pain overwhelmed her.
The team endured the agony of defeat in the final match.
His face reflected the agony of making an impossible choice.
cn: 痛苦席卷全身时，她发出了撕心裂肺的尖叫。
队伍在决赛中承受了失败的煎熬。
他的脸上写满了做出艰难抉择的痛苦。

en: The weather was agreeable, with a gentle breeze and warm sunshine.
She found his proposal quite agreeable and nodded in approval.
The hotel staff were always agreeable to special requests.
cn: 天气宜人，微风和煦，阳光温暖。
她觉得他的提议很令人满意，点头表示同意。
酒店员工总是乐于接受特殊要求。

en: The nurse rushed to aid the injured man.
Visual aids can enhance classroom learning.
Developed countries often provide aid to poorer nations.
cn: 护士急忙救助那名受伤的男子。
视觉教具能提升课堂学习效果。
发达国家常向较贫穷国家提供援助。

en: The bride walked down the aisle gracefully.
You'll find canned goods in aisle 5.
He sat by the aisle for easy access.
cn: 新娘优雅地走过教堂通道。
罐装食品在5号过道。
他坐在靠过道的位置以便进出。

en: The fire alarm woke everyone at midnight.
She felt a sudden alarm when the lights went out.
The government alarmed the public with the new virus data.
cn: 火灾警报在午夜惊醒了所有人。
灯光熄灭时，她突然感到一阵惊慌。
政府公布的新病毒数据引发了公众恐慌。

definitions.definition: 专辑（音乐、照片等的集合）

en: She bought the band's new album on vinyl.
The photo album was filled with memories of their trip.
Ancient Romans used albums to display public notices.
cn: 她买了这支乐队新发行的黑胶唱片专辑。
相册里装满了他们旅行的回忆。
古罗马人用白板公示公告。

en: The doctor advised him to avoid alcohol completely.
This sanitizer contains 70% isopropyl alcohol.
Ancient Egyptians used alcohol as a solvent for perfumes.
cn: 医生建议他彻底戒酒。
这款消毒剂含70%异丙醇。
古埃及人用酒精作为香水的溶剂。

en: The guard remained alert throughout the night.
A weather alert was issued for the coastal area.
The teacher alerted the students to the upcoming exam.
cn: 守卫整夜保持警觉。
沿海地区发布了天气警报。
老师提醒学生注意即将到来的考试。

en: The scientist claimed to have evidence of alien life.
She felt alien in a culture so different from her own.
The law restricts land ownership by alien corporations.
cn: 科学家声称掌握了外星生命存在的证据。
在截然不同的文化中，她感到格格不入。
该法律限制外资公司拥有土地。

en: His constant criticism began to alienate his colleagues.
The government alienated public land to private developers.
Social media can alienate people from real-life interactions.
cn: 他的不断批评开始让同事们疏远他。
政府将公有土地转让给私人开发商。
社交媒体可能让人脱离现实生活中的互动。

en: The prosecution alleges that the defendant stole the documents.
She alleges racial discrimination in her workplace.
The article alleges corruption without providing concrete proof.
cn: 控方指控被告窃取了文件。
她声称在工作场所遭受种族歧视。
文章断言存在腐败，但未提供具体证据。

en: The medicine helped to alleviate her chronic pain.
Planting trees can alleviate air pollution in urban areas.
His humorous remarks alleviated the tension in the room.
cn: 药物帮助缓解了她的慢性疼痛。
植树可以减轻城市地区的空气污染。
他的幽默发言缓和了房间里的紧张气氛。

definitions.definition: 联盟，联合（国家、组织或个人的合作关系）
联姻（通过婚姻结成的联盟）

en: The two companies formed an alliance to develop new technology.
Their alliance was strengthened by mutual economic interests.
The medieval alliance between the kingdoms lasted for decades.
cn: 两家公司结成联盟以开发新技术。
共同经济利益巩固了他们的联盟。
这些王国之间的中世纪联盟持续了数十年。

en: The manager will allocate tasks based on employees' skills.
Funds were allocated to rebuild the community center.
The system automatically allocates memory for new programs.
cn: 经理将根据员工技能分配任务。
资金被划拨用于重建社区中心。
系统自动为新程序分配内存。

definitions.definition: 合金（两种或多种金属的混合物）
将（金属）熔合成合金；掺杂（以改变性质）

en: Brass is an alloy of copper and zinc.
The gold was alloyed with silver to increase its hardness.
His happiness was alloyed with a hint of sadness.
cn: 黄铜是铜和锌的合金。
黄金中掺入银以提高硬度。
他的快乐中掺杂着一丝忧伤。

en: The tailor altered the dress to fit her perfectly.
His perspective altered after traveling abroad.
The software allows users to alter the settings easily.
cn: 裁缝修改了裙子，使其完全合身。
出国旅行后，他的观点发生了变化。
该软件允许用户轻松调整设置。

en: The experiment requires alternate days of fasting and eating.
She alternates between joy and sadness when recalling the past.
The stripes alternate in color between black and white.
cn: 实验需要禁食日和进食日交替进行。
回忆往事时，她在喜悦与悲伤间反复切换。
条纹的颜色黑白相间。

definitions.definition: 可供选择的事物；替代方案

en: We need to find an alternative route due to the road closure.
She prefers alternative medicine like acupuncture.
The company is exploring alternatives to plastic packaging.
cn: 因道路封闭，我们需要另寻一条路线。
她更青睐针灸等替代疗法。
该公司正在探索塑料包装的替代方案。

definitions.definition: 不明确的；有多种解释的

en: His reply was ambiguous, leaving us unsure of his true intentions.
The law’s wording is deliberately ambiguous to allow flexibility.
The ending of the movie is ambiguous, open to multiple interpretations.
cn: 他的回答模棱两可，让我们无法确定他的真实意图。
法律的措辞刻意含糊，以保留灵活性。
电影的结局是开放式的，允许多种解读。

definitions.definition: 雄心，抱负（强烈的成功欲望）

en: Her ambition to become a scientist drove her to study day and night.
The project fulfilled his lifelong ambition.
Without ambition, one’s potential remains dormant.
cn: 她成为科学家的抱负驱使她日夜学习。
这个项目实现了他毕生的追求。
没有雄心，人的潜力将永远沉睡。

definitions.definition: 费力的；要求高的（如 ambitious project）

en: She has an ambitious plan to revolutionize the industry.
The novel’s ambitious scope covers three generations of a family.
Critics called the project overly ambitious but admired its vision.
cn: 她有一个雄心勃勃的计划，要彻底改革这个行业。
这部小说宏大的叙事跨度涵盖了一个家族的三代人。
批评者认为该项目过于好高骛远，但仍赞赏其远见。

en: The committee voted to amend the proposal.
He promised to amend his behavior after the incident.
The constitution was amended to protect civil rights.
cn: 委员会投票修改提案。
他承诺在事件后改正自己的行为。
宪法经过修正以保障公民权利。

definitions.definition: （辩论或冲突中可用的）论据、材料

en: The soldiers ran out of ammunition during the battle.
She gathered scientific data as ammunition for her debate.
The factory produces ammunition for military use.
cn: 士兵们在战斗中耗尽了弹药。
她收集科学数据作为辩论的“弹药”。
这家工厂生产军用弹药。

definitions.definition: 放大（声音、信号等）；增强（效果或情感）

en: The microphone can amplify even the faintest sounds.
She used statistics to amplify her argument.
The writer amplified the short story into a novel.
cn: 这台麦克风能放大最微弱的声音。
她用统计数据来增强论点的说服力。
作者将短篇故事扩展成了一部长篇小说。

en: She drew an analogy between the human heart and a pump.
The teacher used a chess analogy to explain strategic thinking.
Analogies are powerful tools in scientific communication.
cn: 她将人类心脏比作泵。
老师用国际象棋作类比来解释战略思维。
类比是科学传播中的有力工具。

en: Scientists analyse the data to find patterns.
The teacher asked us to analyse the poem line by line.
This tool helps analyse complex financial reports.
cn: 科学家分析数据以寻找规律。
老师让我们逐行分析这首诗。
这个工具用于解析复杂的财务报告。

definitions.definition: 分析（对事物的组成部分进行系统性研究）
解析（数学或逻辑中的分解过程）

en: The lab conducted a detailed analysis of the water samples.
His analysis of the poem revealed hidden metaphors.
In mathematics, Fourier analysis breaks down complex waves into simpler components.
cn: 实验室对水样进行了详细分析。
他对这首诗的分析揭示了隐含的隐喻。
数学中，傅里叶分析将复杂波形分解为更简单的成分。

definitions.definition: （动植物）原种；（机器、思想等的）原型

en: My ancestors came from a small village in Ireland.
This fossil may be the ancestor of modern birds.
The invention is considered the ancestor of all smartphones.
cn: 我的祖先来自爱尔兰的一个小村庄。
这块化石可能是现代鸟类的祖先。
这项发明被视为所有智能手机的原型。

definitions.definition: 古代人（尤指古埃及/希腊/罗马人）

en: The archaeologists discovered an ancient temple buried under the sand.
In ancient times, people believed the Earth was flat.
This manuscript contains wisdom from the ancients.
cn: 考古学家发现了一座埋在沙下的古老神庙。
在古代，人们认为地球是平的。
这份手稿记载了古人的智慧。

en: The constant noise began to annoy the neighbors.
Don’t annoy the bees or they might sting you.
His habit of interrupting people is truly annoying.
cn: 持续的噪音开始惹恼邻居。
别招惹蜜蜂，否则它们可能蜇你。
他打断别人的习惯实在令人厌烦。

en: The company holds an annual meeting to review its performance.
She subscribes to a gardening annual for plant care tips.
The festival is an annual event that attracts thousands of visitors.
cn: 公司每年召开会议回顾业绩。
她订阅了一本园艺年刊以获取植物养护建议。
这个节日是一年一度的活动，吸引了数千名游客。

en: The author chose to remain anonymous.
An anonymous donor funded the entire project.
The message came from an anonymous email address.
cn: 这位作者选择保持匿名。
一位匿名捐助者资助了整个项目。
这条信息来自一个匿名邮箱地址。

en: The team tried to anticipate potential problems before launching the project.
She anticipated his request by preparing the documents in advance.
Economists anticipate a rise in inflation next year.
cn: 团队在启动项目前试图预判潜在问题。
她提前准备好文件，预见到了他的需求。
经济学家预计明年通胀会上升。

definitions.definition: 焦虑，忧虑（强烈的紧张或不安情绪）
渴望，热望（古义，现代较少用）

en: Her anxiety about the exam kept her awake all night.
The uncertainty of the future filled him with quiet anxiety.
In medieval texts, "anxiety" sometimes referred to a longing for divine connection.
cn: 她对考试的焦虑让她整夜未眠。
未来的不确定性让他陷入无声的忧虑。
在中世纪文献中，“anxiety”偶指对神性联结的渴慕。

en: She rents a small apartment downtown.
The apartment has a beautiful view of the park.
They converted the old house into three apartments.
cn: 她在市中心租了一间小公寓。
这套公寓能俯瞰公园的美景。
他们将老房子改造成三套公寓。

definitions.definition: 道歉；正式的辩解或辩护

en: She made a sincere apology for her mistake.
His speech was an apology for free speech.
The company issued a public apology after the scandal.
cn: 她为她的错误真诚道歉。
他的演讲是对言论自由的辩护。
丑闻发生后，公司发表了公开致歉。

definitions.definition: 器械，设备（指用于特定目的的复杂工具或机器）
机构，组织（尤指政府或官僚体系中的）

en: The laboratory purchased new apparatus for DNA analysis.
The state apparatus responded slowly to the crisis.
The firefighter’s breathing apparatus saved his life.
cn: 实验室购置了新的DNA分析设备。
国家机构对危机的反应迟缓。
消防员的呼吸装置救了他的命。

en: The charity made an appeal for donations.
She decided to appeal the court’s decision.
His idea has great appeal to young audiences.
cn: 该慈善机构呼吁捐款。
她决定对法庭判决提出上诉。
他的想法对年轻观众很有吸引力。

en: Her elegant appearance caught everyone's attention.
The sudden appearance of the sun lifted our spirits.
He made a brief appearance at the party before leaving.
cn: 她优雅的外表吸引了所有人的注意。
太阳的突然出现振奋了我们的精神。
他在派对上短暂露面后就离开了。

en: The government tried to appease the protesters by promising reforms.
A small snack may appease your hunger temporarily.
His apology did little to appease her anger.
cn: 政府承诺改革以安抚抗议者。
少量零食可暂时缓解饥饿感。
他的道歉几乎未能平息她的怒火。

en: The book includes an appendix with detailed references.
He had to undergo surgery to remove his inflamed appendix.
Check the appendix for additional data tables.
cn: 这本书附有详细参考文献的附录。
他不得不接受手术切除发炎的阑尾。
查看附录中的附加数据表。

en: The audience applauded wildly after the performance.
Critics applauded the film for its innovative storytelling.
We should applaud efforts to protect the environment.
cn: 演出结束后，观众热烈鼓掌。
评论家称赞这部电影叙事创新。
我们应赞许保护环境的努力。

definitions.definition: 器具，装置（尤指家用电器）
应用，适用（古义，现较少用）

en: The store sells a wide range of kitchen appliances, from blenders to microwaves.
Modern medical appliances have significantly improved patient care.
The appliance of this theory requires careful consideration.
cn: 这家商店出售各种厨房电器，从搅拌机到微波炉。
现代医疗设备极大地改善了患者护理。
这一理论的应用需要仔细考量。（古义例句）

en: She submitted an application for the scholarship.
This technology has practical applications in medicine.
The application of the ointment should be gentle.
cn: 她提交了奖学金申请。
该技术在医学上有实际应用。
涂抹药膏时应轻柔。

en: She applied sunscreen before going to the beach.
This law applies to all citizens equally.
He applied for a scholarship at Harvard.
cn: 她去海滩前涂抹了防晒霜。
这项法律平等适用于所有公民。
他申请了哈佛大学的奖学金。

definitions.definition: 评估，估价（尤指对价值或质量的正式评定）

en: The bank requires an appraisal of the property before approving the loan.
Her annual performance appraisal highlighted exceptional leadership skills.
The antique dealer’s appraisal confirmed the vase was a Ming dynasty original.
cn: 银行要求对房产进行评估后才批准贷款。
她的年度绩效评估突出了卓越的领导能力。
古董商的鉴定证实这只花瓶是明代真品。

en: The plane is now approaching the runway.
We need a new approach to solve this problem.
She approached the topic with caution.
cn: 飞机正在接近跑道。
我们需要新方法来解决这个问题。
她谨慎地着手处理这一话题。

en: The teacher used appropriate examples to explain the concept.
The government appropriated funds for the new hospital.
His casual clothes were not appropriate for the formal event.
cn: 老师用恰当的例子解释了这个概念。
政府为新建医院拨出了专项资金。
他的休闲着装不适合这场正式活动。

definitions.definition: 赞成（常与 of 连用）

en: The committee approved the new policy unanimously.
She doesn’t approve of his lifestyle.
The FDA approved the drug after rigorous testing.
cn: 委员会一致通过了新政策。
她不认同他的生活方式。
美国食品药品监督管理局在严格测试后批准了该药物。

en: Her reply was apt and witty.
He's apt at picking up new languages.
Old pipes are apt to leak.
cn: 她的回答既恰当又机智。
他擅长快速掌握新语言。
老旧的管道容易漏水。

en: The decision seemed completely arbitrary.
Arbitrary rules often frustrate creativity.
The king exercised arbitrary power over his subjects.
cn: 这一决定显得完全武断。
专断的规则常扼杀创造力。
国王对臣民行使专制权力。

en: The rainbow formed a perfect arc across the sky.
The electric current arced between the two wires.
She traced the arc of the pendulum with her eyes.
cn: 彩虹在天空中划出一道完美的弧线。
电流在两条电线之间形成了电弧。
她的目光追随着钟摆的弧形轨迹。

definitions.definition: 竞技场；活动场所；舞台（比喻）

en: The gladiators fought bravely in the ancient arena.
She entered the political arena with a bold reform plan.
The concert turned the stadium into a vibrant musical arena.
cn: 角斗士们在古老的竞技场中英勇搏斗。
她带着大胆的改革计划踏入政治舞台。
这场演唱会将体育场变成了充满活力的音乐殿堂。

en: They often argue about politics.
The lawyer argued the case persuasively.
She argued that the policy was unfair.
cn: 他们经常争论政治问题。
律师有力地论证了案件。
她主张该政策不公平。

en: The knight's armor clanked as he walked.
The vehicle is armored to withstand explosions.
Her confidence acts as an armor against criticism.
cn: 骑士行走时盔甲铿锵作响。
这辆车配有防爆装甲。
她的自信像盔甲一样抵御批评。

en: The speech aroused strong emotions in the audience.
The smell of coffee aroused him from his deep sleep.
Her research aroused interest in environmental issues.
cn: 演讲激起了听众强烈的情绪。
咖啡的气味将他从沉睡中唤醒。
她的研究引发了人们对环境问题的关注。

en: She helped arrange the flowers for the wedding.
We need to arrange a meeting to discuss the project.
The books are arranged alphabetically by author.
cn: 她帮忙为婚礼布置花束。
我们需要安排一次会议讨论这个项目。
这些书按作者姓氏字母顺序排列。

en: The flower arrangement on the table was exquisite.
This piano arrangement of the symphony is innovative.
They reached a mutual arrangement about the schedule.
cn: 桌上的插花布置非常精美。
这首交响曲的钢琴改编版很有创新性。
他们就日程达成了共同协议。

en: The soldiers were arrayed in perfect formation.
She wore an array of colorful bracelets.
The store offers a vast array of electronic gadgets.
cn: 士兵们以完美的队形排列。
她戴着一串色彩斑斓的手镯。
这家商店提供种类繁多的电子设备。

en: The police arrested the suspect near the train station.
The bright colors of the painting arrested my attention immediately.
The new drug may arrest the progression of the disease.
cn: 警方在火车站附近逮捕了嫌疑人。
画作鲜艳的色彩立刻吸引了我的注意。
这种新药可能阻止病情恶化。

en: His arrogant tone made the audience uncomfortable.
She dismissed the idea with an arrogant wave of her hand.
Arrogant people often overestimate their abilities.
cn: 他傲慢的语气让听众感到不适。
她傲慢地挥挥手驳回了这个想法。
自大的人往往高估自己的能力。

definitions.definition: 干线，主干道（比喻交通或系统的核心通道）

en: The coronary artery supplies blood to the heart muscle.
The river acts as an artery for trade in the region.
Blockage in a brain artery can cause a stroke.
cn: 冠状动脉为心肌供血。
这条河是该地区贸易的运输干线。
脑动脉阻塞可能引发中风。

definitions.definition: 表达清晰的；能说会道的
清晰地表达；用关节连接

en: She is highly articulate in debates.
The robot’s arms articulate at multiple points.
He struggled to articulate his emotions.
cn: 她在辩论中表达非常清晰。
机器人的手臂在多个关节处连接。
他难以清晰地表达自己的情感。

en: The garden was decorated with artificial flowers.
Her smile seemed artificial during the interview.
Scientists developed artificial intelligence to solve complex problems.
cn: 花园里装饰着人造花。
面试时她的笑容显得很勉强。
科学家开发人工智能以解决复杂问题。

en: The artillery fired dozens of rounds at dawn.
Modern artillery requires precise coordination.
The museum displays medieval artillery pieces.
cn: 炮兵部队在黎明时分发射了数十发炮弹。
现代炮术需要精确的协同作战。
博物馆展出了中世纪的火炮。

en: The path ascends steeply to the mountain summit.
She watched the smoke ascend into the sky.
Historians ascend the origins of this tradition to the 12th century.
cn: 小路陡峭地通向山顶。
她看着烟雾升向天空。
历史学家将这一传统的起源追溯至12世纪。

en: The detective worked hard to ascertain the truth.
We need to ascertain whether the data is accurate.
The study aims to ascertain the effects of climate change.
cn: 侦探努力查明了真相。
我们需要确定数据是否准确。
该研究旨在确定气候变化的影响。

en: Historians often ascribe the fall of Rome to internal corruption.
She ascribed her success to hard work and luck.
The poem was wrongly ascribed to an unknown medieval author.
cn: 历史学家常将罗马的衰落归因于内部腐败。
她将自己的成功归因于努力和运气。
这首诗被错误地归于一位不知名的中世纪作者。

en: We must consider every aspect of the problem before making a decision.
The building has a southern aspect, so it gets plenty of sunlight.
In Russian, verbs have both tense and aspect.
cn: 在做出决定前，我们必须考虑问题的每个方面。
这栋建筑朝南，因此阳光充足。
俄语中，动词兼具时态和体。

definitions.definition: 渴望；抱负（强烈追求的目标）

en: Her aspiration to become a doctor motivated her to study hard.
The patient’s aspiration was monitored during surgery.
His lifelong aspiration was to promote peace in the region.
cn: 她成为医生的抱负激励她努力学习。
手术中监测了患者的吸气情况。
他毕生的愿望是推动该地区的和平。

definitions.definition: 暗杀，刺杀（尤指针对政治或公众人物的蓄意谋杀）

en: The assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand triggered World War I.
The novel depicts a fictional assassination attempt on the president.
Modern security systems make political assassinations increasingly rare.
cn: 斐迪南大公遇刺事件引发了第一次世界大战。
这部小说虚构了一起针对总统的暗杀阴谋。
现代安保系统使政治暗杀事件日益减少。

en: The soldiers launched a surprise assault at dawn.
He was arrested for assaulting a police officer.
Verbal assault can be as harmful as physical violence.
cn: 士兵们在黎明时分发动了突袭。
他因袭击警察被捕。
言语攻击可能与肢体暴力同样有害。

en: The workers will assemble the car parts on the production line.
Protesters began to assemble in the square at dawn.
This bookshelf is easy to assemble with the included tools.
cn: 工人们将在生产线上组装汽车零件。
抗议者于黎明时分开始在广场聚集。
这个书架用附带的工具很容易组装。

definitions.definition: 断言，坚称（以自信或权威的方式陈述）

en: She asserted her innocence throughout the trial.
The government must assert its authority in times of crisis.
He asserted that the theory was fundamentally flawed.
cn: 她在审判中始终坚称自己无罪。
政府必须在危机时刻维护其权威。
他断言该理论存在根本性缺陷。

en: The committee will assess the impact of the new policy.
The house was assessed at $500,000 for tax purposes.
Teachers need to assess students' progress regularly.
cn: 委员会将评估新政策的影响。
这栋房子因税务目的被核定为50万美元。
教师需定期评估学生的进步情况。

definitions.definition: 资产；财产（有价值的事物）
优点；有利条件（抽象价值）

en: The company's biggest asset is its innovative team.
Patience is an invaluable asset in negotiations.
They liquidated assets to pay off the debt.
cn: 这家公司最大的资产是其创新团队。
耐心是谈判中的无价优势。
他们变卖资产以偿还债务。

en: The teacher will assign homework every Friday.
They assigned a new project manager to the team.
The contract assigns all intellectual property rights to the company.
cn: 老师每周五都会布置作业。
他们为团队指派了一位新项目经理。
合同将所有知识产权转让给公司。

definitions.definition: 任务；作业（分配的工作或学习任务）

en: The teacher gave us a challenging math assignment.
His assignment to the Paris office surprised everyone.
Completing the assignment on time requires good planning.
cn: 老师布置了一份有难度的数学作业。
他被派往巴黎分公司的决定让所有人惊讶。
按时完成任务需要良好的规划。

en: Children assimilate new languages faster than adults.
The community gradually assimilated the immigrants.
Some cultures resist being assimilated into mainstream society.
cn: 儿童比成人更快掌握新语言。
这个社区逐渐接纳了移民。
某些文化抗拒被主流社会同化。

en: She offered her assistance to the elderly man crossing the street.
Technical assistance is available 24/7 for registered users.
The project was completed with the assistance of local volunteers.
cn: 她主动帮助那位过马路的老人。
注册用户可全天候获得技术支援。
该项目在当地志愿者的协助下完成。

en: She chose to associate with positive-minded people.
He is an associate professor at the university.
The study found a strong association between sleep and memory.
cn: 她选择与积极向上的人交往。
他是这所大学的副教授。
研究发现睡眠与记忆力之间存在强关联。

en: She joined the local business association to expand her network.
There is a strong association between smoking and lung cancer.
The smell of lavender evokes happy childhood associations for me.
cn: 她加入了本地商业协会以拓展人脉。
吸烟与肺癌之间存在强关联。
薰衣草的气味唤起我童年的美好联想。

en: Don't assume everyone agrees with you.
She will assume the role of CEO next month.
The situation assumed a dangerous turn.
cn: 不要假设所有人都同意你。
她下个月将担任CEO一职。
局势呈现出危险的转折。

definitions.definition: （权力或责任的）承担；（身份的）取得

en: The theory is based on a false assumption.
Her assumption of the CEO role surprised everyone.
We cannot make assumptions without evidence.
cn: 该理论基于一个错误的假设。
她接任CEO一职令所有人意外。
我们不能无证据地妄下结论。

definitions.definition: 保证；确信（正式承诺或信心）

en: The company gave written assurance of product safety.
She answered the questions with calm assurance.
His assurance of support eased their worries.
cn: 该公司出具了产品安全的书面保证。
她沉着自信地回答了问题。
他承诺支持，缓解了他们的忧虑。

definitions.definition: 确保，保证（某事必然发生或属实）
使某人确信，向某人保证（后接人称宾语）

en: The contract assures timely delivery of the goods.
She assured me that the data was accurate.
Regular maintenance assures the machine's longevity.
cn: 合同确保货物按时交付。
她向我保证数据是准确的。
定期维护能保证机器的使用寿命。

definitions.definition: 运动员；体育家（尤指参加竞技比赛的人）

en: She trained for years to become an Olympic athlete.
The athlete broke the world record in the 100-meter dash.
Professional athletes need to maintain peak physical condition.
cn: 她训练多年，成为奥运会运动员。
这位运动员打破了100米短跑的世界纪录。
职业运动员需保持巅峰体能状态。

definitions.definition: （希腊神话）阿特拉斯（擎天巨人）

en: The library has a rare 17th-century atlas of the Mediterranean.
The atlas vertebra supports the skull's movement.
In Greek mythology, Atlas was condemned to hold up the heavens.
cn: 图书馆藏有一本17世纪的地中海珍本地图集。
寰椎支撑着头骨的转动。
希腊神话中，阿特拉斯被罚永远擎起天空。

en: The rocket entered the Earth's atmosphere at high speed.
The café has a cozy atmosphere with soft lighting.
The film creates an atmosphere of suspense from the beginning.
cn: 火箭以高速进入地球大气层。
这家咖啡馆灯光柔和，氛围舒适。
这部电影从一开始就营造出悬疑的基调。

en: Please attach the document to your email.
The spider attached its thread to the leaf.
She quickly attached herself to the new team.
cn: 请将文件附在邮件中。
蜘蛛将丝固定在叶子上。
她迅速融入了新团队。

definitions.definition: 攻击；发作（如疾病、情绪等）

en: The army plans to attack at dawn.
His article attacks the government's new policy.
She suffered a sudden asthma attack.
cn: 军队计划在黎明时发动攻击。
他的文章猛烈抨击政府的新政策。
她突然哮喘发作。

en: She worked hard to attain fluency in Spanish.
The team aims to attain a 20% increase in sales this year.
True happiness is attained through self-acceptance.
cn: 她努力学习以达到西班牙语流利的水平。
团队计划今年实现销售额20%的增长。
真正的快乐是通过自我接纳获得的。

en: She made an attempt to solve the puzzle.
The climbers will attempt to reach the summit tomorrow.
His attempt at humor fell flat.
cn: 她尝试解开这个谜题。
登山者明天将尝试登顶。
他试图幽默，但效果不佳。

en: The flight attendant handed out drinks to passengers.
She works as a museum attendant, guiding visitors through exhibits.
High humidity is often attendant on tropical storms.
cn: 空乘人员向乘客分发饮料。
她是博物馆接待员，引导游客参观展品。
高湿度常伴随热带风暴出现。

en: Her positive attitude inspires everyone around her.
The statue captures the athlete's dynamic attitude.
Changing your attitude can change your life.
cn: 她积极的态度激励着身边的每个人。
雕像捕捉了运动员的动态姿势。
改变态度可以改变人生。

en: The bright colors of the flowers attract bees.
His speech attracted widespread criticism.
The museum uses interactive exhibits to attract young visitors.
cn: 花朵鲜艳的颜色吸引了蜜蜂。
他的演讲引发了广泛批评。
博物馆通过互动展品吸引年轻游客。

en: The city's vibrant culture makes it highly attractive to tourists.
She wore an attractive dress that caught everyone's attention.
The job offer included an attractive salary and benefits package.
cn: 这座城市充满活力的文化对游客极具吸引力。
她穿了一条引人注目的裙子，吸引了所有人的目光。
这份工作提供了诱人的薪资和福利待遇。

en: Patience is an essential attribute for a teacher.
She attributes her success to hard work and luck.
The sculpture is attributed to an unknown artist.
cn: 耐心是教师必备的特质。
她将成功归因于努力和运气。
这件雕塑被归于一位匿名艺术家之手。

en: The rare painting was sold at auction for a record price.
They decided to auction their antique collection to raise funds.
Online auctions have become increasingly popular in recent years.
cn: 这幅稀有画作在拍卖会上以创纪录的价格售出。
他们决定拍卖古董藏品以筹集资金。
近年来，网络拍卖日益流行。

en: The audience applauded loudly after the performance.
The president granted an audience to the foreign diplomats.
Her speech captivated the entire audience.
cn: 演出结束后，观众热烈鼓掌。
总统接见了外国外交官。
她的演讲吸引了全场听众。

en: The museum confirmed the painting was an authentic Van Gogh.
Her authentic personality made her instantly likable.
This recipe uses authentic Italian ingredients.
cn: 博物馆确认这幅画是梵高的真迹。
她真诚的个性让人一见如故。
这道食谱采用了正宗的意大利食材。

en: J.K. Rowling is the author of the Harry Potter series.
The report was authored by a team of scientists.
As an author, she draws inspiration from everyday life.
cn: J.K.罗琳是《哈利·波特》系列的作者。
这份报告由一组科学家撰写。
作为一名作家，她从日常生活中汲取灵感。

en: The book provides authoritative guidance on marine biology.
Her authoritative tone left no room for argument.
The study was published in an authoritative journal.
cn: 这本书提供了关于海洋生物学的权威指导。
她专断的语气不容争辩。
该研究发表在权威期刊上。

en: The government has the authority to enforce laws.
She is a leading authority on climate change.
Local authorities are responsible for public sanitation.
cn: 政府有权执行法律。
她是气候变化领域的权威专家。
地方当局负责公共卫生。

en: The manager will authorize the payment once the project is completed.
Only the president can authorize the use of military force.
This document authorizes you to access confidential files.
cn: 项目完成后，经理将批准付款。
只有总统有权授权使用军事力量。
此文件授权您查阅机密档案。

en: The region became an autonomous province in 1987.
The robot operates as an autonomous unit.
Autonomous vehicles rely on advanced sensors.
cn: 该地区于1987年成为自治省。
该机器人作为独立单元运行。
自动驾驶汽车依赖先进传感器。

definitions.definition: （哲学/生物学）自发性，自我调节能力

en: The region fought for autonomy from central government control.
Children need gradual autonomy to develop decision-making skills.
The robot's autonomy allows it to adapt to unexpected obstacles.
cn: 该地区为脱离中央政府控制争取自治权。
儿童需要逐步的自主权以培养决策能力。
机器人的自主性使其能适应意外障碍。

en: No amount of effort could avail against the storm.
She availed herself of every opportunity to learn.
His advice was of little avail in the crisis.
cn: 任何努力都无法抵御这场风暴。
她利用一切机会学习。
他的建议在危机中收效甚微。

en: The report is available for download on our website.
Are you available for a meeting tomorrow afternoon?
Fresh strawberries are only available in summer.
cn: 这份报告可在我们网站上下载。
你明天下午有空开会吗？
新鲜草莓仅在夏季供应。

en: She averted her eyes from the gruesome scene.
The quick response averted a potential disaster.
He tried to avert suspicion by acting normally.
cn: 她移开视线，不去看那可怕的场景。
快速反应避免了一场潜在的灾难。
他试图通过正常举止来避开怀疑。

en: The Wright brothers made history with their contributions to aviation.
Modern aviation relies heavily on advanced technology.
She pursued a career in aviation to fulfill her dream of flying.
cn: 莱特兄弟以他们对航空的贡献载入史册。
现代航空高度依赖先进技术。
她投身航空业以实现飞行梦想。

en: She swerved to avoid hitting the deer.
The contract was declared void to avoid legal disputes.
He wears sunglasses to avoid direct sunlight.
cn: 她急转方向盘以避免撞到鹿。
合同被宣布无效以避免法律纠纷。
他戴太阳镜以避免阳光直射。

en: She won an award for her scientific research.
The court awarded damages to the victim.
The Nobel Prize is the highest award in many fields.
cn: 她因科学研究获奖。
法院判定赔偿受害者。
诺贝尔奖是许多领域的最高荣誉。

definitions.definition: 有…意识的（如环保意识的 "environmentally aware"）

en: She became aware of a faint humming sound.
The campaign aims to make people more environmentally aware.
He was acutely aware of the risks involved.
cn: 她注意到一阵微弱的嗡嗡声。
该活动旨在提升人们的环保意识。
他敏锐地意识到了其中的风险。

en: He felt awkward at the formal dinner.
The handle is awkward to grip.
She gave an awkward apology.
cn: 他在正式晚宴上感到局促不安。
这个把手很难握持。
她尴尬地道歉。

definitions.definition: 轴；轴线（数学、物理中的中心线或旋转线）
坐标轴（图表中的参考线）
联盟，轴心（政治或军事联盟，如二战中的轴心国）

en: The Earth rotates on its axis every 24 hours.
The x-axis and y-axis intersect at the origin.
Germany, Italy, and Japan formed the Axis powers during WWII.
cn: 地球每24小时绕地轴旋转一周。
x轴与y轴在原点相交。
德国、意大利和日本在二战期间组成轴心国。

definitions.definition: 背景（指环境、经历或幕后情况）

en: The mountains form a beautiful background to the village.
She has a background in computer science.
The negotiations took place against a background of political tension.
cn: 群山为村庄构成了美丽的背景。
她有计算机科学的专业背景。
谈判在政治紧张的氛围下进行。

definitions.definition: 细菌（复数形式，单数为 bacterium）

en: Some bacteria are beneficial to human digestion.
The lab is studying antibiotic-resistant bacteria.
Bacteria multiply rapidly in warm environments.
cn: 某些细菌对人类消化有益。
实验室正在研究抗药性细菌。
细菌在温暖环境中快速繁殖。

definitions.definition: 芭蕾舞（一种古典舞蹈形式）

en: She has trained in ballet since childhood.
The Nutcracker is a famous Christmas ballet.
The ballet company will tour Europe next year.
cn: 她从小接受芭蕾舞训练。
《胡桃夹子》是一部著名的圣诞芭蕾舞剧。
该芭蕾舞团明年将赴欧洲巡演。

definitions.definition: 竹子（一种高大的禾本科植物，茎干中空，常用于建筑或制作器具）

en: The panda feeds mainly on bamboo.
Bamboo grows rapidly in tropical climates.
They built a bridge using bamboo poles.
cn: 大熊猫主要以竹子为食。
竹子在热带气候中生长迅速。
他们用竹竿搭建了一座桥。

en: She tied her hair with a rubber band.
The band played their new single at the concert.
They banded together to protest the new law.
cn: 她用橡皮筋扎起头发。
乐队在音乐会上演奏了新单曲。
他们联合起来抗议新法规。

definitions.definition: 绷带（用于包扎伤口的材料）

en: She wrapped the bandage tightly around his wounded arm.
The nurse taught me how to bandage a sprained ankle properly.
Keep the bandage dry to avoid infection.
cn: 她将绷带紧紧缠在他受伤的手臂上。
护士教我如何正确包扎扭伤的脚踝。
保持绷带干燥以防感染。

en: The door shut with a loud bang.
She banged the table in anger.
Her straight bangs perfectly framed her face.
cn: 门砰的一声关上了。
她愤怒地猛拍桌子。
她的齐刘海完美修饰了脸型。

en: The royal banquet lasted until midnight.
They banqueted the winners with gourmet dishes.
A simple picnic turned into an impromptu banquet.
cn: 皇家宴会持续至午夜。
他们以美食盛宴款待获胜者。
一场野餐即兴变成了临时宴会。

en: She could barely hear the whisper over the noise.
He had barely enough money to buy a sandwich.
The sun had barely risen when they started working.
cn: 在嘈杂声中，她几乎听不见低语。
他的钱勉强够买一个三明治。
太阳刚升起，他们就开始工作了。

en: She found a real bargain at the flea market.
They bargained for hours over the price of the car.
The union made a bargain with management to avoid layoffs.
cn: 她在跳蚤市场淘到了真正的便宜货。
他们为这辆车的价格讨价还价了好几小时。
工会与管理层达成协议以避免裁员。

definitions.definition: 贫瘠的（土地）；不结果实的（植物）
无趣的；缺乏创意的（比喻义）

en: The barren desert stretched for miles without a single plant.
Her barren imagination failed to produce any original ideas.
After years of overuse, the soil became barren and unproductive.
cn: 贫瘠的沙漠绵延数英里，寸草不生。
她贫乏的想象力未能产生任何原创观点。
多年过度耕作后，土壤变得贫瘠而荒芜。

en: The protesters built a barricade across the road.
Soldiers barricaded the entrance to the palace.
The old door served as a makeshift barricade.
cn: 抗议者在路上筑起路障。
士兵封锁了宫殿入口。
旧门被临时用作障碍物。

en: The mountain acted as a natural barrier against invaders.
Language barriers can hinder effective communication.
They installed a barrier to control the crowd.
cn: 这座山脉曾是抵御入侵者的天然屏障。
语言障碍可能阻碍有效沟通。
他们设置了路障以控制人群。

en: Trust is the basis of any healthy relationship.
The research provided a solid basis for further experiments.
Payments are calculated on a weekly basis.
cn: 信任是任何健康关系的基础。
这项研究为后续实验提供了坚实依据。
款项按周计算支付。

definitions.definition: 一批，一组（相同事物或人）

en: The factory produced a batch of 500 toys.
She batch-cooked meals for the week.
The software processes data in batches.
cn: 工厂生产了500件玩具的一批货。
她批量烹饪了一周的饭菜。
该软件分批处理数据。

en: The waves battered the coast during the storm.
She mixed the batter for the pancakes.
The batter hit a home run in the ninth inning.
cn: 暴风雨中海浪猛烈拍打着海岸。
她搅拌了煎饼的面糊。
击球手在第九局打出了全垒打。

en: The wooden beam supports the roof of the old barn.
A beam of sunlight broke through the clouds.
Her face beamed with joy when she heard the news.
cn: 这根木梁支撑着旧谷仓的屋顶。
一束阳光穿透云层。
听到消息时，她脸上洋溢着喜悦。

en: She prepared the documents beforehand to save time.
If you study beforehand, the exam will feel easier.
His beforehand planning ensured the project’s success.
cn: 她事先准备好了文件以节省时间。
如果提前学习，考试会更轻松。
他事前的规划确保了项目成功。（古旧形容词用法）

en: The children behaved well during the ceremony.
She struggled to behave herself in front of the guests.
Materials behave differently under extreme temperatures.
cn: 孩子们在仪式上表现得很好。
她难以在客人面前保持得体举止。
材料在极端温度下会表现出不同特性。

definitions.definition: 行为，举止（个体或群体的表现方式）
（科学领域）特定条件下的反应模式

en: The teacher praised the child's polite behavior during the field trip.
Scientists observed the mating behavior of birds in their natural habitat.
Changes in consumer behavior often reflect broader economic trends.
cn: 老师表扬了孩子在实地考察中的礼貌举止。
科学家观察了鸟类在自然栖息地的交配行为。
消费者行为的变化常反映更广泛的经济趋势。

en: The baby kicked her belly playfully.
The ship's belly was filled with cargo.
He laughed so hard his belly ached.
cn: 宝宝顽皮地踢了她的肚子。
船的货舱装满了货物。
他笑得太厉害，肚子都疼了。

en: Regular exercise is beneficial to both physical and mental health.
The new policy has beneficial effects on small businesses.
As a beneficial owner, she receives dividends from the shares.
cn: 定期锻炼对身心健康都有益。
新政策对小企业产生了有利影响。
作为受益所有人，她获得了股份分红。

definitions.definition: 受益（常与 from/by 连用）

en: Regular exercise has many health benefits.
The new policy will benefit small businesses.
She benefited greatly from her mentor’s advice.
cn: 定期锻炼对健康大有裨益。
新政策将使小企业受益。
她从导师的建议中获益良多。

definitions.definition: 无意中暴露（秘密、情感等）

en: He felt betrayed when his friend shared his secret.
Her trembling voice betrayed her fear.
To betray one's country is the ultimate crime.
cn: 当朋友泄露他的秘密时，他感到被背叛了。
她颤抖的声音暴露了她的恐惧。
背叛祖国是最严重的罪行。

en: The complex instructions bewilder many new users.
She was bewildered by the sudden change of plans.
The maze of corridors in the old building would bewilder any visitor.
cn: 复杂的说明让许多新用户感到困惑。
计划的突然变动让她不知所措。
旧建筑里迷宫般的走廊会让任何访客迷失方向。

definitions.definition: 在…的另一边；超出（范围或限度）

en: The mountains lie beyond the river.
His generosity goes beyond our expectations.
She looked beyond, searching for answers.
cn: 群山坐落于河流的另一边。
他的慷慨超出了我们的预期。
她望向远方，寻找答案。

definitions.definition: 书目（书籍或文献的列表，通常包含出版信息）
文献学（研究书籍历史、版本的学科）

en: The professor asked us to include a bibliography at the end of our research paper.
Her work in bibliography revealed rare manuscripts from the 15th century.
Digital tools have revolutionized the way bibliographies are compiled today.
cn: 教授要求我们在研究论文末尾附上参考文献目录。
她的文献学研究发现了15世纪的罕见手稿。
数字工具彻底改变了当今书目的编纂方式。

definitions.definition: 传记（记录个人生平的书面作品）

en: The biography of Marie Curie reveals her struggles as a female scientist.
He spent years researching materials for his biography of Shakespeare.
A good biography balances factual accuracy with compelling storytelling.
cn: 居里夫人传记揭示了她作为女性科学家的奋斗历程。
他花费多年时间研究材料，撰写莎士比亚传记。
优秀的传记在事实准确性与叙事吸引力间取得平衡。

en: The artist's bizarre paintings left the audience both confused and fascinated.
She wore a bizarre costume to the party, resembling a giant pineapple.
The plot of the movie was so bizarre that no one could predict the ending.
cn: 这位艺术家怪异的画作让观众既困惑又着迷。
她穿了一套古怪的服装参加派对，看起来像一只巨型菠萝。
这部电影的情节离奇到无人能猜到结局。

en: Please write your name in the blank space.
She handed me a blank sheet of paper.
His expression was completely blank.
cn: 请在空白处写下你的名字。
她递给我一张白纸。
他的表情一片茫然。

en: The firefighters struggled to control the blaze.
Her eyes blazed with anger.
The news blazed across social media within minutes.
cn: 消防员奋力控制火势。
她眼中燃起怒火。
消息几分钟内传遍社交媒体。

definitions.definition: 榨取（金钱或资源）；使（颜色）渗开

en: His knee began to bleed after the fall.
The company was accused of bleeding local resources.
The red dye bleeds when washed in hot water.
cn: 跌倒后他的膝盖开始流血。
该公司被指控榨取当地资源。
这种红色染料在热水中洗涤时会渗色。

en: She didn't even blink when the bright light flashed.
The warning light blinks every three seconds.
In the blink of an eye, the opportunity was gone.
cn: 强光闪过时，她连眼睛都没眨一下。
警示灯每三秒闪烁一次。
转瞬间，机会就消失了。

en: The cherry trees blossom in early spring.
Her talent blossomed under the mentor's guidance.
A single blossom fell onto the mossy ground.
cn: 樱花树在早春开花。
她的才华在导师指导下蓬勃发展。
一朵花飘落在长满苔藓的地上。

en: The diplomat's blunder caused an international scandal.
She blundered through the dark room, knocking over a vase.
Forgetting the client's name was a blunder he couldn't recover from.
cn: 这位外交官的愚蠢错误引发了国际丑闻。
她在黑暗的房间里跌跌撞撞，打翻了一个花瓶。
忘记客户的名字是他无法挽回的大错。

en: The knife is too blunt to cut the tomato.
She appreciated his blunt honesty, even if it was harsh.
Repeated use will blunt the scissors over time.
cn: 这把刀太钝了，切不动番茄。
她欣赏他的直言不讳，尽管话很刺耳。
反复使用会逐渐使剪刀变钝。

en: The rain blurred the windshield, making it hard to see.
Her memories of the event were just a blur.
The artist intentionally blurred the lines between reality and fantasy.
cn: 雨水使挡风玻璃变得模糊，难以看清。
她对那件事的记忆只是一片模糊。
艺术家刻意模糊了现实与幻想的界限。

en: She blushed when he complimented her.
The rose has a delicate blush of pink.
His blunt question made me blush with embarrassment.
cn: 当他称赞她时，她脸红了。
这朵玫瑰带着淡淡的粉红色。
他直白的问题让我尴尬得脸红。

en: Employees received a year-end bonus for their hard work.
The sunny weather was a bonus during our vacation.
This recipe is easy to make, and the delicious taste is a bonus.
cn: 员工因辛勤工作获得了年终奖金。
晴朗的天气是我们假期中的意外之喜。
这个食谱制作简单，美味的口感更是锦上添花。

en: The museum provides a free booklet about the exhibition.
She published her poems in a handmade booklet.
The instruction booklet was missing from the package.
cn: 博物馆免费提供展览小册子。
她将诗作印成手工小册子出版。
包装盒里缺少说明书小册子。

definitions.definition: 突然的增长或繁荣（如经济繁荣）

en: The tech industry is experiencing a boom.
We heard a loud boom from the construction site.
The city's population boomed after the gold rush.
cn: 科技行业正在蓬勃发展。
我们听到建筑工地传来一声巨响。
淘金热后，这座城市人口激增。

definitions.definition: 临时摊位（如市集或展览中的小隔间）

en: She sells handmade jewelry at a booth in the flea market.
He stepped into the voting booth to cast his ballot.
The photo booth at the party was a big hit.
cn: 她在跳蚤市场的一个摊位卖手工珠宝。
他走进投票间投下选票。
派对上的拍照亭大受欢迎。

en: The river forms a natural border between the two countries.
Her dress was bordered with delicate lace.
The park borders the university campus to the east.
cn: 这条河流构成了两国之间的天然边界。
她的裙子镶着精致的蕾丝边。
公园东侧与大学校园接壤。

en: The lecture was so boring that half the audience fell asleep.
He specializes in precision boring of engine cylinders.
Her stories about work are always boring.
cn: 这场讲座无聊到半数听众都睡着了。
他专攻发动机气缸的精密钻孔。
她那些关于工作的故事总是很乏味。

en: The ball bounced off the wall and landed in the garden.
Her energy and bounce made her a great team leader.
The bank bounced his check due to insufficient funds.
cn: 球从墙上弹起，落进了花园。
她的活力和干劲使她成为优秀的团队领导。
银行因资金不足退回了他的支票。

definitions.definition: 受约束的；必然的；准备前往（某地）的

en: The athlete bounded over the hurdle with ease.
Our research is bound by ethical guidelines.
She's bound for Tokyo next week.
cn: 运动员轻松跃过跨栏。
我们的研究受伦理准则约束。
她下周将前往东京。

definitions.definition: 肠（尤指人或动物的内脏器官）
（复数形式 bowels）内部，深处（比喻用法）

en: The doctor examined his bowel for signs of infection.
The ancient tomb was hidden deep in the bowels of the mountain.
A healthy diet promotes good bowel function.
cn: 医生检查了他的肠道是否有感染迹象。
古墓隐藏在山的深处。
健康饮食有助于肠道功能正常运转。

definitions.definition: 联合抵制；拒绝参与（贸易、社交等）

en: The union decided to boycott goods from companies exploiting workers.
The artist faced a boycott after controversial statements.
A successful boycott can force policy changes.
cn: 工会决定抵制剥削工人的公司商品。
该艺术家因争议言论遭到抵制。
成功的抵制行动能迫使政策调整。

en: The wall was reinforced with steel braces.
She braced herself for the impact.
His teeth were straightened with braces.
cn: 这面墙用钢支架加固了。
她绷紧身体准备迎接冲击。
他的牙齿用牙箍矫正了。

definitions.definition: 用括号括起；将…归为同类

en: Please put the numbers in square brackets.
The shelf is fixed to the wall with metal brackets.
These students fall into the 18-20 age bracket.
cn: 请将数字放在方括号内。
架子用金属支架固定在墙上。
这些学生属于18-20岁年龄段。

en: This brand is known for its eco-friendly products.
The cattle were branded with the ranch's symbol.
His past mistakes branded him as unreliable.
cn: 这个品牌以环保产品著称。
牛群被打上牧场的烙印标记。
他过去的错误让他被贴上了不可靠的标签。

definitions.definition: 违反，破坏（规则、协议等）；缺口，裂口
违反（法律、协议）；攻破（防线）

en: The company was fined for breaching environmental regulations.
A breach in the dam caused severe flooding.
The hacker breached the security system within minutes.
cn: 该公司因违反环保法规被罚款。
大坝的裂口导致了严重洪水。
黑客在几分钟内攻破了安全系统。

en: The car had a breakdown on the highway.
She suffered a mental breakdown after months of stress.
The report includes a breakdown of expenses by category.
cn: 车子在高速公路上抛锚了。
在数月的压力后，她精神崩溃了。
报告包含按类别细分的开支明细。

definitions.definition: 重大突破（尤指科学、技术或研究领域）

en: The new drug is a major breakthrough in cancer treatment.
Soldiers made a breakthrough under heavy enemy fire.
Her research provided the breakthrough needed to solve the equation.
cn: 这种新药是癌症治疗领域的重大突破。
士兵们在敌军猛烈火力下成功突围。
她的研究提供了解决该方程的关键突破。

en: Farmers breed cattle for high-quality meat.
Polar bears breed in the Arctic regions.
His lies will only breed distrust.
cn: 农民饲养牛以获取优质肉类。
北极熊在北极地区繁殖。
他的谎言只会滋生不信任。

definitions.definition: 酿造（啤酒等）；冲泡（茶、咖啡）
（茶、咖啡等）被冲泡；酝酿（事件、情绪）
酿造的饮料；一次冲泡的量

en: He learned to brew beer from his grandfather.
A storm is brewing in the west.
This tea needs to brew for three minutes.
cn: 他跟祖父学会了酿造啤酒。
西方正酝酿着一场风暴。
这种茶需冲泡三分钟。

definitions.definition: 贿赂（指为影响他人行为而给予的金钱或好处）
向…行贿；用贿赂手段影响

en: The official was arrested for accepting a bribe.
They tried to bribe the witness into silence.
A bribe can corrupt even honest people.
cn: 这名官员因受贿被捕。
他们试图贿赂证人保持沉默。
贿赂甚至能腐蚀诚实的人。

en: The meeting was deliberately kept brief.
She wrote a brief for the legal team.
The president was briefed on the security situation.
cn: 会议被刻意安排得很简短。
她为法律团队撰写了一份案情摘要。
总统听取了安全局势的简要汇报。

en: The stars were brilliant in the night sky.
She gave a brilliant performance in the competition.
His brilliant idea solved the problem instantly.
cn: 夜空中的星星璀璨夺目。
她在比赛中表现卓越。
他绝妙的主意立刻解决了问题。

definitions.definition: 边缘（尤指危险或未知事物的边缘）

en: The glass was placed on the brink of the table.
Climate change has pushed many species to the brink of extinction.
She stood at the brink of a major life decision.
cn: 玻璃杯被放在桌子边缘。
气候变化将许多物种推向灭绝的边缘。
她站在人生重大抉择的临界点上。

en: She walked at a brisk pace to catch the train.
The brisk morning air woke him up instantly.
He brisked up the meeting with a few jokes.
cn: 她步伐轻快地赶火车。
清晨清新的空气立刻让他清醒过来。
他用几个笑话让会议活跃起来。

en: The statue was cast in bronze over 200 years ago.
Her hair had a warm bronze tint under the sunlight.
He won a bronze medal in the Olympic Games.
cn: 这座雕像于200多年前用青铜铸造。
阳光下，她的头发泛着温暖的古铜色光泽。
他在奥运会上获得了一枚铜牌。

definitions.definition: （鸟类或昆虫的）一窝幼崽；一家的孩子们

en: The hen guarded her brood fiercely.
He brooded over the mistake for weeks.
A brood of children played in the yard.
cn: 母鸡凶狠地守护着她的一窝小鸡。
他为那个错误郁郁沉思了好几周。
一大家孩子在院子里玩耍。

en: She got a bruise on her knee after falling off the bike.
Handle the peaches gently to avoid bruising them.
His harsh words bruised her self-confidence.
cn: 她骑车摔倒后膝盖上有一块淤青。
轻拿轻放桃子，避免碰伤。
他刻薄的话语挫伤了她的自信心。

en: The dictator ruled with brutal force.
The marathon was canceled due to brutal heat.
Her criticism was brutally honest.
cn: 这位独裁者以残暴手段统治。
马拉松因酷热天气取消。
她的批评尖锐得近乎残忍。

definitions.definition: 雄鹿；美元（俚语）；责任（非正式）
猛烈反抗；振作（非正式，如 buck up）

en: The buck stopped abruptly and stared at us.
He earned fifty bucks delivering newspapers.
The horse bucked wildly when the rider mounted.
cn: 雄鹿突然停下，盯着我们。
他送报纸赚了五十美元。
骑手上马时，马猛然弓背跃起。

en: The rose bush is covered in tiny buds.
Trees begin to bud in early spring.
Her talent for painting budded at a young age.
cn: 玫瑰丛上满是小小的花蕾。
树木在早春时节开始发芽。
她的绘画天赋在年幼时便已萌芽。

en: The government announced a new education budget.
She budgets carefully to save for her trip.
This hotel offers budget accommodations for students.
cn: 政府宣布了一项新的教育预算。
她精打细算，为旅行存钱。
这家酒店提供经济型学生住宿。

en: There's a bug crawling on the windowsill.
The software update fixed several critical bugs.
Stop bugging me about the homework!
cn: 窗台上有一只小虫在爬。
这次软件更新修复了几个关键漏洞。
别再拿作业来烦我了！

en: The bulk of the work was completed in just two days.
Buying in bulk can save you a lot of money.
The mountain bulked large against the evening sky.
cn: 这项工作的大部分在两天内就完成了。
批量购买能省不少钱。
暮色中，山峦显得格外巍峨。

definitions.definition: 公牛；雄性动物（如象、鲸等）

en: The farmer keeps a fierce bull in the pasture.
Investors turned bullish after the economic report.
He tried to bull his way through the crowd.
cn: 农夫在牧场养了一头凶猛的公牛。
经济报告发布后，投资者转为看涨。
他试图强行挤过人群。

en: The school posts a weekly bulletin with upcoming events.
The government bulletined the new policy online.
Check the bulletin board for the latest updates.
cn: 学校每周发布活动预告简报。
政府在线发布了新政策公告。
查看公告板获取最新信息。

en: He was accused of being a bully in school.
Don't let anyone bully you into doing something wrong.
The manager’s bullying behavior created a toxic work environment.
cn: 他被指控在学校里欺负他人。
不要让别人胁迫你做错事。
经理的霸凌行为造成了恶劣的工作氛围。

en: She tripped and got a bump on her forehead.
The car bumped into the fence while reversing.
The plane bumped through the storm clouds.
cn: 她绊倒了，额头上肿了个包。
倒车时，汽车撞上了围栏。
飞机颠簸着穿过暴风云层。

en: The donkey struggled under the heavy burden of firewood.
She didn’t want to burden her family with her financial problems.
The burden of proof lies with the prosecution.
cn: 驴子艰难地驮着沉重的柴火。
她不想让家庭为她的财务问题烦恼。
举证责任在控方。

en: The new policy was delayed by layers of bureaucracy.
She fought against the bureaucracy to get her project approved.
Startup companies often avoid bureaucracy to stay agile.
cn: 新政策因层层官僚程序而延误。
她为项目获批与官僚体系抗争。
初创公司常避免官僚制度以保持灵活。

en: The ancient burial site was discovered by archaeologists last year.
She attended her grandfather's burial in a quiet ceremony.
The law requires proper burial of hazardous waste.
cn: 考古学家去年发现了这处古代墓葬遗址。
她参加了一场简朴的祖父葬礼。
法律规定有害废物必须妥善掩埋。

en: The museum displays a marble bust of Julius Caesar.
The police busted an illegal gambling ring.
His business went bust after the market crash.
cn: 博物馆展出了一尊尤利乌斯·凯撒的大理石半身像。
警方捣毁了一个非法赌博团伙。
市场崩盘后，他的企业破产了。

definitions.definition: 嗡嗡声；活跃的讨论；电话
发出嗡嗡声；忙碌；充满活力

en: The bees buzzed around the flowers.
There's been a lot of buzz about the new movie.
My phone buzzed twice during the meeting.
cn: 蜜蜂在花丛间嗡嗡飞舞。
关于这部新电影有很多热议。
会议期间我的手机震动了两次。

definitions.definition: 旁路；绕行道路；分流术（医学）

en: The construction forced drivers to take a bypass around the city.
The surgeon performed a coronary bypass to restore blood flow.
She bypassed the traditional publishing route by self-publishing her book.
cn: 施工迫使司机绕行城市的旁路。
外科医生进行了冠状动脉搭桥手术以恢复血流。
她通过自助出版绕过了传统出版流程。

definitions.definition: 小屋（尤指简陋的木质结构）；船舱；机舱

en: They built a log cabin in the woods.
The pilot announced turbulence from the cabin.
She booked a cabin with a porthole view.
cn: 他们在森林里搭了一间木屋。
飞行员从机舱内播报了颠簸预警。
她预订了一间带舷窗视野的船舱。

definitions.definition: 内阁（政府高层官员组成的决策机构）
橱柜（带抽屉或门的储物家具）

en: The prime minister held a meeting with her cabinet.
He stored the porcelain in a glass-fronted cabinet.
The antique cabinet was carved from oak.
cn: 首相与内阁成员召开会议。
他将瓷器存放在玻璃门橱柜中。
这个古董橱柜由橡木雕刻而成。

en: The bridge is supported by steel cables.
They cabled the news to headquarters.
Fiber-optic cables transmit data at high speed.
cn: 这座桥由钢缆支撑。
他们向总部发送了电报。
光纤电缆能高速传输数据。

definitions.definition: 自助餐厅（顾客自取食物的餐饮场所）

en: The university cafeteria offers a variety of healthy options.
We grabbed lunch at the hospital cafeteria.
The cafeteria was crowded during the lunch rush.
cn: 这所大学的自助餐厅提供多种健康选择。
我们在医院自助餐厅吃了午饭。
午餐高峰期时自助餐厅人满为患。

definitions.definition: 钙（一种金属元素，符号 Ca，常见于骨骼、牙齿等）

en: Milk is rich in calcium, which is essential for bone health.
The doctor recommended calcium supplements for osteoporosis prevention.
Calcium carbonate is a common ingredient in antacids.
cn: 牛奶富含钙，对骨骼健康至关重要。
医生建议服用钙补充剂以预防骨质疏松。
碳酸钙是抗酸药中的常见成分。

en: A banana contains about 105 calories.
She tracks her daily calorie intake carefully.
Burning calories through exercise is essential for weight loss.
cn: 一根香蕉约含105卡路里。
她仔细记录每日卡路里摄入量。
通过运动消耗卡路里对减重至关重要。

en: The concert was canceled due to heavy rain.
She canceled her subscription to the magazine.
The system allows you to cancel the operation within 10 seconds.
cn: 音乐会因大雨取消。
她注销了杂志订阅。
该系统允许你在10秒内撤销操作。

definitions.definition: [天文] 巨蟹座（大写首字母）

en: Early detection significantly improves cancer survival rates.
Corruption is a cancer that erodes public trust.
The sun enters Cancer in late June.
cn: 早期发现极大提高癌症存活率。
腐败是侵蚀公众信任的痼疾。
太阳在六月下旬进入巨蟹座。

en: She is the most qualified candidate for the job.
All candidates must submit their applications by Friday.
The candidate outlined his policies during the debate.
cn: 她是该职位最合格的候选人。
所有申请者必须在周五前提交材料。
这位候选人在辩论中阐述了他的政策。

definitions.definition: 1. 茎秆（如竹子、甘蔗的茎）；2. 手杖，拐杖

en: The old man walked slowly, leaning on his bamboo cane.
Sugar is extracted from the crushed stalks of the cane.
In the past, teachers would cane students for misbehavior.
cn: 老人拄着竹制手杖缓步前行。
糖是从压碎的甘蔗茎中提取的。
过去，老师会用藤条惩罚行为不端的学生。

en: The castle walls were destroyed by cannon fire.
He scored a cannon in the pool game, hitting three balls in a row.
The truck cannoned into the barrier at full speed.
cn: 城堡的城墙被炮火摧毁。
他在台球比赛中打出连击，连续击中三球。
卡车全速撞上了护栏。

definitions.definition: 教规；标准；经典（尤指宗教或文学领域的权威文本）

en: The canon of Shakespeare's works has influenced generations of writers.
The church canon prohibits clergy from marrying.
Bach's "Canon in D" showcases intricate melodic imitation.
cn: 莎士比亚的作品经典影响了几代作家。
教会教规禁止神职人员结婚。
巴赫的《D大调卡农》展现了精妙的旋律模仿。

en: The artist painted on a large canvas.
The tent is made of waterproof canvas.
We need to canvas the neighborhood for opinions.
cn: 艺术家在一块大画布上作画。
帐篷由防水帆布制成。
我们需要在社区内详细征集意见。

en: She is a capable leader who handles crises calmly.
The team proved capable of completing the project ahead of schedule.
This tool is capable of precise measurements.
cn: 她是一位能干的领导者，能冷静处理危机。
团队证明了自己有能力提前完成项目。
该工具可进行精确测量。

en: The stadium has a seating capacity of 50,000.
She demonstrated a remarkable capacity for leadership.
He was acting in his capacity as a legal advisor.
cn: 这座体育场可容纳5万人。
她展现出卓越的领导才能。
他以法律顾问的身份行事。

definitions.definition: 海角，岬（伸入海中的陆地）

en: The lighthouse stands on the rocky cape.
She wore a red velvet cape to the gala.
Cape Horn is notorious for its rough seas.
cn: 灯塔矗立在多石的海角上。
她穿着红色天鹅绒斗篷参加晚宴。
合恩角因汹涌的海浪而闻名。

definitions.definition: 胶囊；太空舱；密封小容器

en: The medicine is enclosed in a gelatin capsule.
The astronaut entered the space capsule before launch.
She managed to capsule her thesis into three sentences.
cn: 药物被封装在明胶胶囊中。
发射前，宇航员进入了太空舱。
她将论文浓缩成了三句话。

en: The photo had a humorous caption.
She captioned the diagram with clear labels.
The caption under the painting revealed its history.
cn: 这张照片配了幽默的说明文字。
她为图表添加了清晰的标注。
画作下方的标题揭示了它的历史。

en: The soldiers were held captive for three years.
She was a captive audience, enthralled by his stories.
The captive market had no choice but to pay high prices.
cn: 这些士兵被囚禁了三年。
她是被迷住的听众，对他的故事着迷不已。
受控的市场别无选择，只能支付高价。

definitions.definition: 枢机主教（天主教高阶神职人员）

en: The cardinal presided over the conclave to elect the new pope.
A bright red cardinal perched on the snowy branch.
Honesty is a cardinal virtue in many cultures.
cn: 枢机主教主持了选举新教皇的秘密会议。
一只鲜红的北美红雀停在积雪的树枝上。
诚实是许多文化中的基本美德。

definitions.definition: 雕刻（用工具切割材料以形成特定形状）

en: The artist carved a beautiful statue from marble.
Would you like me to carve the turkey?
Glaciers carve valleys over thousands of years.
cn: 艺术家用大理石雕刻出一尊美丽的雕像。
需要我来切火鸡肉吗？
冰川用数千年时间侵蚀出山谷。

definitions.definition: 投掷；投射（光、影等）；选派演员
演员阵容；铸件；投掷动作

en: She cast a stone into the pond.
The director cast him as the villain.
The statue was made from a bronze cast.
cn: 她将一块石头抛入池塘。
导演选定他饰演反派。
这座雕像是用青铜铸件制成的。

en: She wore a casual outfit to the picnic.
Their meeting was purely casual.
He took a casual glance at the report.
cn: 她穿着休闲装去野餐。
他们的相遇纯属偶然。
他随意瞥了一眼报告。

en: The earthquake caused thousands of casualties.
Civilian casualties must be minimized in warfare.
The company was a casualty of the economic crisis.
cn: 地震导致数千人伤亡。
战争中必须尽量减少平民伤亡。
这家公司是经济危机的牺牲品。

definitions.definition: （戏剧或文学中的）悲剧性结局

en: The earthquake was a catastrophe that left thousands homeless.
The play’s catastrophe occurs when the hero betrays his own ideals.
Poor financial planning turned the project into a catastrophe.
cn: 这场地震是一场灾难，导致数千人无家可归。
当主角背叛自己的理想时，戏剧的悲剧性结局降临。
糟糕的财务规划使项目彻底失败。

definitions.definition: 提供饮食服务；满足需求

en: The restaurant caters to vegan customers.
She caters all our office parties.
The program caters to children's educational needs.
cn: 这家餐厅为素食者提供餐饮服务。
她负责我们所有办公室聚会的餐饮。
该项目迎合儿童的教育需求。

definitions.definition: 主教堂（尤指天主教或圣公会教区中规模宏伟的教堂，内设主教座）

en: The cathedral took over 200 years to complete.
Visitors admire the stained glass in the medieval cathedral.
The bishop gave a sermon at the cathedral on Easter Sunday.
cn: 这座主教堂耗时200多年才建成。
游客们赞叹中世纪主教堂的彩绘玻璃。
复活节当天，主教在主教堂布道。

definitions.definition: 天主教的（狭义，首字母大写时 Catholic）

en: She has a catholic appreciation for all genres of music.
The Catholic Church has a long history of tradition.
His catholic approach to learning includes both science and art.
cn: 她对所有音乐类型都有广泛的欣赏。
天主教会拥有悠久的传统历史。
他广泛的学习方法涵盖科学和艺术。

en: She handled the chemicals with great caution.
The sign cautioned drivers about the sharp turn ahead.
His advice served as a caution against impulsive decisions.
cn: 她极其谨慎地处理这些化学品。
标志牌警告司机前方有急转弯。
他的建议是对冲动决策的警示。

en: She gave a cautious reply to the controversial question.
The driver was cautious on the icy road.
Investors are becoming more cautious about risky ventures.
cn: 她对这一争议性问题给出了谨慎的答复。
司机在结冰的路面上开车很小心。
投资者对高风险项目越来越谨慎。

definitions.definition: 空洞，腔（如牙齿龋洞、体腔）

en: The dentist found a small cavity in my molar.
Lava tubes form natural cavities in volcanic regions.
The ultrasound revealed a cavity in the lung tissue.
cn: 牙医发现我的磨牙上有个小龋洞。
熔岩管在火山区域形成天然洞穴。
超声检查显示肺组织中有一个空洞。

definitions.definition: 地下室（尤指储藏食物、酒类的）

en: The wine has been aging in the cellar for over a decade.
She stored preserves in the cellar to keep them cool.
The old house had a damp cellar filled with antique furniture.
cn: 这瓶酒已在地窖中陈酿超过十年。
她将蜜饯储存在地下室以保持凉爽。
老房子有个潮湿的地下室，堆满了古董家具。

definitions.definition: 墓地，公墓（用于埋葬死者的场所）

en: The ancient cemetery was surrounded by cypress trees.
Urban cemeteries often serve as quiet green spaces.
Visitors left flowers on the graves in the military cemetery.
cn: 这座古老的墓地周围环绕着柏树。
城市公墓常作为安静的绿地存在。
访客在军人公墓的墓碑前献上鲜花。

en: The government conducts a national census every ten years.
Ancient Roman censuses were used to determine taxation and military service.
The latest census data reveals a decline in rural populations.
cn: 政府每十年进行一次全国人口普查。
古罗马的人口普查用于确定税收和兵役。
最新普查数据显示农村人口减少。

definitions.definition: 陶瓷制品（常用复数 ceramics）

en: The museum exhibits ancient ceramic artifacts from the Ming Dynasty.
She specializes in ceramic engineering at university.
These ceramic tiles are highly resistant to heat.
cn: 博物馆展出了明代的古代陶瓷制品。
她在大学主修陶瓷工程。
这些瓷砖具有极高的耐热性。

en: Wheat and oats are common cereals grown in this region.
She prefers cereal with milk for breakfast.
Ancient civilizations worshipped Ceres as the goddess of agriculture.
cn: 小麦和燕麦是该地区常见的谷物作物。
她早餐喜欢牛奶配麦片。
古文明将刻瑞斯尊为农业女神。

en: There is no certainty that the project will succeed.
Death is the only certainty in life.
She spoke with absolute certainty about her findings.
cn: 项目能否成功尚无定论。
死亡是生命中唯一确定的事。
她对自己的发现言之凿凿。

definitions.definition: 证明，证实（某事的真实性或准确性）

en: The doctor must certify the cause of death before the burial.
This program is certified by the international quality standard.
She certified the document with her official seal.
cn: 医生必须在埋葬前证明死亡原因。
该项目已通过国际质量标准认证。
她用公章证明了文件的真实性。

en: She accepted the challenge to climb Mount Everest.
The lawyer challenged the credibility of the witness.
This puzzle will challenge your problem-solving skills.
cn: 她接受了攀登珠穆朗玛峰的挑战。
律师质疑了证人的可信度。
这个谜题将考验你的解决问题的能力。

definitions.definition: 香槟（一种起泡白葡萄酒，原产于法国香槟地区）
香槟色（淡橙黄色或浅褐色）

en: They celebrated with a bottle of vintage champagne.
Her dress was a delicate shade of champagne.
Only sparkling wine from Champagne can be called champagne.
cn: 他们用一瓶年份香槟庆祝。
她的裙子是精致的香槟色。
只有香槟地区产的起泡酒才能称为香槟。

en: She became the world chess champion at age 20.
He championed the rights of marginalized communities.
The team fought hard to defend their champion title.
cn: 她20岁时成为国际象棋世界冠军。
他积极捍卫边缘群体的权利。
该队奋力卫冕冠军头衔。

definitions.definition: 圣歌；吟诵；重复的节奏性呼喊

en: The monks began their morning chant in the chapel.
Protesters chanted slogans outside the government building.
The football fans' chant echoed through the stadium.
cn: 僧侣们在小教堂里开始了晨祷吟唱。
抗议者在政府大楼外反复呼喊着口号。
球迷们的助威声回荡在整个体育场。

definitions.definition: 小教堂；附属礼拜堂（尤指学校、医院等机构内的）

en: The university chapel holds services every Sunday.
She lit a candle in the hospital chapel.
The medieval chapel features stunning stained glass.
cn: 大学的小教堂每周日举行礼拜。
她在医院附属礼拜堂点燃了一支蜡烛。
这座中世纪小教堂以华丽的彩绘玻璃闻名。

en: Her strong character helped her overcome difficulties.
The main character in the novel is a detective.
The password must contain at least one special character.
cn: 她坚强的性格帮助她克服了困难。
小说中的主角是一名侦探。
密码必须包含至少一个特殊字符。

en: The striped pattern is a characteristic feature of tigers.
Her optimism is one of her most admirable characteristics.
This chemical has a characteristic smell of sulfur.
cn: 条纹是老虎的典型特征。
她的乐观是她最令人钦佩的特质之一。
这种化学品带有特有的硫磺气味。

definitions.definition: 描述（某人/某物的）特征；使具有某种特性

en: The novel characterizes the protagonist as a rebellious outsider.
Bright colors characterize traditional Mexican art.
Scientists characterize this behavior as a survival instinct.
cn: 这部小说将主人公刻画成一个叛逆的局外人。
鲜艳的色彩是墨西哥传统艺术的典型特征。
科学家将这种行为归类为生存本能。

en: The battery needs to charge for three hours.
There is no charge for this service.
The cavalry prepared to charge at dawn.
cn: 电池需要充电三小时。
此项服务免费。
骑兵准备在黎明时发起冲锋。

en: The police chased the thief through the alley.
Fox hunting is a traditional chase in England.
She chased her dreams with relentless determination.
cn: 警察在小巷中追赶小偷。
猎狐是英格兰的传统狩猎活动。
她以不懈的决心追逐梦想。

en: She cherishes the necklace her grandmother gave her.
He cherishes a dream of traveling around the world.
The old couple cherished their garden for decades.
cn: 她珍藏着祖母送给她的项链。
他怀抱着环游世界的梦想。
这对老夫妇悉心照料他们的花园数十年。

en: He was elected chief of the tribe.
The chief reason for her success is hard work.
The fire chief coordinated the rescue operation.
cn: 他被选为部落首领。
她成功的主要原因是勤奋。
消防队长协调了救援行动。

en: She accidentally chipped a corner of the porcelain vase.
Silicon chips are essential components in modern electronics.
He ordered fish and chips at the seaside restaurant.
cn: 她不小心把瓷花瓶的一角磕掉了碎片。
硅芯片是现代电子设备的核心元件。
他在海边餐厅点了一份炸鱼薯条。

definitions.definition: 胆固醇（一种脂类物质，存在于动物细胞中，过高会导致心血管疾病）

en: High cholesterol can lead to heart disease.
Eggs contain dietary cholesterol but are nutritious.
Doctors recommend checking cholesterol levels annually.
cn: 高胆固醇可能导致心脏病。
鸡蛋含膳食胆固醇但营养丰富。
医生建议每年检查胆固醇水平。

definitions.definition: （音乐的）和弦；弦（几何学中连接两点的直线）

en: The pianist played a melancholic chord.
The line segment is the chord of this circle.
Her story struck a chord with the audience.
cn: 钢琴家弹奏了一个忧郁的和弦。
这条线段是该圆的弦。
她的故事引起了听众的共鸣。

definitions.definition: 合唱队；合唱曲；副歌部分

en: The chorus delivered a powerful finale.
The crowd chorused the slogan enthusiastically.
She hummed the chorus of her favorite song.
cn: 合唱团以震撼的终曲收尾。
人群热情地齐声喊出口号。
她哼着最爱歌曲的副歌部分。

en: She suffers from chronic back pain.
Chronic stress can harm your immune system.
He's a chronic procrastinator.
cn: 她患有慢性背痛。
长期压力会损害免疫系统。
他是个积习难改的拖延者。

en: She broke the chocolate into small chunks.
The algorithm processes data in chunks.
He ate a chunk of bread in two bites.
cn: 她把巧克力掰成小块。
该算法分块处理数据。
他两口就吃掉了一大块面包。

definitions.definition: 循环（如血液、空气的流动）

en: Regular exercise improves blood circulation.
The newspaper has a circulation of over one million.
Fake news spreads rapidly in the circulation of social media.
cn: 定期锻炼促进血液循环。
该报纸发行量超百万份。
假新闻在社交媒体的传播中快速扩散。

definitions.definition: 环境；情况（指影响事件的外部条件）
细节；事件（尤指附带或次要的）

en: Under no circumstances should you open the door to strangers.
The project’s success depended on unforeseen circumstances.
She described the circumstances leading to the accident.
cn: 任何情况下都不应给陌生人开门。
项目的成功取决于不可预见的因素。
她描述了导致事故的细节经过。

definitions.definition: 马戏团；环形广场；喧闹的场面

en: The circus performers amazed the audience with their acrobatic skills.
Piccadilly Circus is a busy intersection in London.
The meeting turned into a circus with everyone shouting at once.
cn: 马戏团演员用杂技表演让观众惊叹不已。
皮卡迪利广场是伦敦一个繁忙的交叉路口。
会议变成了一场闹剧，所有人都在同时大喊大叫。

en: She cited three studies to support her argument.
The judge cited him for contempt of court.
The soldier was cited for bravery in battle.
cn: 她引用三项研究来支持自己的论点。
法官以藐视法庭罪传唤了他。
这名士兵因作战英勇受到表彰。

en: She claims to have seen the missing documents.
The insurance company rejected his claim for damages.
Indigenous people have a strong claim to these lands.
cn: 她声称见过丢失的文件。
保险公司拒绝了他的赔偿索赔。
原住民对这些土地拥有强烈的主权主张。

en: The carpenter used a clamp to hold the pieces of wood together.
She clamped her hand over his mouth to stop him from shouting.
The police clamped down on illegal parking in the city center.
cn: 木匠用夹具将木块固定在一起。
她用手捂住他的嘴，阻止他喊叫。
警方严厉打击市中心的非法停车行为。

definitions.definition: 氏族，家族（尤指有共同祖先的群体）

en: The MacLeod clan gathered for their annual reunion.
She joined a clan of environmental activists in college.
Online gaming clans often develop strong camaraderie.
cn: 麦克劳德家族聚在一起举行年度团聚。
她在大学加入了一个环保活动家的团体。
网络游戏公会常常发展出深厚的友谊。

definitions.definition: 清晰，明确（指思想、表达或视觉的清晰度）
透明，清澈（指物质的物理特性）

en: The clarity of her explanation made the complex topic easy to understand.
The water in the mountain lake was renowned for its exceptional clarity.
Mental clarity is essential for making important decisions.
cn: 她的解释清晰明了，使复杂话题易于理解。
这座高山湖泊的水以异常清澈闻名。
思维清晰对做出重要决策至关重要。

en: The clash of swords echoed through the valley.
Their opinions clashed during the debate.
The bright red curtains clash with the blue sofa.
cn: 刀剑碰撞声在山谷中回荡。
辩论中他们的观点激烈冲突。
鲜红色窗帘与蓝色沙发显得格格不入。

en: She fastened the clasp of her necklace.
He reached out to clasp her hand tightly.
The child clasped the teddy bear in a hug.
cn: 她扣上了项链的搭扣。
他伸出手紧紧握住她的手。
孩子紧紧抱住泰迪熊。

en: Shakespeare's plays are considered classic literature.
She wore a classic black dress to the event.
This car is a classic of 20th-century design.
cn: 莎士比亚的戏剧被视为经典文学。
她穿了一条经典黑色连衣裙出席活动。
这辆车是20世纪设计的典范之作。

definitions.definition: 古典的（指艺术、音乐或文学等传统、经典的风格）
经典的（具有持久价值或权威性）

en: Beethoven's symphonies are central to the classical music repertoire.
She prefers classical architecture over modern designs.
The professor gave a lecture on classical Greek philosophy.
cn: 贝多芬的交响曲是古典音乐曲目的核心。
相较于现代设计，她更偏爱古典建筑风格。
教授做了一场关于古典希腊哲学的讲座。

en: The classification of organisms is fundamental to biology.
This document has a confidential classification.
The library uses a decimal system for book classification.
cn: 生物分类是生物学的基础。
这份文件属于机密级别。
该图书馆采用十进制图书分类法。

en: The store is having a clearance sale to remove old stock.
You need security clearance to access this area.
The defender made a crucial clearance in the last minute.
cn: 商店正在进行清仓甩卖以处理旧库存。
进入该区域需通过安全许可。
后卫在最后一分钟完成关键解围。

en: She works as a clerk in a law firm.
The hotel clerk checked us in efficiently.
Medieval clerks were often responsible for copying manuscripts.
cn: 她在一家律师事务所担任文员。
酒店前台职员高效地为我们办理了入住。
中世纪的文书常负责抄写手稿。

definitions.definition: 客户，委托人（接受专业服务的一方）
【计算机】客户端（访问服务器资源的程序或设备）

en: The lawyer met with her client to discuss the case.
Our company values feedback from every client.
The game client needs an update to connect to the server.
cn: 律师与委托人会面讨论案件。
我们公司重视每位客户的反馈。
游戏客户端需更新才能连接服务器。

en: The eagle nested on the edge of the cliff.
Waves crashed against the base of the cliff.
Hikers were warned not to approach the unstable cliff.
cn: 鹰在悬崖边缘筑巢。
海浪拍打着悬崖底部。
徒步者被警告不要靠近不稳定的悬崖。

definitions.definition: 气候（某地区的长期天气模式）

en: The Mediterranean climate is perfect for growing olives.
The political climate has become increasingly polarized.
Climate change is a global issue that requires immediate action.
cn: 地中海气候非常适合种植橄榄。
政治氛围日益两极分化。
气候变化是需要立即行动的全球性问题。

en: The concert reached its climax with a fireworks display.
The story builds up to a dramatic climax in the final chapter.
Their relationship climaxed in a passionate kiss.
cn: 音乐会在烟花表演中达到高潮。
故事在最后一章推向戏剧性的高潮。
他们的关系以一个热烈的吻达到顶点。

definitions.definition: 紧贴；黏着；坚持（习惯或信念）

en: The wet shirt clung to his skin.
She clung to the hope that he would return.
The child clung to his mother in fear.
cn: 湿衬衫紧贴在他的皮肤上。
她坚持认为他会回来的希望。
孩子害怕地紧紧抱住母亲。

en: She used a clip to hold her hair back.
The editor will clip the unnecessary scenes.
Watch this funny clip from the movie.
cn: 她用发夹把头发挽起来。
编辑会剪掉多余的片段。
看看电影里的这个搞笑片段。

en: Turn the knob clockwise to tighten it.
The dancers moved in a clockwise circle.
The hurricane's winds spiral clockwise in the southern hemisphere.
cn: 顺时针旋转旋钮以拧紧。
舞者们沿顺时针方向绕圈移动。
南半球的飓风气流呈顺时针螺旋。

definitions.definition: 克隆；无性繁殖的个体；复制品

en: Scientists successfully cloned a sheep named Dolly in 1996.
The company plans to clone its best-selling product for the new market.
These two buildings are almost clones of each other.
cn: 科学家于1996年成功克隆了名为多利的绵羊。
该公司计划为新市场复制其畅销产品。
这两栋建筑几乎一模一样。

en: She keeps her winter clothes in the closet.
He is a closet fan of romantic comedies.
The old house had a hidden closet behind the bookshelf.
cn: 她把冬装存放在壁橱里。
他是个偷偷喜欢浪漫喜剧的人。
这栋老房子的书架后藏有一个暗柜。

en: The detective found a crucial clue at the crime scene.
Her diary might clue us in to her disappearance.
The map had no clues to locate the hidden treasure.
cn: 侦探在犯罪现场发现了关键线索。
她的日记可能为我们提供她失踪的线索。
地图上没有提示能定位隐藏的宝藏。

en: The bees formed a tight cluster around the queen.
Galaxies often appear in clusters due to gravitational attraction.
The software clusters similar data points for analysis.
cn: 蜜蜂围绕蜂王聚集成紧密的一团。
星系因引力作用常以星团形式出现。
该软件将相似数据点聚类以便分析。

en: She clutched her bag tightly on the crowded train.
The car’s clutch needs to be replaced.
A clutch of eggs was found in the nest.
cn: 她在拥挤的火车上紧紧抓着手提包。
这辆车的离合器需要更换了。
鸟窝里发现了一窝蛋。

definitions.definition: 联盟（尤指政党或国家间的临时联合）

en: The two parties formed a coalition to win the election.
A coalition of environmental groups protested the new policy.
Their success depended on a fragile coalition of interests.
cn: 两党结成联盟以赢得选举。
环保团体联合抗议新政策。
他们的成功依赖于脆弱的利益联合。

en: The coarse fabric irritated her skin.
His coarse jokes made everyone uncomfortable.
Sandpaper is deliberately made coarse for grinding.
cn: 粗糙的布料刺激了她的皮肤。
他粗俗的笑话让所有人不适。
砂纸特意做得粗糙以便打磨。

definitions.definition: 可卡因（一种从古柯叶中提取的兴奋剂药物）

en: Cocaine was originally used as a local anesthetic in medical procedures.
The leaves of the coca plant are the natural source of cocaine.
Illegal cocaine trafficking remains a global issue.
cn: 可卡因最初被用作医疗手术中的局部麻醉剂。
古柯植物的叶子是可卡因的天然来源。
非法可卡因贩运仍是全球性问题。

en: She ordered a fruity cocktail with a tiny umbrella.
The documentary is a cocktail of humor and tragedy.
He invented a new cocktail using local herbs.
cn: 她点了一杯带小伞的水果味鸡尾酒。
这部纪录片是幽默与悲剧的混合体。
他用本地草药调制了一款新鸡尾酒。

definitions.definition: 认知的；与认识过程相关的

en: Cognitive abilities decline with age if not exercised regularly.
The study focuses on cognitive development in early childhood.
Sleep is essential for cognitive function and memory consolidation.
cn: 认知能力若不经常锻炼，会随着年龄增长而衰退。
该研究聚焦于儿童早期的认知发展。
睡眠对认知功能和记忆巩固至关重要。

definitions.definition: 连贯的，一致的（指逻辑或表达清晰）
黏附的，紧密结合的（物理或化学性质）

en: Her argument was coherent and easy to follow.
The laser produces coherent light waves.
The team lacked a coherent strategy.
cn: 她的论点连贯且易于理解。
激光产生相干的光波。
团队缺乏一致的策略。

en: The two events coincided perfectly, creating a memorable evening.
Our opinions seldom coincide on political issues.
The festival coincides with the harvest season.
cn: 两件事完美同步，造就了一个难忘的夜晚。
我们在政治议题上很少意见一致。
这个节日恰逢丰收季节。

en: By pure coincidence, we booked the same flight.
The coincidence of their opinions surprised everyone.
It’s no coincidence that great minds think alike.
cn: 纯属巧合，我们订了同一班航班。
他们意见的一致让所有人惊讶。
英雄所见略同并非偶然。

definitions.definition: 合作，协作（尤指在创作或工作中）

en: The scientific breakthrough was achieved through international collaboration.
Her collaboration with the artist resulted in a stunning exhibition.
During the war, some citizens were accused of collaboration with the enemy.
cn: 这一科学突破是通过国际协作实现的。
她与艺术家的合作催生了一场惊艳的展览。
战争期间，部分民众被指控与敌人勾结。

en: The old building collapsed during the earthquake.
The company collapsed due to financial mismanagement.
She collapsed from exhaustion after the marathon.
cn: 那座旧建筑在地震中倒塌了。
该公司因财务管理不善而倒闭。
她在马拉松赛后因精疲力竭而虚脱。

en: She discussed the project with her colleague during lunch.
My colleagues supported me when I faced challenges at work.
He is respected as both a mentor and a colleague.
cn: 她在午餐时与同事讨论了该项目。
当我面临工作挑战时，同僚们给予了我支持。
他既是导师也是同事，备受尊敬。

en: The two cars collided at the intersection.
Their opinions collided during the debate.
