Particles collide in the accelerator to create new energy.
cn: 两辆车在十字路口相撞。
辩论中他们的观点激烈冲突。
粒子在加速器中碰撞以产生新能量。

definitions.definition: 碰撞（物理或比喻性冲突）

en: The collision between the two cars caused a traffic jam.
Their disagreement was a collision of ideologies.
Scientists study cosmic collisions to understand galaxy formation.
cn: 两车相撞导致交通堵塞。
他们的分歧是意识形态的冲突。
科学家研究宇宙碰撞以理解星系形成。

en: The museum exhibits artifacts from the colonial period.
Singapore was a British colonial port in the 19th century.
The novel explores the conflicts between colonials and indigenous people.
cn: 博物馆展出了殖民时期的文物。
新加坡曾是19世纪英国的殖民港口。
这部小说探讨了殖民地居民与原住民之间的冲突。

en: The soldiers were trained for close combat.
We must combat climate change with urgent actions.
His research focuses on combating cyber threats.
cn: 士兵们接受了近身战斗训练。
我们必须以紧急行动应对气候变化。
他的研究专注于对抗网络威胁。

en: The dish is a perfect combination of sweet and sour.
He forgot the combination to his safe.
Their teamwork was a winning combination.
cn: 这道菜是甜与酸的完美结合。
他忘记了保险箱的密码。
他们的团队合作是制胜组合。

en: The two companies decided to combine their resources for the project.
Farmers use a combine to harvest wheat efficiently.
Hydrogen and oxygen combine to form water.
cn: 两家公司决定为该项目合并资源。
农民使用联合收割机高效收割小麦。
氢和氧结合形成水。

definitions.definition: 彗星（绕太阳运行的天体，带有明亮彗尾）

en: The comet's tail glowed brightly as it approached the sun.
Halley's Comet becomes visible from Earth every 76 years.
Ancient cultures often interpreted comets as omens of change.
cn: 彗星接近太阳时，其尾部发出明亮的光芒。
哈雷彗星每76年可从地球观测到一次。
古代文明常将彗星解读为变革的预兆。

en: His comic timing made the audience laugh uncontrollably.
She collects vintage comic books from the 1960s.
The play’s comic relief lightened the heavy plot.
cn: 他的喜剧节奏让观众笑得前仰后合。
她收藏20世纪60年代的复古漫画书。
剧中滑稽的调剂缓和了沉重的情节。

en: The general issued a command to retreat.
She commands great respect in her field.
The hill commands a view of the entire valley.
cn: 将军下达了撤退命令。
她在自己的领域备受尊敬。
这座山丘俯瞰整个山谷。

definitions.definition: 纪念；庆祝（重要事件或人物）
作为对…的纪念（如仪式、纪念碑等）

en: The statue was built to commemorate the heroes of the war.
Every year, we commemorate our founder's birthday with a charity event.
The museum exhibit commemorates the 100th anniversary of the civil rights movement.
cn: 这座雕像旨在纪念战争中的英雄们。
每年我们通过慈善活动纪念创始人的诞辰。
博物馆展览纪念了民权运动100周年。

en: The ceremony will commence at noon.
She commenced her speech with a quote from Shakespeare.
Construction is scheduled to commence next month.
cn: 仪式将于中午开始。
她以一句莎士比亚的引言开始了演讲。
工程计划于下个月动工。

en: The teacher commended her students for their creative projects.
I commend this book to anyone interested in history.
The dying knight commended his soul to God.
cn: 老师表扬了学生们富有创意的作业。
我向所有对历史感兴趣的人推荐这本书。
垂死的骑士将自己的灵魂托付给上帝。

definitions.definition: 评论；解说（对事件、文本等的详细分析或解释）
实况报道（尤指体育比赛或新闻事件的现场描述）

en: The book includes a detailed commentary on Shakespeare’s sonnets.
His lively commentary made the football match even more exciting.
The documentary features commentary by leading scientists.
cn: 这本书包含对莎士比亚十四行诗的详细评注。
他生动的实况解说让足球比赛更加精彩。
这部纪录片收录了顶尖科学家的解说。

en: The city is a major commercial hub in Asia.
The TV show was interrupted by too many commercials.
She has a degree in commercial art.
cn: 这座城市是亚洲主要的商业中心。
电视节目被过多的广告打断。
她拥有商业美术学位。

en: The artist received a commission to paint a mural for the city hall.
She earns a 10% commission on every sale she makes.
The government appointed a commission to investigate the incident.
cn: 这位艺术家受委托为市政厅绘制壁画。
她每笔销售可获得10%的佣金。
政府任命了一个委员会调查该事件。

definitions.definition: 做（错事或非法的事）；承诺；投入（时间/资源）

en: She refused to commit to a specific deadline.
The act commits him to a lifelong obligation.
The software commit records all code changes.
cn: 她拒绝承诺具体截止时间。
这一行为使他承担了终身义务。
这次代码提交记录了所有修改。

en: She showed great commitment to her work.
The company made a commitment to reduce carbon emissions.
His commitment to the team inspired others.
cn: 她对工作表现出极大的投入。
该公司承诺减少碳排放。
他对团队的忠诚激励了其他人。

definitions.definition: 委员会（由一群人组成的正式组织，负责特定任务或决策）
全体委员（集合名词，指委员会成员的总称）

en: The committee unanimously approved the new policy.
She was elected chair of the finance committee.
The committee meets every Thursday to discuss progress.
cn: 委员会一致通过了新政策。
她当选为财务委员会主席。
委员会每周四开会讨论进展。

definitions.definition: 商品（可批量生产或交易的有形物品）
有用之物；便利的条件（抽象意义）

en: Crude oil is a globally traded commodity.
Time is the most precious commodity for entrepreneurs.
The region’s mild climate is a valuable agricultural commodity.
cn: 原油是一种全球交易的商品。
时间是对创业者最宝贵的资源。
该地区温和的气候是农业的有利条件。

en: The movie's plot is entertaining but ultimately commonplace.
His speech was full of political commonplaces.
Smartphones are now a commonplace sight in public transport.
cn: 这部电影的情节有趣，但本质上很老套。
他的演讲充斥着政治陈词滥调。
智能手机在公共交通中已是司空见惯的景象。

definitions.definition: 联邦（指国家或政治实体联合体）
公共利益；公共福利（古义）

en: The Commonwealth of Nations includes 54 member states.
He dedicated his life to the commonwealth of his community.
In the 17th century, "commonwealth" often referred to a republican form of government.
cn: 英联邦包含54个成员国。
他毕生致力于社区的公共利益。
17世纪时，“commonwealth”常指共和政体。

en: Bees communicate through dances to indicate flower locations.
The manager failed to communicate the new policy clearly.
Social media helps people communicate across borders.
cn: 蜜蜂通过舞蹈传递花朵位置信息。
经理未能清晰传达新政策。
社交媒体帮助人们跨国界交流。

definitions.definition: 交流，沟通（信息或思想的传递）

en: Effective communication is key to a successful team.
The invention of the telephone revolutionized communication.
She received an official communication from the university.
cn: 有效沟通是团队成功的关键。
电话的发明彻底改变了通信方式。
她收到了大学发来的正式通知。

definitions.definition: 社区；群体（共享空间或兴趣的人群）
共同体（因共同特征联结的集体）

en: The local community organized a charity event.
Online communities connect people across the globe.
Biodiversity is crucial for a healthy ecosystem community.
cn: 当地社区组织了一场慈善活动。
网络社群将世界各地的人们联结起来。
生物多样性对健康的生态群落至关重要。

definitions.definition: 减刑；交换（债务、付款方式等）

en: She commutes from the suburbs to downtown every day.
The judge commuted his sentence from death to life imprisonment.
They agreed to commute their loan payments to a lump sum.
cn: 她每天从郊区通勤到市中心。
法官将他的死刑减为无期徒刑。
他们同意将分期贷款改为一次性付清。

en: The apartment is small but compact, with clever storage solutions.
The machine compacts trash into blocks for recycling.
They signed a compact to share resources during the project.
cn: 这间公寓虽小但布局紧凑，配有巧妙的储物设计。
这台机器将垃圾压缩成块以便回收。
他们签署了一份协议，约定在项目中共享资源。

definitions.definition: （书籍或产品的）配套指南或物品

en: She was my faithful companion during the journey.
The book includes a companion website with interactive exercises.
Dogs are often considered ideal companions for the elderly.
cn: 她是旅途中我忠实的伙伴。
这本书配有包含互动练习的配套网站。
狗常被视为老年人的理想伴侣。

definitions.definition: 比得上的（常与介词 to 连用）

en: The two experiments yielded comparable results.
His writing is hardly comparable to Hemingway's.
The prices are comparable across all major retailers.
cn: 两次实验得出了可比的结果。
他的文笔很难与海明威相提并论。
所有主要零售商的价格都相差无几。

en: She compared the two paintings carefully.
This model cannot compare with the latest version.
Teachers often compare students' progress.
cn: 她仔细比较了两幅画。
这个型号无法与最新版相提并论。
教师常对比学生的进步情况。

en: The comparison between the two paintings reveals subtle differences.
His achievements pale in comparison to hers.
The study makes a detailed comparison of urban and rural lifestyles.
cn: 两幅画的对比显示出细微差异。
他的成就与她的相比黯然失色。
该研究对城乡生活方式进行了详细对比。

en: She stored her jewelry in a small compartment of the suitcase.
Each compartment of the train has its own temperature control.
His mind works in rigid compartments, never mixing logic and emotion.
cn: 她将珠宝存放在行李箱的一个小隔层里。
火车的每个车厢都有独立的温控系统。
他的思维严格分区，从不混淆逻辑与情感。

definitions.definition: （观点、方法等）相容的，不矛盾的

en: The software is compatible with both Windows and Mac.
Their personalities are highly compatible.
The theory must be compatible with experimental data.
cn: 该软件兼容Windows和Mac系统。
他们的性格非常合得来。
理论必须与实验数据相符。

en: The law compels employers to provide safe working conditions.
Her speech was so compelling that the audience applauded for minutes.
Hunger compelled him to steal a loaf of bread.
cn: 法律强制雇主提供安全的工作环境。
她的演讲极具感染力，观众鼓掌长达数分钟。
饥饿迫使他偷了一条面包。

en: The company will compensate employees for overtime work.
Her enthusiasm compensates for her lack of experience.
The sweet flavor compensates the bitterness of the medicine.
cn: 公司会补偿员工的加班时间。
她的热情弥补了经验不足。
甜味抵消了药物的苦味。

en: Athletes from 50 countries will compete in the Olympics.
The two companies compete fiercely for market share.
She refused to compete with her colleagues for promotion.
cn: 50个国家的运动员将角逐奥运会。
这两家公司为市场份额激烈竞争。
她拒绝与同事争夺晋升机会。

definitions.definition: 能力，胜任（完成某任务所需的技能或知识）
权限，管辖权（法律或官方认可的职权范围）

en: Her linguistic competence impressed the interview panel.
The court questioned his competence to stand trial.
This task falls within the competence of the local government.
cn: 她的语言能力给面试小组留下了深刻印象。
法庭质疑他是否具备受审的行为能力。
此项任务属于地方政府的职权范围。

en: She has a highly competitive nature.
Our prices are more competitive than other brands.
The job market is extremely competitive this year.
cn: 她天性非常争强好胜。
我们的价格比其他品牌更有竞争力。
今年就业市场竞争异常激烈。

definitions.definition: 编译（将代码转换为机器语言）

en: The librarian will compile a list of rare manuscripts.
Python programs must be compiled into bytecode before execution.
She compiled years of research into a comprehensive report.
cn: 图书馆员将汇编一份稀有手稿目录。
Python 程序需先编译为字节码才能运行。
她将多年的研究整理成一份详尽的报告。

en: She complained about the noisy neighbors.
Customers may complain directly to the manager.
He never complains despite his difficulties.
cn: 她抱怨邻居太吵闹。
顾客可直接向经理投诉。
尽管困难重重，他从不诉苦。

definitions.definition: 抱怨；投诉；疾病（尤指慢性病）

en: She filed a formal complaint about the noise pollution.
His constant complaints made the team morale drop.
The doctor noted fatigue as a common complaint among patients.
cn: 她就噪音污染问题提交了正式投诉。
他不断的抱怨让团队士气低落。
医生指出疲劳是患者的常见症状。

en: The wine perfectly complements the cheese.
A good listener is a complement to a great conversation.
The team needs players with different skills to complement each other.
cn: 这款酒与奶酪搭配得恰到好处。
善于倾听的人能为精彩对话锦上添花。
团队需要技能互补的成员。

en: The human brain is a highly complex organ.
She developed a complex about her appearance after the incident.
The shopping complex includes a cinema and a gym.
cn: 人脑是一个高度复杂的器官。
那次事件后，她对自身外貌产生了情结。
这个商业综合体包含电影院和健身房。

en: Her fair complexion burned easily in the sun.
The political complexion of the country has shifted dramatically.
A healthy diet can improve your complexion.
cn: 她白皙的皮肤在阳光下很容易晒伤。
该国的政治格局已发生巨变。
健康饮食能改善肤色。

definitions.definition: （结构或系统）由许多相互关联的部分组成的

en: The instructions were so complicated that I gave up.
Their relationship is complicated by cultural differences.
The machine has a complicated mechanism with dozens of moving parts.
cn: 这些说明太复杂了，我直接放弃了。
文化差异使他们的关系变得复杂。
这台机器的结构很复杂，有数十个活动部件。

en: The surgery went well, but later he developed a complication.
Adding new rules will only create more complications.
Her absence was an unexpected complication in our plan.
cn: 手术很成功，但他后来出现了并发症。
增加新规则只会带来更多麻烦。
她的缺席是我们计划中意外的变数。

en: She blushed at the unexpected compliment.
He complimented her on her excellent presentation.
A sincere compliment can brighten someone's day.
cn: 她因意外的赞美而脸红。
他称赞她的演讲非常出色。
真诚的赞美能点亮他人的一天。

en: All members must comply with the club's regulations.
The software complies with international security standards.
Failure to comply may result in penalties.
cn: 所有成员必须遵守俱乐部的规定。
该软件符合国际安全标准。
未遵守规定可能导致处罚。

en: Each component of the machine must be tested separately.
Trust is a key component in any successful relationship.
The chemical analysis revealed the component elements of the compound.
cn: 机器的每个组件都必须单独测试。
信任是任何成功关系的核心要素。
化学分析揭示了该化合物的组成元素。

definitions.definition: 组成，构成（将部分组合成整体）

en: Water is composed of hydrogen and oxygen.
Mozart composed this symphony at the age of eight.
She took a deep breath to compose herself before the speech.
cn: 水由氢和氧组成。
莫扎特八岁时创作了这首交响曲。
演讲前，她深呼吸以平复情绪。

en: The sculpture is made of a composite material.
This alloy is a composite of three metals.
Her style is a composite of classical and modern influences.
cn: 这座雕塑由复合材料制成。
这种合金是三种金属的合成物。
她的风格融合了古典与现代元素。

definitions.definition: 化合物；复合物；围起来的场地

en: Water is a compound of hydrogen and oxygen.
The pharmacist compounded a special medicine for the patient.
The embassy was located inside a heavily guarded compound.
cn: 水是氢和氧的化合物。
药剂师为患者调配了一种特殊药物。
大使馆位于一个戒备森严的大院内。

en: His comprehension of advanced physics is impressive.
The reading comprehension section tests your ability to analyze texts.
She nodded in comprehension as the explanation unfolded.
cn: 他对高等物理的理解令人印象深刻。
阅读理解部分测试你分析文本的能力。
随着解释展开，她点头表示理解。

en: The university offers a comprehensive course on European history.
She has a comprehensive understanding of the issue.
The report provides a comprehensive analysis of market trends.
cn: 这所大学提供一门关于欧洲历史的综合课程。
她对这一问题有全面的理解。
该报告对市场趋势进行了全面分析。

en: The two parties reached a compromise after lengthy negotiations.
She refused to compromise her principles for financial gain.
A good designer knows how to compromise between aesthetics and functionality.
cn: 双方经过漫长谈判后达成妥协。
她拒绝为经济利益放弃原则。
优秀的设计师懂得在美学与功能性之间取得平衡。

en: Wearing seat belts is compulsory in most countries.
English is a compulsory subject in many schools.
The government introduced compulsory voting to increase civic engagement.
cn: 在大多数国家，系安全带是强制性的。
英语是许多学校的必修科目。
政府推行强制投票以提高公民参与度。

en: The system can compute complex equations in seconds.
We need to compute the total cost before submitting the proposal.
Early astronomers computed planetary motions by hand.
cn: 该系统能在几秒内完成复杂方程的计算。
提交提案前，我们需要估算总成本。
早期天文学家徒手计算行星运行轨迹。

definitions.definition: 让步，退让（尤指在争论或竞争中）

en: After hours of debate, he finally conceded the point.
The team conceded defeat when their star player was injured.
She conceded gracefully, allowing her opponent to take the lead.
cn: 经过数小时辩论，他终于承认了这一点。
球队在主力队员受伤后认输了。
她优雅地让步，让对手取得领先。

en: She struggled to conceive a solution to the complex problem.
The artist conceived the sculpture during a trip to Italy.
After years of trying, they finally conceived a child.
cn: 她难以构想出这个复杂问题的解决方案。
这位艺术家在意大利旅行时构思了这座雕塑。
经过多年尝试，他们终于成功怀孕。

definitions.definition: 集中（注意力、资源等）；浓缩（液体）

en: She needs to concentrate on her exam preparation.
The juice is concentrated to reduce shipping costs.
The team concentrated their efforts on solving the core issue.
cn: 她需要集中精力备考。
果汁被浓缩以降低运输成本。
团队集中力量解决核心问题。

en: The concentration of students in the library increased during exam week.
She struggled to maintain concentration while working in a noisy environment.
The concentration of salt in seawater is about 3.5%.
cn: 考试周期间，图书馆里的学生更加集中了。
在嘈杂的环境中，她难以保持专注。
海水中盐的浓度约为3.5%。

en: The concept of democracy varies across cultures.
She struggled to grasp the abstract concept.
The artist’s work challenges traditional concepts of beauty.
cn: 民主的概念因文化而异。
她难以理解这个抽象概念。
这位艺术家的作品挑战了传统的美学观念。

en: The artist's conception of the future was both bold and imaginative.
Conception occurs when a sperm fertilizes an egg.
His conception of justice differs greatly from traditional views.
cn: 这位艺术家对未来的构想既大胆又富有想象力。
受孕发生在精子与卵子结合时。
他对正义的理解与传统观点大相径庭。

en: The environmental issue is a major concern for scientists.
This contract concerns all departments in the company.
Her health began to concern her family.
cn: 环境问题是科学家们的主要关切。
这份合同涉及公司所有部门。
她的健康状况开始让家人担忧。

en: Her report was concise and to the point.
The manual provides concise instructions for assembly.
A concise summary saves readers' time.
cn: 她的报告简洁扼要。
手册提供了简明的组装说明。
简洁的总结能为读者节省时间。

en: The meeting will conclude at 5 PM.
From the evidence, we can conclude that the theory is correct.
The treaty concluded after months of negotiation.
cn: 会议将在下午五点结束。
根据证据，我们可以断定该理论是正确的。
经过数月谈判，条约最终达成。

en: The UN issued a statement to condemn the violent acts.
The court condemned him to life imprisonment.
Poor sanitation condemned the village to repeated epidemics.
cn: 联合国发表声明谴责暴力行为。
法庭判处他无期徒刑。
恶劣的卫生条件使该村屡遭疫情肆虐。

en: The cold air caused the steam to condense into water droplets.
She condensed the 200-page report into a 10-page summary.
The galaxy’s gas clouds slowly condense to form new stars.
cn: 冷空气使水蒸气凝结成水滴。
她将200页的报告压缩成10页的摘要。
星系的气体云逐渐凝聚，形成新的恒星。

en: The teacher will conduct the students to the museum.
Copper conducts electricity efficiently.
His professional conduct impressed the committee.
cn: 老师将带领学生们去博物馆。
铜能高效导电。
他的职业行为给委员会留下了深刻印象。

en: The university will confer an honorary degree upon the scientist.
The team needs to confer before making a final decision.
She conferred with her lawyer about the contract details.
cn: 大学将授予这位科学家荣誉学位。
团队需商讨后再作最终决定。
她就合同细节与律师交换了意见。

en: The annual tech conference attracts innovators worldwide.
She presented her research at an international conference.
The Ivy League is a prestigious athletic conference.
cn: 年度科技会议吸引了全球的创新者。
她在一次国际会议上展示了她的研究。
常春藤联盟是一个著名的体育联合会。

en: She spoke with confidence during the presentation.
His confidence in the team inspired everyone.
The information was shared in strict confidence.
cn: 她在演讲中充满自信。
他对团队的信任鼓舞了所有人。
该信息被严格保密（古义残留）。

en: She gave a confident presentation despite her nervousness.
His confident tone convinced everyone of his plan.
True leaders are confident yet humble.
cn: 尽管紧张，她仍做出了自信的演讲。
他自信的语气让所有人都相信了他的计划。
真正的领导者自信而谦逊。

en: All patient records are strictly confidential.
She spoke in a confidential tone, leaning closer.
The lawyer has access to confidential client information.
cn: 所有患者记录均为严格保密内容。
她以信任的口吻低声说着，身体微微前倾。
律师有权接触委托人的机密信息。

definitions.definition: 配置（系统或设备的排列方式）
结构（事物的整体布局或形态）

en: The software allows users to customize the system configuration.
The configuration of stars in this constellation resembles a lion.
Changing the network configuration requires administrator access.
cn: 该软件允许用户自定义系统配置。
这个星座的星群结构形似狮子。
更改网络配置需管理员权限。

en: The study was confined to adults over 30.
The prisoners are kept within the confines of the jail.
Don't confine your learning to classroom lectures.
cn: 这项研究仅限于30岁以上的成年人。
囚犯被关押在监狱的范围内。
不要将你的学习局限于课堂讲授。

definitions.definition: 批准（宗教仪式中的职位或权利）

en: The experiment confirmed the theory.
The bishop will confirm the new members next Sunday.
Please confirm your attendance by Friday.
cn: 实验证实了这一理论。
主教将于下周日为新成员施坚信礼。
请于周五前确认是否出席。

en: The conflict between the two countries lasted for decades.
Her actions conflict with her words.
Resolving inner conflicts is key to mental health.
cn: 两国间的冲突持续了数十年。
她的言行不一。
解决内心矛盾是心理健康的关键。

en: All students must conform to the school dress code.
The software update will conform the data to the new standard.
His ideas did not conform with traditional beliefs.
cn: 所有学生必须遵守学校的着装规定。
软件更新将使数据符合新标准。
他的观点与传统信仰不符。

en: She decided to confront her boss about the unfair treatment.
The documentary confronts viewers with the harsh reality of climate change.
Soldiers must confront their fears in battle.
cn: 她决定就不公平待遇与老板对质。
这部纪录片迫使观众直面气候变化的残酷现实。
士兵必须在战斗中克服恐惧。

en: The sudden change caused great confusion among the staff.
Her answers only added to the confusion.
The room was in a state of confusion after the party.
cn: 突然的变动让员工们陷入极大困惑。
她的回答反而加剧了混乱。
派对结束后，房间里一片狼藉。

en: The bill was passed by the U.S. Congress after months of debate.
Scientists from 50 countries attended the international congress on climate change.
The annual congress of the labor union will vote on new policies next week.
cn: 这项法案经美国国会数月辩论后获得通过。
来自50个国家的科学家参加了这场关于气候变化的国际会议。
工会年度代表大会将于下周投票表决新政策。

definitions.definition: 认真负责的；本着良心的

en: She is a conscientious worker who never misses a deadline.
The doctor took conscientious notes during the examination.
His conscientious objection to the war was based on moral grounds.
cn: 她是个尽责的员工，从不会错过截止日期。
医生在检查过程中一丝不苟地做了记录。
他基于道德理由对战争提出良心上的反对。

en: She was conscious of every sound in the dark room.
He made a conscious effort to improve his posture.
The patient became conscious minutes after the surgery.
cn: 她清醒地察觉到黑暗房间里每一个声响。
他刻意努力改善自己的姿势。
病人在手术后几分钟恢复了意识。

en: She missed three consecutive classes due to illness.
The team won five consecutive games this season.
Numbers 1, 2, and 3 are consecutive integers.
cn: 她因生病连续缺席了三节课。
该队本赛季连续赢了五场比赛。
数字1、2、3是连续的整数。

en: The committee reached a consensus after hours of debate.
Scientific consensus on climate change is overwhelming.
There was no consensus among the participants.
cn: 委员会经过数小时辩论后达成共识。
关于气候变化的科学共识具有压倒性。
参与者之间未能达成一致意见。

en: She nodded to show her consent.
The patient must consent to the surgery.
Silence does not imply consent.
cn: 她点头表示同意。
患者必须同意接受手术。
沉默不意味着同意。

definitions.definition: 结果，后果（由特定行为或事件引发）
重要性，重大意义（正式用法）

en: The economic consequences of the pandemic were severe.
His discovery was of great consequence to the scientific community.
She didn’t consider the consequences before acting.
cn: 新冠大流行的经济后果十分严重。
他的发现对科学界意义重大。
她行动前未考虑后果。

definitions.definition: 作为结果的，随之发生的

en: The flooding was consequent to three days of heavy rain.
His resignation was a consequent action after the scandal.
The theory is elegant and its predictions are consequent.
cn: 洪水是连续三天暴雨的结果。
他的辞职是丑闻后的必然举动。
该理论简洁，其预测也合乎逻辑。

definitions.definition: 因此，所以（表示结果或推论）

en: The road was icy; consequently, many accidents occurred.
She studied diligently and consequently passed the exam with ease.
The company ignored market trends, consequently losing its competitive edge.
cn: 道路结冰，因此发生了多起事故。
她勤奋学习，所以轻松通过了考试。
该公司忽视了市场趋势，因而失去了竞争优势。

en: Wildlife conservation is crucial for maintaining biodiversity.
The law of energy conservation states that energy cannot be created or destroyed.
The museum focuses on the conservation of ancient artifacts.
cn: 野生动物保护对维持生物多样性至关重要。
能量守恒定律指出能量既不能被创造也不能被消灭。
该博物馆致力于古器物的保护工作。

definitions.definition: 保守主义者；保守派成员

en: His conservative views opposed radical social changes.
The party's conservative wing resisted the reform.
She dressed in a conservative style for the interview.
cn: 他的保守观点反对激进的社会变革。
该党的保守派抵制改革。
她面试时穿着风格保守。

definitions.definition: 果酱；蜜饯（尤指用糖保存的水果）

en: We must conserve water during droughts.
This jar contains homemade blackberry conserve.
The national park was established to conserve wildlife.
cn: 干旱期间必须节约用水。
这罐子里是自制的黑莓蜜饯。
建立国家公园是为了保护野生动物。

definitions.definition: 相当大（或多）的；值得考虑的

en: She has a considerable amount of experience in the field.
The project required a considerable investment of time.
There was a considerable difference between the two versions.
cn: 她在该领域拥有相当丰富的经验。
该项目需要投入大量时间。
两个版本之间存在显著差异。

en: She is always considerate of her colleagues' feelings.
It was considerate of you to bring an umbrella for me.
A considerate leader listens to team members' opinions.
cn: 她总是体谅同事的感受。
你为我带伞真是考虑周到。
体贴的领导者会倾听团队成员的意见。

definitions.definition: 由…组成（与 of 连用）
在于，存在于（与 in 连用）

en: The cake consists of flour, eggs, and sugar.
True leadership consists in inspiring others.
The committee consists of ten members.
cn: 这块蛋糕由面粉、鸡蛋和糖制成。
真正的领导力在于激励他人。
委员会由十名成员组成。

en: Her arguments were logically consistent.
He is consistent in his daily exercise routine.
The data shows consistent growth over the years.
cn: 她的论点逻辑上一致。
他坚持每日锻炼，始终如一。
数据显示多年来的持续增长。

definitions.definition: 控制台，操纵台（如电子设备或仪器的操作面板）

en: She tried to console her friend after the loss.
The game console connects seamlessly to the TV.
The priest’s words consoled the grieving family.
cn: 她在朋友遭遇损失后尽力安慰对方。
这款游戏机可无缝连接电视。
神父的话语抚慰了悲伤的家人。

definitions.definition: 巩固，加强（使更稳固或统一）

en: The company plans to consolidate its offices into one central location.
Regular practice helps consolidate your language skills.
The government aims to consolidate national debt by issuing new bonds.
cn: 该公司计划将办公地点合并至一个中心区域。
定期练习有助于巩固语言能力。
政府计划通过发行新债券来合并国债。

en: The bright red flowers were conspicuous against the green leaves.
His absence from the meeting was conspicuous.
Wealthy families often live in conspicuous luxury.
cn: 鲜艳的红花在绿叶衬托下格外显眼。
他缺席会议的行为非常引人注意。
富裕家庭常以显眼的奢华方式生活。

en: The constant rain made the roads flood.
Speed of light is a fundamental constant in physics.
Her constant support helped me through difficult times.
cn: 持续的降雨导致道路积水。
光速是物理学中的基本常数。
她始终如一的支持帮我度过了艰难时期。

en: The chemical constituents of the solution were analyzed in the lab.
As a constituent of this district, I demand better public services.
Hydrogen and oxygen are constituent elements of water.
cn: 溶液的化学成分在实验室中被分析。
作为本选区的选民，我要求更好的公共服务。
氢和氧是水的组成元素。

en: Twelve months constitute a year.
The committee was constituted in 1995.
These actions constitute a violation of the agreement.
cn: 十二个月构成一年。
该委员会成立于1995年。
这些行为构成对协议的违反。

definitions.definition: 宪法（国家或组织的根本法律文件）
构成，组成（事物的基本结构或成分）
体质，体格（人的生理或心理状态）

en: The U.S. Constitution guarantees freedom of speech.
The constitution of this alloy makes it resistant to heat.
Regular exercise improves physical constitution.
cn: 美国宪法保障言论自由。
这种合金的组成使其耐高温。
规律锻炼能增强体质。

definitions.definition: 强迫，限制（通过规则或外力）

en: The tight deadlines constrained their creativity.
She felt constrained by social expectations.
The law constrains companies from polluting.
cn: 紧迫的截止日期限制了他们的创造力。
她感到被社会期望束缚。
法律强制企业不得污染环境。

definitions.definition: 建造，构造（物理或抽象事物）
构想，概念（心理学或哲学中的理论模型）

en: The bridge was constructed in just two years.
Her argument is based on a flawed theoretical construct.
Children learn to construct sentences step by step.
cn: 这座桥仅用两年时间建成。
她的论点建立在一个有缺陷的理论模型上。
孩子们逐步学习造句。

en: She consulted a lawyer before signing the contract.
The team will consult with experts to solve the problem.
He always consults his notes before giving a speech.
cn: 她在签署合同前咨询了律师。
团队将与专家商议以解决问题。
他演讲前总会参考笔记。

en: She works as a financial consultant for a multinational company.
The hospital appointed a new consultant in cardiology.
We hired a consultant to improve our marketing strategy.
cn: 她是一家跨国公司的财务顾问。
医院任命了一位新的心脏病学顾问医师。
我们聘请了一位顾问来优化营销策略。

definitions.definition: 消耗（资源、时间等）；吃/喝；使沉迷

en: The factory consumes 200 tons of coal monthly.
She was consumed by guilt after the accident.
The fire quickly consumed the wooden house.
cn: 这家工厂每月消耗200吨煤。
事故后，她被愧疚感吞噬。
大火迅速烧毁了木屋。

definitions.definition: 消费者（购买或使用商品/服务的人）
[生态] 消耗者（食物链中以其他生物为食的生物）

en: The new law protects consumers from fraudulent advertising.
As top consumers, lions play a crucial role in the savanna ecosystem.
Sustainable brands educate consumers about ethical purchasing.
cn: 新法律保护消费者免受虚假广告侵害。
作为顶级消耗者，狮子在草原生态系统中至关重要。
可持续品牌教育消费者进行道德采购。

definitions.definition: 消耗，消费（尤指资源、能量或商品）
（旧）肺结核（因疾病消耗身体而得名）

en: The government aims to reduce energy consumption by 20%.
In the 19th century, consumption was a leading cause of death.
Excessive consumption of sugary drinks harms health.
cn: 政府计划将能源消耗降低20%。
19世纪时，肺结核是主要致死疾病之一。
过量饮用含糖饮料危害健康。

en: Avoid direct contact with the chemical.
She contacted the manager to discuss the project.
The two surfaces are in constant contact.
cn: 避免直接接触该化学品。
她联系了经理讨论项目。
这两个表面持续接触。

en: The factory waste contaminated the river, killing thousands of fish.
Fear of contamination led to strict quarantine measures.
His reputation was contaminated by false accusations.
cn: 工厂废水污染了河流，导致数千条鱼死亡。
对污染的恐惧导致了严格的隔离措施。
他的名誉因诬告而受损。

en: She sat quietly to contemplate the meaning of life.
He stood on the hill, contemplating the distant mountains.
Before making a decision, take time to contemplate all options.
cn: 她静坐沉思生命的意义。
他站在山丘上，凝视着远方的群山。
做决定前，花时间权衡所有选项。

en: She looked at him with undisguised contempt.
The judge held the protester in contempt of court.
His contempt for petty rules often got him into trouble.
cn: 她毫不掩饰地轻蔑地看着他。
法官裁定抗议者藐视法庭。
他对琐碎规则的蔑视常让他惹上麻烦。

en: Athletes contend for gold medals in the Olympics.
The lawyer contended that the evidence was insufficient.
They must contend with strong winds during the climb.
cn: 运动员在奥运会上争夺金牌。
律师主张证据不足。
他们攀登时必须应对强风。

en: The debate sparked fierce contention among scholars.
She is in contention for the gold medal.
His theory remains a point of contention in the field.
cn: 这场辩论引发了学者间的激烈争论。
她正在争夺金牌。
他的理论仍是该领域的争议点。

en: She won the poetry contest with her original composition.
The election results were hotly contested by the opposition.
The legal team will contest the patent infringement claim.
cn: 她在诗歌比赛中以原创作品获胜。
反对党对选举结果提出激烈质疑。
法律团队将对专利侵权指控提出抗辩。

definitions.definition: 连续的，频繁的（强调重复性，可能有短暂间隔）
持续的，不间断的（古旧用法，现多用 continuous）

en: The continual noise from construction site disturbed the neighborhood.
She made continual efforts to improve her coding skills.
Continual interruptions made the meeting inefficient.
cn: 建筑工地的持续噪音扰乱了整个街区。
她不断努力提升编程技能。
频繁的打断使得会议效率低下。

definitions.definition: 连续性（时间或空间上的不间断状态）

en: The film editor ensured visual continuity between scenes.
Climate studies require data continuity over decades.
His speech lacked continuity, jumping between unrelated topics.
cn: 电影剪辑师确保了场景间的视觉连贯性。
气候研究需要数十年数据的连续性。
他的演讲缺乏连贯性，在无关话题间跳跃。

definitions.definition: 签订合同；感染（疾病）；收缩

en: They signed a contract to build the new bridge.
Cold air causes metals to contract.
She contracted pneumonia during her trip.
cn: 他们签订了一份建造新桥的合同。
冷空气会导致金属收缩。
她在旅途中感染了肺炎。

en: The evidence contradicts his earlier testimony.
She dared not contradict her boss in public.
His actions contradict his stated principles.
cn: 证据与他先前的证词相矛盾。
她不敢公开反驳上司。
他的行为与他宣称的原则相悖。

definitions.definition: 矛盾（指陈述、观点或行为之间的对立）

en: His actions are in direct contradiction to his words.
The lawyer exposed a contradiction in the witness's testimony.
Life is full of contradictions, and that's what makes it interesting.
cn: 他的行为与言论直接矛盾。
律师揭露了证人证词中的矛盾之处。
生活充满矛盾，而这正是其有趣之处。

en: The contrast between light and shadow creates a dramatic effect.
She contrasted his optimism with her own cautious approach.
The data contrasts sharply with earlier findings.
cn: 光影对比营造出戏剧性效果。
她用自己谨慎的态度对比了他的乐观。
该数据与早先发现形成鲜明对比。

definitions.definition: 促成；投稿（常与 to 连用）

en: She contributed generously to the charity.
Fresh air contributes to good health.
He contributes articles to scientific journals.
cn: 她慷慨地向慈善机构捐款。
新鲜空气有助于健康。
他向科学期刊投稿。

en: His research made a significant contribution to the field of medicine.
All employees are expected to make contributions to the charity fund.
The editor rejected her contribution due to formatting issues.
cn: 他的研究对医学领域作出了重大贡献。
所有员工都应向慈善基金捐款。
编辑因格式问题拒绝了她的投稿。

definitions.definition: 设计；发明（尤指巧妙或非常规的方式）

en: She contrived a clever excuse to leave early.
The prisoners contrived an escape plan using hidden tools.
His smile seemed contrived, not genuine.
cn: 她巧妙编了个提早离开的借口。
囚犯们用藏匿的工具策划了一场越狱。
他的笑容显得刻意而不自然。

definitions.definition: 引起争议的；有争议性的

en: The new policy is highly controversial among scientists.
She avoided making controversial statements during the interview.
The artist's work became controversial for challenging social norms.
cn: 这项新政策在科学界极具争议性。
她在采访中避免发表有争议的言论。
这位艺术家的作品因挑战社会规范而引发争议。

definitions.definition: 争议，公开辩论（指观点对立的公开争论）
分歧，争论（泛指任何意见冲突）

en: The new policy sparked a major controversy among scientists.
Her book revived the controversy over climate change.
The decision was made without controversy.
cn: 这项新政策在科学界引发了重大争议。
她的书重新激起了关于气候变化的争论。
该决定毫无异议地通过了。

en: The committee will convene next Monday to discuss the budget.
The president has the authority to convene an emergency session.
Birds convened on the lakeshore as winter approached.
cn: 委员会将于下周一召开会议讨论预算。
总统有权召集紧急会议。
冬季临近时，鸟儿们聚集到湖岸边。

en: Online shopping is valued for its convenience.
The hotel offers conveniences like free Wi-Fi and a 24-hour gym.
He chose the apartment for its convenience to public transport.
cn: 线上购物因其便利性而受到重视。
这家酒店提供免费Wi-Fi和24小时健身房等便利设施。
他选择这间公寓是因为它靠近公共交通，十分方便。

en: The annual tech convention attracts innovators worldwide.
Wearing black to funerals is a social convention in many cultures.
The Geneva Convention establishes rules for wartime conduct.
cn: 年度科技大会吸引了全球创新者。
葬礼穿黑衣是许多文化中的社会习俗。
《日内瓦公约》制定了战时行为准则。

en: She prefers conventional medicine over alternative therapies.
The army used conventional weapons in the exercise.
His views on marriage are quite conventional.
cn: 她更倾向于传统医学而非替代疗法。
军队在演习中使用了常规武器。
他对婚姻的看法相当传统。

en: The railway lines converge at the central station.
Their opinions gradually converged after the debate.
The lens converges light rays to a focal point.
cn: 铁路轨道在中央车站交汇。
辩论后他们的观点逐渐趋同。
透镜将光线汇聚到焦点。

definitions.definition: 转变，转换（如信仰、用途、形式的改变）

en: His conversion to Buddhism surprised his family.
The conversion of the warehouse into apartments took two years.
Use this tool for PDF to Word conversion.
cn: 他皈依佛教的决定让家人惊讶。
仓库改建为公寓的工程耗时两年。
用此工具实现PDF到Word的格式转换。

definitions.definition: 使转变；使转换（形式、用途、信仰等）

en: She decided to convert the attic into a home office.
He converted to Buddhism after years of study.
The app can convert PDF files to editable text.
cn: 她决定将阁楼改造成家庭办公室。
经过多年研习，他皈依了佛教。
这款应用能将PDF文件转换为可编辑文本。

en: The pipeline conveys water to the village.
Her tone conveyed a sense of urgency.
Artists use colors to convey emotions.
cn: 管道将水输送到村庄。
她的语气传达出紧迫感。
艺术家用色彩传递情感。

en: The jury convicted him of fraud based on the evidence.
After serving ten years, the convict was released on parole.
It's hard to convict without concrete proof.
cn: 陪审团根据证据判定他犯有欺诈罪。
这名囚犯服刑十年后获假释。
没有确凿证据难以定罪。

definitions.definition: 使确信，使认识到（常与of连用）

en: The lawyer convinced the jury of his client's innocence.
I need to convince my parents to let me study abroad.
Data alone cannot convince people to change their habits.
cn: 律师使陪审团相信了他的委托人无罪。
我需要说服父母允许我出国留学。
仅凭数据无法说服人们改变习惯。

en: The farmers formed a cooperative to sell their produce collectively.
She has a very cooperative attitude in team projects.
The success of the project relied on cooperative efforts from all departments.
cn: 农民们成立了一个合作社，共同销售农产品。
她在团队项目中表现出非常合作的态度。
项目的成功依赖于所有部门的通力合作。

en: She struggled to cope with the demands of her new job.
The priest wore an ornate cope during the ceremony.
Healthy habits help us cope better with stress.
cn: 她难以应对新工作的要求。
仪式上，牧师穿着一件华丽的斗篷式长袍。
健康的习惯帮助我们更好地应对压力。

en: She tied the package with a thick cord.
The spinal cord transmits signals between the brain and body.
He carefully corded the logs for transport.
cn: 她用一根粗绳子捆扎包裹。
脊髓在大脑和身体间传递信号。
他仔细地用绳索捆好木材以便运输。

en: She gave us a cordial welcome at the party.
The two leaders had a cordial discussion despite their differences.
This herbal cordial is made from elderflowers and honey.
cn: 她在派对上热情地欢迎了我们。
两位领导人尽管存在分歧，但仍进行了友好的讨论。
这款草本甜酒由接骨木花和蜂蜜制成。

en: She pulled the cork out of the wine bottle with a pop.
Cork is a sustainable material used for flooring.
Remember to cork the juice after opening.
cn: 她“砰”地一声拔出了酒瓶的软木塞。
软木是一种用于地板的可持续材料。
打开果汁后记得用软木塞封好。

en: She holds a senior position in a large corporate firm.
Corporate responsibility includes ethical business practices.
The law defines the rights of a corporate entity.
cn: 她在一家大型公司担任高级职位。
企业责任包括道德商业行为。
法律规定了法人实体的权利。

en: He served in the Marine Corps for ten years.
The press corps waited outside the conference hall.
The diplomatic corps attended the state banquet.
cn: 他在海军陆战队服役了十年。
记者团在会议厅外等候。
外交使团出席了国宴。

en: The police found a decomposing corpse in the abandoned house.
In medieval times, plague corpses were often burned to prevent infection.
The novel begins with the discovery of a corpse on the beach.
cn: 警方在废弃房屋中发现一具腐烂的尸体。
中世纪时，瘟疫尸体常被焚烧以防止传染。
小说以海滩上发现一具尸体开篇。

en: The study found that diet and exercise correlate strongly with longevity.
It's difficult to correlate these two sets of data without more context.
Happiness doesn't always correlate with wealth.
cn: 研究发现饮食和运动与长寿高度相关。
缺乏更多背景信息时，这两组数据难以建立关联。
幸福未必与财富相关。

en: She works as a foreign correspondent for the BBC.
The results were correspondent with our initial predictions.
He has been a correspondent with the newspaper for over a decade.
cn: 她是英国广播公司的一名驻外记者。
结果与我们最初的预测一致。
他作为该报社的通讯员已超过十年。

en: The corresponding chapters in the two textbooks cover similar topics.
She received a corresponding increase in salary after her promotion.
The two datasets show corresponding patterns over time.
cn: 两本教科书的对应章节涵盖了相似的主题。
她晋升后，薪资也相应提高了。
两组数据随时间推移呈现出对应的模式。

en: Acid rain can corrode metal structures over time.
The old pipes had corroded, causing water leaks.
Jealousy can corrode even the strongest relationships.
cn: 酸雨会逐渐腐蚀金属结构。
老化的管道被腐蚀，导致漏水。
嫉妒会侵蚀最牢固的关系。

definitions.definition: 腐败的，堕落的；有错误的（如文件损坏）
使腐败；破坏（数据或文件的完整性）

en: The corrupt official accepted bribes for years.
A virus can corrupt important files on your computer.
Absolute power tends to corrupt absolutely.
cn: 这名腐败官员多年来一直收受贿赂。
病毒会损坏电脑中的重要文件。
绝对权力往往导致绝对腐败。

definitions.definition: 服装（尤指特定场合或时代的服饰）

en: She wore a traditional Japanese costume for the festival.
The actors changed costumes quickly between scenes.
Halloween is a time when people enjoy wearing creative costumes.
cn: 她在节日里穿了一件传统的日本服装。
演员们在场景间快速更换戏服。
万圣节是人们喜欢穿创意服装的时刻。

definitions.definition: 委员会；理事会；会议（指正式协商或决策的团体）

en: The city council approved the new budget.
She was elected to the school council.
The council meets every month to discuss local issues.
cn: 市议会批准了新预算。
她当选为学校理事会成员。
委员会每月开会讨论当地事务。

en: She sought legal counsel before signing the contract.
The teacher counseled the student on career choices.
His counsel was to remain patient during negotiations.
cn: 她在签署合同前咨询了法律顾问。
老师就职业选择为学生提供建议。
他的建议是在谈判中保持耐心。

en: She placed the money on the counter and left.
The scientist used a Geiger counter to measure radiation.
He countered my argument with solid evidence.
cn: 她把钱放在柜台上后离开了。
科学家用盖革计数器测量辐射。
他用确凿证据反驳了我的观点。

definitions.definition: 对应的人或物；副本；配对物

en: The CEO met with her Chinese counterpart to discuss the joint venture.
The agreement requires signatures from both counterparts.
The novel’s protagonist finds his counterpart in a parallel universe.
cn: 首席执行官与她的中国对应方会面，商讨合资事宜。
协议需要双方代表的签署。
小说主角在平行宇宙中找到了另一个自己。

definitions.definition: 优惠券（可兑换商品或折扣的凭证）
息票（债券或票据的利息凭证）

en: She clipped a coupon from the magazine to save money on groceries.
The bond’s coupon rate determines its annual interest payment.
Digital coupons are now more popular than paper ones.
cn: 她从杂志上剪下一张优惠券，用于节省杂货开支。
债券的息票利率决定了其年利息支付额。
电子优惠券如今比纸质券更受欢迎。

en: The case was settled out of court.
The royal court moved to Windsor for the summer.
He courted public opinion by donating to charities.
cn: 案件在庭外和解。
王室宫廷夏季迁至温莎。
他通过捐款给慈善机构来讨好公众。

en: He held the door open as a gesture of courtesy.
The ambassador was received with the utmost courtesy.
Common courtesy dictates that you reply to invitations promptly.
cn: 他出于礼貌为他人扶着门。
大使受到了极为周到的礼遇。
基本的礼节要求及时回复邀请。

definitions.definition: 覆盖范围（如媒体、保险、信号等）

en: The news channel provides global coverage of major events.
Check your insurance policy for coverage details before traveling.
The WiFi coverage in this building is excellent.
cn: 该新闻频道对重大事件进行全球报道。
出行前请核对保险条款的保障范围。
这栋楼的无线网络覆盖非常好。

en: He was labeled a coward for refusing to confront the bully.
The soldier despised cowardice more than death.
Her voice trembled, but she refused to be a coward.
cn: 他因不敢对抗霸凌者而被贴上懦夫的标签。
这名士兵对懦弱的厌恶胜过死亡。
她的声音颤抖，但拒绝做个胆小鬼。

en: The cabin felt cozy with its fireplace and soft blankets.
She cozied up with a book on the rainy afternoon.
The café has a cozy vibe that attracts locals.
cn: 小木屋因壁炉和柔软的毯子显得温暖舒适。
雨天下午，她惬意地蜷缩着看书。
这家咖啡馆氛围亲切，吸引了许多当地人。

en: The baby slept soundly in the wooden cradle.
Greece is often called the cradle of Western civilization.
She cradled the injured bird in her palms.
cn: 婴儿在木摇篮里睡得很香。
希腊常被称为西方文明的发源地。
她用手轻轻托着受伤的小鸟。

en: The car crashed into a tree.
The stock market crashed after the news.
My computer keeps crashing when I open this file.
cn: 汽车撞上了一棵树。
消息公布后股市暴跌。
每次打开这个文件，我的电脑都会死机。

definitions.definition: （尤指艺术或想象的）作品；产物

en: The artist's latest creation is a sculpture made from recycled materials.
The creation of the universe remains one of science's greatest mysteries.
Her cooking is not just food—it's a true creation.
cn: 这位艺术家的最新作品是一件用回收材料制成的雕塑。
宇宙的起源仍是科学界最大的谜团之一。
她的烹饪不仅是食物，更是一种真正的艺术创作。

en: The witness provided a credible account of the incident.
Her research is based on credible sources.
To be credible, a news report must be fact-checked.
cn: 目击者对事件提供了可信的描述。
她的研究基于可靠的来源。
新闻报道必须经过事实核查才能可信。

definitions.definition: 相信；把…归功于；记入贷方

en: She has excellent credit and can easily get a loan.
The discovery was credited to a team of young scientists.
You need three more credits to graduate.
cn: 她的信用极佳，能轻松获得贷款。
这一发现归功于一支年轻科学家团队。
你还需要修满3个学分才能毕业。

definitions.definition: 全体船员；全体乘务员；一组工作人员

en: The film crew worked overnight to finish the scene.
The airline crew ensured passenger safety during the emergency.
He hangs out with the same crew every weekend.
cn: 电影剧组通宵工作以完成拍摄。
紧急情况下，机组人员确保了乘客安全。
他每周都和同一伙人出去玩。

en: The police are working to reduce violent crime in the city.
It’s a crime to waste food when so many people are starving.
He committed the crime out of desperation.
cn: 警方正努力减少城市中的暴力犯罪。
在许多人挨饿时浪费食物是一种罪过。
他出于绝望犯下了罪行。

en: The criminal was sentenced to ten years in prison.
Criminal behavior often stems from complex social factors.
She specializes in criminal law and human rights.
cn: 这名罪犯被判处十年监禁。
犯罪行为通常源于复杂的社会因素。
她专攻刑法与人权领域。

definitions.definition: 跛子；残障者（现多视为冒犯性用语）

en: The accident crippled his ability to walk.
The economic sanctions crippled the country's trade.
cn: 事故使他丧失了行走能力。
经济制裁严重削弱了该国的贸易。

en: The country is facing an economic crisis.
The doctor said the patient's fever would break at the crisis of the illness.
Climate change has become a global crisis.
cn: 该国正面临经济危机。
医生表示，病人的发烧会在病情转折点退去。
气候变化已成为全球性危机。

en: The apple was crisp and juicy.
She wore a crisp white shirt to the interview.
The autumn air was crisp and refreshing.
cn: 苹果又脆又多汁。
她穿了一件挺括的白衬衫去面试。
秋日的空气清新宜人。

en: The main criterion for hiring is problem-solving ability.
This study fails to meet the scientific criteria.
Price should not be the only criterion for choosing a product.
cn: 招聘的主要标准是解决问题的能力。
这项研究不符合科学准则。
价格不应是选择产品的唯一标准。

en: She is a film critic for a major newspaper.
Don’t be such a harsh critic of your own work.
The play received mixed reviews from critics.
cn: 她是一家主流报纸的电影评论家。
不要对自己的作品过于苛刻。
这部剧获得了评论家褒贬不一的评价。

en: The project reached a critical phase.
She gave a critical analysis of the novel.
His condition is critical but stable.
cn: 项目进入了关键阶段。
她对小说进行了批判性分析。
他的病情危急但稳定。

en: His criticism of the novel focused on its weak character development.
Constructive criticism helps students improve their writing skills.
She studies film criticism at university.
cn: 他对小说的批评集中于其薄弱的人物塑造。
建设性批评能帮助学生提升写作能力。
她在大学学习电影评论。

definitions.definition: 评价（尤指艺术作品或学术内容）

en: The manager criticized the team for missing the deadline.
She often criticizes films in her blog with sharp insights.
Constructive criticism helps students improve their work.
cn: 经理批评团队未按时完成任务。
她常在博客中以犀利视角评价电影。
建设性的批评能帮助学生改进作业。

en: The crowd cheered as the team won the championship.
Don't crowd the elevator—wait for the next one.
Tourists crowded the streets during the festival.
cn: 人群在队伍夺冠时欢呼起来。
别挤电梯，等下一趟吧。
节日期间游客挤满了街道。

en: This meeting is crucial for the future of our project.
The crucible was a crucial tool in medieval alchemy.
His testimony provided the crucial evidence needed to solve the case.
cn: 这次会议对我们项目的未来至关重要。
坩埚是中世纪炼金术的关键工具。
他的证词提供了破案所需的关键证据。

en: The old wall began to crumble after years of neglect.
She sprinkled cookie crumbles over the ice cream.
His confidence crumbled under the pressure.
cn: 多年失修后，旧墙开始坍塌。
她在冰淇淋上撒了饼干屑。
在压力下，他的信心逐渐瓦解。

en: The machine can crush rocks into fine powder.
The rebellion was brutally crushed by the government.
She had a crush on her math teacher in high school.
cn: 这台机器能把石头碾成细粉。
叛乱被政府残酷镇压。
她高中时暗恋过数学老师。

definitions.definition: 黄瓜（一种长形、绿色、多汁的蔬菜）

en: She added sliced cucumber to her salad for extra crunch.
Cucumbers are mostly water, making them very hydrating.
The farmer grew cucumbers vertically to save space.
cn: 她在沙拉里加了黄瓜片以增加脆感。
黄瓜大部分是水分，因此非常解渴。
这位农民垂直种植黄瓜以节省空间。

en: The year-long project will culminate in a public exhibition.
His career culminated with a Nobel Prize.
The festival culminates with a fireworks display.
cn: 这个为期一年的项目将以一场公开展览告终。
他的职业生涯以获得诺贝尔奖达到巅峰。
节日以烟花表演作为压轴。

definitions.definition: 文化（特定社会或群体的习俗、信仰、艺术等）
培养（微生物或细胞的培育过程）
培育（微生物或细胞）；培养（技能或品质）

en: Japanese culture values harmony and respect.
The scientist cultured bacteria in a petri dish.
Travel broadens one’s understanding of different cultures.
cn: 日本文化重视和谐与尊重。
科学家在培养皿中培育细菌。
旅行拓宽人们对不同文化的理解。

definitions.definition: 累积的，渐增的（指通过连续添加而逐渐增加）

en: The cumulative effect of small daily improvements can lead to significant success over time.
Her cumulative knowledge in the field made her an expert.
The report analyzed the cumulative impact of pollution on the ecosystem.
cn: 每日微小进步的累积效应，终将带来巨大的成功。
她在该领域积累的知识使她成为专家。
报告分析了污染对生态系统的累积影响。

en: The city installed new curbs to improve pedestrian safety.
She struggled to curb her impatience during the meeting.
Strict laws are needed to curb pollution.
cn: 该市安装了新路缘以提高行人安全。
她在会议中努力克制自己的不耐烦。
需要严格的法律来遏制污染。

en: The current situation requires immediate action.
Strong ocean currents can affect ship navigation.
This wire carries an electric current of 10 amps.
cn: 当前形势需要立即采取行动。
强烈的洋流会影响船舶航行。
这根导线承载10安培的电流。

en: The witch cast a curse on the village.
He cursed under his breath when he dropped the glass.
Gambling became a curse to his family.
cn: 女巫对村庄施了诅咒。
杯子摔碎时，他低声咒骂了一句。
赌博成了他家族的祸根。

en: It is customary to bring a gift when visiting a new neighbor.
The judge ruled based on customary law rather than written statutes.
Wearing black at funerals is customary in many cultures.
cn: 拜访新邻居时带礼物是一种惯例。
法官依据习惯法而非成文法作出裁决。
在许多文化中，葬礼穿黑衣是习俗。

definitions.definition: 聪明的，机灵的（古义，现较少用）

en: The puppy has such a cute face.
She wore a cute dress to the party.
cn: 这只小狗的脸太可爱了。
她穿了一条可爱的裙子去参加派对。

en: The seasons follow a natural cycle.
She cycles to work every day.
The washing machine is stuck in a rinse cycle.
cn: 季节遵循自然循环。
她每天骑自行车上班。
洗衣机卡在了漂洗循环中。

en: The gas is stored in a high-pressure cylinder.
The artist used a cylinder to create perfect circles.
Each cylinder in the engine fires at a different time.
cn: 气体储存在高压钢瓶中。
艺术家用圆柱体工具绘制完美的圆。
发动机的每个汽缸在不同时间点火。

definitions.definition: 愤世嫉俗的；怀疑他人动机的

en: His cynical laughter made it clear he didn’t believe a word of her promise.
The article takes a cynical view of political campaigns.
She was cynical about the company’s sudden concern for the environment.
cn: 他嘲讽的笑声表明，他根本不信她的承诺。
这篇文章对政治竞选持冷嘲热讽的态度。
她对公司突然关心环境的动机深表怀疑。

en: She threw a dart at the board and hit the bullseye.
The rabbit darted into the bushes when it heard a noise.
His eyes darted around the room, searching for an exit.
cn: 她向靶子投出飞镖，击中了靶心。
兔子听到声响后猛地窜进了灌木丛。
他的目光在房间里快速扫视，寻找出口。

definitions.definition: 数据库（存储结构化数据的系统）
数据集（特定领域的信息集合）

en: The hospital maintains a secure database of patient records.
Researchers analyzed the climate database spanning 100 years.
SQL is a common language for querying relational databases.
cn: 医院维护着一个安全的患者病历数据库。
研究人员分析了跨越百年的气候数据集。
SQL是查询关系型数据库的通用语言。

definitions.definition: 耀眼的光；令人赞叹的事物

en: The sunlight dazzled her as she stepped outside.
His performance dazzled the audience with its creativity.
The diamond's dazzle under the spotlight was breathtaking.
cn: 她走到室外时，阳光刺得她睁不开眼。
他的表演以创意令观众惊叹不已。
钻石在聚光灯下的璀璨光芒令人屏息。

definitions.definition: 截止期限（必须完成某事的最后时间）
（历史上）监狱周围的死线（越线者被射杀）

en: The deadline for submissions is midnight on Friday.
She missed the deadline and lost her deposit.
During the war, prisoners knew crossing the deadline meant death.
cn: 提交截止时间是周五午夜。
她错过了截止日期，损失了押金。
战争期间，囚犯们知道越过死线意味着死亡。

en: The snake's venom is deadly to humans.
She was deadly serious about her decision.
The two cars collided with deadly force.
cn: 这种蛇的毒液对人类是致命的。
她对这一决定极其认真。
两辆车以致命的冲击力相撞。

definitions.definition: （大学）院长；系主任；（基督教）教长

en: The dean announced new policies for the faculty.
She was appointed dean of the medical school last year.
The cathedral's dean presided over the ceremony.
cn: 院长宣布了针对教职工的新政策。
她去年被任命为医学院院长。
大教堂的教长主持了仪式。

en: The candidates will debate on national television tonight.
She debated whether to accept the job offer.
The issue sparked a heated debate among scientists.
cn: 候选人今晚将在全国电视节目中进行辩论。
她仔细考虑是否接受这份工作邀请。
该问题引发了科学家们的激烈讨论。

en: The invention revolutionized the industry in the last decade.
She plans to achieve financial independence within a decade.
The city's population grew rapidly during the first decade of the 21st century.
cn: 这项发明在过去十年彻底改变了该行业。
她计划在十年内实现财务自由。
21世纪的前十年，该市人口快速增长。

en: The abandoned house showed signs of decay.
Sugar can cause tooth decay if not cleaned properly.
Ancient civilizations often rose and decayed over centuries.
cn: 这座废弃的房屋显露出腐烂的痕迹。
如果不及时清洁，糖分会导致牙齿蛀蚀。
古代文明常在数百年间兴起又衰败。

en: He tried to deceive the public with false promises.
Appearances can often deceive.
She deceived herself into thinking he would change.
cn: 他试图用虚假承诺欺骗公众。
外表常常具有欺骗性。
她自欺欺人地以为他会改变。

en: She wore a decent dress to the formal event.
The food was decent, though not exceptional.
He’s a decent man who always helps his neighbors.
cn: 她穿了一件得体的裙子参加正式活动。
食物还不错，尽管不算出色。
他是个正派的人，总是帮助邻居。

en: The metric system is a decimal system of measurement.
Convert the fraction to a decimal for easier calculation.
The error was due to rounding the decimal incorrectly.
cn: 公制是一种十进制计量系统。
将分数转换为小数以便计算。
错误源于小数部分舍入不当。

en: The general made a decisive move to capture the enemy's stronghold.
Her decisive answer left no room for further discussion.
The final vote was decisive in passing the new policy.
cn: 将军采取了决定性行动，攻占了敌军的据点。
她果断的回答让讨论再无余地。
最终投票对通过新政策起到了决定性作用。

en: She decorated the room with fresh flowers for the party.
The soldier was decorated for bravery in battle.
They decorated the Christmas tree with colorful lights.
cn: 她为派对用鲜花装饰了房间。
这名士兵因战斗中的英勇表现被授予勋章。
他们用彩灯装饰了圣诞树。

en: The government plans to decrease taxes next year.
A steady decrease in temperature was recorded overnight.
Regular exercise can decrease the risk of heart disease.
cn: 政府计划明年减税。
夜间气温持续下降。
定期锻炼可降低心脏病风险。

en: The king issued a decree banning all public gatherings.
The court decreed that the land be returned to its original owner.
Emergency decrees often limit civil liberties during crises.
cn: 国王颁布法令禁止一切公众集会。
法院裁定土地归还原主。
紧急政令常在危机时期限制公民自由。

definitions.definition: 奉献；致力于（时间、精力等）

en: She dedicated her life to medical research.
The book is dedicated to his mentor.
They dedicated a memorial to the war heroes.
cn: 她毕生致力于医学研究。
这本书题献给他的导师。
他们为战争英雄设立了纪念碑。

definitions.definition: 推论，演绎（通过逻辑推理得出结论）

en: From the evidence, we can deduce that the suspect was left-handed.
Sherlock Holmes deduced the murderer's identity by observing tiny details.
The scientist deduced a new theory from experimental data.
cn: 根据证据，我们可以推断嫌疑人是左撇子。
福尔摩斯通过观察细微线索推断出凶手身份。
科学家从实验数据中推导出新理论。

definitions.definition: 扣除，减去（从总量中移除部分）
推论，演绎（逻辑上推导出结论）

en: The bank will deduct the fee from your account automatically.
From the evidence, we can deduct that the suspect was present at the scene.
Taxes are deducted directly from your paycheck.
cn: 银行将自动从您的账户中扣除费用。
根据证据，我们可以推断嫌疑人曾在现场。
税款会直接从你的工资中扣除。

en: The court deemed the evidence insufficient.
She deemed it necessary to apologize.
His actions were deemed unacceptable by the committee.
cn: 法院认为证据不足。
她认为有必要道歉。
委员会认为他的行为不可接受。

en: The company defaulted on its loan payments.
The program will run with default settings.
His default response to criticism was silence.
cn: 该公司未能按期偿还贷款。
程序将按默认设置运行。
他对批评的惯常反应是沉默。

en: The army defeated the invaders after a long battle.
She refused to accept defeat and tried again.
Overconfidence can lead to defeat.
cn: 军队在长期战斗后击败了入侵者。
她拒绝接受失败，再次尝试。
过度自信可能导致失败。

en: The manufacturer recalled the product due to a defect in the design.
He defected to a rival company last year.
Her attention to detail helps her spot even the smallest defect.
cn: 制造商因设计缺陷召回产品。
他去年叛逃到了竞争对手公司。
她对细节的关注使她能发现最微小的瑕疵。

definitions.definition: 辩护的；防御的（古义/罕见用法）

en: The defendant pleaded not guilty to all charges.
In medieval times, a defendant often had to fight to prove innocence.
The lawyer focused on the defendant's alibi during the trial.
cn: 被告对所有指控表示不认罪。
中世纪时，被告常需通过决斗证明清白。
律师在庭审中重点论证了被告的不在场证明。

en: The protesters showed defiance by ignoring the police orders.
Her defiance of tradition inspired many young artists.
The child's defiance faded when he realized the consequences.
cn: 抗议者无视警方命令，表现出反抗。
她对传统的挑战激励了许多年轻艺术家。
当孩子意识到后果时，他的反抗态度消退了。

en: Vitamin D deficiency can lead to bone disorders.
The project failed due to a deficiency in funding.
His main deficiency is lack of attention to detail.
cn: 维生素D缺乏可能导致骨骼疾病。
该项目因资金不足而失败。
他的主要缺点是缺乏对细节的关注。

en: The government is struggling to reduce the budget deficit.
A deficit of vitamins can lead to health problems.
The team's main deficit is lack of experience.
cn: 政府正努力减少预算赤字。
维生素不足可能导致健康问题。
该团队的主要不足是缺乏经验。

en: The dictionary defines "altruism" as selfless concern for others.
Scientists are working to define the boundaries of the black hole.
Her leadership style defines clarity and decisiveness.
cn: 词典将“利他主义”定义为无私关心他人。
科学家正努力划定黑洞的边界。
她的领导风格以清晰果断为特色。

en: She definitely wants to join the project.
This is definitely the best solution.
The meeting will definitely start at 9 AM.
cn: 她明确想加入这个项目。
这无疑是最佳解决方案。
会议肯定会在上午9点开始。

definitions.definition: 定义（对词语或概念的精确解释）
清晰度（图像或声音的细节表现）

en: The dictionary provides a clear definition of the term.
High-definition TVs display images with exceptional detail.
Her speech lacked definition, leaving the audience confused.
cn: 词典给出了该术语的明确定义。
高清电视能呈现细节丰富的图像。
她的演讲定义模糊，让听众感到困惑。

en: The study provides definitive evidence of climate change.
This dictionary is considered the definitive guide to modern English.
The judge's ruling was definitive and could not be appealed.
cn: 这项研究提供了气候变化的确凿证据。
该词典被视为现代英语的权威指南。
法官的裁决是终局性的，不可上诉。

en: She defied her parents and dropped out of college.
The skyscraper's design seems to defy gravity.
His illness defied all medical explanations.
cn: 她违抗父母，从大学退学。
这座摩天大楼的设计似乎违背了重力法则。
他的疾病让医学无法解释。

en: The debate degenerated into a shouting match.
His health degenerated rapidly after the accident.
The film portrays a degenerate aristocrat in 18th-century France.
cn: 辩论演变成了争吵。
事故后他的健康状况迅速恶化。
这部电影描绘了18世纪法国一位堕落的贵族。

en: The officer was degraded for disobeying orders.
Plastic bags take centuries to degrade in nature.
His sarcastic comments degraded the value of her achievements.
cn: 这名军官因违抗命令被降级。
塑料袋在自然环境中需要数百年才能降解。
他的讽刺言论贬低了她成就的价值。

en: She made a deliberate effort to avoid eye contact.
The jury deliberated for hours before reaching a verdict.
His slow speech was deliberate, not hesitant.
cn: 她刻意避免眼神接触。
陪审团商讨数小时后作出裁决。
他缓慢的语速是深思熟虑的，而非犹豫不决。

en: The delicate porcelain vase shattered when it fell.
Negotiating the contract required delicate handling.
Her skin was so delicate that sunlight easily burned it.
cn: 那只精致的瓷花瓶掉落时摔碎了。
谈判合同需要谨慎处理。
她的皮肤非常娇嫩，阳光一晒就会灼伤。

en: The workers demanded higher wages.
There is a growing demand for renewable energy.
She demanded an explanation for the delay.
cn: 工人们要求加薪。
对可再生能源的需求日益增长。
她要求对延误作出解释。

definitions.definition: 证明；展示（通过证据或行动）

en: The scientist demonstrated the theory with a simple experiment.
Thousands gathered to demonstrate against the new law.
Her smile demonstrated her relief.
cn: 科学家用一个简单实验证明了该理论。
数千人聚集示威反对新法律。
她的笑容显示出她的放松。

definitions.definition: （心理学）压抑，否认（一种防御机制）

en: His denial of the allegations shocked the public.
The patient's denial of her illness delayed treatment.
Denial is a common coping mechanism in traumatic situations.
cn: 他对指控的否认令公众震惊。
患者对病情的否认延误了治疗。
压抑是创伤情境中常见的应对机制。

definitions.definition: 表示，象征（通过符号或标志明确指示）
在逻辑学/数学中指“严格定义”

en: A red traffic light denotes that drivers must stop.
In this equation, 'x' denotes an unknown variable.
The term 'AI' now denotes a broad range of technologies.
cn: 红色交通灯表示驾驶员必须停车。
在此方程中，“x”代表一个未知变量。
“AI”一词如今泛指多种技术。

en: The minister denounced the violence as a threat to democracy.
She was denounced to the authorities for hiding refugees.
His speech denounced corruption in the government.
cn: 部长谴责暴力行为是对民主的威胁。
她因藏匿难民被举报给当局。
他的演讲公开抨击了政府腐败。

en: The dentist recommended brushing twice a day.
She has an appointment with her dentist this afternoon.
Modern dentists use advanced technology for painless treatments.
cn: 牙医建议每天刷牙两次。
她今天下午约了牙医。
现代牙医使用先进技术实现无痛治疗。

en: The suspect denied all charges against him.
She was denied entry to the country due to invalid documents.
He can't deny the fact that he benefited from the system.
cn: 被告否认了所有对他的指控。
她因证件无效被拒绝入境。
他无法否认自己从该制度中获益的事实。

definitions.definition: 描绘（用图画或文字表现）
描述，刻画（通过语言或艺术形式）

en: The mural depicts scenes from ancient mythology.
Her novel vividly depicts life in rural America.
The artist depicted the storm with bold brushstrokes.
cn: 这幅壁画描绘了古代神话中的场景。
她的小说生动刻画了美国乡村生活。
艺术家用大胆的笔触描绘了暴风雨。

definitions.definition: 驱逐出境（尤指因非法居留或犯罪）

en: The government decided to deport the illegal immigrants.
In medieval times, nobles were expected to deport themselves with dignity.
The criminal was deported to his home country after serving his sentence.
cn: 政府决定驱逐非法移民。
中世纪时，贵族需以庄重举止示人。
该罪犯服刑后被遣返回原籍国。

en: The bad news depressed her for days.
Depress the lever to start the machine.
Rising inflation may further depress the economy.
cn: 这个坏消息让她消沉了好几天。
按下操纵杆启动机器。
通胀上升可能加剧经济萧条。

definitions.definition: 凹陷，洼地（地理/物理形态）

en: She sought therapy for chronic depression.
The meteorite impact left a deep depression in the ground.
The Great Depression of the 1930s caused global unemployment.
cn: 她因长期抑郁寻求心理治疗。
陨石撞击在地面留下深坑。
1930年代的经济大萧条导致全球失业潮。

en: The court ruled to deprive him of parental rights.
Overwork can deprive you of joy in life.
The law aims to deprive criminals of their illicit gains.
cn: 法院裁决剥夺他的监护权。
过度工作会剥夺你生活的乐趣。
该法律旨在剥夺犯罪分子的非法所得。

definitions.definition: 获得，源自（从某事物中取得或推论）
起源，衍生（常与 from 连用）

en: Many English words derive from Latin.
She derived great pleasure from reading.
The theory derives its name from the scientist who proposed it.
cn: 许多英语词汇源自拉丁语。
她从阅读中获得极大乐趣。
该理论以其提出者的名字命名。

en: The airplane began to descend toward the runway.
His mood descended into gloom after the bad news.
She descended the stairs slowly, holding the railing.
cn: 飞机开始向跑道下降。
听到坏消息后，他的情绪陷入低落。
她扶着栏杆，缓缓走下楼梯。

en: Modern humans are descendants of early hominids.
This tradition is a descendant of ancient rituals.
The document lists all descendants of the royal family.
cn: 现代人类是早期原始人类的后代。
这一传统是古代仪式的衍生物。
文件记录了王室家族的所有子孙。

en: The plane began its descent toward the runway.
She is of Italian descent.
The meeting marked a descent into chaos.
cn: 飞机开始向跑道下降。
她有意大利血统。
会议陷入了混乱。

en: She asked him to describe the accident in detail.
The artist described a circle on the canvas with quick strokes.
The term "Renaissance" describes a period of cultural rebirth in Europe.
cn: 她让他详细描述事故经过。
艺术家用快速笔触在画布上勾勒出一个圆形。
“文艺复兴”一词描述了欧洲文化复兴的时期。

definitions.definition: 应得，值得（指因行为、品质或成就而获得回报或惩罚）

en: She worked hard and deserves a promotion.
His rude behavior deserves an apology.
This ancient temple deserves to be preserved.
cn: 她努力工作，理应得到晋升。
他的粗鲁行为应该道歉。
这座古庙值得保护。

en: The architect presented a bold design for the new museum.
She designs sustainable clothing using recycled materials.
The course teaches the basic principles of graphic design.
cn: 建筑师为新博物馆提交了一个大胆的设计方案。
她利用回收材料设计可持续服装。
这门课程教授平面设计的基本原则。

en: The manager will designate a team leader for the project.
This area is designated as a wildlife sanctuary.
She is the designate CEO, starting her role next month.
cn: 经理将为该项目指定一名团队负责人。
该区域被划定为野生动物保护区。
她是已任命的首席执行官，将于下月就职。

definitions.definition: 值得拥有的；合意的；性感的
令人向往的事物（罕见用法）

en: The house has many desirable features, such as a large garden.
She wore a desirable red dress to the party.
Job security is highly desirable in uncertain economic times.
cn: 这栋房子有许多诱人的特点，比如大花园。
她穿了一条令人心动的红色连衣裙参加派对。
在经济不稳定时期，工作保障非常令人向往。

en: She has a burning desire to travel the world.
The novel explores human desires and fears.
He desired nothing more than her happiness.
cn: 她怀有周游世界的炽热愿望。
这部小说探讨了人类的欲望与恐惧。
他唯一渴望的是她的幸福。

en: She despised his cowardice.
The artist despised commercial compromises.
Don't despise small beginnings.
cn: 她鄙视他的懦弱。
这位艺术家蔑视商业妥协。
勿因起点渺小而轻视。

definitions.definition: 尽管，不管（表示让步关系）
轻蔑，侮辱（古旧用法，现代罕见）

en: She persevered despite the difficulties.
Despite the rain, the event was well-attended.
He helped me despite our past disagreements.
cn: 她不顾困难坚持了下来。
尽管下雨，活动仍有很多人参加。
尽管我们过去有分歧，他还是帮助了我。

en: The train's final destination is Paris.
Hard work is the destination of success.
After years of research, she reached her destination: a cure for the disease.
cn: 这列火车的终点站是巴黎。
努力是成功的必由之路。
经过多年研究，她实现了目标：找到治愈这种疾病的方法。

definitions.definition: 预定的，指定的（如目的地）

en: She felt destined to become a writer from childhood.
The package is destined for international delivery.
Their love seemed destined by fate.
cn: 她自幼就觉得自己注定要成为作家。
这个包裹预定发往国际。
他们的爱情仿佛是命运的安排。

en: She believed it was her destiny to become a great leader.
The destiny of nations is often shaped by small decisions.
He challenged the idea that destiny is predetermined.
cn: 她相信成为伟大领袖是她的天命。
国家的命运常被微小的决定所改变。
他质疑命运是注定的这一观点。

en: The hurricane caused widespread destruction along the coast.
Overuse of pesticides leads to the destruction of soil fertility.
The documentary exposed the destruction of ancient artifacts by looters.
cn: 飓风在沿海地区造成了大规模破坏。
过度使用杀虫剂会导致土壤肥力被彻底破坏。
这部纪录片揭露了掠夺者对古代文物的毁坏行为。

en: The hurricane was highly destructive, leveling entire neighborhoods.
Criticism should be constructive, not destructive.
Some chemicals have destructive effects on marine life.
cn: 飓风破坏性极强，夷平了整个社区。
批评应是建设性的，而非破坏性的。
某些化学物质对海洋生物具有毁灭性影响。

en: The mechanic detached the engine from the car frame.
It's important to detach emotions from professional decisions.
The glacier chunk detached and floated into the ocean.
cn: 机械师将发动机从车架上拆卸下来。
将情感与职业决策分离很重要。
冰川断裂的一块脱离并漂入海洋。

en: She explained the plan in great detail.
The report details the causes of the accident.
Pay attention to the small details in the contract.
cn: 她详细解释了计划。
报告详述了事故原因。
注意合同中的细小条款。

en: The police can detain suspects for up to 48 hours without charge.
Heavy snow detained us at the airport for hours.
The lawyer argued that the evidence was insufficient to detain his client.
cn: 警方可拘留嫌疑人长达48小时而不起诉。
大雪耽搁我们在机场数小时。
律师辩称证据不足，不应拘留其当事人。

definitions.definition: 发现，察觉（隐藏或细微的事物）

en: The test can detect early signs of cancer.
The radar detected an unknown object approaching.
She detected a hint of sarcasm in his voice.
cn: 该检测能发现癌症的早期迹象。
雷达探测到一个不明物体正在接近。
她察觉到他语气中的一丝讽刺。

en: Early detection of cancer significantly improves survival rates.
The device uses infrared technology for motion detection.
Her keen detection of the error saved the project from failure.
cn: 癌症的早期检测极大提高存活率。
该设备利用红外技术进行运动探测。
她敏锐地发现了错误，避免了项目失败。

definitions.definition: 侦探（从事调查犯罪或搜集信息的人）
侦探的；侦查的（如 detective work）

en: The detective carefully examined the fingerprints at the crime scene.
She enjoys reading detective novels with intricate plots.
His detective skills helped solve the decade-old mystery.
cn: 侦探仔细检查了犯罪现场的指纹。
她喜欢读情节复杂的侦探小说。
他的侦查技巧帮助破解了这桩十年悬案。

en: The patient's condition began to deteriorate rapidly.
Pollution can deteriorate air quality in urban areas.
Without maintenance, the old building will continue to deteriorate.
cn: 患者的病情开始迅速恶化。
污染会加剧城市地区的空气质量恶化。
缺乏维护的话，这栋老建筑会持续破败。

en: The plane deviated from its original course due to bad weather.
She never deviates from her principles.
The study deviated slightly from traditional methods.
cn: 飞机因恶劣天气偏离了原定航线。
她从不违背自己的原则。
这项研究与传统方法略有不同。

definitions.definition: 装置；设备（如电子设备或机械工具）
方法；策略（尤指巧妙的设计或计划）

en: The new device can detect air pollution in real time.
She used a clever device to solve the puzzle.
Marketing devices like slogans are essential for brand recognition.
cn: 这款新设备能实时检测空气污染。
她用了一个巧妙的方法解开谜题。
口号等营销策略对品牌认知至关重要。

en: She devised a clever strategy to win the competition.
The engineer devised a new method to recycle plastic.
The property was left to him by devise.
cn: 她设计了一个聪明的策略来赢得比赛。
这位工程师发明了一种回收塑料的新方法。
这笔财产是通过遗赠留给他的。

en: She decided to devote her life to medical research.
The museum devotes a section to local artists.
He devoted every weekend to volunteering at the shelter.
cn: 她决定毕生致力于医学研究。
博物馆专设一个展区介绍本地艺术家。
他将每个周末都用于在收容所做志愿者。

en: The doctor diagnosed the patient with pneumonia.
Engineers are trying to diagnose the cause of the power outage.
Early diagnosis can significantly improve treatment outcomes.
cn: 医生诊断患者患有肺炎。
工程师正试图诊断停电的原因。
早期诊断能极大提高治疗效果。

en: The manager dictated a letter to his assistant.
No one has the right to dictate how others should live.
The treaty was dictated by the victorious nations.
cn: 经理向助理口述了一封信。
无人有权命令他人该如何生活。
条约由战胜国强加制定。

en: The microscope helps differentiate between bacterial and viral infections.
Cells begin to differentiate into specialized types during embryonic development.
Good teachers differentiate their teaching methods to suit diverse learners.
cn: 显微镜有助于区分细菌性和病毒性感染。
细胞在胚胎发育过程中开始分化为特定类型。
优秀的教师会调整教学方法以适应不同学习者。

en: The scent of lavender diffused throughout the room.
His writing style is often diffuse and hard to follow.
Light diffuses when it passes through frosted glass.
cn: 薰衣草的气味弥漫了整个房间。
他的写作风格常常冗长难懂。
光线透过磨砂玻璃时会扩散。

definitions.definition: 消化（食物）；理解吸收（信息）

en: It takes hours for the body to digest a heavy meal.
She paused to digest the shocking news.
The magazine publishes a monthly digest of research papers.
cn: 身体需要数小时消化一顿大餐。
她停下来试图理解这个令人震惊的消息。
该杂志每月发布研究论文摘要。

en: She maintained her dignity even in the face of criticism.
The ceremony was conducted with great dignity.
Every human being has inherent dignity.
cn: 她在批评面前仍保持着尊严。
仪式举行得庄严肃穆。
每个人都拥有与生俱来的尊严。

definitions.definition: 困境（必须在两个不理想选项间抉择的处境）

en: She faced the dilemma of choosing between career and family.
The ethical dilemma left him sleepless for nights.
The politician's proposal created a false dilemma.
cn: 她面临事业与家庭之间的两难抉择。
这个道德困境让他彻夜难眠。
这位政客的提议制造了一个虚假的两难局面。

definitions.definition: 细致认真的（强调持续专注）

en: She is a diligent student who always completes her assignments ahead of time.
The team made diligent efforts to ensure the project's accuracy.
His diligent research laid the foundation for the breakthrough.
cn: 她是个勤奋的学生，总提前完成作业。
团队细致努力以确保项目精确性。
他刻苦的研究为突破奠定了基础。

en: The chemist will dilute the acid with water before use.
His arguments were diluted by irrelevant examples.
The paint appears lighter when diluted.
cn: 化学家会在使用前用水稀释这种酸。
他的论点被无关的例子冲淡了说服力。
颜料稀释后颜色会显得更浅。

en: The room was too dim to read without a lamp.
Her memories of childhood had dimmed over time.
He dimmed the lights to create a cozy atmosphere.
cn: 房间太暗，不开灯无法阅读。
她对童年的记忆随时间流逝变得模糊。
他调暗灯光以营造舒适的氛围。

en: The model calculates the fourth dimension of spacetime.
The room’s dimensions are 5 meters by 4 meters.
Her research adds a new dimension to the debate.
cn: 该模型计算了时空的第四维度。
房间的尺寸是5米乘4米。
她的研究为辩论增添了新的视角。

en: The water supply will diminish if the drought continues.
Her enthusiasm diminished after repeated failures.
The medicine helps to diminish inflammation.
cn: 如果干旱持续，供水将减少。
多次失败后，她的热情减弱了。
这种药物有助于减轻炎症。

en: We will dine at the new Italian restaurant tonight.
The ambassador dined with foreign delegates.
She prefers to dine early during weekdays.
cn: 今晚我们将在新开的意大利餐厅用餐。
大使宴请了外国代表。
工作日她喜欢提早吃晚餐。

en: She framed her diploma and hung it on the wall.
The embassy requires a diploma as proof of education.
In ancient Rome, a diploma granted privileges to soldiers.
cn: 她将文凭装裱起来挂在墙上。
大使馆要求提供文凭作为学历证明。
古罗马时期，官方文件授予士兵特权。

en: The diplomat negotiated a peace treaty between the two countries.
She handled the awkward situation with the skill of a seasoned diplomat.
His calm demeanor makes him a natural diplomat in tense discussions.
cn: 这位外交官促成了两国间的和平协议。
她以资深外交官的技巧化解了尴尬局面。
他沉稳的举止使其在紧张谈判中天生具备外交风范。

en: The phone directory lists all local businesses.
Save the file in the project directory.
Medieval directories often contained maps of pilgrimage routes.
cn: 电话簿列出了所有本地企业。
将文件保存在项目文件夹中。
中世纪指南常包含朝圣路线地图。

en: The accident disabled him permanently.
You can disable the firewall in the settings.
The virus disables the computer's main functions.
cn: 这场事故使他终身残疾。
你可以在设置中禁用防火墙。
病毒会破坏电脑的主要功能。

en: The earthquake was a natural disaster that devastated the region.
His career ended in disaster after the scandal.
Losing her passport was a personal disaster during the trip.
cn: 这场地震是一场摧毁该地区的自然灾害。
丑闻之后，他的职业生涯以惨败告终。
旅行中丢失护照对她来说是个人不幸。

en: The earthquake had disastrous effects on the city.
His careless mistake proved disastrous for the project.
The policy change could be disastrous for small businesses.
cn: 地震对这座城市造成了灾难性影响。
他的粗心错误给项目带来了极糟糕的后果。
这一政策变化可能对小企业来说是毁灭性的。

definitions.definition: 被丢弃的物品；（纸牌游戏中）弃牌

en: She decided to discard the old magazines to make space.
In poker, you must discard two cards before drawing new ones.
The company discarded its outdated policies to embrace innovation.
cn: 她决定丢弃旧杂志以腾出空间。
扑克游戏中，你必须弃掉两张牌才能补新牌。
公司摒弃了过时的政策以拥抱创新。

en: It takes practice to discern the subtle flavors in this wine.
She could discern a faint light in the distance.
Philosophers strive to discern the nature of reality.
cn: 要辨别这款酒的微妙风味需要练习。
她隐约能辨认出远处的微弱光亮。
哲学家致力于领悟现实的本质。

definitions.definition: 释放；排出；解雇；履行（职责）

en: The factory was fined for illegally discharging waste into the river.
The soldier received an honorable discharge after 10 years of service.
The battery can discharge quickly in cold weather.
cn: 这家工厂因非法向河流排放废物被罚款。
这名士兵服役10年后光荣退伍。
这种电池在寒冷天气下会快速放电。

en: The school emphasizes strict discipline in classrooms.
She disciplined herself to study two hours daily.
Psychology is a discipline that explores human behavior.
cn: 这所学校注重课堂纪律。
她严格要求自己每天学习两小时。
心理学是研究人类行为的学科。

en: The journalist refused to disclose her sources.
The report disclosed serious financial irregularities.
He disclosed the package carefully, revealing a rare book.
cn: 这名记者拒绝透露她的消息来源。
报告揭露了严重的财务违规行为。
他小心地拆开包裹，露出一本珍贵的书。

en: The store offers a 20% discount on all items this weekend.
Investors often discount future risks in their calculations.
His theory was initially discounted by the scientific community.
cn: 本周末该店所有商品打八折。
投资者常低估未来风险。
他的理论最初被科学界忽视。

en: She gave him a discreet signal to leave the room.
The furniture had a discreet elegance.
Journalists must be discreet when handling sensitive information.
cn: 她谨慎地示意他离开房间。
这些家具低调而优雅。
记者处理敏感信息时必须谨慎。

definitions.definition: 差异，不一致（指数据、陈述或事实之间的矛盾）

en: There was a significant discrepancy between the two reports.
The accountant noticed discrepancies in the financial records.
How do you explain this discrepancy in your testimony?
cn: 两份报告之间存在显著差异。
会计师发现财务记录中的不一致之处。
你如何解释证词中的矛盾？

en: The data is analyzed in discrete time intervals.
Each chapter forms a discrete unit of the book.
Quantum physics deals with discrete energy levels.
cn: 数据以离散时间间隔进行分析。
每一章构成书中独立的单元。
量子物理学研究离散的能级。

en: The test is designed to discriminate between different levels of ability.
It is illegal to discriminate against employees based on gender.
The chef can discriminate subtle flavors in the dish.
cn: 这项测试旨在区分不同能力水平。
基于性别歧视员工是违法的。
这位厨师能辨别菜肴中细微的风味差异。

en: The vaccine eradicated the deadly disease.
Pollution is a disease of modern industrialization.
She studies rare genetic diseases.
cn: 疫苗消灭了这种致命疾病。
污染是现代工业化的弊病。
她研究罕见的遗传性疾病。

en: He wore a disguise to avoid being recognized.
Her smile disguised the sadness she felt.
The spy’s disguise was almost perfect.
cn: 他戴着伪装以避免被认出。
她的笑容掩饰了内心的悲伤。
那名间谍的伪装几乎天衣无缝。

en: The smell of rotten eggs filled the room with disgust.
His cruel behavior disgusted everyone around him.
She couldn't hide her disgust at the unfair decision.
cn: 腐烂鸡蛋的气味让房间里充满厌恶感。
他的残忍行为令周围所有人感到恶心。
她无法掩饰对这一不公正决定的愤慨。

en: The news of the defeat filled them with dismay.
She was dismayed by his lack of interest.
His expression changed from joy to dismay.
cn: 失败的消息使他们充满沮丧。
她因他的缺乏兴趣而感到沮丧。
他的表情由喜悦变为惊慌。

en: The manager decided to dismiss the employee for repeated tardiness.
The judge dismissed the case due to lack of evidence.
She quickly dismissed the idea as impractical.
cn: 经理因员工屡次迟到决定解雇他。
法官因证据不足驳回此案。
她迅速否定了这个不切实际的想法。

en: The room was in complete disorder after the party.
Genetic factors may disorder the immune system.
She was diagnosed with an eating disorder.
cn: 派对结束后，房间一片狼藉。
遗传因素可能导致免疫系统紊乱。
她被诊断出患有饮食失调症。

en: The general dispatched troops to the frontier.
She dispatched the report within an hour.
The journalist sent a dispatch from the war zone.
cn: 将军派遣部队前往边境。
她一小时内迅速完成了报告。
记者从战区发回一篇报道。

en: The police used tear gas to disperse the crowd.
Sunlight disperses the fog quickly.
Seeds disperse naturally by wind or animals.
cn: 警方使用催泪瓦斯驱散人群。
阳光迅速驱散了雾气。
种子通过风或动物自然传播。

definitions.definition: 取代；置换（某人或某物的位置）
迫使（某人）离开家园或职位

en: The flood displaced thousands of residents.
Digital cameras have largely displaced film cameras.
She felt displaced in the new corporate culture.
cn: 洪水迫使数千居民离开家园。
数码相机已基本取代胶片相机。
在新企业文化中，她感到格格不入。

en: The museum will display the ancient artifacts next month.
Her calmness displayed great courage in the crisis.
The computer display suddenly went black.
cn: 博物馆将于下月展出这些古代文物。
她的冷静在危机中展现出极大的勇气。
电脑显示器突然黑屏了。

en: The city improved its waste disposal system.
He has full disposal of the company's resources.
Proper disposal of chemicals prevents pollution.
cn: 该市改进了垃圾处理系统。
他拥有公司资源的完全支配权。
化学品的妥善处置能防止污染。

en: She disposed the chairs in a semicircle for the meeting.
The factory must dispose of chemical waste safely.
His cheerful manner disposed everyone to trust him.
cn: 她将椅子摆成半圆形以便开会。
工厂必须安全处理化学废料。
他开朗的举止让大家都愿意信任他。

en: Her cheerful disposition makes her popular among colleagues.
The architect planned the disposition of rooms for optimal sunlight.
The will grants him full disposition of the estate.
cn: 她开朗的性格使她在同事中很受欢迎。
建筑师为获得最佳采光规划了房间的布局。
遗嘱授予他完全的财产处置权。

en: She deliberately disregarded his advice.
The safety regulations were treated with total disregard.
Disregard for the rules will result in penalties.
cn: 她故意无视了他的建议。
安全规定被完全漠视。
忽视规则将导致处罚。

definitions.definition: 打断，扰乱（正常进程或状态）
（科技领域）颠覆（传统行业或模式）

en: The protest disrupted traffic for hours.
Streaming services have disrupted traditional TV.
A loud noise disrupted my concentration.
cn: 抗议活动导致交通中断数小时。
流媒体服务颠覆了传统电视行业。
一声巨响打断了我的专注。

definitions.definition: 使消散；浪费（精力、资源等）

en: The morning sun helped dissipate the fog.
He tends to dissipate his energy on trivial matters.
Her anger dissipated after hearing the explanation.
cn: 晨光驱散了雾气。
他总在琐事上浪费精力。
听完解释后，她的怒气消散了。

en: The ancient alchemists learned to distill alcohol from fermented grains.
His advice is distilled from a lifetime of experience in the industry.
The morning dew seemed to distill on the leaves.
cn: 古代炼金术士学会了从发酵的谷物中蒸馏出酒精。
他的建议是从一生行业经验中提炼出的精华。
晨露仿佛在叶子上凝结滴落。

en: The two species have distinct color patterns.
Her voice was distinct even in the noisy crowd.
The law makes a distinct difference between these cases.
cn: 这两种物种有截然不同的颜色图案。
即使在嘈杂的人群中，她的声音也清晰可辨。
法律对这些案例作了明确区分。

en: It's hard to distinguish the twins because they look so alike.
His talent for painting distinguished him from his peers.
The scientist distinguished between the two chemical compounds.
cn: 这对双胞胎长得太像了，很难区分。
他的绘画天赋使他在同龄人中脱颖而出。
科学家区分了这两种化合物。

definitions.definition: 使变形（物理或抽象层面）

en: The mirror distorted her reflection into a grotesque shape.
Politicians often distort statistics to support their arguments.
Pain distorted his face into a grimace.
cn: 镜子将她的倒影扭曲成怪诞的形状。
政客常歪曲统计数据以佐证其观点。
疼痛让他的脸扭曲成一副怪相。

en: The noise outside distracted her from studying.
His speech was designed to distract attention from the real issue.
Bright colors can distract babies easily.
cn: 外面的噪音让她无法专心学习。
他的演讲旨在转移人们对实质问题的注意力。
鲜艳的颜色很容易让婴儿分心。

definitions.definition: 分布（空间或统计上的排列）

en: The distribution of food to the refugees was well-organized.
This map shows the global distribution of rainfall.
The company expanded its distribution channels to reach rural areas.
cn: 向难民分发食物的过程井然有序。
这张地图展示了全球降雨量的分布。
该公司扩展了销售网络以覆盖农村地区。

definitions.definition: 干扰，扰乱（指打破平静或秩序的行为或事件）
骚乱，动乱（尤指公共场合的混乱）

en: The loud construction caused a disturbance in the neighborhood.
Police were called to control the disturbance at the protest.
Emotional disturbance can affect children's academic performance.
cn: 施工噪音严重干扰了社区居民。
警方被召来控制抗议活动中的骚乱。
情绪困扰可能影响孩子的学业表现。

definitions.definition: （人或事物）由不同部分组成的

en: The city is known for its diverse cultural heritage.
A diverse range of opinions was expressed during the meeting.
The ecosystem thrives because of its diverse species.
cn: 这座城市以其多元的文化遗产闻名。
会议上表达了多种不同的观点。
该生态系统因物种多样而繁荣。

definitions.definition: 转移；转向；分散注意力的事物

en: The traffic diversion caused delays for commuters.
Reading is her favorite diversion after work.
The magician’s trick was a clever diversion.
cn: 交通改道导致通勤者延误。
阅读是她下班后最爱的消遣。
魔术师的戏法是一次巧妙的注意力转移。

definitions.definition: 使转向；转移（注意力、资金等）
娱乐，消遣（古义/文学用法）

en: The construction diverted traffic to a side road.
She tried to divert his attention with a joke.
The magician's tricks diverted the children for hours.
cn: 施工将车辆分流到一条辅路。
她试图用一个玩笑转移他的注意力。
魔术师的戏法让孩子们开心了好几个小时。

en: The temple was believed to be a divine place.
She has a divine voice that captivates everyone.
Ancient priests tried to divine the future through rituals.
cn: 这座寺庙曾被认为是神圣之地。
她的嗓音美妙绝伦，令人沉醉。
古祭司试图通过仪式预言未来。

en: They decided to file for divorce after years of unhappiness.
The artist divorced himself from traditional styles.
The scandal led to a divorce between the two political allies.
cn: 在多年不幸福后，他们决定申请离婚。
这位艺术家脱离了传统风格。
这场丑闻导致两位政治盟友分道扬镳。

en: The spinning ride made me feel dizzy.
She was dizzy with excitement after winning the award.
The high altitude can dizzy inexperienced climbers.
cn: 旋转的游乐设施让我头晕。
获奖后，她兴奋得头晕目眩。
高海拔会让缺乏经验的登山者感到眩晕。

en: The ship slowly approached the dock.
The company docked his salary for being late.
Seagulls gathered near the fishing dock.
cn: 船只缓缓驶向码头。
公司因他迟到扣除了工资。
海鸥聚集在渔港附近。

definitions.definition: 教义，学说（尤指宗教或政治领域的权威理论）
官方政策（政府或组织的指导原则）

en: The church upholds the doctrine of original sin.
The Monroe Doctrine shaped US foreign policy for decades.
His economic doctrines were controversial but influential.
cn: 教会坚持原罪教义。
门罗主义塑造了美国数十年的外交政策。
他的经济学说虽有争议但影响深远。

definitions.definition: 躲闪，避开（迅速移动以躲避攻击或障碍）

en: The boxer dodged the punch with a quick step to the side.
She always finds a dodge to avoid doing chores.
The politician’s answer was a clever dodge of the controversial question.
cn: 拳击手向侧面快速跨步，躲过了这一拳。
她总能找到逃避家务的借口。
政客的回答巧妙地避开了这个争议性问题。

definitions.definition: 少量发放（尤指食物或钱）

en: He has been on the dole for six months since the factory closed.
The charity organization doled out food to the homeless.
She accepted her fate without a dole of self-pity.
cn: 自从工厂关闭后，他已经领了六个月的失业救济金。
该慈善机构向无家可归者分发食物。
她接受了自己的命运，没有一丝自怜。

definitions.definition: 海豚（海洋哺乳动物，属鲸目）

en: The dolphin leaped gracefully out of the water.
Scientists study dolphin communication patterns.
Swimming with dolphins is a popular tourist activity.
cn: 海豚优雅地跃出水面。
科学家研究海豚的交流模式。
与海豚共游是受欢迎的旅游项目。

definitions.definition: 领域，范围（指知识、活动或控制的区域）

en: The study of marine biology falls within his domain of expertise.
They registered a new domain for their online business.
The king's domain extended across the entire valley.
cn: 海洋生物学的研究属于他的专业领域。
他们为在线业务注册了一个新域名。
国王的领地覆盖了整个山谷。

definitions.definition: （比喻）穹顶状物体（如天空、山脉等）

en: The dome of St. Peter's Basilica is a masterpiece of Renaissance architecture.
Stars glittered in the vast dome of the night sky.
The observatory has a retractable dome for telescope viewing.
cn: 圣彼得大教堂的穹顶是文艺复兴建筑的杰作。
繁星在夜空的巨大穹顶上闪烁。
天文台有一个可伸缩的圆顶用于望远镜观测。

en: She prefers domestic chores to office work.
The company focuses on both domestic and international markets.
In the 19th century, many wealthy families employed domestics.
cn: 她更喜欢家务而非办公室工作。
该公司同时关注国内和国际市场。
19世纪时，许多富裕家庭雇佣家仆。

en: The dominant team controlled the game from start to finish.
Brown eyes are a dominant trait in humans.
Her dominant personality made her a natural leader.
cn: 占优势的球队自始至终掌控着比赛。
棕眼是人类的一种显性特征。
她强势的个性使她成为天生的领导者。

en: The empire once dominated vast territories.
Her voice dominated the conversation.
This species dominates the ecosystem.
cn: 这个帝国曾统治过辽阔的疆域。
她的声音在谈话中占据了主导。
该物种在生态系统中占据优势地位。

definitions.definition: 捐赠（常与介词 to 连用）

en: She decided to donate her entire art collection to the museum.
Many celebrities donate to environmental causes anonymously.
You can donate blood every three months if you meet the health requirements.
cn: 她决定将全部艺术收藏捐赠给博物馆。
许多名人匿名捐赠支持环保事业。
若符合健康条件，你可每三个月献血一次。

en: The museum relies on public donations to maintain its collections.
She made a generous donation to the local food bank.
Organ donation can save multiple lives.
cn: 博物馆依赖公众捐赠维持馆藏。
她向本地食物银行慷慨捐款。
器官捐献能挽救多条生命。

definitions.definition: 注定；判决（尤指不幸的命运）

en: The prophecy spoke of doom for the kingdom.
His reckless actions doomed the project from the start.
The scientist warned of environmental doom if no action is taken.
cn: 预言讲述了王国的覆灭。
他的鲁莽行为从一开始就注定了项目的失败。
科学家警告说，若不采取行动，环境将面临灾难。

en: She was doubtless the best candidate for the job.
The results will doubtless surprise many people.
His honesty is doubtless, but his methods are questionable.
cn: 她无疑是这份工作的最佳人选。
结果肯定会让许多人惊讶。
他的诚实无可置疑，但方法值得商榷。

en: She made several revisions to the first draft of her novel.
