The military drafted him during the war.
Open the window to create a draft and cool the room.
cn: 她修改了小说初稿的多处内容。
战争期间军队征召了他。
打开窗户通风让房间凉快些。

definitions.definition: 拖拽；缓慢而费力地移动
拖拽的动作；阻力；枯燥乏味的事物

en: The fishermen dragged the net ashore.
High heels are a drag to walk in for long.
The meeting dragged on for three hours.
cn: 渔民们把渔网拖上岸。
长时间穿高跟鞋走路很累人。
会议拖拖拉拉开了三个小时。

en: The plumber fixed the clogged drain.
Constant work drains her energy.
They drained the swamp to build a road.
cn: 水管工修好了堵塞的排水管。
持续的工作消耗她的精力。
他们排干沼泽以修建道路。

en: The city's drainage system prevents flooding during heavy rains.
Wetlands play a key role in natural drainage.
Poor drainage in the field led to crop failure.
cn: 城市的排水系统在暴雨期间防止了洪水。
湿地在自然排水过程中起关键作用。
田间的排水不良导致作物歉收。

en: The play's dramatic ending left the audience in tears.
She made a dramatic gesture to emphasize her point.
The landscape underwent dramatic changes after the volcanic eruption.
cn: 戏剧的震撼结局让观众落泪。
她做了个夸张的手势来强调自己的观点。
火山喷发后，这片地貌发生了翻天覆地的变化。

definitions.definition: 激烈的，猛烈的（指行动或效果）

en: The government took drastic measures to control the pandemic.
A drastic change in temperature can harm crops.
She made a drastic decision to quit her job and travel the world.
cn: 政府采取了严厉措施以控制疫情。
温度的剧烈变化会损害农作物。
她做出了一个极端的决定：辞职去环游世界。

en: The main drawback of this plan is its high cost.
Exporters can claim a drawback on customs duties.
Lack of space is a significant drawback in urban apartments.
cn: 该计划的主要缺点是成本高昂。
出口商可申请关税退税。
空间不足是城市公寓的一大弊端。

en: She lives in constant dread of losing her job.
The villagers dread the coming of the storm season.
His dread was palpable as he entered the dark room.
cn: 她始终生活在失去工作的恐惧中。
村民们对风暴季节的到来感到恐惧。
他走进黑暗房间时的恐惧感显而易见。

en: The dreadful storm destroyed the entire village.
She had a dreadful feeling that something was wrong.
This coffee tastes dreadful!
cn: 那场可怕的暴风雨摧毁了整个村庄。
她有一种可怕的预感，觉得出事了。
这咖啡难喝极了！

en: The dentist used a small drill to remove the decay.
Soldiers must drill regularly to maintain combat readiness.
She drilled the multiplication tables with her students.
cn: 牙医用小钻头清除蛀牙部分。
士兵必须定期操练以保持战备状态。
她带领学生反复练习乘法表。

en: The crops failed due to prolonged drought.
California faced a severe drought for five consecutive years.
There's a drought of new ideas in the current research field.
cn: 农作物因长期干旱而歉收。
加利福尼亚连续五年遭遇严重干旱。
当前研究领域缺乏新思路。

en: The car has dual exhaust pipes for better performance.
She holds dual citizenship in Canada and Japan.
The course offers a dual focus on theory and practice.
cn: 这辆车配备双排气管以提升性能。
她拥有加拿大和日本的双重国籍。
该课程兼顾理论与实践的二元重点。

definitions.definition: 配音（影视作品）；授予称号

en: They decided to dub the movie into Spanish for the Latin American market.
The king dubbed him a knight with the ceremonial sword.
His friends dubbed him "Flash" because he always ran so fast.
cn: 他们决定为拉丁美洲市场将这部电影配成西班牙语。
国王用仪式剑授予他骑士称号。
朋友们给他起绰号“闪电”，因为他跑得飞快。

en: The evidence supporting his claim is dubious at best.
She gave a dubious reply when asked about the missing files.
Investors grew dubious about the company's financial stability.
cn: 支持他主张的证据充其量是可疑的。
当被问及丢失的文件时，她给出了含糊其辞的回答。
投资者对公司的财务稳定性产生了怀疑。

en: The artist made a duplicate of the painting for exhibition.
Please duplicate the document and distribute it to the team.
The keys are identical duplicates, so either will work.
cn: 艺术家为展览制作了这幅画的复制品。
请复印这份文件并分发给团队。
这些钥匙是完全相同的复制品，任意一把都能用。

definitions.definition: 使显得矮小；使相形见绌

en: Snow White lived with seven dwarfs in the forest.
The skyscraper dwarfs all nearby buildings.
Dwarf planets like Pluto orbit the sun.
cn: 白雪公主和七个小矮人住在森林里。
这座摩天大楼使周围建筑相形见绌。
冥王星等矮行星绕太阳运行。

definitions.definition: 详述；沉思（常与 on/upon 连用）

en: The tribe dwells in the mountains.
Don't dwell on past mistakes.
Bats often dwell in dark caves.
cn: 该部落居住在山区。
不要沉湎于过去的错误。
蝙蝠常栖息在黑暗的洞穴中。

definitions.definition: 鹰（尤指体型较大的猛禽）
（高尔夫）老鹰球（低于标准杆两杆）

en: The eagle soared high above the mountains.
He scored an eagle on the 15th hole.
The national emblem features a golden eagle.
cn: 鹰在群山上空翱翔。
他在第15洞打出了老鹰球。
国徽上饰有一只金雕。

definitions.definition: 复活节（基督教重要节日，纪念耶稣复活）

en: We painted eggs for Easter.
Easter Sunday is a joyful celebration.
The Easter bunny hides chocolates in the garden.
cn: 我们为复活节彩绘了鸡蛋。
复活节周日是充满欢庆的日子。
复活节兔子把巧克力藏在花园里。

en: She was known for her eccentric fashion sense.
The old inventor’s eccentric ideas often amazed his neighbors.
The engine uses an eccentric cam to convert rotary motion.
cn: 她以古怪的时尚品味闻名。
这位老发明家古怪的想法常让邻居们吃惊。
这台引擎通过偏心凸轮转换旋转运动。

en: The solar eclipse will be visible in North America next month.
Her talent eclipsed all other performers at the show.
The moon partially eclipsed the sun at dawn.
cn: 下个月的日食将在北美可见。
她的才华让演出中其他表演者黯然失色。
黎明时分，月亮部分遮蔽了太阳。

definitions.definition: 生态学（研究生物与环境相互关系的科学）
生态系统（特定环境下的生物群落及其相互作用）

en: Human activities have significantly impacted the ecology of coastal regions.
She decided to study ecology to better understand climate change.
The book explores the delicate ecology of rainforests.
cn: 人类活动严重影响了沿海地区的生态系统。
她决定学习生态学以更深入理解气候变化。
这本书探讨了雨林脆弱的生态平衡。

en: The government introduced new economic reforms to boost growth.
Solar energy is an economic alternative to fossil fuels.
Her economic use of time impressed her colleagues.
cn: 政府推出新的经济改革以促进增长。
太阳能是化石燃料的一种经济替代方案。
她对时间的高效利用令同事印象深刻。

definitions.definition: 经济的；节约的（指高效利用资源）

en: She drives an economical car that consumes less fuel.
The recipe is economical, using simple ingredients to create a delicious meal.
The government promotes economical energy use to reduce costs.
cn: 她开一辆省油的经济型汽车。
这个食谱很实惠，用简单的食材做出美味的一餐。
政府提倡节约能源以降低成本。

definitions.definition: 经济（一个国家或地区的财富和生产系统）

en: The country's economy relies heavily on tourism.
She practices economy by recycling old clothes.
A carpool system is an economy of time and fuel.
cn: 该国的经济严重依赖旅游业。
她通过回收旧衣物践行节约。
拼车系统是一种时间和燃料的节约。

definitions.definition: 可食用的，适合人类食用的

en: These berries are edible, but their leaves are toxic.
The restaurant uses only locally sourced edible flowers.
During the survival training, we learned to identify edible insects.
cn: 这些浆果可食用，但叶子有毒。
这家餐厅仅使用本地采购的可食用花卉。
在生存训练中，我们学会了识别可食用昆虫。

definitions.definition: 有效的；产生预期结果的
实际的；事实上的（法律或军事等语境）

en: The new policy proved highly effective in reducing pollution.
She is the effective leader of the organization, though not officially appointed.
Vitamin C is effective against common colds when taken regularly.
cn: 这项新政策在减少污染方面非常有效。
她是该组织实际上的领导者，尽管未被正式任命。
定期服用维生素C对预防感冒有效。

en: The new software improved the efficiency of data processing.
Energy efficiency is crucial for sustainable development.
His efficiency at work earned him a promotion.
cn: 新软件提高了数据处理的效率。
能源效率对可持续发展至关重要。
他高效的工作表现使他获得了晋升。

en: The new software is highly efficient in processing large datasets.
Solar panels have become more efficient over the past decade.
An efficient workflow saves both time and resources.
cn: 这款新软件处理大型数据集非常高效。
过去十年间，太阳能电池板的效能显著提升。
高效的工作流程能节省时间和资源。

definitions.definition: 自我（心理学中指个体的自我意识或身份认同）
自负，自尊心（口语中常含贬义）

en: His ego was bruised by the criticism.
In Freudian theory, the ego mediates between desires and reality.
She has such a big ego that she never admits mistakes.
cn: 他的自尊心因批评受挫。
弗洛伊德理论中，自我在欲望与现实间起调节作用。
她自负到从不认错。

en: The pilot had to eject from the crashing plane.
The DVD player automatically ejects the disc after playback.
Protesters were ejected from the government building.
cn: 飞行员不得不从坠毁的飞机中弹射逃生。
DVD播放器在播放完成后自动弹出光盘。
抗议者被驱逐出政府大楼。

en: She wore an elaborate gown to the ball.
The scientist elaborated on her research findings.
The chef elaborated a simple recipe into a gourmet dish.
cn: 她穿着一件精致的礼服参加舞会。
科学家详细阐述了她的研究发现。
主厨将一道简单的食谱精心加工成了美食。

en: Several years had elapsed before they met again.
The deadline elapsed without any submission.
She didn’t notice how quickly the time had elapsed.
cn: 多年过去后，他们才再次相见。
截止时间已过，却无人提交。
她没注意到时间流逝得如此之快。

en: The elastic band snapped when stretched too far.
Her schedule is elastic enough to accommodate last-minute changes.
This fabric has high elastic recovery.
cn: 橡皮筋拉伸过度时断裂了。
她的日程安排很灵活，可以适应临时变动。
这种面料弹性回复性极佳。

definitions.definition: 令人激动的；高度刺激的

en: The electric fan stopped working due to a power outage.
Her performance created an electric atmosphere in the concert hall.
Electric vehicles are becoming more popular as a sustainable alternative.
cn: 电风扇因停电停止运转。
她的表演在音乐厅营造出激动人心的氛围。
电动汽车作为可持续替代品正日益普及。

definitions.definition: 令人激动的；紧张的（引申义）

en: The electrical wiring in the old house needs replacement.
Her performance had an electrical effect on the audience.
Always turn off the power before handling electrical equipment.
cn: 这栋老房子的电线需要更换。
她的表演让观众感到震撼。
操作电器前务必切断电源。

en: The electrician fixed the faulty wiring in our house.
She trained for three years to become a licensed electrician.
We need to call an electrician to install the new lighting system.
cn: 电工修好了我们房子里有故障的线路。
她接受了三年培训，成为持证电工。
我们需要叫电工来安装新的照明系统。

en: The city was plunged into darkness due to a failure in the electricity supply.
Her performance on stage was full of electricity.
Static electricity can make your hair stand on end.
cn: 由于电力供应故障，整座城市陷入黑暗。
她的舞台表演充满感染力。
静电会让你的头发竖起来。

definitions.definition: 电子（带负电的亚原子粒子）
电子技术相关产物（如 electron microscope）

en: An electron carries a negative charge.
The electron microscope reveals atomic structures.
Electrons orbit the nucleus in specific energy levels.
cn: 电子携带负电荷。
电子显微镜能显示原子结构。
电子在特定能级绕原子核运动。

en: The electronic devices in this lab are highly sensitive.
She studies electronic engineering at university.
Modern cars rely heavily on electronic systems.
cn: 实验室里的电子设备非常灵敏。
她在大学学习电子工程。
现代汽车高度依赖电子系统。

definitions.definition: 简洁而精巧的（指设计或解决方案）

en: She wore an elegant black dress to the gala.
The solution was both simple and elegant.
His handwriting was as elegant as his manners.
cn: 她穿着一袭优雅的黑色礼服出席晚宴。
这个解决方案既简单又精巧。
他的字迹如同他的举止一般优雅。

en: Carbon is a key element in organic compounds.
Honesty is an essential element of a healthy relationship.
The hikers struggled against the elements during the storm.
cn: 碳是有机化合物的关键元素。
诚实是健康关系的基本要素。
徒步者在暴风雨中与恶劣天气搏斗。

en: The book covers elementary principles of physics.
She teaches at an elementary school in Tokyo.
The solution is elementary if you understand the core concept.
cn: 这本书涵盖了物理学的基本原理。
她在东京的一所小学任教。
如果你理解核心概念，解决方法很简单。

definitions.definition: 使（思想、境界等）高尚；振奋

en: The crane elevated the steel beam to the top floor.
Reading philosophy books can elevate your thinking.
Her inspiring speech elevated the team's morale.
cn: 起重机将钢梁吊升至顶楼。
阅读哲学书籍能提升你的思维境界。
她鼓舞人心的演讲提振了团队士气。

definitions.definition: 引出（信息、反应等）；诱出（真相、回答等）

en: The lawyer tried to elicit a confession from the witness.
Her speech elicited cheers from the crowd.
The survey aims to elicit honest feedback from employees.
cn: 律师试图从证人那里诱出供词。
她的演讲引来了人群的欢呼。
该调查旨在从员工中获取真实反馈。

definitions.definition: 符合条件的；合格的（尤指具备资格或满足要求）

en: Only citizens over 18 are eligible to vote.
She is eligible for a promotion due to her outstanding performance.
This coupon is eligible for all items in the store.
cn: 只有18岁以上的公民有资格投票。
她因表现优异，符合晋升条件。
此优惠券适用于店内所有商品。

en: The vaccine helped eliminate smallpox worldwide.
We need to eliminate unnecessary expenses.
The team was eliminated in the first round.
cn: 疫苗帮助全球消灭了天花。
我们必须削减不必要的开支。
该队在第一轮就被淘汰了。

en: The university attracts the academic elite from around the world.
She joined an elite group of scientists working on the project.
Elite athletes often train for years to compete at the Olympics.
cn: 这所大学吸引了全球学术精英。
她加入了从事该项目的精英科学家团队。
精英运动员通常为奥运比赛训练多年。

definitions.definition: 清晰动人的（指语言或表达）

en: Her eloquent speech moved the audience to tears.
The poem is an eloquent expression of grief.
His writing is eloquent yet concise.
cn: 她雄辩的演讲让听众落泪。
这首诗是对悲伤的动人表达。
他的文字既雄辩又简洁。

definitions.definition: 上船（或飞机、车）；开始从事

en: The troops embarked at Southampton for the D-Day invasion.
She embarked on a career in journalism after graduation.
The ship embarked 500 passengers before departure.
cn: 部队在南安普顿登船，准备诺曼底登陆。
毕业后，她开始了新闻事业的征程。
这艘船在启航前搭载了500名乘客。

en: His clumsy apology only served to embarrass her further.
Too many rules can embarrass creativity.
She was embarrassed by her lack of preparation.
cn: 他笨拙的道歉反而让她更尴尬。
过多的规则会阻碍创造力。
她因准备不足而感到窘迫。

definitions.definition: 将某物牢固地插入或固定；使融入

en: The journalist was embedded with the army to report the war.
These values are deeply embedded in our society.
The diamond was embedded in a gold ring.
cn: 这名记者随军报道战争。
这些价值观深深植根于我们的社会。
钻石被镶嵌在一枚金戒指中。

en: The statue embodies the spirit of freedom.
The new policy embodies several key reforms.
Her actions embody the principles she preaches.
cn: 这座雕像体现了自由的精神。
新政策包含多项关键改革。
她的行为践行了她所宣扬的原则。

definitions.definition: 浮现，出现（从隐蔽或不可见状态）

en: The sun emerged from behind the clouds.
New evidence emerged during the trial.
She emerged as a leader after the crisis.
cn: 太阳从云层后浮现。
审判期间出现了新证据。
危机后，她脱颖而出成为领导者。

definitions.definition: （作定语）应急的，紧急的（如 emergency exit）

en: The hospital has a special ward for emergency cases.
In an emergency, dial 911 immediately.
She kept a flashlight in her bag for emergencies.
cn: 医院设有急诊病房处理紧急病例。
遇到紧急情况，请立即拨打911。
她包里常备手电筒以防突发状况。

definitions.definition: 情感，情绪（如喜悦、愤怒、悲伤等）
（艺术或表演中的）感染力，激情

en: Her voice trembled with emotion as she spoke about her childhood.
The film captures the raw emotion of human struggle.
He struggled to control his emotions during the debate.
cn: 她谈起童年时，声音因情绪激动而颤抖。
这部电影捕捉了人类抗争的原始情感。
他在辩论中努力控制自己的情绪。

en: The teacher placed special emphasis on critical thinking skills.
In this sentence, the emphasis falls on the first syllable of "important".
His speech lacked emphasis, making it hard to follow his main point.
cn: 老师特别强调了批判性思维的重要性。
这个句子中，重音落在“important”的第一个音节上。
他的演讲缺乏重点，让人难以抓住核心论点。

definitions.definition: 使突出（如通过语调或视觉手段）

en: The teacher emphasized the importance of punctuation.
His red tie emphasized the formal tone of his outfit.
The report emphasizes the need for immediate action.
cn: 老师强调了标点符号的重要性。
他的红色领带突出了着装的正式感。
报告着重指出需要立即采取行动。

definitions.definition: 经验主义的（基于观察或实验而非理论）
实证的（可通过实际验证的）

en: The theory needs empirical evidence to be validated.
Her approach was purely empirical, relying on decades of field observations.
Empirical studies show that the new drug is effective in 80% of cases.
cn: 该理论需要实证证据来验证。
她的方法完全是经验主义的，基于数十年的实地观察。
实证研究表明，这种新药对80%的病例有效。

en: She found employment at a local school after graduation.
The government aims to reduce youth unemployment.
His employment of metaphors made the speech vivid.
cn: 毕业后，她在当地一所学校找到了工作。
政府计划降低青年失业率。
他对隐喻的运用让演讲生动起来。

definitions.definition: 围场，围栏（用于圈起土地或动物的封闭区域）
附件（信件或包裹中的附加物品）

en: The sheep grazed peacefully within the stone enclosure.
Please check the email attachment for documents in the enclosure.
Historical records show the enclosure of common lands changed rural life.
cn: 羊群在石砌围栏内安静地吃草。
请查看邮件附件中的文件。
历史记录显示，公地的圈占改变了乡村生活。

definitions.definition: 偶然遇到；遭遇（尤指意外或不愉快的事）

en: She encountered an old friend at the airport.
The explorers encountered fierce storms during their voyage.
His proposal encountered strong opposition from the committee.
cn: 她在机场偶遇了一位老友。
探险家们在航行中遭遇了猛烈的风暴。
他的提案遭到了委员会的强烈反对。

en: The teacher encouraged her students to ask questions.
Good weather encourages outdoor activities.
His success encouraged others to pursue their dreams.
cn: 老师鼓励学生提问。
好天气促进户外活动。
他的成功激励了他人追寻梦想。

en: She endeavored to finish the project before the deadline.
His scientific endeavors earned him a Nobel Prize.
We must endeavor to improve our environment.
cn: 她竭力在截止日期前完成项目。
他的科学探索为他赢得了诺贝尔奖。
我们必须努力改善环境。

definitions.definition: 赋予（才能、品质等抽象特质）

en: The billionaire endowed a new research institute.
She is endowed with exceptional musical talent.
The scholarship was endowed by a local philanthropist.
cn: 这位亿万富翁捐赠成立了一所新研究所。
她天生拥有非凡的音乐天赋。
这项奖学金由一位当地慈善家资助设立。

en: The marathon tests both physical and mental endurance.
This fabric is known for its endurance under extreme conditions.
His endurance through hardships inspired everyone around him.
cn: 马拉松考验身体与精神的双重耐力。
这种面料以极端环境下的耐用性著称。
他在困境中展现的坚韧激励了身边所有人。

en: She endured years of hardship to achieve her dream.
Ancient traditions still endure in this village.
The material can endure extreme temperatures.
cn: 她忍受多年艰辛以实现梦想。
古老的习俗在这个村庄依然延续。
这种材料能承受极端温度。

definitions.definition: 精力充沛的；充满活力的

en: The energetic puppy ran around the yard all morning.
Solar panels convert sunlight into energetic particles.
Her energetic teaching style kept the students engaged.
cn: 这只精力充沛的小狗整个上午都在院子里奔跑。
太阳能板将阳光转化为高能粒子。
她充满活力的教学风格让学生们全程投入。

en: The police are tasked to enforce traffic laws.
Strict penalties help enforce compliance with regulations.
Parents should not enforce their opinions on children.
cn: 警方负责执行交通法规。
严厉的惩罚有助于强制遵守规章。
父母不应将自己的观点强加给孩子。

definitions.definition: 参与；从事（与 in 连用）

en: The teacher tried to engage all students in the discussion.
His speech engaged the audience from the very beginning.
She decided to engage a lawyer for the legal case.
cn: 老师试图让所有学生参与讨论。
他的演讲一开始就吸引了观众。
她决定为这起法律案件聘请律师。

en: Their engagement was announced in the local newspaper.
The professor encourages student engagement in class discussions.
The post received high engagement with over 10,000 likes.
cn: 他们的订婚消息登在了当地报纸上。
这位教授鼓励学生参与课堂讨论。
这条帖子的互动量很高，获得超过1万次点赞。

definitions.definition: 发动机，引擎（将能量转化为机械力的装置）

en: The car's engine roared to life.
James Watt improved the steam engine in the 18th century.
The fire engine rushed to the scene with sirens blaring.
cn: 汽车的引擎轰鸣着启动。
詹姆斯·瓦特在18世纪改良了蒸汽机。
消防车鸣着警笛冲向现场。

definitions.definition: 提高，增强（质量、价值或吸引力）

en: The new software enhances the performance of older computers.
Lighting can enhance the mood of a room dramatically.
Regular exercise enhances both physical and mental well-being.
cn: 新软件提升了旧电脑的性能。
灯光能显著增强房间的氛围感。
定期锻炼能改善身心健康。

definitions.definition: 启发，启迪（使人理解或觉悟）
照亮（古义或比喻性用法）

en: The teacher's words enlightened me about the importance of critical thinking.
Medieval monasteries helped enlighten Europe by preserving ancient texts.
His research aims to enlighten public understanding of climate change.
cn: 老师的教导让我明白了批判性思维的重要性。
中世纪修道院通过保存古籍启迪了欧洲文明。
他的研究旨在提升公众对气候变化的认识。

en: The elephant was truly enormous, towering over the trees.
She faced an enormous challenge in her new role.
The project required an enormous amount of time and resources.
cn: 大象体型极为庞大，高耸于树林之上。
她在新角色中面临巨大挑战。
该项目需要耗费大量的时间和资源。

definitions.definition: 使富裕；使丰富（物质或精神层面）
提高营养价值（如食物强化）

en: Fertilizers are used to enrich the soil for better crop growth.
Traveling can enrich your understanding of different cultures.
The cereal is enriched with vitamins and minerals.
cn: 肥料用于肥沃土壤以促进作物生长。
旅行能丰富你对不同文化的理解。
这种谷物添加了维生素和矿物质以强化营养。

definitions.definition: 登记；注册（成为成员或学生）

en: You must enroll in the course before the deadline.
She decided to enroll at Harvard University.
The program allows students to enroll online.
cn: 你必须在截止日期前注册这门课程。
她决定申请哈佛大学入学。
该项目允许学生在线报名。

en: After the heavy rain, flooding ensued in the valley.
The argument ensued from a simple misunderstanding.
cn: 大雨过后，山谷中洪水随之而来。
这场争论由一个小小的误会引发。

en: The project will entail significant financial investment.
The estate was entailed to the eldest son.
Success entails hard work and perseverance.
cn: 该项目需要大量资金投入。
该地产被限定由长子继承。
成功需要努力和坚持。

en: The festival offers a variety of entertainment for all ages.
Streaming platforms have revolutionized home entertainment.
His jokes provided endless entertainment during the trip.
cn: 这个节日为所有年龄段的人提供多种娱乐活动。
流媒体平台彻底改变了家庭娱乐方式。
他的笑话为旅途提供了无尽的乐趣。

definitions.definition: （对某活动或主题的）强烈兴趣

en: Her enthusiasm for science inspired her students.
The team played with great enthusiasm despite the rain.
His sudden enthusiasm for gardening surprised everyone.
cn: 她对科学的热情激励了她的学生。
尽管下雨，球队仍以极大热情投入比赛。
他对园艺突然产生的强烈兴趣让所有人惊讶。

en: She gave an enthusiastic speech that inspired the audience.
He is enthusiastic about learning new languages.
The team received enthusiastic support from their fans.
cn: 她发表了热情洋溢的演讲，鼓舞了听众。
他对学习新语言充满热情。
球队得到了粉丝们的热烈支持。

en: This ticket entitles you to a free drink.
She entitled her memoir "Breaking Boundaries".
The law entitles workers to paid leave.
cn: 凭此券可免费领取一杯饮料。
她将回忆录取名为《打破边界》。
该法律赋予员工带薪休假的权利。

definitions.definition: 实体（独立存在的事物或概念）
（法律或商业中的）独立法人单位

en: The company was registered as a separate legal entity.
Scientists debate whether viruses should be considered living entities.
The database stores each customer as a distinct entity.
cn: 该公司注册为独立法人实体。
科学家争论病毒是否应被视为生命体。
数据库将每位客户存储为独立实体。

definitions.definition: 企业家（指组织、管理企业并承担风险的人）

en: The young entrepreneur launched a tech startup with just a small loan.
Successful entrepreneurs often embrace failure as a learning opportunity.
She was recognized as a social entrepreneur for her sustainable business model.
cn: 这位年轻的企业家仅凭一小笔贷款就创立了一家科技公司。
成功的企业家常将失败视为学习机会。
她因可持续的商业模式被公认为社会企业家。

definitions.definition: 环境（自然或社会条件的总和）

en: The company aims to reduce its impact on the environment.
Children thrive in a supportive learning environment.
Polar bears are highly sensitive to changes in their Arctic environment.
cn: 该公司致力于减少对环境的影响。
儿童在支持性的学习环境中茁壮成长。
北极熊对北极环境的变化极为敏感。

definitions.definition: 设想，想象（未来可能的情景）

en: She could hardly envisage living in a foreign country alone.
The project was more complex than they had originally envisaged.
We must envisage the challenges ahead with clarity.
cn: 她难以想象独自在异国生活的情景。
该项目比他们最初设想的更为复杂。
我们必须清醒地正视未来的挑战。

definitions.definition: 纪元；时代（地质、天文或历史的重要分期）
重大事件的开端或转折点

en: The invention of the printing press marked a new epoch in human communication.
The Jurassic epoch was characterized by the dominance of dinosaurs.
Her discovery ushered in an epoch of genetic research breakthroughs.
cn: 印刷术的发明标志着人类传播的新纪元。
侏罗纪纪元的特征是恐龙的统治地位。
她的发现开启了基因研究突破的新时代。

en: The constitution guarantees equality before the law.
Solving this equation requires understanding the equality of both sides.
Gender equality remains a global challenge.
cn: 宪法保障法律面前的平等。
解此方程需理解两边的等式关系。
性别平等仍是全球性挑战。

definitions.definition: 赤道（地球表面距离南北两极相等的假想圆周线）

en: The equator divides the Earth into the Northern and Southern Hemispheres.
Tropical climates are typically found near the equator.
Celestial equator is an imaginary projection of Earth's equator into space.
cn: 赤道将地球分为北半球和南半球。
热带气候通常出现在赤道附近。
天球赤道是地球赤道在太空中的假想投影。

en: The laboratory is equipped with advanced microscopes.
His training equipped him to handle emergencies.
They spent a fortune to equip the expedition.
cn: 实验室配备了先进的显微镜。
他的训练使他具备处理紧急情况的能力。
他们花费巨资为探险队配备物资。

en: The two chemicals are equivalent in potency.
She found no equivalent for the word in her native language.
Silence is sometimes equivalent to agreement.
cn: 这两种化学物质的效力是等同的。
她在母语中找不到这个词的对应表达。
沉默有时等同于同意。

en: The flagpole stands erect in the square.
They plan to erect a monument to honor the heroes.
The cat's ears became erect when it heard the noise.
cn: 旗杆笔直地矗立在广场上。
他们计划建立一座纪念碑以纪念英雄。
猫听到声响时竖起了耳朵。

definitions.definition: 削弱，逐渐破坏（抽象概念）

en: The coastline is shaped by constant erosion from waves.
Corruption leads to the erosion of public trust.
Soil erosion can be prevented by planting trees.
cn: 海浪的持续侵蚀塑造了海岸线。
腐败会导致公众信任的逐渐丧失。
植树可以防止土壤侵蚀。

en: The report contained several erroneous conclusions.
His assumption proved to be entirely erroneous.
The software flagged the entry as erroneous due to mismatched data.
cn: 这份报告包含了一些错误的结论。
他的假设被证明完全错误。
由于数据不匹配，软件将该条目标记为错误。

definitions.definition: （火山等）喷发；（冲突、情绪等）突然爆发

en: The volcano could erupt at any moment.
Laughter erupted from the audience during the comedy show.
Violence erupted after the controversial decision.
cn: 这座火山随时可能喷发。
喜剧表演时，观众席突然爆发出笑声。
争议性决定引发暴力冲突。

definitions.definition: 护送者；护卫队；陪同人员

en: The president arrived with an armed escort.
She offered to escort the elderly lady home.
The ship was escorted by two naval vessels.
cn: 总统在武装护卫队陪同下抵达。
她主动提出护送那位老妇人回家。
这艘船由两艘海军舰艇护航。

definitions.definition: 本质，精髓（事物的根本属性）
香精，精华（提取的浓缩物质）

en: The essence of democracy is freedom of speech.
Vanilla essence is commonly used in baking.
She captured the essence of the poem in her translation.
cn: 民主的精髓是言论自由。
香草香精常用于烘焙。
她的翻译抓住了这首诗的神韵。

en: Water is essential for all living organisms.
The essential ingredients of this recipe are flour and eggs.
Time management is an essential skill in modern workplaces.
cn: 水是所有生物生存的必需品。
这道食谱的必要成分是面粉和鸡蛋。
时间管理是现代职场中的必备技能。

definitions.definition: 建立，设立（机构、系统或规则）

en: The company plans to establish a new branch in Tokyo.
His research established a link between diet and heart disease.
The treaty established lasting peace between the two nations.
cn: 该公司计划在东京设立新分部。
他的研究证实了饮食与心脏病的关联。
该条约确立了两国间的持久和平。

en: The garden design reflects a strong esthetic sensibility.
His esthetic approach to photography emphasizes simplicity and balance.
The building’s esthetic appeal lies in its fusion of traditional and modern elements.
cn: 花园设计体现了强烈的审美感受力。
他摄影的审美方式强调简洁与平衡。
这座建筑的审美吸引力在于其传统与现代元素的融合。

en: The contractor will estimate the cost of the renovation.
Her estimate of the situation proved accurate.
Can you give a rough estimate of how long the project will take?
cn: 承包商将估算翻修费用。
她对形势的评估被证明是准确的。
你能粗略估计一下项目需要多久吗？

en: The stars seemed eternal in the night sky.
Their eternal quarrels exhausted everyone around them.
The monument stands as an eternal reminder of peace.
cn: 繁星在夜空中显得永恒不朽。
他们无休止的争吵让周围人精疲力竭。
这座纪念碑是永恒的和平象征。

en: The city is known for its vibrant ethnic neighborhoods.
She studies ethnic music traditions from around the world.
The festival celebrates ethnic diversity through food and dance.
cn: 这座城市以其充满活力的民族聚居区闻名。
她研究世界各地的民族音乐传统。
这个节日通过美食和舞蹈庆祝民族多样性。

en: Teachers need to evaluate students' progress objectively.
The algorithm evaluates thousands of data points per second.
We will evaluate the proposal based on cost and feasibility.
cn: 教师需要客观评估学生的进步。
该算法每秒计算数千个数据点。
我们将根据成本和可行性评估该提案。

en: The fingerprints provided crucial evidence in the case.
Her smile evidenced her relief.
There is no evidence to support this theory.
cn: 指纹为案件提供了关键证据。
她的笑容表明她如释重负。
没有证据支持这一理论。

en: The fingerprints were evident on the glass.
Her happiness was evident in her smile.
There is no evident solution to this problem.
cn: 玻璃上的指纹清晰可见。
她的笑容明显流露出幸福。
这个问题没有显而易见的解决方法。

en: The villain's evil plan threatened the entire city.
She believes no one is born inherently evil.
The documentary exposed the evil of child labor.
cn: 反派的邪恶计划威胁了整个城市。
她认为没有人天生邪恶。
这部纪录片揭露了童工的罪恶。

en: The smell of rain evoked childhood memories.
Her speech evoked strong emotions in the audience.
The painting evokes a sense of mystery.
cn: 雨的气息唤起了童年的回忆。
她的演讲引发了听众强烈的情感共鸣。
这幅画营造出一种神秘感。

en: The theory of evolution explains the diversity of life.
Language is a product of cultural evolution.
The dancers performed a complex evolution across the stage.
cn: 进化论解释了生命的多样性。
语言是文化演变的产物。
舞者在舞台上完成了复杂的队形变换。

en: Don't exaggerate the difficulties; they're manageable.
His claims were clearly exaggerated to attract attention.
She tends to exaggerate when telling stories.
cn: 别夸大困难，它们是可以解决的。
他的说法明显夸大其词，以博取关注。
她讲故事时总爱添油加醋。

en: The project's costs may exceed the initial budget.
Her performance exceeded all our expectations.
Speed limits are set to ensure drivers do not exceed safe velocities.
cn: 该项目成本可能超出初始预算。
她的表现远超我们所有人的预期。
限速是为了确保驾驶员不超过安全速度。

en: Everyone passed the exam, with the exception of two students.
The judge overruled the defense's exception to the evidence.
This rule applies to all cases without exception.
cn: 除两名学生外，其他人都通过了考试。
法官驳回了辩方对证据的异议。
此规则无一例外适用于所有情况。

en: Her exceptional talent in mathematics earned her a scholarship.
This weather is exceptional for December.
The team made exceptional progress in just three months.
cn: 她在数学上的非凡才能为她赢得了奖学金。
这种天气在十二月很罕见。
该团队在短短三个月内取得了惊人的进展。

en: The company warned against excess consumption of energy.
She trimmed the excess fabric from the dress.
His excess enthusiasm sometimes annoys others.
cn: 公司警告避免能源的过度消耗。
她剪去了裙子上多余的布料。
他过度的热情有时会惹人厌烦。

en: Excessive sugar consumption can lead to health problems.
She apologized for her excessive enthusiasm during the meeting.
The government imposed fines for excessive noise pollution.
cn: 过量摄入糖分会导致健康问题。
她为自己在会议中过度的热情道歉。
政府对过度的噪音污染处以罚款。

en: They exchanged gifts at the Christmas party.
The stock exchange crashed due to economic instability.
Can I exchange dollars for euros here?
cn: 他们在圣诞派对上互赠礼物。
由于经济不稳定，股市暴跌。
这里可以将美元兑换成欧元吗？

en: She exclaimed in delight when she saw the surprise.
"That's impossible!" he exclaimed angrily.
The crowd exclaimed as the fireworks lit up the sky.
cn: 她看到惊喜时高兴地叫了起来。
“这不可能！”他愤怒地喊道。
烟花点亮夜空时，人群发出惊叹。

definitions.definition: 排除；拒绝接纳；将…关在门外

en: The policy excludes students with low attendance.
She felt excluded from the conversation.
The price excludes taxes and fees.
cn: 该政策将出勤率低的学生排除在外。
她感到自己被排除在谈话之外。
此价格不含税费。

en: This club is exclusive to members only.
The magazine published an exclusive interview with the president.
She owns an exclusive boutique in Paris.
cn: 该俱乐部仅限会员进入。
该杂志刊登了对总统的独家专访。
她在巴黎拥有一家高档精品店。

en: We went on an excursion to the nearby mountains last weekend.
His lecture included an excursion into quantum physics.
The school organizes annual excursions for students.
cn: 上周末我们去了附近山区短途旅行。
他的讲座短暂探讨了量子物理学。
学校每年为学生组织远足活动。

en: The software will execute the command immediately.
The court ordered to execute the prisoner at dawn.
The contract was executed in the presence of witnesses.
cn: 该软件将立即执行命令。
法庭下令在黎明时分处决囚犯。
合同在见证人面前签署生效。

definitions.definition: 执行（尤指计划、任务或法律判决）

en: The execution of the project was flawless.
The court ordered the execution of the criminal.
His idea was brilliant, but the execution failed.
cn: 该项目的执行过程毫无瑕疵。
法院下令对罪犯执行死刑。
他的想法很出色，但执行失败了。

en: She was promoted to chief executive officer last year.
The executive committee will meet tomorrow.
His executive skills made the project successful.
cn: 她去年晋升为首席执行官。
执行委员会将于明日召开会议。
他的执行能力确保了项目的成功。

en: The teacher used a diagram to exemplify the scientific principle.
His actions exemplify the spirit of teamwork.
This case exemplifies the challenges faced by small businesses.
cn: 老师用图表举例说明这一科学原理。
他的行为是团队精神的典范。
该案例展现了小型企业面临的典型挑战。

en: Children under 12 are exempt from the admission fee.
The new law exempts small businesses from certain taxes.
His diplomatic status made him exempt from local laws.
cn: 12岁以下儿童免门票。
新法律免除小企业的部分税项。
他的外交身份使他免受当地法律约束。

definitions.definition: 施加（力量、影响等）；努力行使（权威、能力等）

en: She had to exert all her strength to move the heavy box.
The government exerted its authority to maintain order.
Don’t exert yourself too much during recovery.
cn: 她必须使出全力才能搬动那个沉重的箱子。
政府行使权威以维持秩序。
恢复期间不要过度劳累。

en: The long hike exhausted all of us.
Car exhaust contributes to air pollution.
She felt emotionally exhausted after the debate.
cn: 长时间的徒步让我们筋疲力尽。
汽车尾气加剧空气污染。
辩论后她感到精神透支。

en: The museum will exhibit rare fossils next month.
Her paintings were the highlight of the exhibit.
The lawyer exhibited new evidence in court.
cn: 博物馆下月将展出稀有化石。
她的画作是展览的亮点。
律师在法庭上提交了新证据。

en: The poet lived in exile for twenty years.
The king was exiled after the revolution.
She felt a sense of exile in the unfamiliar city.
cn: 这位诗人在流亡中度过了二十年。
革命后，国王被流放。
在这座陌生城市里，她感到一种背井离乡的孤独。

en: The existence of life on other planets remains unproven.
Her existence in the small town felt lonely and meaningless.
The philosopher questioned the very nature of human existence.
cn: 其他星球上是否存在生命仍未被证实。
她在这个小镇的生活孤独而乏味。
这位哲学家质疑人类存在的本质。

en: The market sells exotic fruits from Southeast Asia.
She has an exotic taste in fashion.
The zoo exhibits many exotic animals.
cn: 这家市场出售来自东南亚的异国水果。
她的时尚品味独特而前卫。
动物园展出了许多外来动物。

definitions.definition: 扩大，扩展（物理或抽象范围）

en: The company plans to expand its operations to Asia next year.
Heat causes metals to expand.
Could you expand on your proposal in the meeting?
cn: 该公司计划明年将业务扩展至亚洲。
热量会导致金属膨胀。
你能在会议上详细阐述你的提案吗？

definitions.definition: 扩张；扩展（物理或抽象范围的增大）
膨胀（气体或物体的体积增大）

en: The rapid expansion of the universe was confirmed by astronomers.
The company plans an expansion into Asian markets next year.
Heat causes the expansion of metal.
cn: 天文学家证实了宇宙的快速膨胀。
该公司计划明年向亚洲市场扩张。
热量导致金属膨胀。

en: The team set out on an expedition to the Arctic.
The scientific expedition discovered a new species of butterfly.
He completed the task with remarkable expedition.
cn: 队伍出发前往北极进行探险。
科学考察队发现了一种新的蝴蝶物种。
他以惊人的速度完成了任务。

en: The school may expel students for serious misconduct.
The engine expels harmful gases through the exhaust pipe.
The government expelled the diplomat for espionage.
cn: 学校可能因严重不当行为开除学生。
发动机通过排气管排出有害气体。
政府以间谍罪驱逐了这名外交官。

en: The company will expend considerable resources on this project.
She expends too much energy worrying about trivial matters.
Governments must carefully expend taxpayers' money.
cn: 该公司将在此项目上投入大量资源。
她耗费太多精力担忧琐事。
政府必须谨慎使用纳税人的钱。

definitions.definition: 支出，花费（指金钱、时间或资源的消耗）
经费，开支（具体款项或预算项目）

en: The government plans to reduce public expenditure next year.
Tracking daily expenditures helps manage personal finances.
The project requires significant expenditure of time and energy.
cn: 政府计划明年减少公共开支。
记录每日支出有助于管理个人财务。
该项目需要投入大量时间和精力。

en: The company will cover all travel expenses.
Don't expense personal purchases to the company account.
Cutting unnecessary expenses is key to financial health.
cn: 公司将承担所有差旅费用。
不要将个人消费计入公司账户。
减少不必要的开支是财务健康的关键。

en: She is an expert in marine biology.
His expert hands repaired the watch swiftly.
The report was reviewed by a panel of experts.
cn: 她是海洋生物学领域的专家。
他熟练的双手迅速修好了手表。
该报告由专家小组审核。

en: Her expertise in molecular biology earned her a prestigious award.
The project requires technical expertise and creative thinking.
He demonstrated his expertise by solving the complex problem in minutes.
cn: 她在分子生物学领域的专业知识为她赢得了著名奖项。
该项目需要技术专长与创造性思维。
他通过几分钟内解决复杂问题展示了自己的专业能力。

en: My passport will expire next month.
The ancient tradition has expired with the last elder.
Plants expire oxygen during the day.
cn: 我的护照下个月到期。
这一古老传统随着最后一位长者的离世而消失。
植物在白天释放氧气。

definitions.definition: 明确的，清晰的（指信息或表达）
直白的，露骨的（常指性或其他敏感内容）

en: The contract includes explicit instructions for termination.
Her explicit description left no room for misunderstanding.
The film was rated R for explicit language and violence.
cn: 合同中包含明确的终止条款。
她直白的描述让人毫无误解余地。
这部电影因露骨语言和暴力内容被定为R级。

en: The novel recounts his exploits during the war.
Solar energy is a clean resource waiting to be exploited.
Some companies exploit workers by paying unfair wages.
cn: 这部小说记述了他在战争中的英勇事迹。
太阳能是待开发的清洁资源。
有些公司通过支付不公工资剥削工人。

en: Scientists explore the deep ocean to discover new species.
She loves to explore different cultures through travel.
The book explores the themes of identity and belonging.
cn: 科学家探索深海以发现新物种。
她喜欢通过旅行探究不同文化。
这本书深入探讨了身份与归属的主题。

en: The journalist exposed the corruption scandal.
Children should be exposed to diverse cultures early.
Prolonged exposure to sunlight can damage your skin.
cn: 记者揭露了这起腐败丑闻。
儿童应尽早接触多元文化。
长时间暴露在阳光下会损伤皮肤。

en: The professor’s exposition of quantum theory was remarkably clear.
The World’s Fair was an international exposition of technological innovations.
The symphony’s exposition introduces the main musical themes.
cn: 教授对量子理论的阐述非常清晰。
世界博览会是科技创新的国际性展览。
交响乐的呈示部呈现了核心音乐主题。

en: Her facial expression revealed her disappointment.
Freedom of expression is a fundamental human right.
The equation is a complex mathematical expression.
cn: 她的表情透露出失望。
言论自由是一项基本人权。
这个等式是一个复杂的数学表达式。

definitions.definition: 精美的；极致的（指品质或美感）
剧烈的；敏锐的（指感受或感知）

en: She wore an exquisite silk gown to the ball.
The pianist has an exquisite sense of timing.
The pain was so exquisite that he could barely speak.
cn: 她穿着一件精美的丝绸礼服出席舞会。
这位钢琴家对节奏的把握极为敏锐。
剧痛让他几乎无法说话。

en: The farm has extensive fields of wheat.
She conducted extensive research on climate change.
The museum offers extensive collections of ancient artifacts.
cn: 农场拥有广阔的小麦田。
她对气候变化进行了广泛的研究。
该博物馆藏有大量古代文物。

en: The extent of the damage surprised everyone.
She tested the extent of his patience.
The forest covers an extent of 500 square miles.
cn: 损坏的程度让所有人震惊。
她试探了他耐心的限度。
这片森林占地500平方英里。

en: The external walls of the building are painted white.
External factors like weather can affect crop growth.
The company focuses on both internal and external communication.
cn: 建筑物的外墙被漆成白色。
天气等外部因素会影响作物生长。
该公司注重内部与外部的双向沟通。

definitions.definition: （火、火山等）熄灭的；不再活跃的

en: The dodo bird has been extinct for over 300 years.
Scientists fear this rare species may soon go extinct.
The volcano was once active but is now considered extinct.
cn: 渡渡鸟已灭绝超过300年。
科学家担心这一稀有物种可能很快灭绝。
这座火山曾活跃过，但如今已被视为死火山。

definitions.definition: 使（希望、情感等）破灭；终结

en: The firefighters worked tirelessly to extinguish the wildfire.
His harsh words extinguished her last hope for reconciliation.
Please extinguish all candles before leaving the room.
cn: 消防员不懈努力扑灭山火。
他刻薄的话语让她和解的最后希望破灭。
离开房间前请熄灭所有蜡烛。

en: Scientists extract DNA from blood samples.
This paragraph is an extract from her latest novel.
The dentist had to extract the damaged tooth.
cn: 科学家从血液样本中提取DNA。
这段文字摘自她最新出版的小说。
牙医不得不拔除那颗损坏的牙齿。

en: She showed extraordinary courage in the face of danger.
The scientist made an extraordinary discovery.
His memory is extraordinary—he can recall every detail.
cn: 她在危险面前表现出非凡的勇气。
这位科学家做出了惊人的发现。
他的记忆力非凡，能记住每个细节。

en: She wore an extravagant diamond necklace to the party.
The film's extravagant special effects overshadowed its plot.
Critics called his claims extravagant and unsubstantiated.
cn: 她戴了一条奢华的钻石项链参加派对。
这部电影夸张的特效掩盖了剧情。
评论家称他的主张夸大其词且缺乏依据。

en: She took extreme measures to protect her privacy.
The weather reached an extreme of 45°C last summer.
His opinions are often at the opposite extreme of mine.
cn: 她采取了极端措施来保护隐私。
去年夏季气温达到了45摄氏度的极端高温。
他的观点常与我的截然相反。

en: The dress is made of fine silk fabric.
The fabric of society depends on mutual trust.
This fabric softens after washing.
cn: 这条裙子由优质丝绸面料制成。
社会的结构依赖于相互信任。
这种布料洗后会变柔软。

definitions.definition: 制造，组装（尤指工业产品）

en: The company fabricates aircraft parts from recycled materials.
He fabricated an excuse to avoid the meeting.
Ancient civilizations fabricated tools from bronze and stone.
cn: 这家公司用回收材料制造飞机零件。
他编了个借口逃避会议。
古代文明用青铜和石头制作工具。

en: Each facet of the diamond reflected light brilliantly.
The book explores every facet of human emotions.
The architect faceted the glass wall to create dynamic shadows.
cn: 钻石的每个刻面都闪耀着光芒。
这本书探讨了人类情感的方方面面。
建筑师将玻璃墙琢面以形成动态的光影效果。

definitions.definition: 帮助（过程或行动更易完成）

en: The new software will facilitate data analysis.
Teachers use visual aids to facilitate learning.
The agreement aims to facilitate trade between countries.
cn: 新软件将简化数据分析流程。
教师利用视觉教具促进学习。
该协议旨在促进国家间的贸易往来。

en: Time is a critical factor in this experiment.
We need to factor in the cost of materials.
cn: 时间是该实验的关键因素。
我们需要将材料成本纳入考量。

definitions.definition: 天赋，能力（尤指心智或身体的特殊能力）

en: She joined the faculty of Harvard Law School last year.
cn: 她去年加入了哈佛法学院的教职团队。

en: She has great faith in her team's ability.
The ceremony is central to their faith.
He acted in good faith, unaware of the deception.
cn: 她对团队的能力充满信心。
这一仪式是他们信仰的核心。
他本着诚信行事，未察觉欺骗。

en: The museum discovered the painting was a fake.
He faked his signature on the document.
Her smile seemed fake and forced.
cn: 博物馆发现这幅画是赝品。
他在文件上伪造了签名。
她的笑容显得虚假而勉强。

en: The prolonged drought led to a devastating famine in the region.
During the war, many cities suffered from coal famine.
Scientists warn of a potential water famine in the next decade.
cn: 持续干旱导致该地区爆发毁灭性饥荒。
战争期间，许多城市遭遇煤炭短缺。
科学家警告未来十年可能出现水资源危机。

en: The children were delighted by the fantastic tales of dragons and wizards.
She did a fantastic job organizing the event.
His plan sounded fantastic, but utterly impractical.
cn: 孩子们对龙与巫师的奇幻故事感到欣喜。
她筹备活动的表现棒极了。
他的计划听起来天马行空，却完全不切实际。

en: Her fantasy was to live in a castle by the sea.
The novel blends fantasy elements with historical facts.
He often fantasizes about becoming a famous musician.
cn: 她的幻想是住在海边的城堡里。
这部小说将幻想元素与历史事实融合。
他常幻想自己成为著名音乐家。

en: The magician's tricks fascinated the children.
She was fascinated by the intricate patterns of the coral reef.
His theories continue to fascinate scientists decades later.
cn: 魔术师的戏法让孩子们着迷不已。
她被珊瑚礁复杂的纹路深深吸引。
数十年后，他的理论仍令科学家们痴迷。

en: The accident was fatal to three passengers.
His fatal mistake cost the company millions.
In Greek mythology, the Fates controlled fatal destinies.
cn: 这场事故导致三名乘客丧生。
他的致命错误让公司损失了数百万。
希腊神话中，命运女神掌控着注定的结局。

en: The soldiers collapsed from fatigue after the long march.
Mental fatigue can affect your decision-making ability.
The repetitive task fatigued her both physically and emotionally.
cn: 士兵们在长途行军后因疲劳倒下。
精神疲劳会影响你的决策能力。
重复性工作让她身心俱疲。

en: The plan sounds feasible, but we need more data to confirm.
Solar energy is a feasible alternative to fossil fuels.
Is it feasible to finish the project by Friday?
cn: 这个计划听起来可行，但我们需要更多数据来确认。
太阳能是化石燃料的一种可行替代方案。
在周五前完成这个项目可行吗？

en: The wedding feast lasted until midnight.
They feasted on lobster and champagne.
The art exhibition was a visual feast.
cn: 婚宴持续到午夜。
他们尽情享用龙虾和香槟。
这场艺术展是一场视觉盛宴。

en: The smartphone's most impressive feature is its battery life.
The documentary features interviews with climate scientists.
Her sharp cheekbones are her defining facial feature.
cn: 这款智能手机最令人印象深刻的特点是它的电池续航。
这部纪录片重点呈现了气候科学家的访谈。
她高颧骨是标志性的面部特征。

en: Switzerland is a federal republic consisting of 26 cantons.
The federal government announced new environmental policies.
Their alliance was federal rather than unitary.
cn: 瑞士是由26个州组成的联邦共和国。
联邦政府宣布了新的环境政策。
他们的联盟是联邦制而非中央集权制。

en: The European Federation promotes economic cooperation among its members.
A federation of small states was formed to resist external threats.
The sports federation sets rules for international competitions.
cn: 欧洲联盟促进成员国间的经济合作。
为抵御外部威胁，小国组成了联邦。
该体育联合会制定国际赛事规则。

definitions.definition: （论点、借口等）站不住脚的，拙劣的

en: The old man's voice was so feeble that I could barely hear him.
Her argument against the policy was feeble and unconvincing.
After the illness, he felt too feeble to climb the stairs.
cn: 老人的声音微弱到我几乎听不见。
她对政策的反驳站不住脚，难以服人。
病后他虚弱得连楼梯都爬不动。

definitions.definition: 伙伴关系；友谊；团体资格

en: He was awarded a research fellowship at Harvard.
The hiking club fosters a strong sense of fellowship among its members.
Their fellowship lasted despite years of separation.
cn: 他在哈佛大学获得了研究员职位。
徒步俱乐部在成员间培养了深厚的伙伴情谊。
尽管多年分离，他们的友谊依然长存。

en: She has a naturally feminine grace.
In French, "lune" (moon) is a feminine noun.
The design combines masculine strength with feminine curves.
cn: 她天生带有女性的优雅。
法语中，“lune”（月亮）是阴性名词。
该设计融合了阳刚的力量感与阴柔的曲线美。

en: The ferry crosses the river every hour.
They ferried supplies to the island by boat.
The old ferry terminal is now a tourist attraction.
cn: 渡船每小时横渡河流一次。
他们用船将物资运送到岛上。
昔日的渡口如今成了旅游景点。

definitions.definition: 肥料（促进植物生长的物质）
促进发展的因素（比喻义）

en: Organic fertilizer improves soil quality over time.
Education is the fertilizer of innovation.
The farmer spread fertilizer evenly across the field.
cn: 有机肥料会逐渐改善土壤质量。
教育是创新的催化剂。
农民将肥料均匀地撒在田地里。

en: Her novel blurs the line between fiction and reality.
The report was dismissed as pure fiction.
Science fiction often explores futuristic technologies.
cn: 她的模糊了虚构与现实的界限。
这份报告被斥为纯属虚构。
科幻常常探索未来科技。

en: The data is presented in bar figures.
She cut a fine figure in her new dress.
I figure we’ll arrive by noon.
cn: 数据以柱状图形式呈现。
她穿着新裙子显得仪态优雅。
我估计我们中午前能到。

en: She works in finance at a multinational bank.
The government will finance the new infrastructure project.
Personal finance management is crucial for long-term stability.
cn: 她在跨国银行的金融部门工作。
政府将为新的基础设施项目提供资金。
个人理财管理对长期稳定至关重要。

en: The company is facing financial difficulties due to the economic downturn.
She works in the financial sector, specializing in investment analysis.
Good financial planning is essential for long-term stability.
cn: 该公司因经济衰退面临财务困难。
她在金融行业工作，专攻投资分析。
良好的财务规划对长期稳定至关重要。

en: Human knowledge is finite, but curiosity is infinite.
The resources on Earth are finite and must be conserved.
In mathematics, a finite set has a countable number of elements.
cn: 人类的知识是有限的，但好奇心是无限的。
地球上的资源是有限的，必须节约使用。
数学中，有限集合的元素是可数的。

en: The dress requires some fitting adjustments.
His apology was a fitting response to the situation.
Plumbing fittings are essential for water supply systems.
cn: 这条裙子需要一些尺寸调整。
他的道歉是对这一情境的恰当回应。
管道配件是供水系统的关键部件。

definitions.definition: 固定装置（如家具、灯具等永久安装的物体）
固定状态（指长期存在或难以改变的事物）

en: The bathroom fixtures were replaced during the renovation.
He became a fixture in the local music scene.
The light fixture is securely attached to the ceiling.
cn: 翻修期间更换了浴室固定装置。
他成了当地音乐界的常驻人物。
灯具牢固地安装在天花板上。

en: The castle's flank was protected by a steep cliff.
The general ordered troops to flank the enemy from the east.
She placed a hand on her dog's flank as they walked.
cn: 城堡的侧面由陡峭的悬崖保护。
将军命令部队从东侧包抄敌人。
散步时，她的手轻放在狗的侧腹上。

definitions.definition: 片状悬垂物（如口袋盖、信封口盖）；拍打声；慌乱状态

en: The bird's wings began to flap wildly as it took off.
She sealed the envelope and tucked in the flap.
Don't flap—we still have plenty of time to finish the project.
cn: 鸟起飞时翅膀剧烈拍动。
她封好信封，折进封口盖。
别慌——我们还有充足时间完成项目。

definitions.definition: 燃烧；突然发怒；突然爆发

en: The flare of the match lit up her face.
Tempers flared during the debate.
The ship launched a distress flare.
cn: 火柴的亮光照亮了她的脸。
辩论中情绪突然激动起来。
船只发射了一枚求救信号弹。

en: The chemist heated the liquid in a glass flask.
He carried a silver flask of whiskey in his coat pocket.
Medieval pilgrims often used leather flasks to hold water.
cn: 化学家在玻璃烧瓶中加热液体。
他的大衣口袋里装着一个银质威士忌酒瓶。
中世纪朝圣者常用皮质水壶装水。

en: The land here is very flat, perfect for cycling.
She moved into a small flat in London last year.
The soda tastes flat because it’s been open too long.
cn: 这片土地非常平坦，适合骑行。
她去年搬进了伦敦的一间小公寓。
这汽水没气了，因为开得太久。

definitions.definition: 使显得更美（如照片、光线等）

en: She flattered him by praising his outdated suit.
The soft lighting flatters her complexion.
Don’t be flattered by their attention—they want something from you.
cn: 她通过称赞他那套过时的西装来奉承他。
柔和的灯光让她的肤色显得更美。
别被他们的关注冲昏头脑，他们另有所图。

en: The diamond had a tiny flaw that reduced its value.
His argument was flawed by oversimplification.
Even the best plans can contain hidden flaws.
cn: 这颗钻石有一处微小瑕疵，降低了它的价值。
他的论点因过度简化而存在缺陷。
即使最完美的计划也可能隐藏疏漏。

en: The yoga mat is made of flexible material for easy storage.
A flexible schedule allows employees to balance work and life.
His flexible approach solved the conflict creatively.
cn: 瑜伽垫采用柔韧材质，便于收纳。
弹性工作时间让员工能平衡工作与生活。
他灵活的方式创造性地化解了冲突。

definitions.definition: 短暂的放纵；一时的热情

en: She flung the door open in anger.
He had a brief fling with photography in college.
The monkey flung itself from branch to branch.
cn: 她愤怒地把门猛地推开。
他大学时短暂迷恋过摄影。
猴子在树枝间快速跳跃。

definitions.definition: 翻转；突然改变（态度、立场）

en: She flipped the pancake with a quick wrist motion.
The audience's opinion flipped after the shocking revelation.
His flip remark offended the serious panelists.
cn: 她手腕一抖，快速翻动了煎饼。
惊人的真相揭露后，观众的态度彻底反转。
他轻率的言论冒犯了严肃的评委们。

en: The leaves float gently on the pond.
The company plans to float shares next month.
We watched the parade float decorated with flowers.
cn: 树叶轻轻漂浮在池塘上。
公司计划下月发行股票。
我们观看了装饰鲜花的游行彩车。

en: Stock prices fluctuate daily due to market demand.
Her mood tends to fluctuate between joy and sadness.
The temperature fluctuates significantly in desert regions.
cn: 股票价格因市场需求每日波动。
她的情绪常在快乐与悲伤间起伏。
沙漠地区的温度波动显著。

definitions.definition: 脸红；潮红；一阵强烈情感

en: She felt a flush of embarrassment when she realized her mistake.
The toilet won't flush properly.
Make sure the edges are flush with the wall.
cn: 她意识到错误时，脸上泛起一阵尴尬的红晕。
马桶冲水不畅。
确保边缘与墙面齐平。

definitions.definition: （鸟或昆虫）振翅；飘动；快速跳动（如心脏）

en: The leaves fluttered in the autumn breeze.
Her heart fluttered when she heard the news.
The butterfly fluttered its wings and flew away.
cn: 秋风中树叶轻轻摇曳。
听到消息时，她的心怦怦直跳。
蝴蝶振翅飞走了。

en: The waves turned to foam as they crashed against the rocks.
The mad dog was foaming at the mouth.
She stirred the latte until a thick foam formed on top.
cn: 海浪拍打岩石时化作泡沫。
疯狗口吐白沫。
她搅拌拿铁，直到表面形成一层厚厚的泡沫。

en: The camera automatically adjusts its focus.
She needs to focus on her studies.
The debate became the focus of public attention.
cn: 相机自动调节焦距。
她需要集中精力学习。
这场辩论成为公众关注的焦点。

en: The chocolate was wrapped in gold foil.
Her quick thinking foiled the robbery attempt.
The dark background acts as a foil to the bright flowers.
cn: 巧克力用金箔纸包裹。
她的机智挫败了抢劫企图。
深色背景衬托出鲜花的明亮。

en: She carefully folded the letter before putting it in the envelope.
The map had deep folds from being stored in a pocket.
The Himalayas were formed by the fold of tectonic plates.
cn: 她将信仔细折好，放入信封。
地图因长期放在口袋里而有了深深的折痕。
喜马拉雅山脉由板块褶皱形成。

en: The police used force to disperse the crowd.
She forced herself to smile despite the pain.
The force of his argument convinced the committee.
cn: 警方使用武力驱散人群。
尽管痛苦，她强迫自己微笑。
他论证的说服力打动了委员会。

en: She is one of the foremost experts in neuroscience.
Safety must be foremost in our minds during the experiment.
The captain stood foremost on the deck, guiding the ship.
cn: 她是神经科学领域最重要的专家之一。
实验中，安全必须是我们最先考虑的事项。
船长站在甲板最前方指挥船只。

en: The economist tried to foresee the impact of the new policy.
No one could have foreseen the sudden market crash.
Her ability to foresee problems saved the project.
cn: 经济学家试图预见新政策的影响。
没人能预见到市场的突然崩溃。
她预见问题的能力挽救了整个项目。

en: The blacksmith will forge a sword from the heated metal.
He was arrested for trying to forge a banknote.
Despite obstacles, the team continued to forge ahead with the project.
cn: 铁匠将用烧红的金属锻造一把剑。
他因试图伪造钞票被捕。
尽管遇到阻碍，团队仍坚定推进项目。

en: The invitation requires formal attire.
His apology was formal but insincere.
The agreement is only a formal recognition of cooperation.
cn: 邀请函要求着正装出席。
他的道歉很正式，但缺乏诚意。
该协议仅是合作的形式性认可。

definitions.definition: 格式化；按特定方式组织

en: The document must be saved in PDF format.
She knows how to format a hard drive for optimal performance.
The conference will follow a round-table discussion format.
cn: 文件必须以PDF格式保存。
她懂得如何格式化硬盘以获得最佳性能。
会议将采用圆桌讨论的形式。

definitions.definition: 令人畏惧的；可怕的（因强大或困难）
令人钦佩的；杰出的（因卓越或艰巨）

en: The mountain presented a formidable challenge to the climbers.
Her formidable intellect earned respect from all colleagues.
The fortress was protected by formidable walls.
cn: 这座山对登山者构成了巨大的挑战。
她杰出的才智赢得了所有同事的尊敬。
堡垒被令人望而生畏的高墙保护着。

en: The chemical formula for water is H₂O.
She has a winning formula for success in business.
"How do you do?" is a formal greeting formula.
cn: 水的化学分子式是H₂O。
她有一套成功的商业准则。
“您好吗？”是一种正式的问候惯用语。

definitions.definition: 系统阐述；规划；用公式表示

en: Scientists formulated a new theory to explain the phenomenon.
The pharmacist formulated the medicine according to the prescription.
It took months to formulate a response to the complex issue.
cn: 科学家提出新理论来解释这一现象。
药剂师根据处方配制药剂。
针对这一复杂问题，耗时数月才制定出应对方案。

en: The soldiers retreated to the fort for safety.
The old fort stands on a hill overlooking the valley.
They built a wooden fort to defend against enemy attacks.
cn: 士兵们撤退到堡垒中寻求庇护。
古老的要塞矗立在山丘上，俯瞰山谷。
他们建造了一座木制堡垒以抵御敌人进攻。

definitions.definition: 即将到来的（指事件或时间）
乐于助人的，坦率的（指态度或行为）

en: The forthcoming election has drawn widespread attention.
She was very forthcoming with details about the project.
The manager promised to be forthcoming with updates.
cn: 即将到来的选举引起了广泛关注。
她非常坦率地提供了项目的细节。
经理承诺会及时提供更新信息。

en: The ancient Roman forum was a center of political and social life.
She posted her question on an online gardening forum.
The conference provided a forum for experts to exchange ideas.
cn: 古罗马广场是政治与社交生活的中心。
她在园艺论坛上发布了问题。
这次会议为专家们提供了交流思想的平台。

definitions.definition: 化石（保存于地层中的古生物遗迹）
化石的；陈腐的（比喻过时或僵化的事物）

en: The museum displays a fossil of a dinosaur footprint.
His ideas are fossilized and refuse to adapt to new trends.
Coal is formed from fossilized plants over millions of years.
cn: 博物馆展出一块恐龙足迹化石。
他的思想僵化，拒绝适应新趋势。
煤是由植物化石经过数百万年形成的。

en: She decided to foster a child from the orphanage.
The program aims to foster creativity in students.
He grew up in a foster family after his parents passed away.
cn: 她决定收养一名孤儿院的孩子。
该项目旨在培养学生的创造力。
父母去世后，他在寄养家庭长大。

definitions.definition: 肮脏的；恶臭的；违反规则的

en: The water in the pond smelled foul.
He fouled his opponent during the match and received a yellow card.
The politician’s reputation was fouled by corruption scandals.
cn: 池塘里的水散发恶臭。
他在比赛中对对手犯规，吃到黄牌。
这位政客的名誉因腐败丑闻而败坏。

en: The glass shattered into tiny fractions.
Only a fraction of the students passed the exam.
cn: 玻璃碎成了许多小碎片。
只有一小部分学生通过了考试。

en: The X-ray revealed a hairline fracture in his wrist.
Extreme pressure can fracture even the strongest materials.
The political scandal fractured public trust in the government.
cn: X光显示他的手腕有一处骨裂。
极大压力甚至能使最坚固的材料断裂。
政治丑闻瓦解了公众对政府的信任。

en: The fragile vase shattered when it fell.
Her fragile health requires constant care.
The ceasefire agreement is fragile and may not last.
cn: 易碎的花瓶掉落时摔得粉碎。
她虚弱的身体需要持续照料。
停火协议很脆弱，可能无法持久。

definitions.definition: 芳香，香味（尤指令人愉悦的）

en: The fragrance of roses filled the garden.
She prefers light fragrances in summer.
The fragrance industry relies on natural and synthetic scents.
cn: 玫瑰的芬芳弥漫了整个花园。
夏季她偏爱清淡的香水。
香水工业依赖天然与合成香料。

definitions.definition: 疯狂的；狂乱的（因极度恐惧或兴奋）
匆忙的；紧张的（形容活动或行为）

en: She made a frantic call to the police after witnessing the accident.
The office was in a frantic rush to meet the deadline.
His frantic gestures showed how desperate he was.
cn: 目睹事故后，她疯狂地打电话报警。
办公室里人们为赶截止日期忙得焦头烂额。
他狂乱的手势暴露了内心的绝望。

en: He was convicted of fraud for falsifying financial records.
The email promised a lottery prize, but it was just a fraud.
She realized the antique vase was a fraud after noticing the modern stamp.
cn: 他因伪造财务记录被判欺诈罪。
那封邮件声称中了彩票，实则是一场骗局。
发现现代印章后，她意识到这个古董花瓶是赝品。

definitions.definition: （物理）频率（单位时间内周期性事件发生的次数）

en: The frequency of earthquakes in this region has increased recently.
This radio station broadcasts at a frequency of 98.5 MHz.
High-frequency words are essential for language learners.
cn: 该地区地震发生的频率近期有所上升。
该电台以98.5兆赫的频率广播。
高频词汇对语言学习者至关重要。

en: She makes frequent trips to Paris for work.
The cafe was frequented by artists and writers.
Frequent exercise improves overall health.
cn: 她因工作频繁前往巴黎。
这家咖啡馆曾是艺术家和作家的常聚之地。
经常锻炼能提升整体健康水平。

en: Oil reduces friction between moving parts.
There was constant friction between the two departments.
Static friction prevents the box from sliding.
cn: 润滑油减少运动部件间的摩擦。
两个部门间矛盾不断。
静摩擦力阻止箱子滑动。

en: She wore a shawl with colorful fringes.
The topic was considered fringe science for decades.
Trees fringed the quiet lake.
cn: 她披着一条带彩色流苏的披肩。
这一课题数十年来被视为边缘科学。
树木环绕着静谧的湖泊。

en: The airplane stopped to refuel before crossing the ocean.
His harsh words only fueled the argument.
Renewable fuels are essential for reducing carbon emissions.
cn: 飞机在越洋前停下来补充燃料。
他的激烈言辞让争论升级。
可再生燃料对减少碳排放至关重要。

definitions.definition: 实现（承诺、目标等）；履行（职责）

en: She worked hard to fulfill her dream of becoming a doctor.
The company must fulfill its contractual obligations.
This meal will fulfill your nutritional needs for the day.
cn: 她努力奋斗，实现了成为医生的梦想。
公司必须履行合同义务。
这顿饭能满足你一天的营养需求。

en: The primary function of the heart is to pump blood.
This program will not function without proper input.
In math, a linear function has a constant rate of change.
cn: 心脏的主要功能是泵血。
没有正确输入，该程序无法运行。
数学中，线性函数的变化率是恒定的。

en: The government allocated funds for education.
She started a fund to support local artists.
The project is funded by private donations.
cn: 政府为教育拨付了资金。
她设立了一项基金以支持本地艺术家。
该项目由私人捐款资助。

definitions.definition: 基础的；根本的；至关重要的

en: The fundamental principles of physics apply universally.
Respect is fundamental to a healthy relationship.
She lacks a fundamental understanding of the topic.
cn: 物理学的基本原理普遍适用。
尊重是健康关系的基石。
她对该主题缺乏根本性的理解。

definitions.definition: 激烈的，猛烈的（如动作或自然现象）

en: He was furious when he discovered the broken window.
The debate turned into a furious exchange of accusations.
The ship battled through furious waves during the storm.
cn: 他发现窗户被打破时暴跳如雷。
辩论演变成激烈的相互指责。
船只在暴风雨中与汹涌的波涛搏斗。

definitions.definition: 提供（设备或物品）；布置（房间）

en: The apartment is furnished with modern appliances.
They furnished the expedition with necessary supplies.
Her testimony furnished crucial evidence for the case.
cn: 这间公寓配备了现代化家电。
他们为探险队提供了必要物资。
她的证词为案件提供了关键证据。

definitions.definition: 家具（指可移动的室内陈设物品，如桌子、椅子等）

en: The antique furniture adds charm to the room.
They invested in high-quality office furniture.
Modern furniture often prioritizes minimalism.
cn: 这件古董家具为房间增添了魅力。
他们投资购买了高品质的办公家具。
现代家具常以极简风格为优先。

definitions.definition: 此外；而且（用于补充或强调前文）

en: The plan is inefficient; furthermore, it’s too expensive.
She excels in academics, and furthermore, she’s a talented musician.
The data is incomplete; furthermore, the methodology is flawed.
cn: 该计划效率低下，而且成本过高。
她学业优异，此外还是一位有才华的音乐家。
数据不完整，此外研究方法也存在缺陷。

definitions.definition: （神话中的）复仇女神（大写 Fury）

en: His face turned red with fury when he heard the news.
In Greek mythology, the Furies punished moral crimes.
The storm struck the coast with the fury of nature.
cn: 听到消息时，他气得满脸通红。
希腊神话中，复仇女神惩罚道德罪行。
风暴以自然的狂暴袭击了海岸。

en: The fuse blew when the circuit was overloaded.
The two companies plan to fuse their resources for the project.
Heat caused the metals to fuse into a single alloy.
cn: 电路过载时保险丝熔断了。
两家公司计划合并资源完成该项目。
高温使金属熔合成一种合金。

definitions.definition: 融合；合并（尤指不同事物的结合）

en: The fusion of jazz and classical music creates a unique sound.
Nuclear fusion powers the sun and stars.
This restaurant is famous for its fusion cuisine blending Asian and European flavors.
cn: 爵士乐与古典乐的融合产生了独特的声音。
核聚变为太阳和恒星提供能量。
这家餐厅以融合亚洲与欧洲风味的料理闻名。

definitions.definition: 一群杰出或耀眼的人/物

en: The Milky Way is a spiral galaxy.
She joined a galaxy of famous actors in the film.
Ancient myths describe the galaxy as a river of light.
cn: 银河系是一个旋涡星系。
她与一群著名演员共同出演了这部电影。
古代神话将银河描述为一条光之河。

en: He lost all his savings because he couldn't stop gambling.
Starting a business is always a gamble.
She gambled on the stock market and won big.
cn: 他因沉迷赌博失去了全部积蓄。
创业总是一场冒险。
她在股市上冒险押注，大获全胜。

en: The street was littered with garbage after the festival.
Don't listen to his garbage—he has no idea what he's talking about.
The app automatically deletes garbage files to save storage space.
cn: 节日过后，街上堆满了垃圾。
别听他的废话，他根本不知所云。
该应用会自动删除垃圾文件以节省存储空间。

definitions.definition: 服装，衣物（尤指特定用途或设计的）

en: The designer showcased a new garment made from recycled fabrics.
Workers in the factory carefully inspect each garment for defects.
Traditional garments often reflect a culture’s history and values.
cn: 设计师展示了一件用再生面料制成的新服装。
工厂工人仔细检查每件衣物的瑕疵。
传统服饰常反映一个文化的历史与价值观。

definitions.definition: 喘气，倒抽气（因惊讶、疼痛或窒息）

en: She gasped in shock when she saw the spider.
His last gasp was heard across the silent room.
The cold water made him gasp for breath.
cn: 她看到蜘蛛时吓得倒抽一口气。
他最后的喘息声在寂静的房间里清晰可闻。
冷水让他喘不过气来。

definitions.definition: 测量标准；计量器；厚度/直径

en: The fuel gauge shows the tank is almost empty.
It’s difficult to gauge her true feelings.
This wire has a 12-gauge thickness.
cn: 燃油表显示油箱几乎空了。
很难揣测她的真实感受。
这根电线的直径为12号规格。

definitions.definition: 凝视，注视（长时间固定地看）

en: She gazed at the stars for hours, lost in thought.
His intense gaze made her feel uneasy.
The child gazed in wonder at the fireworks.
cn: 她凝望星空数小时，陷入沉思。
他强烈的目光让她感到不安。
孩子惊奇地凝视着烟花。

en: The mechanic checked the gears of the car.
She geared her speech toward a younger audience.
Our camping gear is packed and ready.
cn: 机械师检查了汽车的齿轮。
她调整了演讲内容以迎合年轻听众。
我们的露营装备已打包完毕。

en: Scientists generalize patterns from experimental data.
It's dangerous to generalize about a whole culture.
The model can generalize well to unseen scenarios.
cn: 科学家从实验数据中归纳规律。
对整个文化一概而论是危险的。
该模型能很好地推广到未见的场景中。

en: Wind turbines generate electricity from wind power.
The discussion generated many innovative ideas.
Some animals generate offspring rapidly in favorable conditions.
cn: 风力涡轮机通过风能发电。
这次讨论催生了许多创新想法。
某些动物在适宜环境下繁殖迅速。

en: She is known for her generous donations to charity.
The chef served a generous portion of pasta.
His generous spirit made him popular among friends.
cn: 她以对慈善事业的慷慨捐赠闻名。
厨师端上了一份分量十足的意大利面。
他慷慨的性情让他在朋友中很受欢迎。

en: Genetic mutations can lead to variations in species.
The study focuses on the genetic diversity of crops.
His talent seems almost genetic.
cn: 基因突变可能导致物种变异。
这项研究关注作物的遗传多样性。
他的才能仿佛与生俱来。

en: The museum confirmed the painting was a genuine Van Gogh.
She has a genuine passion for helping others.
His apology sounded genuine and heartfelt.
cn: 博物馆确认这幅画是梵高的真迹。
她对帮助他人抱有真诚的热情。
他的道歉听起来真挚而诚恳。

definitions.definition: 地质学（研究地球物质组成、结构及演化的科学）

en: She majored in geology and now works as a field researcher.
The book explains how plate tectonics revolutionized geology.
Geology helps us understand Earth's past climates.
cn: 她主修地质学，现从事野外研究工作。
这本书阐释了板块构造论如何革新地质学。
地质学帮助我们理解地球过去的气候。

en: The dinosaur skeleton in the museum is truly gigantic.
They faced gigantic challenges while building the bridge.
A gigantic wave crashed against the shore during the storm.
cn: 博物馆里的恐龙骨架确实巨大无比。
他们在建造这座桥时面临着巨大的挑战。
暴风雨中，一个巨浪猛烈拍打在岸上。

en: The children couldn't stop giggling at the silly clown.
Her nervous giggle betrayed her embarrassment.
A giggle escaped her lips when she saw the puppy's antics.
cn: 孩子们被滑稽的小丑逗得咯咯笑个不停。
她紧张的傻笑暴露了她的尴尬。
看到小狗的滑稽动作，她忍不住笑出了声。

definitions.definition: 已知事实（法律/数学术语）

en: The experiment was repeated under given conditions.
Given his experience, he was the best candidate.
The proof starts from the givens of Euclidean geometry.
cn: 实验在特定条件下重复进行。
考虑到他的经验，他是最佳人选。
该证明从欧几里得几何的公设出发。

en: She carried herself with effortless glamour.
The old tales speak of fairies using glamour to disguise themselves.
The film captures the glamour of 1950s Hollywood.
cn: 她举手投足间散发着 effortless glamour。
古老传说中，仙女用 glamour 伪装自己。
这部电影捕捉了1950年代好莱坞的 glamour。

en: She glanced at her watch and realized she was late.
He stole a glance at the mysterious letter on the desk.
The sunlight glanced off the surface of the lake.
cn: 她瞥了一眼手表，发现自己迟到了。
他偷偷扫了一眼桌上那封神秘的信。
阳光在湖面上闪烁。

definitions.definition: 腺体（分泌化学物质的器官）

en: The thyroid gland regulates metabolism.
Sweat glands help cool the body.
The doctor examined his swollen lymph glands.
cn: 甲状腺负责调节新陈代谢。
汗腺有助于身体降温。
医生检查了他肿大的淋巴腺。

definitions.definition: 发出刺眼的光；怒目而视

en: The glare of the sun made it hard to see the road.
She gave him a glare when he interrupted her.
The polished floor glared under the spotlights.
cn: 刺眼的阳光让人看不清道路。
他打断她时，她怒视了他一眼。
抛光地板在聚光灯下反光刺眼。

en: The gleam of the lighthouse guided the ship through the fog.
Her eyes gleamed with excitement when she saw the gift.
The old coin gleamed faintly under the moonlight.
cn: 灯塔的微光指引船只穿过迷雾。
看到礼物时，她的眼睛因兴奋而发亮。
那枚古币在月光下隐隐闪烁。

en: The swan glided across the lake without a ripple.
Hang gliders can glide for miles on thermal currents.
Her fingers glided over the piano keys effortlessly.
cn: 天鹅掠过湖面，未激起一丝涟漪。
悬挂式滑翔机能借助热气流滑翔数英里。
她的手指在琴键上流畅地滑过，毫不费力。

definitions.definition: 闪光；耀眼的光芒；华丽的外表

en: The stars glittered in the midnight sky.
Her dress was covered in silver glitter.
The city’s glitter masked its social problems.
cn: 午夜星空中繁星闪烁。
她的裙子上缀满银色亮片。
城市的繁华掩盖了社会问题。

en: The room was filled with gloom as the storm clouds blocked the sun.
She couldn't shake off the gloom after hearing the bad news.
His face gloomed with disappointment when he saw the results.
cn: 暴风雨的乌云遮住阳光，房间陷入昏暗。
听到坏消息后，她无法摆脱忧郁情绪。
看到结果时，他的脸色因失望而阴沉下来。

en: The gloomy weather matched her somber mood.
His face grew gloomy when he heard the bad news.
The room was small and gloomy, with only one tiny window.
cn: 阴沉的天气与她忧郁的心情相呼应。
听到坏消息时，他的脸色变得阴沉。
房间狭小而昏暗，只有一扇小窗。

definitions.definition: 微弱而稳定的光；红润的光泽

en: The embers continued to glow in the fireplace.
Her face had a healthy glow after the workout.
The screen glows softly in the dark room.
cn: 余烬在壁炉中持续发出微光。
锻炼后，她的脸庞焕发健康的红润。
屏幕在黑暗的房间里柔和地亮着。

en: She wore a gorgeous red dress to the party.
The sunset over the ocean was absolutely gorgeous.
He gave her a gorgeous bouquet of roses.
cn: 她穿了一条华丽的红裙参加派对。
海上的日落美得令人窒息。
他送了她一束极美的玫瑰花。

definitions.definition: 闲话，流言；爱说闲话的人

en: She loves to gossip about her neighbors.
The office gossip spread quickly.
Don’t believe everything you hear—it’s just gossip.
cn: 她喜欢议论邻居的闲话。
办公室的流言传得飞快。
别轻信传闻，那不过是闲话。

definitions.definition: 长袍；礼服（尤指正式场合穿的宽松外衣）

en: She wore an elegant silk gown to the ball.
The judge's black gown symbolizes authority in court.
He changed into his cozy gown after a long day at work.
cn: 她穿着一件优雅的丝绸礼服参加舞会。
法官的黑色长袍象征着法庭的权威。
漫长的工作日后，他换上了舒适的睡袍。

definitions.definition: （尤指上位者对下位者）仁慈的，宽厚的

en: She gave a gracious smile to the nervous newcomer.
The queen was gracious enough to grant them an audience.
The hotel’s gracious decor reflected its historic charm.
cn: 她向紧张的新人报以亲切的微笑。
女王仁慈地接见了他们。
酒店优雅的装潢展现了其历史魅力。

en: She will graduate from Harvard next year.
The university graduated 500 students this semester.
The thermometer is graduated in Celsius.
cn: 她明年将从哈佛大学毕业。
该大学本学期授予了500名学生学位。
温度计以摄氏度为刻度单位。

en: Wheat is a common grain used in bread production.
The table’s polished surface revealed the beautiful grain of the oak wood.
She brushed a grain of salt off the counter.
cn: 小麦是制作面包的常见谷物。
抛光后的桌面展现出橡木的美丽纹理。
她从台面上拂去一粒盐。

en: The university granted her a scholarship for outstanding academic performance.
The government issued a grant to support renewable energy research.
He reluctantly granted that their approach might be effective.
cn: 大学因她优异的学术表现授予其奖学金。
政府发放拨款以支持可再生能源研究。
他勉强承认他们的方法可能有效。

en: The book contains vivid graphic descriptions of historical events.
She specializes in graphic design for digital platforms.
The report uses graphic charts to illustrate population growth.
cn: 这本书包含对历史事件的生动图形描述。
她专注于数字平台的图形设计。
报告用图表生动展示了人口增长趋势。

definitions.definition: 坟墓；adj. 严重的，严肃的

en: They laid flowers on the grave of the unknown soldier.
His face was grave as he delivered the bad news.
The situation poses a grave threat to global security.
cn: 他们将鲜花放在无名战士的墓上。
他传达坏消息时面色凝重。
这一局势对全球安全构成严重威胁。

en: The cows graze peacefully in the meadow.
She fell and grazed her knee on the pavement.
The doctor cleaned the graze on his arm.
cn: 牛群在草地上安静地吃草。
她摔倒时膝盖在人行道上擦破了皮。
医生清理了他手臂上的擦伤。

en: The mechanic applied grease to the gears.
Grease the pan before baking to prevent sticking.
cn: 机械师给齿轮涂了润滑脂。
烘焙前在平底锅上涂油以防粘连。

definitions.definition: 悲痛，悲伤（因失去或不幸引发的强烈情绪）

en: She was overcome with grief after her dog passed away.
The poem expresses profound grief for lost love.
cn: 她的狗去世后，她悲痛欲绝。
这首诗表达了对逝去爱情的深切哀伤。

en: She still grieves for her lost cat.
The news grieved the whole community.
It's healthy to grieve after a major loss.
cn: 她仍在为逝去的猫哀伤。
这个消息让整个社区陷入悲痛。
经历重大失去后，哀伤是健康的表现。

en: The soldier's face was grim as he delivered the bad news.
The future looks grim for small businesses in this economy.
She gave a grim smile and turned away.
cn: 士兵面色阴沉地传达了坏消息。
在这种经济环境下，小企业的前景堪忧。
她露出一丝苦笑，转身离开。

definitions.definition: 露齿而笑（通常表示快乐、傻笑或嘲讽）

en: She grinned at me from across the room.
His grin widened when he saw the surprise.
"I told you so," he said with a sly grin.
cn: 她在房间对面朝我咧嘴一笑。
看到惊喜时，他的笑容更灿烂了。
“我早说过吧。”他狡黠地笑道。

en: She tightened her grip on the rope as she climbed.
The politician's speech gripped the nation.
His understanding of physics shows a strong grip on the subject.
cn: 她在攀登时紧紧抓住绳子。
这位政治家的演讲震撼了全国。
他对物理学的理解展现了对这一学科的深刻掌握。

definitions.definition: 呻吟；发出低沉的声音（表达痛苦、不满或压力）

en: He let out a groan as he lifted the heavy box.
The old floorboards groaned under their weight.
She groaned in frustration when her computer crashed again.
cn: 他抬起重箱时发出一声呻吟。
老旧的地板在他们的重量下吱呀作响。
电脑再次崩溃时，她懊恼地叹了口气。

definitions.definition: 凹槽；沟槽；常规模式；舒适状态

en: The carpenter cut a deep groove into the wood.
This song has a strong groove that makes you want to dance.
After years of routine, he was stuck in a groove and needed change.
cn: 木匠在木头上刻了一道深槽。
这首歌节奏感极强，让人忍不住想跳舞。
多年的常规生活让他陷入固定模式，亟需改变。

en: She groped for the light switch in the dark.
The detective groped for clues to solve the mystery.
The law strictly prohibits groping others in public transport.
cn: 她在黑暗中摸索电灯开关。
侦探苦苦寻找破案线索。
法律严禁在公共交通上猥亵他人。

en: The company's gross profit reached $1 million last year.
His jokes were so gross that everyone felt uncomfortable.
The film grossed over $500 million worldwide.
cn: 该公司去年毛利润达100万美元。
他的笑话粗俗不堪，令所有人不适。
这部电影全球票房收入超过5亿美元。

en: The product comes with a two-year guarantee.
Hard work does not guarantee success, but it improves your chances.
She guaranteed the loan for her friend.
cn: 该产品提供两年保修。
努力不保证成功，但能增加机会。
她为朋友的贷款作了担保。

en: She was appointed legal guardian of her younger siblings.
The organization acts as a guardian of traditional crafts.
Ancient myths often depict dragons as guardians of treasure.
cn: 她被指定为弟弟妹妹的法定监护人。
该组织是传统工艺的守护者。
古代神话常将龙描绘为宝藏的守护者。

en: The storm hampered rescue efforts.
She packed a picnic hamper with sandwiches and fruit.
Heavy traffic hampered our progress.
cn: 暴风雨阻碍了救援工作。
她将三明治和水果装进野餐篮。
拥堵的交通拖慢了我们的进度。

en: The student received a handbook outlining the university's policies.
This handbook provides step-by-step instructions for assembling the furniture.
Always keep the safety handbook accessible in the laboratory.
cn: 学生收到了一本概述大学政策的手册。
这本手册提供了组装家具的逐步说明。
实验室里应随时备有安全手册。

en: His injury was a major handicap in the competition.
The new regulations may handicap small businesses.
She refused to let her disability become a handicap.
cn: 他的伤势是比赛中的一大障碍。
新法规可能对小企业造成不利影响。
她拒绝让自己的残疾成为阻碍。

definitions.definition: 强壮的，耐寒的（指植物或人）

en: The hardy shrubs survived the harsh winter.
She was a hardy traveler, unafraid of rough conditions.
His hardy attitude inspired the team.
cn: 这些耐寒灌木熬过了严冬。
她是个大胆的旅行者，不惧艰苦条件。
他勇敢的态度激励了团队。

en: The harmony between colors in this painting is breathtaking.
They sang in perfect harmony during the choir performance.
Social harmony requires mutual understanding and respect.
cn: 这幅画中色彩的和谐令人惊叹。
合唱表演中，他们的歌声完美和鸣。
社会和谐需要相互理解与尊重。

en: She made a hasty decision without considering the consequences.
The hasty retreat of the soldiers left their equipment behind.
Avoid hasty judgments; take time to analyze the situation.
cn: 她草率地做了决定，没有考虑后果。
士兵们匆忙撤退，落下了装备。
避免仓促判断，花时间分析情况。

en: The eggs will hatch in about two weeks.
They hatched a plan to escape the prison.
She climbed through the hatch into the ship’s hold.
cn: 这些蛋大约两周后孵化。
他们策划了一个越狱计划。
她从舱口爬进船舱。

en: His speech was full of hatred toward injustice.
Years of conflict deepened the hatred between the two communities.
She looked at him with pure hatred in her eyes.
cn: 他的言论充满了对不公正的憎恨。
多年的冲突加深了两个社区间的仇恨。
她看着他，眼中带着纯粹的厌恶。

definitions.definition: 拖运的距离或货物；一次捕获量（如渔获）

en: The fishermen hauled the net onto the deck.
It was a long haul to transport the equipment across the desert.
The police made a huge haul of illegal drugs.
cn: 渔民将渔网拖上甲板。
将设备运过沙漠是一段漫长的拖运过程。
警方查获了大量非法毒品。

en: The old castle is said to be haunted by a ghost.
Memories of the war still haunt him decades later.
This café was our favorite haunt in college.
cn: 据说那座古堡有鬼魂出没。
战争的记忆数十年后仍困扰着他。
这家咖啡馆是我们大学时最常去的地方。

en: The hawk circled high above the field, searching for prey.
Street vendors hawk souvenirs to tourists near the monument.
She hawked loudly to clear her throat before speaking.
cn: 鹰在田野上空盘旋，搜寻猎物。
小贩在纪念碑附近向游客兜售纪念品。
她大声清嗓，然后开始讲话。

en: Climbing without proper equipment is a serious hazard.
The chemical plant poses environmental hazards.
He hazarded all his savings on the investment.
cn: 不佩戴专业装备攀岩极其危险。
这家化工厂存在环境隐患。
他把全部积蓄押注在这项投资上。

en: The books were piled in a heap on the floor.
She heaped praise on her team for their hard work.
A heap of broken toys lay in the corner.
cn: 书籍杂乱地堆在地板上。
她对团队的辛勤工作大加赞扬。
一堆破损的玩具堆在角落。

en: The sailors heaved the anchor onto the deck.
Her chest heaved with sobs after the news.
A sudden heave of the ground startled the hikers.
cn: 水手们把锚拖上了甲板。
听到消息后，她的胸膛因抽泣而剧烈起伏。
地面的突然隆起让徒步者们吓了一跳。

definitions.definition: 脚后跟；鞋或袜的后跟部分
给（鞋）装后跟；用脚后跟触碰

en: She scraped her heel on the rough pavement.
The cobbler will heel these shoes with durable rubber.
The sailboat heeled sharply in the strong wind.
cn: 她的脚后跟被粗糙的人行道擦伤了。
鞋匠将为这双鞋装上耐磨的橡胶后跟。
帆船在强风中剧烈倾斜。

en: The curtains will heighten the room's elegance.
Tensions heightened after the disagreement.
Exercise can heighten your awareness of body movements.
cn: 这些窗帘会提升房间的雅致感。
分歧过后，紧张局势加剧。
锻炼能增强你对身体运动的感知。

definitions.definition: 继承人（法律或传统意义上的财产、头衔继承者）

en: The prince is the heir to the throne.
She was named sole heir in her father's will.
As the eldest son, he became the heir of the family estate.
cn: 这位王子是王位的继承人。
她在父亲的遗嘱中被指定为唯一继承人。
作为长子，他成为了家族财产的继承人。

en: The Northern Hemisphere experiences winter in December.
Damage to the left hemisphere may affect language ability.
The artist painted a hemisphere to represent Earth.
cn: 北半球在十二月迎来冬季。
左脑半球受损可能影响语言能力。
艺术家画了一个半球来代表地球。

en: The new policy will be implemented henceforth.
Henceforth, all reports must be submitted by Friday.
She vowed henceforth to speak her mind.
cn: 新政策将从即日起实施。
此后，所有报告须在周五前提交。
她发誓从此要直言不讳。

definitions.definition: 草本植物（尤指药用或调味用的香草）

en: Basil and thyme are common herbs used in Italian cuisine.
She grows medicinal herbs in her garden.
This recipe calls for fresh herbs, not dried ones.
cn: 罗勒和百里香是意大利烹饪中常用的香草。
她在花园里种植药用草本植物。
这道食谱要求用新鲜香草，而非干制的。

definitions.definition: 遗产（指家族、文化或历史传承的财产、传统或特征）
继承物（法律或象征意义上的遗留物）

en: The museum preserves the cultural heritage of indigenous peoples.
She inherited a rich heritage of storytelling from her grandmother.
Protecting natural heritage is crucial for future generations.
cn: 这座博物馆保存着原住民的文化遗产。
她从祖母那里继承了丰富的讲故事传统。
保护自然遗产对子孙后代至关重要。

en: She hesitated before answering the difficult question.
The speaker hesitated, searching for the right words.
Don’t hesitate to ask for help if you need it.
cn: 她在回答这个难题前犹豫了一下。
演讲者停顿片刻，寻找合适的词语。
如果需要帮助，请毫不犹豫地提出来。

en: The corporate hierarchy often slows down decision-making.
In medieval theology, angels were arranged in a strict hierarchy.
She climbed the academic hierarchy to become a dean.
cn: 公司层级制度常导致决策缓慢。
中世纪神学中，天使被严格划分等级。
她在学术体系中晋升为院长。

definitions.definition: 最精彩的部分；高光时刻

en: The highlight of the trip was visiting the ancient temple.
She used a yellow marker to highlight the key points in the document.
His performance was the highlight of the entire concert.
cn: 这次旅行的亮点是参观那座古庙。
她用黄色标记笔突出了文件中的关键点。
他的表演是整个音乐会最精彩的部分。

definitions.definition: 徒步行走；大幅上升（如价格）

en: We planned a weekend hike in the mountains.
The company hiked the prices by 20% due to inflation.
Gasoline prices have hiked again this month.
cn: 我们计划周末去山里徒步。
因通货膨胀，该公司将价格提高了20%。
本月汽油价格再次大幅上涨。

definitions.definition: 后面的；后方的（古义/罕见）

en: Heavy rain hindered the progress of the construction.
His injury didn’t hinder him from winning the race.
The tall shelf stood hinder to the doorway.
cn: 大雨阻碍了施工进度。
他的伤势并未妨碍他赢得比赛。
高大的架子挡在门后。（古义例句）

en: The door creaked on its rusty hinges.
The plot hinges on a single misunderstanding.
Our success hinges on your decision.
cn: 门在生锈的铰链上嘎吱作响。
剧情的关键在于一个误会。
我们的成败取决于你的决定。

en: The historian spent decades deciphering medieval manuscripts.
As a historian, she specializes in oral traditions of indigenous cultures.
The book provides a fresh perspective, written by a young historian.
cn: 这位历史学家花费数十年破译中世纪手稿。
作为历史学家，她专攻原住民文化的口述传统。
这本书由一位年轻历史学家撰写，提供了新颖的视角。

en: The phenomenon was hitherto unknown to scientists.
Hitherto, all attempts to solve the problem had failed.
His true intentions were hitherto concealed.
cn: 这一现象此前从未被科学家发现。
迄今为止，所有解决问题的尝试均告失败。
他的真实意图至今仍被隐藏。

definitions.definition: 升起，吊起（尤指用绳索或机械装置）

en: The crew hoisted the sails as the wind picked up.
A hydraulic hoist is used to lift heavy machinery.
She hoisted her backpack onto her shoulders.
cn: 船员们趁风势增大时升起了帆。
液压起重机用于吊起重型机械。
她把背包甩上了肩膀。

definitions.definition: 同类的；均匀的；由相同或相似成分组成的

en: The mixture should be stirred until it becomes homogeneous.
A homogeneous society shares common cultural values.
The alloy has a homogeneous structure under microscopic examination.
cn: 混合物应搅拌至均匀状态。
同质化社会拥有共同的文化价值观。
显微镜下观察，该合金结构均匀。

en: The rabbit hopped across the field.
She hopped over the puddle to keep her shoes dry.
Hops are essential for brewing beer.
cn: 兔子蹦跳着穿过田野。
她跳过水坑以免弄湿鞋子。
啤酒花是酿造啤酒的关键原料。

en: The firefighter quickly unrolled the hose to extinguish the fire.
She wore striped hose with her vintage dress.
Can you hose down the patio before the guests arrive?
cn: 消防员迅速展开软管灭火。
她穿着条纹长筒袜搭配复古连衣裙。
你能在客人到来前用软管冲洗一下露台吗？

definitions.definition: （商业或服务行业的）友好接待

en: The locals are known for their warm hospitality to tourists.
Luxury hotels pride themselves on exceptional hospitality services.
Her hospitality made us feel at home during the trip.
cn: 当地人以其对游客的热情好客而闻名。
豪华酒店以卓越的接待服务为荣。
她的款待让我们在旅途中感到宾至如归。

en: The terrorists kept three diplomats as hostages.
He felt like a hostage to his demanding job.
The ancient treaty required the exchange of hostages.
cn: 恐怖分子扣押了三名外交官作为人质。
他感觉自己被高压工作绑架了。
这份古老条约要求交换人质。

en: The hostile crowd threw stones at the police.
Plants struggle to survive in hostile environments.
His hostile attitude made teamwork impossible.
cn: 敌对的人群向警察投掷石块。
植物在恶劣环境中艰难生存。
他的敌对态度使团队合作无法进行。

definitions.definition: 猎犬（尤指用于追捕的犬类）

en: The hound picked up the scent of the fox.
Reporters hounded the celebrity for a statement.
Greyhounds are among the fastest breeds of hounds.
cn: 猎犬嗅到了狐狸的气味。
记者们纠缠那位名人要求发表声明。
灵缇是最快的猎犬品种之一。

definitions.definition: 家庭；户（指同住一个住所的人）

en: The average household size in the city has decreased over the past decade.
She is responsible for managing household expenses.
This detergent is designed for household use.
cn: 过去十年，该市的平均家庭规模有所缩小。
她负责管理家庭开支。
这种洗涤剂专为家庭使用设计。

en: The helicopter hovered above the crash site.
She hovered near the door, unsure whether to enter.
The temperature hovers around 30°C in summer.
cn: 直升机在事故现场上空盘旋。
她在门旁徘徊，不确定是否该进去。
夏季气温持续在30摄氏度左右。

definitions.definition: （狼、狗等）嚎叫；（风）呼啸；（人因痛苦或愤怒）吼叫

en: The wolf began to howl at the full moon.
The wind howled through the cracks in the old house.
He howled in pain when he stubbed his toe.
cn: 狼对着满月开始嚎叫。
狂风从老房子的缝隙中呼啸而过。
他踢到脚趾时痛得大叫。

en: The puppies huddled together for warmth.
The team huddled to discuss the final play.
She huddled the papers into her bag.
cn: 小狗们挤在一起取暖。
球队聚在一起商讨最后一击。
她把文件胡乱塞进包里。

en: She gave her friend a warm hug before leaving.
The child hugged the teddy bear tightly.
A hug can sometimes say more than words.
cn: 离开前，她给了朋友一个温暖的拥抱。
孩子紧紧抱着泰迪熊。
有时，一个拥抱胜过千言万语。

en: The refrigerator began to hum softly in the quiet kitchen.
She hummed a tune while watering the plants.
The hum of distant traffic faded as we entered the forest.
cn: 安静的厨房里，冰箱开始发出轻微的嗡嗡声。
她一边给植物浇水，一边哼着小曲。
当我们进入森林时，远处车流的嘈杂声逐渐消失。

en: The documentary highlights the resilience of humanity in crises.
Treating prisoners with humanity is a sign of civilized society.
She holds a PhD in humanities, specializing in ethics.
cn: 这部纪录片展现了人类在危机中的韧性。
人道对待囚犯是文明社会的标志。
她拥有人文学科博士学位，专攻伦理学。

en: Despite his success, he remained humble.
The defeat humbled the arrogant team.
She comes from a humble background.
cn: 尽管成功了，他依然谦逊。
这次失败让那支傲慢的队伍学会了谦卑。
她出身卑微。

en: The high humidity made the heat feel even more oppressive.
Plants thrive in environments with moderate humidity.
The weather forecast predicts rising humidity levels tomorrow.
cn: 高湿度让炎热显得更加难熬。
植物在湿度适中的环境中生长旺盛。
天气预报显示明日湿度将上升。

en: He hurled the ball across the field with all his strength.
The storm hurled debris against the windows.
After drinking too much, he suddenly hurled into the bushes.
cn: 他用尽全力将球掷过场地。
暴风雨将碎片猛烈砸向窗户。
饮酒过量后，他突然冲到灌木丛中呕吐。

definitions.definition: 飓风（特指大西洋和东北太平洋的强热带气旋）

en: The hurricane caused widespread damage along the coast.
Residents evacuated before the hurricane made landfall.
Scientists study hurricane patterns to improve early warnings.
cn: 飓风对沿海地区造成大面积破坏。
居民在飓风登陆前撤离。
科学家研究飓风模式以改进早期预警。

definitions.definition: 假设（科学或逻辑中的初步解释，需进一步验证）
前提（哲学或数学中的基础命题）

en: The researcher proposed a new hypothesis to explain the experimental results.
In geometry, axioms are accepted without proof, but hypotheses require testing.
His argument collapsed because its initial hypothesis was flawed.
cn: 研究者提出一个新假设来解释实验结果。
几何学中，公理无需证明，但假设需验证。
他的论证失败因其初始前提存在缺陷。

definitions.definition: 歇斯底里的，情绪失控的
极其滑稽可笑的（非正式用法）

en: She became hysterical when she heard the tragic news.
The comedian's performance was absolutely hysterical.
His hysterical laughter echoed through the empty hallway.
cn: 听到噩耗时，她变得歇斯底里。
那位喜剧演员的表演简直让人笑到发狂。
他失控的笑声在空荡的走廊里回荡。

en: She is the ideal candidate for the job.
The trip was far from ideal due to the bad weather.
His ideals of justice inspired many people.
cn: 她是这份工作的理想人选。
由于天气恶劣，这次旅行远非理想。
他的正义理想激励了许多人。

en: The two signatures are virtually identical.
Identical twins share 100% of their genetic material.
The equation remains identical after transformation.
cn: 这两份签名几乎一模一样。
同卵双胞胎的基因完全相同。
该方程变换后仍保持恒等。

definitions.definition: 识别；鉴定（确认身份或特征的过程）

en: The identification of the suspect took three days.
Please bring two forms of identification to the interview.
Early identification of the disease improves treatment outcomes.
cn: 嫌疑人的身份鉴定花了三天时间。
面试时请携带两种身份证明文件。
疾病的早期识别能提高治疗效果。
