The contract outlines the obligations of both parties.
cn: 纳税是公民的法律义务。
她感到有道德义务帮助难民。
合同列明了双方的责任。

definitions.definition: 令人反感的，骇人听闻的（引申义）

en: The court banned the book for containing obscene material.
His obscene wealth contrasts sharply with the poverty around him.
The graffiti was deemed obscene and promptly removed.
cn: 法院因该书含有淫秽内容而将其禁封。
他骇人的财富与周围的贫困形成鲜明对比。
涂鸦被判定为低俗内容并迅速清除。

en: The meaning of his poem remains obscure.
Fog obscured the mountain peak.
She gave an obscure answer to avoid the question.
cn: 他的诗作含义依然晦涩难懂。
雾气笼罩了山峰。
她给出模糊的回答以回避问题。

en: The fallen tree was an obstacle to traffic.
Lack of funding is the main obstacle to the project.
She overcame every obstacle with determination.
cn: 倒下的树成了交通障碍。
资金短缺是该项目的主要阻碍。
她以决心克服了每一个困难。

definitions.definition: 获得，得到（通过努力或请求）

en: She managed to obtain a rare copy of the book.
This custom still obtains in some rural areas.
The data was obtained through rigorous experiments.
cn: 她成功获得了这本书的珍本。
这一习俗仍在部分农村地区流行。
数据是通过严谨的实验获得的。

en: She enjoys an occasional glass of wine with dinner.
The room was decorated with occasional balloons for the celebration.
He works as an occasional consultant for the company.
cn: 她偶尔喜欢在晚餐时喝一杯葡萄酒。
房间里零星点缀着为庆祝准备的气球。
他偶尔为这家公司担任顾问。

en: Teaching is her chosen occupation.
The building was under enemy occupation during the war.
Gardening is a relaxing occupation for retirees.
cn: 教学是她选择的职业。
战争期间这栋建筑被敌军占领。
园艺是退休人士的休闲活动。

en: The army decided to occupy the strategic town.
Her work occupies most of her time.
He occupied himself with reading during the flight.
cn: 军队决定占领这个战略重镇。
她的工作占据了她大部分时间。
他在飞行期间以阅读消磨时间。

definitions.definition: 被想到（常与 to 连用）

en: The accident occurred at midnight.
A brilliant idea occurred to her while showering.
Errors may occur if the system is overloaded.
cn: 事故发生在午夜。
洗澡时她突然想到一个绝妙的主意。
系统超载时可能出现错误。

definitions.definition: 气味（尤指强烈或独特的气味，可中性或贬义）

en: The odor of fresh bread filled the bakery.
A strong chemical odor came from the laboratory.
The flowers release a sweet odor to attract bees.
cn: 面包店里弥漫着新鲜面包的香气。
实验室传来一股强烈的化学气味。
这些花朵散发出甜香以吸引蜜蜂。

en: His rude comment caused great offense to the audience.
The player received a penalty for a serious offense.
The team's offense scored three goals in the first half.
cn: 他的无礼言论严重冒犯了听众。
该球员因严重犯规被处罚。
球队的进攻方在上半场攻入三球。

en: His remarks were deeply offensive to the entire community.
The army launched a major offensive at dawn.
She found the joke highly offensive.
cn: 他的言论严重冒犯了整个社区。
军队在黎明时发动了大规模进攻。
她觉得这个笑话极其无礼。

definitions.definition: 抵消；补偿；分支；平版印刷

en: The company uses carbon credits to offset its emissions.
The printer adjusted the offset for clearer text.
The new branch was an offset of the main stem.
cn: 该公司用碳信用抵消其排放。
印刷工调整了平版印刷以使文字更清晰。
新枝条是主干的分支。

en: The lioness fiercely protects her offspring.
His research focuses on the offspring of immigrant families.
These plants produce offspring with unique color variations.
cn: 母狮凶狠地保护她的幼崽。
他的研究聚焦移民家庭的后代。
这些植物繁殖出具有独特颜色变异的幼苗。

en: She added sliced olives to the salad.
The walls were painted in a soft olive green.
Olive trees can live for hundreds of years.
cn: 她在沙拉里加了切片橄榄。
墙面被刷成柔和的橄榄绿色。
橄榄树能存活数百年。

en: The windows were made of opaque glass to ensure privacy.
His explanation was deliberately opaque, leaving us more confused.
The chemical solution turned opaque after mixing.
cn: 窗户采用不透明玻璃以保证隐私。
他的解释故意含糊其辞，让我们更加困惑。
混合后化学溶液变得浑浊不透明。

en: He defeated his opponent in the chess match.
The senator’s opponents criticized the new policy.
Opponent teams often struggle against their defense.
cn: 他在国际象棋比赛中击败了对手。
参议院的反对者们批评了新政策。
对手球队常难以突破他们的防守。

en: The protesters oppose the new law.
His ideas directly oppose mine.
We must oppose injustice with courage.
cn: 抗议者反对这项新法律。
他的观点与我的直接对立。
我们必须勇敢对抗不公。

definitions.definition: 压迫，压制（以权威或武力不公平地控制）
使心情沉重，使压抑（情感上的压迫感）

en: The dictator used the army to oppress political dissent.
The gloomy weather oppressed her spirits.
Laws should protect citizens, not oppress them.
cn: 独裁者动用军队镇压政治异见。
阴郁的天气让她的情绪低落。
法律应保护公民，而非压迫他们。

en: The microscope uses optical lenses to magnify tiny objects.
Optical illusions can trick our brains into seeing things differently.
She works in an optical shop, helping customers choose eyeglasses.
cn: 显微镜利用光学透镜放大微小物体。
视觉错觉会欺骗大脑，让我们看到不同的景象。
她在眼镜店工作，帮助顾客挑选眼镜。

en: Her optimism helped the team stay motivated during tough times.
Scientific progress thrives on a blend of skepticism and optimism.
Despite setbacks, he clung to his optimism about the future.
cn: 她的乐观让团队在困难时期保持了动力。
科学进步源于怀疑精神与乐观主义的结合。
尽管遭遇挫折，他仍对未来保持乐观。

definitions.definition: 乐观的；抱有乐观态度的

en: Despite the challenges, she remained optimistic about the project.
His optimistic outlook often inspires his teammates.
The report ended on an optimistic note, predicting economic recovery.
cn: 尽管面临挑战，她仍对项目保持乐观。
他乐观的态度常常激励队友。
报告以乐观的基调结尾，预测经济将复苏。

en: The temperature for yeast fermentation is at its optimum around 30°C.
This algorithm finds the optimum solution with minimal resources.
Plants grow poorly when conditions deviate from the optimum.
cn: 酵母发酵的最适温度约为30摄氏度。
该算法能以最少资源找到最优解。
当环境偏离最适条件时，植物生长不良。

en: You have the option to accept or decline the offer.
The software provides multiple language options.
He bought a call option on Tesla stocks.
cn: 你有接受或拒绝该提议的选择权。
该软件提供多语言选项。
他购买了特斯拉股票的看涨期权。

definitions.definition: 轨道（天体或人造卫星的运行路径）

en: The satellite entered a stable orbit around Earth.
The company expanded its orbit to include Asian markets.
Electrons orbit the nucleus at high speed.
cn: 卫星进入了稳定的地球轨道。
该公司将业务范围扩展至亚洲市场。
电子以高速绕原子核运行。

definitions.definition: 管弦乐队；乐池（剧场中乐队演奏的区域）

en: The orchestra played a stunning symphony.
She has been a violinist in the orchestra for ten years.
The conductor raised his baton, and the orchestra fell silent.
cn: 管弦乐队演奏了一曲震撼的交响乐。
她担任该管弦乐队的小提琴手已十年。
指挥举起指挥棒，乐队随即安静下来。

definitions.definition: 矿石（含金属的天然矿物）

en: The miners extracted iron ore from the mountain.
This region is rich in copper ore deposits.
Processing raw ore requires specialized equipment.
cn: 矿工从山中开采铁矿石。
该地区富含铜矿矿床。
加工原矿石需要专用设备。

definitions.definition: 使适应；确定方向；以……为方向

en: The compass helped the sailors orient themselves in the open sea.
She took a course to orient new employees to the company culture.
The museum's collection focuses on art from the Orient.
cn: 指南针帮助水手在公海中确定方向。
她开设了一门课程，帮助新员工适应公司文化。
该博物馆的藏品以东方艺术为主。

definitions.definition: 东方的；亚洲的（尤指东亚）
（旧用法）东方人（可能具冒犯性）

en: The museum has a gallery dedicated to oriental art.
This spice is commonly used in oriental cuisine.
cn: 博物馆设有东方艺术专题展厅。
这种香料常见于东方菜肴。

definitions.definition: 适应；培训（对新环境或工作的引导）

en: The map helps with orientation in unfamiliar cities.
New employees undergo a week of orientation.
The orientation of the building maximizes sunlight.
cn: 地图有助于在陌生城市中确定方向。
新员工接受为期一周的入职培训。
建筑物的朝向设计最大化利用了阳光。

en: The origin of this tradition dates back to ancient times.
Her family is of humble origin.
Scientists are still debating the origin of the universe.
cn: 这一传统的起源可追溯至古代。
她的家庭出身卑微。
科学家仍在争论宇宙的起源。

en: The original manuscript was lost in the 19th century.
She has a very original approach to problem-solving.
This painting is a copy; the original hangs in the Louvre.
cn: 这份原始手稿在19世纪遗失了。
她解决问题的办法极具独创性。
这幅画是复制品，原作藏于卢浮宫。

en: The idea originated from an ancient legend.
The river originates in the Himalayan glaciers.
She originated a new method of data analysis.
cn: 这个想法源自一个古老的传说。
这条河发源于喜马拉雅冰川。
她开创了一种新的数据分析方法。

en: The Christmas tree was covered with sparkling ornaments.
She ornamented her essay with poetic quotations.
The architect believed that function should precede ornament.
cn: 圣诞树上挂满了闪闪发光的装饰品。
她用诗意的引文为文章增色。
建筑师认为功能应优先于装饰。

definitions.definition: 正统的（尤指宗教或信仰）

en: She follows orthodox medical practices.
The orthodox view is that the economy will recover soon.
He challenged orthodox ideas about education.
cn: 她遵循正统的医疗方法。
普遍观点认为经济将很快复苏。
他挑战了传统的教育观念。

en: The outbreak of the virus caused global panic.
An outbreak of violence disrupted the peace talks.
In spring, an outbreak of wildflowers covers the hillside.
cn: 病毒的爆发引发了全球恐慌。
暴力事件的爆发打断了和平谈判。
春天，野花突然盛开，覆盖了整个山坡。

en: She bought a new outfit for the job interview.
The team was outfitted with the latest technology.
His hiking outfit included a waterproof jacket and sturdy boots.
cn: 她为求职面试买了一套新衣服。
团队配备了最新技术设备。
他的徒步装备包括防水夹克和结实的靴子。

en: The artist sketched the outline of the mountain before adding details.
Please submit an outline of your proposal by Friday.
The report outlines the main challenges facing the industry.
cn: 艺术家先勾勒出山的轮廓，再添加细节。
请在周五前提交你的提案大纲。
报告概述了该行业面临的主要挑战。

en: The factory's daily output reached 500 units.
The program will output the results to a file.
High creative output requires focused effort.
cn: 工厂的日产量达到500件。
程序将把结果输出到文件。
高创意产出需要专注投入。

en: The decision to cut down the ancient forest caused public outrage.
His rude comments outraged the entire audience.
She felt a deep sense of outrage at the injustice.
cn: 砍伐古森林的决定引发了公愤。
他粗鲁的言论激怒了全场听众。
她对不公正现象感到极度愤慨。

en: From the outset, the project faced unexpected challenges.
She made her intentions clear at the outset of the meeting.
The rules were established at the very outset to avoid confusion.
cn: 项目从一开始就面临意外挑战。
会议一开始她就表明了意图。
规则在一开始就制定好了，以避免混乱。

en: The ship set sail outward bound for distant lands.
Her outward calm hid inner turmoil.
The door opens outward, not inward.
cn: 船只启航，驶向远方的陆地。
她外表的平静掩盖了内心的动荡。
这门向外开，而非向内。

en: She worked hard to overcome her fear of public speaking.
The team overcame many obstacles to win the championship.
He was overcome with joy when he heard the news.
cn: 她努力克服了对公开演讲的恐惧。
这支队伍战胜了重重障碍，最终赢得冠军。
听到消息时，他喜极而泣。

en: The river overflowed after heavy rains.
Her heart overflowed with joy.
The buffer overflow caused a system crash.
cn: 大雨后河水泛滥。
她心中充满喜悦。
缓冲区溢出导致系统崩溃。

definitions.definition: 企业日常开支（如租金、水电等）

en: The birds circled overhead, searching for prey.
The company reduced overhead by switching to remote work.
An overhead projector displayed the slides during the lecture.
cn: 鸟儿在头顶盘旋，寻找猎物。
公司通过远程办公降低了运营成本。
讲座中使用了一台高架投影仪展示幻灯片。

en: I couldn't help but overhear your conversation about the trip.
She overheard her boss discussing layoffs in the hallway.
The walls were so thin that we constantly overheard our neighbors' arguments.
cn: 我无意中听到了你们关于旅行的谈话。
她在走廊偶然听到老板讨论裁员事宜。
墙壁太薄，我们总能听到邻居的争吵。

en: The tiles on the roof overlap to prevent leaks.
Our work schedules overlap for two hours.
There is some overlap between the two theories.
cn: 屋顶瓦片交错重叠以防漏水。
我们的工作时间有两小时重合。
这两种理论存在部分交集。

en: The hotel room overlooks the bay, offering stunning sunset views.
She tends to overlook minor mistakes in her enthusiasm for the project.
The detective overlooked a crucial clue in the initial investigation.
cn: 酒店房间俯瞰海湾，可欣赏壮丽的日落景色。
她对项目的热情使她常常忽略小错误。
侦探在初步调查中忽视了一条关键线索。

en: The city built a new overpass to ease traffic congestion at the intersection.
We walked across the pedestrian overpass to get to the other side of the highway.
The view from the overpass offers a unique perspective of the city streets below.
cn: 该市新建了一座立交桥以缓解十字路口的交通拥堵。
我们步行穿过人行天桥到了高速公路的另一边。
从立交桥上望去，下面的城市街道景色独具一格。

en: His overt criticism of the policy surprised everyone.
The company made an overt effort to improve working conditions.
She showed overt hostility towards the new rules.
cn: 他对政策的公开批评让所有人感到意外。
该公司公开努力改善工作条件。
她对新规定表现出明显的敌意。

en: The rebels planned to overthrow the corrupt government.
The overthrow of the monarchy marked a new era.
A sudden storm can overthrow even the tallest trees.
cn: 叛军计划推翻腐败的政府。
君主制的颠覆标志着一个新时代。
一场暴风雨甚至能掀翻最高的树木。

definitions.definition: 推翻；倾覆（法律、决定或物理状态）

en: The court voted to overturn the controversial law.
A strong wind could overturn the small boat.
The protestors demanded the government overturn its decision.
cn: 法院投票推翻了这项有争议的法律。
强风可能掀翻这艘小船。
抗议者要求政府撤销决定。

definitions.definition: （情感或数量上）压倒，使难以承受

en: The sudden workload overwhelmed her.
The army was overwhelmed by enemy forces.
Kindness can overwhelm hostility.
cn: 突如其来的工作量让她不堪重负。
军队被敌军彻底击溃。
善意能化解敌意。

en: The team felt an overwhelming pressure to win the championship.
She was overcome by an overwhelming desire to help.
The evidence against him was overwhelming.
cn: 队伍感受到赢得冠军的巨大压力。
她被一种强烈的助人欲望所征服。
对他不利的证据具有压倒性。

definitions.definition: 欠（债务、人情等）；应给予（感激、义务等）

en: I owe you twenty dollars for the concert ticket.
She owes her success to hard work and persistence.
We owe our grandparents a visit this weekend.
cn: 我欠你二十美元的音乐会门票钱。
她的成功归功于努力和坚持。
这周末我们该去看看祖父母了。

definitions.definition: 猫头鹰；惯于夜间活动的人

en: The owl hunts small rodents at night.
Her wisdom was compared to that of an owl.
We heard an owl hooting in the woods.
cn: 猫头鹰在夜间捕食小型啮齿动物。
她的智慧被比作猫头鹰（象征智慧）。
我们听到树林里传来猫头鹰的叫声。

definitions.definition: 氧化物（由氧与其他元素化合生成的化合物）

en: Rust is a form of iron oxide.
Aluminum oxide is used in abrasives and ceramics.
The reaction produces carbon dioxide and water.
cn: 锈是氧化铁的一种形式。
氧化铝用于磨料和陶瓷制品。
该反应生成二氧化碳和水。

definitions.definition: 氧气（无色无味的气体，支持燃烧和生命）

en: Plants release oxygen during photosynthesis.
Oxygen masks dropped when the cabin pressure decreased.
Deep-sea divers carry tanks of compressed oxygen.
cn: 植物在光合作用中释放氧气。
机舱压力下降时，氧气面罩自动脱落。
深海潜水员携带压缩氧气瓶。

definitions.definition: 臭氧（一种由三个氧原子组成的分子，化学式O₃）
（比喻）清新空气；令人振奋的氛围

en: The ozone layer protects Earth from harmful ultraviolet radiation.
After the storm, the air smelled fresh with a hint of ozone.
Her energetic speech brought an ozone of excitement to the room.
cn: 臭氧层保护地球免受有害紫外线辐射。
暴风雨后，空气中带着一丝臭氧的清新气味。
她充满活力的演讲为房间注入了振奋的氛围。

definitions.definition: 包裹；包装；成套服务或产品
打包；包装；将…组合成整体

en: The courier delivered a small package to my doorstep.
This software package includes tools for data analysis.
She carefully packaged the fragile items with bubble wrap.
cn: 快递员将一个小包裹送到我家门口。
该软件包包含数据分析工具。
她用气泡膜仔细包装易碎物品。

en: The two nations signed a peace pact after years of conflict.
A pact was made between the companies to share resources.
Breaking the pact would have serious consequences.
cn: 两国在多年冲突后签署了和平协定。
这些公司达成协议共享资源。
违反协议将导致严重后果。

definitions.definition: 小册子（通常指无装订的印刷品，用于宣传或信息传播）

en: The museum distributes a free pamphlet about its exhibits.
She wrote a pamphlet on sustainable gardening.
Political pamphlets were circulated before the election.
cn: 博物馆免费发放介绍展品的小册子。
她撰写了一本关于可持续园艺的小册子。
选举前散发了政治宣传册。

en: The crowd fled in panic when the fire broke out.
News of the virus caused widespread panic.
Don't panic—we still have time to fix this.
cn: 火灾发生时，人群惊慌逃散。
病毒消息引发了广泛恐慌。
别慌，我们还有时间解决。

en: She prefers paperbacks because they're lighter and cheaper.
The novel was first published in hardcover and later released as a paperback.
The airport bookstore has a wide selection of paperbacks for travelers.
cn: 她更喜欢平装书，因为它们更轻便、更便宜。
这本小说最初以精装版发行，后来推出了平装版。
机场书店为旅客准备了种类繁多的平装书。

en: The island was a tropical paradise with white sandy beaches.
In the painting, Adam and Eve are depicted in the Garden of Paradise.
After a long hike, the shaded spring felt like paradise.
cn: 这座岛屿是拥有白色沙滩的热带乐园。
画中描绘了亚当和夏娃在伊甸园的场景。
长途徒步后，阴凉的泉水边宛如天堂。

definitions.definition: 悖论（看似矛盾但可能正确的陈述）

en: The idea of time travel is full of paradoxes.
It’s a paradox that standing is more tiring than walking.
His advice—“be spontaneous”—was itself a paradox.
cn: 时间旅行的概念充满悖论。
站着比走路更累，这是一种矛盾现象。
他的建议“要自然”本身就是个悖论。

definitions.definition: 段落（文章中的独立部分）
短篇报道（尤指新闻中的简讯）

en: Each paragraph should focus on a single main idea.
The editor asked me to shorten the opening paragraph.
A small paragraph in the newspaper mentioned the event.
cn: 每个段落应围绕一个核心观点展开。
编辑要求我缩短开篇段落。
报纸上的一则简讯提到了该事件。

en: The two roads run parallel to each other.
Her career path parallels that of her mentor.
Draw a parallel between the two historical events.
cn: 这两条道路彼此平行。
她的职业轨迹与她的导师相似。
在这两起历史事件间找出相似之处。

en: The accident paralyzed his legs.
Fear paralyzed her ability to speak.
The strike paralyzed the city's transportation.
cn: 事故使他的双腿瘫痪。
恐惧让她说不出话。
罢工使城市交通陷入瘫痪。

en: The model requires three input parameters to function.
We need to work within the parameters of the budget.
Cultural norms set invisible parameters for behavior.
cn: 该模型需要三个输入参数才能运行。
我们必须在预算范围内工作。
文化规范为行为设定了无形的界限。

definitions.definition: 依赖他人生活的人，食客

en: The tapeworm is a parasite that lives in the intestines of its host.
He was seen as a parasite, living off his family’s wealth without working.
Some plants act as parasites, stealing nutrients from nearby roots.
cn: 绦虫是一种寄生在宿主肠道内的寄生虫。
他被视为寄生虫，不工作却靠家族财富生活。
某些植物是寄生植物，从邻近植物的根系窃取养分。

en: The report gives only a partial view of the situation.
Judges must not be partial towards either side.
She has a partial solution to the problem.
cn: 这份报告仅提供了对局部的看法。
法官不得偏袒任何一方。
她对这个问题有一个不完全的解决方案。

en: Every participant received a certificate after the workshop.
She was an active participant in the community project.
The study requires at least 50 participants to be valid.
cn: 每位参与者在研讨会后都获得了证书。
她是该社区项目的积极参与者。
这项研究需要至少50名参与者才能有效。

en: The office was divided by a glass partition.
They agreed to partition the land equally.
The partition of India in 1947 caused massive migration.
cn: 办公室用玻璃隔断分隔开来。
他们同意平均分割这块土地。
1947年印度分治导致大规模人口迁移。

definitions.definition: 强烈的情感（尤指爱、愤怒或热情）

en: She spoke with passion about human rights.
Music has always been his greatest passion.
The team played with passion and determination.
cn: 她充满激情地谈论人权。
音乐一直是他最大的热爱。
这支队伍以热情和决心投入比赛。

en: His passive attitude towards problems often leads to delays.
The sentence is written in the passive voice.
She remained passive during the argument.
cn: 他对问题的消极态度常导致拖延。
这个句子是用被动语态写的。
她在争论中保持沉默。

definitions.definition: 消遣，娱乐（一种打发时间的活动）

en: Reading is her favorite pastime on rainy days.
Gardening became a peaceful pastime after retirement.
The festival offers various pastimes for visitors.
cn: 雨天读书是她最爱的消遣。
园艺成了退休后宁静的消遣。
节日为游客提供了多种娱乐活动。

definitions.definition: 油酥点心（如馅饼、蛋挞等）

en: She baked a flaky pastry filled with apples.
The chef specializes in French pastries.
Roll out the pastry thinly before cutting it into shapes.
cn: 她烤了一个夹苹果的酥皮点心。
这位厨师擅长做法式酥点。
将油酥面团擀薄后再切割成形。

en: The cows grazed peacefully in the lush pasture.
Farmers pasture their sheep on these hills during summer.
Overgrazing can turn fertile pasture into barren land.
cn: 奶牛在茂盛的牧场上安静地吃草。
夏季，农民们在这些山坡上放牧羊群。
过度放牧会使肥沃的牧场变成贫瘠之地。

definitions.definition: 授予专利；取得…的专利权

en: The company filed a patent for its new technology.
His disappointment was patent to everyone in the room.
The government patented the invention to protect the inventor's rights.
cn: 该公司为其新技术申请了专利。
他的失望对房间里的每个人来说都显而易见。
政府为该发明授予专利以保护发明者的权利。

definitions.definition: 可怜的，可悲的（常含贬义，指因无能或失败而引发轻蔑）
无力的，差劲的（形容事物质量低劣或效果微弱）

en: His pathetic attempt at cooking ended with burnt toast and a smoking pan.
cn: 他蹩脚的烹饪尝试以烤焦的面包和冒烟的平底锅告终。

en: He was hailed as a patriot for his sacrifices during the war.
True patriots prioritize their country's welfare over personal gain.
The monument honors the patriots who fought for independence.
cn: 他因战争中的牺牲被誉为爱国者。
真正的爱国者将国家利益置于个人得失之上。
这座纪念碑纪念为独立而战的爱国者们。

en: His patriotic speech moved the crowd to tears.
Waving flags is a common patriotic act during national holidays.
She felt a deep patriotic duty to serve her country.
cn: 他的爱国演讲让听众感动落泪。
挥舞国旗是国家节日期间常见的爱国行为。
她深感为国服务是崇高的爱国责任。

en: The police increased patrols in the downtown area after the incident.
Soldiers patrol the border day and night.
Our neighborhood has a volunteer patrol to ensure safety.
cn: 事件发生后，警方加强了市中心区域的巡逻。
士兵们日夜在边境巡逻。
我们社区有一支志愿巡逻队保障安全。

definitions.definition: 赞助人（尤指艺术或慈善事业的资助者）
（古罗马）保护民（受贵族庇护的自由民）

en: The museum's patron donated a rare painting to its collection.
He has been a loyal patron of this café for years.
In ancient Rome, a patron was responsible for the legal protection of his clients.
cn: 这位博物馆的赞助人捐赠了一幅珍稀画作。
他是这家咖啡馆多年的忠实顾客。
在古罗马，保护人需为其庇护的自由民提供法律保护。

en: The fabric has a floral pattern.
Her behavior follows a predictable pattern.
Architects often pattern their designs after nature.
cn: 这块布料有花卉图案。
她的行为遵循可预测的模式。
建筑师常模仿自然进行设计。

en: The city plans to pave the dirt road next year.
Ancient Romans paved their highways with stone blocks.
Her success was paved by years of hard work.
cn: 该市计划明年铺设这条土路。
古罗马人用石块铺设他们的主干道。
她的成功源于多年的辛勤付出。

en: The climbers reached the mountain peak at dawn.
Sales tend to peak during the holiday season.
Her career peaked with the Nobel Prize win.
cn: 登山者在黎明时分抵达山顶。
销售额通常在假日季达到顶峰。
她的职业生涯因诺贝尔奖而达到巅峰。

en: She wore a necklace of exquisite pearls.
The morning dew lay like pearls on the grass.
His words were pearls of wisdom.
cn: 她戴着一串精美的珍珠项链。
晨露如珍珠般点缀在草叶上。
他的话是智慧的结晶。

en: The dish had a peculiar taste, unlike anything I'd tried before.
Each culture has its own peculiar traditions.
He gave me a peculiar look when I mentioned her name.
cn: 这道菜有一种奇特的味道，与我以前尝过的任何东西都不同。
每种文化都有其独特的传统。
当我提到她的名字时，他奇怪地看了我一眼。

en: She pressed the pedal to accelerate the car.
He pedaled furiously to climb the hill.
The piano's sustain pedal creates resonance.
cn: 她踩下踏板加速汽车。
他奋力蹬车爬上山坡。
钢琴的延音踏板能产生共鸣效果。

en: The city built wider sidewalks to protect pedestrians.
His speech was rather pedestrian, lacking original ideas.
Pedestrian traffic increases during rush hour.
cn: 该市修建了更宽的人行道以保护行人。
他的演讲相当平淡，缺乏原创观点。
高峰时段行人流量会增加。

en: She carefully peeled the apple with a knife.
The paint on the wall has started to peel.
Orange peel can be used to make zest for cooking.
cn: 她用小刀仔细地削苹果皮。
墙上的油漆开始剥落了。
橙子皮可制成烹饪用的橙皮屑。

definitions.definition: 木钉；挂钩；衣夹；（乐器的）弦轴
用钉子固定；限定（价格等）

en: She hung her coat on the wooden peg by the door.
The government pegged the currency to the US dollar.
He tightened the peg to tune his violin.
cn: 她把外套挂在门边的木钉上。
政府将货币与美元挂钩。
他拧紧弦轴来调准小提琴的音。

en: The judge imposed a heavy penalty for tax evasion.
The team scored from a penalty kick in the final minute.
Late submissions will incur a penalty of 10% per day.
cn: 法官对逃税行为处以重罚。
球队在最后一分钟通过点球得分。
逾期提交将面临每日10%的罚金。

en: The pendulum swings back and forth with perfect regularity.
Public opinion is a pendulum that never stops moving.
He adjusted the pendulum to keep accurate time.
cn: 钟摆以完美的规律来回摆动。
民意是永不停止摇摆的钟摆。
他调整钟摆以确保时间准确。

definitions.definition: 企鹅（南极洲及南半球其他地区的不会飞的海鸟）

en: The penguin waddled across the icy shore.
Climate change threatens penguin habitats.
Penguins use their wings as flippers to swim.
cn: 企鹅摇摇晃晃地走过结冰的海岸。
气候变化威胁企鹅的栖息地。
企鹅将翅膀当作鳍状肢来游泳。

en: The Korean Peninsula is located in East Asia.
They built a lighthouse at the tip of the peninsula.
Florida is a well-known peninsula in the southeastern United States.
cn: 朝鲜半岛位于东亚。
他们在半岛的顶端建造了一座灯塔。
佛罗里达是美国东南部著名的半岛。

definitions.definition: 感知，觉察（通过感官获得信息的过程）
理解，看法（对事物的个人解读或观点）

en: Her perception of colors changed after the accident.
Cultural background influences our perception of beauty.
The study examines infants' perception of facial expressions.
cn: 事故后，她对颜色的感知发生了变化。
文化背景影响我们对美的理解。
该研究探讨婴儿对面部表情的觉察能力。

en: She strives for perfection in every detail of her work.
The dish was cooked to perfection.
Perfection is an ideal, not a reality.
cn: 她追求工作中每个细节的完美。
这道菜烹制得恰到好处。
完美是一种理想，而非现实。

en: Her piano performance moved the audience to tears.
The company evaluates employees based on their performance.
This car has excellent fuel performance.
cn: 她的钢琴演奏让观众感动落泪。
公司根据员工表现进行评估。
这辆车的燃油性能极佳。

en: She wore a delicate perfume that reminded him of spring.
The flowers perfumed the entire room.
This perfume is made from rare essential oils.
cn: 她身上淡淡的香水味让他想起春天。
花朵的芬芳弥漫了整个房间。
这款香水由珍稀精油制成。

en: The professor discussed the periodic motion of planets in the solar system.
Sodium is a reactive metal in the periodic table.
She receives periodic updates from her research team.
cn: 教授讨论了太阳系中行星的周期性运动。
钠是周期表中一种活泼的金属元素。
她定期收到研究团队的进度更新。

en: The magazine is a monthly periodical focusing on environmental issues.
Her migraines followed a periodical pattern, occurring every two weeks.
University libraries subscribe to hundreds of academic periodicals.
cn: 这本杂志是关注环境问题的月刊。
她的偏头痛呈周期性模式，每两周发作一次。
大学图书馆订阅了数百种学术期刊。

definitions.definition: 使消亡；使腐烂（罕见用法）

en: Without water, plants will perish quickly.
Ancient civilizations perished due to climate change.
The old documents perished in the fire.
cn: 没有水，植物会迅速枯死。
古代文明因气候变化而消亡。
那些古老文件在大火中焚毁。

en: The tattoo is a permanent reminder of her journey.
He moved from temporary to permanent employment.
She got a permanent to curl her hair.
cn: 纹身是她旅程的永久纪念。
他从临时工转为了正式员工。
她烫了头发让卷度持久。

en: The smell of fresh bread permeated the entire bakery.
Sunlight permeates through the curtains in the morning.
His ideas gradually permeated into mainstream culture.
cn: 新鲜面包的香气弥漫了整个面包店。
晨光透过窗帘渗入房间。
他的思想逐渐渗透到主流文化中。

en: It is not permissible to smoke in this area.
The error margin was within permissible limits.
Are these chemicals permissible for use in food production?
cn: 此区域禁止吸烟。
误差范围在允许限度内。
这些化学品允许用于食品生产吗？

en: The waterfall creates a perpetual mist in the valley.
She was tired of their perpetual arguments.
The museum houses a perpetual flame honoring war heroes.
cn: 瀑布在山谷中形成永不停歇的水雾。
她厌倦了他们无休止的争吵。
博物馆内供奉着纪念战争英雄的长明火。

en: His sudden silence perplexed everyone in the room.
The instructions were so vague that they only served to perplex the users.
She gave him a perplexed look when he mentioned the unknown name.
cn: 他突然的沉默让房间里所有人都感到困惑。
说明过于模糊，反而让用户更加困惑。
当他提到那个陌生名字时，她露出了困惑的表情。

en: If symptoms persist, consult a doctor immediately.
She persisted in her efforts to reform the education system.
The rumor persisted despite official denials.
cn: 如果症状持续，请立即就医。
她坚持不懈地推动教育改革。
尽管官方否认，谣言仍持续流传。

en: She was persistent in her efforts to learn English.
The persistent rain caused flooding in the area.
His persistent questions finally led to the truth.
cn: 她坚持不懈地学习英语。
持续的降雨导致该地区洪水泛滥。
他锲而不舍的提问最终揭示了真相。

definitions.definition: 视角；观点（观察事物的特定方式）
透视法（绘画中的空间表现技法）
透视的（与透视法相关的）

en: The documentary offers a fresh perspective on climate change.
Renaissance artists mastered linear perspective in their paintings.
Try to see the issue from his perspective before judging.
cn: 这部纪录片为气候变化提供了新的视角。
文艺复兴时期的艺术家精通绘画中的线性透视法。
在评判前，先试着从他的角度理解问题。

definitions.definition: 信仰；信念（尤指宗教或政治观点）

en: She used logic and emotion in equal measure for her persuasion.
Despite his efforts at persuasion, the committee remained unconvinced.
People of different political persuasions attended the debate.
cn: 她运用逻辑与情感并重的方式进行劝说。
尽管他竭力说服，委员会仍不为所动。
持有不同政治信念的人们参加了这场辩论。

en: His pessimistic outlook made him expect failure in every endeavor.
Despite the setbacks, she refused to become pessimistic.
The report presented a pessimistic view of the economic recovery.
cn: 他悲观的态度让他对每件事都预期失败。
尽管遭遇挫折，她拒绝变得悲观。
这份报告对经济复苏持悲观看法。

en: The farmer used natural predators to control pests in his crops.
Stop being such a pest and let me work!
Mosquitoes are considered a major pest in tropical regions.
cn: 农夫用天敌来控制庄稼里的害虫。
别这么烦人，让我工作！
蚊子被视为热带地区的主要有害生物。

en: Over 10,000 people signed the petition to protect the local park.
Citizens petitioned the government for cleaner air policies.
Her petition for a retrial was denied by the court.
cn: 超过一万人签署了保护当地公园的请愿书。
市民向政府请愿要求更清洁的空气政策。
她要求重审的申请被法院驳回。

en: Don’t waste time on petty arguments.
She was tired of his petty complaints.
The manager ignored petty details to focus on the big picture.
cn: 别把时间浪费在琐碎的争吵上。
她受够了他那些斤斤计较的抱怨。
经理忽略了细枝末节，专注于大局。

en: The project is in its final phase.
The moon's phases affect tidal patterns.
We will phase the new policies gradually.
cn: 该项目处于最后阶段。
月相影响潮汐模式。
我们将逐步分阶段实施新政策。

definitions.definition: 现象（可观察的事件或事实）
非凡的人或事物（引申义）

en: The northern lights are a natural phenomenon that attracts many tourists.
Her talent for music is truly a phenomenon.
Scientists studied the phenomenon of climate change extensively.
cn: 北极光是一种吸引众多游客的自然现象。
她的音乐才华堪称非凡。
科学家们广泛研究气候变化现象。

en: The drug's physiological effects were carefully monitored.
Physiological changes during exercise include increased heart rate.
His research focuses on the physiological basis of behavior.
cn: 该药物的生理效应被严格监测。
运动时的生理变化包括心率加快。
他的研究专注于行为的生理学基础。

definitions.definition: 朝圣者（尤指宗教目的的旅行者）
流浪者；长途跋涉的人（比喻用法）

en: The pilgrim traveled hundreds of miles to reach the sacred shrine.
Medieval pilgrims often carried staffs and wore distinctive badges.
She described her artistic journey as a pilgrim in search of truth.
cn: 这位朝圣者跋涉数百英里抵达圣地。
中世纪的朝圣者常手持木杖，佩戴特殊徽章。
她将艺术探索比作追寻真理的朝圣之旅。

en: The pirate ship was spotted near the coast.
He was accused of pirating software for profit.
In the 18th century, pirates ruled the Caribbean.
cn: 海盗船在海岸附近被发现。
他因盗版软件牟利被起诉。
18世纪时，海盗主宰了加勒比海。

en: He drew a pistol from his coat pocket.
The detective pistoled the lock to break in.
Early pistols were notoriously inaccurate.
cn: 他从大衣口袋掏出一把手枪。
侦探用手枪击碎门锁闯入。
早期手枪以精度极差著称。

definitions.definition: 音高；投掷；沥青；推销用语

en: The singer’s pitch was perfect during the performance.
He used a shovel to spread hot pitch on the roof.
The startup founder pitched her idea to the investors.
cn: 歌手在演出中的音高非常准确。
他用铲子将热沥青涂在屋顶上。
初创公司创始人向投资者推销她的创意。

definitions.definition: 瘟疫；灾难；令人头疼的事物

en: The Black Death was a devastating plague in medieval Europe.
Financial problems continued to plague the company for years.
Mosquitoes are a real plague in tropical regions.
cn: 黑死病是中世纪欧洲的一场毁灭性瘟疫。
财务问题多年来一直困扰着这家公司。
蚊子在热带地区真是令人头疼的存在。

definitions.definition: 行星（围绕恒星运行的天体）
（占星学中的）星体（传统上指肉眼可见的七颗天体，包括太阳和月亮）

en: Earth is the third planet from the Sun.
Ancient astronomers studied the movements of planets.
In astrology, the position of planets is believed to influence human affairs.
cn: 地球是太阳系第三颗行星。
古代天文学家研究行星的运行轨迹。
占星学中，行星的位置被认为会影响人事。

en: The workers plastered the walls smoothly.
She applied a plaster to the small cut.
His hair was plastered to his forehead by the rain.
cn: 工人将墙面抹得平整光滑。
她给伤口贴了一张创可贴。
雨水把他的头发紧贴在额头上。

definitions.definition: 达到稳定水平；进入停滞期

en: The Tibetan Plateau is often called the "Roof of the World."
After rapid growth, sales began to plateau.
Her career reached a plateau, prompting her to learn new skills.
cn: 西藏高原常被称为“世界屋脊”。
快速增长后，销售额开始趋于平稳。
她的职业发展进入停滞期，促使她学习新技能。

en: His explanation sounds plausible, but we need more evidence.
The salesman gave a plausible excuse for the delayed delivery.
Her theory is plausible but lacks experimental support.
cn: 他的解释听起来合理，但我们需要更多证据。
销售员为延迟交货提供了一个看似可信的借口。
她的理论看似合理，但缺乏实验支持。

en: He made a desperate plea for help.
The defendant entered a plea of not guilty.
Her tearful plea touched everyone's heart.
cn: 他绝望地恳求帮助。
被告提出无罪抗辩。
她含泪的请求打动了每个人的心。

en: She pleaded with him to stay.
The lawyer will plead the case in court tomorrow.
He pleaded ignorance when asked about the missing files.
cn: 她恳求他留下来。
律师将于明日出庭为此案辩护。
被问及丢失的文件时，他以不知情为由辩解。

en: He made a pledge to donate part of his income to charity.
The land was held as a pledge for the loan.
Students pledged to reduce plastic use on campus.
cn: 他承诺将部分收入捐给慈善机构。
这块土地被作为贷款的抵押品。
学生们承诺在校园内减少塑料制品的使用。

en: The diver plunged into the crystal-clear water.
Stock prices plunged after the economic report.
She decided to take the plunge and start her own business.
cn: 跳水者扎入清澈的水中。
经济报告发布后股价暴跌。
她决定冒险一试，开始创业。

en: She finds solace in writing poetry.
The imagery in his poetry is strikingly vivid.
There’s a subtle poetry in the way light filters through the leaves.
cn: 她在写诗中找到慰藉。
他诗中的意象鲜明生动。
光线穿过树叶的方式有一种微妙的诗意。

en: Some mushrooms are highly poisonous and can cause death if eaten.
She gave him a poisonous look after the argument.
The factory released poisonous gases into the atmosphere.
cn: 某些蘑菇有剧毒，食用可能导致死亡。
争吵后，她恶狠狠地瞪了他一眼。
这家工厂向大气排放有毒气体。

en: She poked the fire to make it burn brighter.
Don't poke your nose into other people's business.
He just poked around the house all day.
cn: 她拨了拨火，让它烧得更旺。
别多管闲事。（直译：别把鼻子戳进别人的事里）
他一整天都在家里闲晃。

definitions.definition: 极地的；与地球两极相关的

en: The polar bear is uniquely adapted to survive in the Arctic.
Their opinions on the issue are polar opposites.
Scientists study polar ice caps to understand climate change.
cn: 北极熊具有独特的适应性，能在北极生存。
他们对此问题的观点截然相反。
科学家通过研究极地冰盖来理解气候变化。

en: The flag was mounted on a tall wooden pole.
The Earth's magnetic poles are shifting gradually.
Their opinions represent two opposite poles of the debate.
cn: 旗帜挂在一根高大的木杆上。
地球的磁极正在逐渐偏移。
他们的观点代表了辩论中对立的两极。

en: She polished the silverware until it shone.
His essay needs some polish before submission.
The furniture has a deep polish from years of care.
cn: 她将银器擦得闪闪发亮。
他的论文还需稍加润色才能提交。
多年的保养让家具表面光泽深邃。

en: She paused to ponder the question before answering.
Philosophers often ponder the meaning of life.
He sat by the window, pondering his next move.
cn: 她在回答前停下来仔细思考这个问题。
哲学家们常常沉思生命的意义。
他坐在窗边，思索下一步行动。

definitions.definition: 教皇（罗马天主教会最高领袖的称号）

en: The pope delivered a speech on global peace.
In medieval Europe, the pope held significant political influence.
Some Eastern Orthodox churches also use "pope" for their bishops.
cn: 教皇就全球和平发表了演讲。
在中世纪欧洲，教皇拥有重要的政治影响力。
一些东正教会也用“pope”称呼其主教。

definitions.definition: 门廊（建筑物入口处有顶的开放式空间）
（美式）阳台（房屋外侧的开放式平台）

en: She sat on the porch, sipping tea and watching the sunset.
The old house has a wraparound porch with wooden rocking chairs.
In summer, we often eat dinner on the screened porch to avoid mosquitoes.
cn: 她坐在门廊上，喝着茶看日落。
这栋老房子有一个带摇椅的环绕式门廊。
夏天我们常在纱窗阳台上吃晚饭以防蚊子。

definitions.definition: 仔细阅读；沉思（常与 over 连用）

en: Sweat exits the body through pores in the skin.
She pored over the ancient manuscript for clues.
Plant leaves have tiny pores for gas exchange.
cn: 汗液通过皮肤上的毛孔排出体外。
她仔细研读古老的手稿以寻找线索。
植物叶片有用于气体交换的微小气孔。

en: The artist portrayed the queen in a formal pose.
He portrayed the villain with chilling realism.
The novel vividly portrays life in medieval Europe.
cn: 艺术家以正式姿态描绘了女王。
他以令人胆寒的真实感扮演了反派。
小说生动刻画了中世纪欧洲的生活。

en: She posed for the portrait with a serene smile.
His kindness was just a pose to gain trust.
The question posed a serious challenge to the theory.
cn: 她带着平静的微笑摆好姿势准备画像。
他的友善只是获取信任的伪装。
这个问题对该理论提出了严峻挑战。

en: She has a positive attitude toward life.
The test results came back positive.
He gave positive feedback on the project.
cn: 她对生活抱有积极的态度。
检测结果呈阳性。
他对项目给予了肯定的反馈。

en: She possesses a rare collection of medieval manuscripts.
Fear possessed him when he entered the abandoned house.
The law states that citizens possess the right to free speech.
cn: 她拥有一批珍贵的中世纪手稿。
当他走进废弃房屋时，恐惧支配了他。
法律规定公民享有言论自由权。

en: She has perfect posture when playing the piano.
The politician postured as a champion of the poor.
Good posture helps prevent back pain.
cn: 她弹钢琴时姿势非常标准。
这位政客摆出一副穷人捍卫者的姿态。
良好的姿势有助于预防背痛。

en: She has the potential to become a great leader.
The drug has potential side effects.
We are exploring the potential of renewable energy.
cn: 她有潜力成为一名伟大的领导者。
这种药物可能有副作用。
我们正在探索可再生能源的潜力。

en: Millions of people still live in extreme poverty.
The poverty of her imagination made the story dull.
His research focuses on reducing child poverty.
cn: 仍有数百万人生活在极端贫困中。
她想象力的匮乏使得故事索然无味。
他的研究致力于减少儿童贫困问题。

definitions.definition: 可实施的，行得通的（指计划、想法等）
可通行的（指道路、路线等）

en: The committee is evaluating whether the proposed plan is practicable.
The mountain path is only practicable in dry weather.
We need to find a practicable solution to this complex problem.
cn: 委员会正在评估所提出的计划是否可行。
这条山路仅在天气干燥时可以通行。
我们需要为这个复杂问题找到一个行得通的解决方案。

en: The priest preached about kindness in his sermon.
She preaches the importance of environmental protection.
Stop preaching and start acting!
cn: 牧师在布道中宣讲仁慈。
她宣扬环境保护的重要性。
别再空谈，付诸行动吧！

definitions.definition: 在...之前发生（或出现）；先于

en: The lightning usually precedes the thunder.
A detailed explanation should precede the experiment.
In the protocol, ambassadors precede other diplomats in rank.
cn: 闪电通常先于雷声出现。
实验前需先进行详细说明。
根据礼仪规范，大使的级别高于其他外交官。

en: The court's decision set a legal precedent.
There is no precedent for such a situation.
His actions were without precedent in company history.
cn: 法院的判决确立了一项法律先例。
这种情况尚无先例可循。
他的行为在公司历史上没有先例。

en: She kept her precious jewels in a safe.
Time is the most precious resource we have.
His grandmother's advice was precious to him.
cn: 她将珍贵的珠宝存放在保险箱中。
时间是我们拥有的最宝贵资源。
祖母的忠告对他来说无比珍贵。

en: The scientist took precise measurements to ensure the experiment's accuracy.
Her instructions were clear and precise, leaving no room for confusion.
The watch is known for its precise timekeeping.
cn: 科学家进行了精确测量以确保实验的准确性。
她的指示清晰而严谨，不容任何混淆。
这款手表以走时精准著称。

en: The heavy rain precluded us from holding the outdoor ceremony.
His prior commitment precluded any chance of attending the meeting.
Strict regulations preclude the use of unapproved materials.
cn: 大雨使我们无法举行户外仪式。
他先前的承诺使他完全无法参加会议。
严格的规定排除了使用未经批准材料的可能性。

definitions.definition: 前任；前辈（指职位、职务上的前一位担任者）

en: My predecessor left detailed notes to help me transition into the role.
The new model is faster than its predecessor.
We should learn from the mistakes of our predecessors.
cn: 我的前任留下了详细的笔记，帮助我顺利接手工作。
新款比旧款速度更快。
我们应从前人的错误中吸取教训。

en: The weather forecast predicts heavy rain tomorrow.
Ancient astrologers tried to predict events by studying stars.
No one could have predicted the sudden market crash.
cn: 天气预报预测明天有大雨。
古代占星家试图通过观测星象来预言事件。
没人能预料到市场的突然崩溃。

en: The predominant color in her painting is deep blue.
English is the predominant language in international business.
His predominant characteristic is his relentless optimism.
cn: 她画作的主色调是深蓝色。
英语是国际商务中的主导语言。
他最显著的特质是始终如一的乐观。

en: A dark suit is preferable to a light one for evening wear.
It would be preferable to postpone the meeting.
Fresh ingredients are always preferable to canned ones.
cn: 深色西装比浅色更适合晚间穿着。
推迟会议会是更可取的做法。
新鲜食材总比罐装的更胜一筹。

en: She has a strong preference for tea over coffee.
The committee gave preference to candidates with practical experience.
Personal preference should not influence professional decisions.
cn: 她比起咖啡更偏爱茶。
委员会优先考虑有实践经验的候选人。
个人偏好不应影响专业决策。

en: The study aims to reduce racial prejudice in schools.
His honesty prejudiced the jury in his favor.
Don’t let gossip prejudice you against her.
cn: 这项研究旨在减少学校中的种族偏见。
他的诚实让陪审团对他产生了有利的偏见。
别让流言蜚语让你对她产生偏见。

en: The team conducted a preliminary analysis of the data.
The first round is just a preliminary to the main competition.
We need to complete some preliminary paperwork before starting the project.
cn: 团队对数据进行了初步分析。
第一轮仅是主赛事的预赛。
项目启动前需完成一些预备文件工作。

en: The project failed due to premature decisions.
Premature babies often need special medical care.
His premature retirement surprised everyone.
cn: 该项目因仓促决策而失败。
早产儿通常需要特殊医疗护理。
他的提前退休让所有人感到意外。

en: She holds the premier position in the company.
The premier announced new economic policies.
This museum houses the premier collection of Renaissance art.
cn: 她在公司担任最高职位。
总理宣布了新的经济政策。
该博物馆拥有最顶尖的文艺复兴艺术藏品。

en: The argument is based on a false premise.
Let me premise my remarks by stating the facts.
The study premises that climate change is accelerating.
cn: 这一论点建立在错误的前提上。
请允许我先陈述事实作为开场。
该研究以气候变化加速为前提。

en: Customers pay a premium for organic products.
This hotel offers premium services to its guests.
The stock is trading at a 10% premium to its market value.
cn: 消费者为有机产品支付额外费用。
这家酒店为客人提供优质服务。
该股票以高于市场价10%的溢价交易。

definitions.definition: 处方（医生开具的治疗方案）
规定，法规（正式指令或规则）

en: The doctor gave me a prescription for antibiotics.
The new prescription requires all employees to wear safety gear.
Ancient Roman prescriptions were often carved on stone tablets.
cn: 医生给我开了一张抗生素处方。
新规定要求所有员工佩戴安全装备。
古罗马的法规常刻在石板上。

definitions.definition: 呈现；表现形式（如数据、艺术）

en: She gave a brilliant presentation on climate change.
The presentation of the award will take place tomorrow.
This app improves the presentation of complex data.
cn: 她做了一场关于气候变化的精彩演讲。
颁奖仪式将于明天举行。
该应用优化了复杂数据的呈现方式。

definitions.definition: 保护，保存（免受损害或变化）

en: We must preserve these ancient forests for future generations.
Grandmother used to preserve peaches in honey.
The wildlife preserve is home to endangered species.
cn: 我们必须为后代保护这些原始森林。
祖母过去常用蜂蜜腌制桃子。
这片野生动物保护区是濒危物种的家园。

definitions.definition: 主持（会议、活动等）；担任主席
统辖；掌管（正式场合或机构）

en: She will preside over the annual shareholders' meeting next week.
The judge presided the trial with fairness and patience.
Ancient kings often presided at religious ceremonies to assert their authority.
cn: 她将于下周主持年度股东大会。
法官以公正和耐心主持了这场审判。
古代国王常主持宗教仪式以宣示权威。

en: The water pressure in the pipes is too high.
She felt pressure to succeed from her family.
The government pressured the company to reduce emissions.
cn: 管道中的水压过高。
她感受到来自家庭的成功压力。
政府施压该公司减少排放。

en: The university's prestige attracts top scholars worldwide.
She wore a dress of undeniable prestige.
His prestige in the field earned him the leadership role.
cn: 这所大学的声望吸引了全球顶尖学者。
她穿了一条尽显高贵的裙子。
他在该领域的威望使他赢得了领导职位。

definitions.definition: 大概，可能（基于合理推测）

en: Presumably, the meeting will be postponed due to the storm.
He didn't answer the phone, presumably because he was busy.
The project will presumably take three months to complete.
cn: 由于暴风雨，会议很可能会推迟。
他没接电话，大概是因为在忙。
这个项目预计需要三个月完成。

definitions.definition: 假定；推测（基于有限证据）

en: We must presume innocence until guilt is proven.
I presume you’ve already read the report?
He presumed to give advice without being asked.
cn: 在证明有罪之前，我们必须假定无罪。
我猜你已经读过报告了吧？
他未经请求就擅自提建议。

definitions.definition: 借口；托词（表面理由，常含欺骗性）

en: He used a business meeting as a pretext to avoid the family gathering.
The spy entered the building under the pretext of making a delivery.
Her kindness was just a pretext to gain his trust.
cn: 他以商务会议为借口逃避家庭聚会。
间谍以送货为幌子进入大楼。
她的友善只是获取他信任的托词。

definitions.definition: 说服（常与 on/upon 连用）

en: Justice will prevail in the end.
The custom of wearing hats indoors still prevails in some regions.
She prevailed upon her father to lend her the car.
cn: 正义终将获胜。
室内戴帽的习俗仍在某些地区盛行。
她说服父亲把车借给了她。

en: The belief that hard work leads to success is prevalent in many cultures.
Smartphones have become prevalent tools for communication.
During the pandemic, mask-wearing was prevalent worldwide.
cn: 努力工作能带来成功的信念在许多文化中普遍存在。
智能手机已成为占主导地位的通讯工具。
疫情期间，戴口罩的做法在全球范围内盛行。

en: She showed no interest in previous discussions.
The previous owner left the house in good condition.
Check the previous chapter for background information.
cn: 她对先前的讨论毫无兴趣。
前主人将房子保持得完好。
背景信息请查阅前一章节。

en: The director allowed us to preview the first episode of the new series.
You can preview the document before printing it.
The movie preview attracted a large audience to the cinema.
cn: 导演允许我们预览新剧集的第一集。
打印前你可以预先查看文档。
电影的预告片吸引了大量观众到影院。

en: The lion stalked its prey silently through the grass.
Cybercriminals often prey on elderly people.
Owls prey mainly on small rodents at night.
cn: 狮子悄无声息地在草丛中潜近它的猎物。
网络罪犯常以老年人为目标进行诈骗。
猫头鹰主要在夜间捕食小型啮齿动物。

definitions.definition: 神父，牧师（基督教或其他宗教的圣职人员）

en: The priest delivered a sermon on kindness.
In ancient Egypt, priests performed rituals in temples.
She decided to confide in the local priest about her struggles.
cn: 这位神父布道关于仁慈的主题。
在古埃及，祭司们在神庙中执行仪式。
她决定向当地牧师倾诉她的困境。

en: The study is primarily focused on climate change.
She works primarily as a consultant but also teaches part-time.
The damage was primarily caused by human error.
cn: 这项研究主要关注气候变化。
她主要从事顾问工作，但也兼职教学。
损坏主要由人为错误导致。

en: The primary goal of education is to foster critical thinking.
She attended a primary school in the countryside.
He won the Democratic primary in New Hampshire.
cn: 教育的主要目标是培养批判性思维。
她曾就读于乡村的一所小学。
他在新罕布什尔州赢得了民主党初选。

en: She is in the prime of her career.
The coach primed the team before the final match.
cn: 她正处于事业的巅峰期。
教练在决赛前为团队做了充分准备。

en: The archaeologists discovered primitive tools made of stone.
His painting style is deliberately primitive, with bold colors and rough shapes.
Some tribes still live a primitive lifestyle in the rainforest.
cn: 考古学家发现了石器时代的原始工具。
他的绘画风格刻意追求原始感，色彩浓烈，线条粗犷。
一些部落仍在雨林中过着原始的生活。

en: The principal announced new school policies during assembly.
The principal amount of the loan must be repaid within five years.
She played the principal role in the theater production.
cn: 校长在集会上宣布了新校规。
贷款本金需在五年内偿还。
她在戏剧中担任主角。

en: The experiment confirmed a basic principle of physics.
She refused to compromise her principles.
Democracy operates on the principle of majority rule.
cn: 这个实验验证了物理学的一项基本原理。
她拒绝违背自己的原则。
民主制度遵循多数决原则运作。

en: Safety is our top priority.
The project has priority over all others.
Tickets will be sold in order of priority.
cn: 安全是我们的首要任务。
该项目优先于其他所有项目。
门票将按优先顺序出售。

en: She values her privacy and rarely posts on social media.
The new law aims to protect digital privacy.
The hotel room offered complete privacy with soundproof walls.
cn: 她重视隐私，很少在社交媒体上发帖。
新法律旨在保护数字隐私。
这间酒店房间的隔音墙提供了绝对的私密性。

en: Education should be a right, not a privilege.
He was privileged to attend the private conference.
Wealth often brings social privileges.
cn: 教育应是权利，而非特权。
他获准参加这场内部会议。
财富常带来社会特权。

en: The probability of rain tomorrow is 70%.
In quantum physics, probability determines particle behavior.
There's a high probability he'll win the election.
cn: 明天降雨的概率是70%。
在量子物理学中，概率决定粒子行为。
他赢得选举的可能性很高。

en: The surgeon used a sterile probe to examine the wound.
Journalists probed into the corruption scandal for months.
NASA's space probe sent back stunning images of Jupiter.
cn: 外科医生用无菌探针检查伤口。
记者们对这起腐败丑闻进行了数月的深入调查。
美国宇航局的太空探测器传回了木星的惊人图像。

definitions.definition: 程序，步骤（正式或官方的操作流程）
手术（医学领域特定用法）

en: The company has strict procedures for handling complaints.
The surgical procedure took less than an hour.
Follow the correct procedure to reset your password.
cn: 公司有严格的投诉处理流程。
这台手术用时不到一小时。
按照正确步骤重置密码。

definitions.definition: （会议、诉讼等的）正式记录；活动进程

en: The conference proceedings will be published next month.
Legal proceedings against the company have begun.
She reviewed the proceedings of the previous meeting.
cn: 会议记录将于下月出版。
针对该公司的法律诉讼已启动。
她查阅了上次会议的纪要。

en: The manufacturing process requires strict quality control.
She learned how to process raw data into meaningful reports.
Grief is a natural process that takes time.
cn: 制造过程需要严格的质量控制。
她学会了如何将原始数据处理成有意义的报告。
悲伤是一个需要时间的自然过程。

en: The king proclaimed a national holiday.
Her confident tone proclaimed her authority.
The poster proclaimed the arrival of the circus.
cn: 国王宣布全国放假一天。
她自信的语气彰显了她的权威。
海报宣告了马戏团的到来。

en: She transformed her small garden into a productive vegetable patch.
The meeting was highly productive, with three key decisions made.
His creative block ended, and he entered a productive phase.
cn: 她将小花园改造成高产菜地。
会议效率极高，达成了三项关键决议。
创作瓶颈结束后，他进入了高产阶段。

en: New technologies have significantly improved agricultural productivity.
Employee productivity is often linked to workplace satisfaction.
The country ranks high in terms of economic productivity.
cn: 新技术大幅提高了农业生产力。
员工生产率常与工作满意度相关。
该国的经济生产率排名靠前。

definitions.definition: 公开宣称；声称（尤指信仰或情感）
教授（学科，古义或正式用法）

en: She professed her love for classical music.
He professed to be an expert, but his advice was flawed.
In medieval times, monks professed vows of poverty.
cn: 她公开表达了对古典音乐的热爱。
他自称专家，但其建议漏洞百出。
中世纪时，僧侣公开立誓守贫。

definitions.definition: 职业，专业（需专门知识或培训的领域）
公开声明，宣称（尤指信仰或立场）

en: Teaching is a rewarding profession that requires patience and dedication.
She made a profession of her political beliefs during the rally.
The medical profession has seen significant advancements in recent years.
cn: 教学是一项需要耐心和奉献的有意义的职业。
她在集会上公开表明了自己的政治信仰。
近年来，医学领域取得了重大进展。

en: She is a professional photographer with over 10 years of experience.
His professional attitude impressed the clients.
The tennis tournament is open to both amateurs and professionals.
cn: 她是一名拥有10年以上经验的职业摄影师。
他的专业态度给客户留下了深刻印象。
这场网球比赛对业余选手和职业选手均开放。

en: Her proficiency in Spanish impressed the interviewers.
The course aims to develop technical proficiency in programming.
His proficiency with tools made the repair work effortless.
cn: 她的西班牙语熟练程度令面试官印象深刻。
该课程旨在培养编程技术上的精通能力。
他对工具的熟练使用让维修工作毫不费力。

en: The new marketing strategy proved highly profitable.
Reading books is a profitable use of your time.
They turned a failing business into a profitable venture.
cn: 这一新营销策略被证明非常有利可图。
阅读书籍是对时间的有益利用。
他们将一家濒临倒闭的企业转变为盈利项目。

en: His speech had a profound impact on the audience.
She felt a profound sadness after the loss.
The book explores profound questions about human existence.
cn: 他的演讲对观众产生了深远的影响。
失去后，她感到深深的悲伤。
这本书探讨了关于人类存在的深刻问题。

en: The company adopted a progressive approach to employee benefits.
She is a vocal advocate for progressive environmental policies.
The disease causes progressive loss of muscle control.
cn: 该公司采取了渐进式的员工福利政策。
她是环保进步政策的积极倡导者。
这种疾病会导致肌肉控制能力逐渐丧失。

en: The school prohibits students from using phones in class.
Smoking is strictly prohibited in this area.
High costs prohibit many people from accessing healthcare.
cn: 学校禁止学生在课堂上使用手机。
此区域严禁吸烟。
高昂费用使许多人无法获得医疗服务。

en: The team completed the research project on time.
The tree projects a long shadow in the evening sun.
She projected confidence during her presentation.
cn: 团队按时完成了该研究项目。
树木在夕阳下投下长长的影子。
她在演讲中展现出了自信。

en: The doctor suggested surgery to prolong his life.
She tried to prolong the conversation by asking trivial questions.
Modern medicine has prolonged the average human lifespan significantly.
cn: 医生建议通过手术延长他的生命。
她试图用琐碎的问题拖延谈话。
现代医学显著延长了人类的平均寿命。

en: The church tower was the most prominent feature of the skyline.
She played a prominent role in the scientific breakthrough.
His prominent cheekbones gave his face a distinctive look.
cn: 教堂的塔楼是天际线上最醒目的特征。
她在这项科学突破中发挥了重要作用。
他高耸的颧骨让他的面容独具特色。

definitions.definition: 表现出未来成功潜力的

en: She is a promising young scientist with groundbreaking ideas.
The early test results look promising for the new drug.
His promising career was cut short by the accident.
cn: 她是一位有前途的年轻科学家，拥有突破性的想法。
这种新药的早期测试结果看起来很有希望。
一场事故中断了他本应光明的事业。

en: She worked hard and was promoted to manager within a year.
This campaign aims to promote environmental awareness.
The company spends millions to promote its new smartphone.
cn: 她努力工作，一年内就被晋升为经理。
该活动旨在提升环保意识。
公司花费数百万推广新款智能手机。

en: She is prone to headaches in humid weather.
The patient lay prone during the examination.
Young drivers are more prone to accidents.
cn: 她在潮湿天气容易头痛。
检查时患者呈俯卧位。
年轻司机更容易出事故。

en: The scientist presented conclusive proof of the theory.
Please check the printer's proof before mass production.
This fabric is water-resistant but not fully waterproof.
cn: 科学家提出了该理论的确凿证据。
批量印刷前请核对校样。
这种面料防水但不完全耐水。

definitions.definition: 宣传（常含贬义，指系统性、偏颇的信息传播）

en: The film exposed the government's wartime propaganda.
She dismissed the claims as mere propaganda.
The leaflets were pure propaganda, with no factual basis.
cn: 这部电影揭露了政府的战时宣传。
她认为这些说法不过是宣传伎俩。
这些传单是纯粹的宣传，毫无事实依据。

definitions.definition: 传播（思想、知识等）；繁殖（植物或生物）

en: Farmers propagate new plants by cuttings.
The internet helps propagate ideas rapidly.
Misinformation can propagate through social media.
cn: 农民通过扦插繁殖新植株。
互联网帮助快速传播思想。
错误信息可能通过社交媒体蔓延。

en: The engine uses burning gases to propel the rocket forward.
She was propelled to fame by her groundbreaking research.
Wind can propel a sailboat across the water effortlessly.
cn: 发动机利用燃烧气体推动火箭前进。
她的突破性研究使她一举成名。
风能轻松推动帆船穿越水面。

en: The house is now her legal property.
Scientists studied the chemical properties of the substance.
Respect for intellectual property is crucial in research.
cn: 这栋房子现在是她的合法财产。
科学家研究了该物质的化学特性。
尊重知识产权在研究中至关重要。

definitions.definition: 先知（宗教或精神领域的预言者）
预言家（能预见未来的人或事物）

en: The prophet warned the people of the coming disaster.
Many considered him a prophet of technological innovation.
Ancient prophets often spoke in riddles.
cn: 先知警告人们即将到来的灾难。
许多人视他为科技创新的预言家。
古代先知常以谜语的形式预言。

definitions.definition: 向…提出建议（尤指不当要求）

en: The committee rejected his proposition to cut funding.
In logic, a proposition must be either true or false.
He was propositioned by a stranger at the bar.
cn: 委员会否决了他削减资金的提议。
在逻辑学中，命题必须非真即假。
他在酒吧被陌生人提出了不当要求。

definitions.definition: 散文（与诗歌相对的非韵文文体）
平淡无奇的表达（引申义）

en: Her prose is clear and concise, making complex ideas accessible.
The report was written in dry bureaucratic prose.
He can turn even mundane events into lively prose.
cn: 她的散文清晰简洁，使复杂思想易于理解。
这份报告以枯燥的官僚式文体写成。
他能将平凡小事转化为生动的散文。

en: The state decided to prosecute the case due to new evidence.
She plans to prosecute her studies in environmental law.
Failure to prosecute corrupt officials undermines public trust.
cn: 由于新证据出现，州政府决定起诉此案。
她计划继续攻读环境法学。
对腐败官员的不起诉会削弱公众信任。

en: The job offers excellent career prospects.
They are prospecting for gold in the mountains.
The prospect of rain ruined our picnic plans.
cn: 这份工作提供良好的职业前景。
他们正在山区勘探金矿。
下雨的可能性破坏了我们的野餐计划。

definitions.definition: 潜在的（尤指可能成为客户或成员的人）

en: The company is evaluating prospective employees this week.
Prospective changes in the law may affect small businesses.
She attended a seminar for prospective homebuyers.
cn: 公司本周正在评估潜在雇员。
法律的预期变化可能影响小型企业。
她参加了面向潜在购房者的研讨会。

en: The city became prosperous through trade and innovation.
She comes from a prosperous family with a long history.
The prosperous economy attracted many investors.
cn: 这座城市通过贸易和创新变得繁荣。
她出身于一个历史悠久的富裕家庭。
繁荣的经济吸引了众多投资者。

definitions.definition: 蛋白质（生物体内的重要有机化合物，由氨基酸组成）

en: Egg whites are rich in protein.
Athletes need more protein to repair muscles.
This plant-based protein powder is easy to digest.
cn: 蛋清富含蛋白质。
运动员需要更多蛋白质修复肌肉。
这种植物蛋白粉易于消化。

en: The citizens organized a protest against the new law.
She protested her innocence in front of the jury.
The workers threatened to protest if wages were cut.
cn: 市民们组织抗议反对新法律。
她在陪审团面前申明自己的清白。
工人威胁若降薪将发起抗议。

definitions.definition: 原型（原始模型或初代版本）

en: The engineer built a prototype to test the new design.
This robot is the prototype for future household assistants.
Her innovative approach became a prototype for social reforms.
cn: 工程师制作了原型来测试新设计。
这款机器人是未来家用助手的原型。
她的创新方法成为社会改革的范例。

definitions.definition: provide 的过去式/过去分词：提供

en: You can borrow the car, provided you return it by 5 PM.
The materials were provided free of charge.
Provided no one objects, we’ll postpone the meeting.
cn: 只要你在下午5点前归还，就可以借这辆车。
这些材料是免费提供的。
倘若无人反对，我们将推迟会议。

definitions.definition: 条款；规定（法律或合同中的）

en: The government ensured the provision of clean water to the disaster-stricken area.
Article 5 of the contract contains a provision about termination.
The ship was provisioned for a six-month voyage.
cn: 政府确保向灾区供应清洁用水。
合同第5条包含一项关于终止的条款。
这艘船配备了六个月的航行物资。

en: Her provocative remarks sparked a heated debate.
The ad used provocative imagery to attract attention.
His tone was deliberately provocative during the negotiation.
cn: 她的挑衅言论引发了一场激烈争论。
广告用挑逗性图像吸引眼球。
谈判中他的语气刻意带有煽动性。

en: His rude remarks provoked an angry response.
The documentary provoked a heated debate about climate change.
She deliberately provoked him by ignoring his advice.
cn: 他的粗鲁言论激起了愤怒的回应。
这部纪录片引发了关于气候变化的激烈争论。
她故意无视他的建议来激怒他。

definitions.definition: 接近，邻近（指空间或时间上的靠近）

en: The proximity of the school to the park makes it convenient for children to play after class.
Cultural proximity often facilitates better understanding between neighboring countries.
The sensor detects the proximity of objects within a 5-meter range.
cn: 学校靠近公园，方便孩子们课后玩耍。
文化上的邻近性常促进邻国间更好的理解。
该传感器能检测5米范围内物体的接近。

definitions.definition: 修剪（树枝、植物）；删减（文字等）
西梅干（李子的一种干果）

en: She carefully pruned the rose bushes to encourage new growth.
The editor pruned redundant paragraphs from the manuscript.
These prunes are rich in fiber and antioxidants.
cn: 她仔细修剪玫瑰丛以促进新枝生长。
编辑删去了手稿中冗余的段落。
这些西梅干富含纤维和抗氧化剂。

definitions.definition: 精神病医生；精神病学家

en: The psychiatrist prescribed medication to help manage her anxiety.
He decided to consult a psychiatrist after experiencing prolonged insomnia.
Modern psychiatrists often combine therapy with pharmacological treatments.
cn: 这位精神病医生开了药以帮助控制她的焦虑。
在长期失眠后，他决定咨询一位精神病医生。
现代精神病学家常将心理疗法与药物治疗结合使用。

en: The study examines the psychological effects of social media on teenagers.
She provided psychological support to disaster survivors.
His fear of heights has a psychological rather than physical cause.
cn: 这项研究探讨了社交媒体对青少年的心理影响。
她为灾难幸存者提供了心理支持。
他的恐高症源于心理而非生理原因。

definitions.definition: 布丁（一种甜点，通常由牛奶、糖、蛋等制成，质地柔软）

en: She made a chocolate pudding for dessert.
In the UK, "pudding" can sometimes mean any dessert.
He’s always thinking about his next pudding.
cn: 她做了一份巧克力布丁当甜点。
在英国，“pudding”有时可泛指任何甜点。
他总在惦记下一顿饭。（俚语用法）

en: She baked a delicious pumpkin pie for Thanksgiving.
The farmer harvested dozens of pumpkins from the field.
Don't act like such a pumpkin—everyone's contribution matters.
cn: 她为感恩节烤了一个美味的南瓜派。
农夫从田里收获了数十个南瓜。
别摆出一副大人物的样子——每个人的贡献都很重要。

en: She purchased a vintage dress at the flea market.
The company made a large purchase of new equipment.
He kept a firm purchase on the rope during the climb.
cn: 她在跳蚤市场买了一条复古连衣裙。
公司大批购置了新设备。
他在攀爬时紧紧抓住绳子。

en: The water filter can purify contaminated water.
Ancient rituals were believed to purify the soul.
Plants help purify the air by absorbing toxins.
cn: 这款滤水器能净化受污染的水。
古人相信仪式能涤净灵魂。
植物通过吸收毒素净化空气。

en: The purity of the mountain air is refreshing.
She was admired for the purity of her character.
The lab tests confirmed the 99.9% purity of the gold.
cn: 山间空气的纯净令人神清气爽。
她因品性纯洁而受人尊敬。
实验室检测证实黄金纯度为99.9%。

en: His pursuit of knowledge led him to study abroad.
The police are in pursuit of the escaped prisoner.
Fishing is her favorite outdoor pursuit.
cn: 他对知识的追求促使他出国留学。
警方正在追捕逃犯。
钓鱼是她最喜爱的户外活动。

en: She decided to pursue a career in medicine.
The police pursued the suspect through the alley.
He continues to pursue his passion for photography.
cn: 她决定从事医学事业。
警察在小巷中追捕嫌疑人。
他继续追求对摄影的热爱。

definitions.definition: 与质量相关的；性质上的

en: The study uses a qualitative approach to analyze cultural trends.
There's a qualitative difference between these two fabrics.
Her feedback provided qualitative insights beyond the statistics.
cn: 该研究采用定性方法分析文化趋势。
这两种面料存在质的差异。
她的反馈提供了统计数据之外的定性洞见。

definitions.definition: 量化（用数值表示或测量）

en: Scientists strive to quantify the effects of climate change.
The survey aims to quantify customer satisfaction levels.
Happiness is difficult to quantify in monetary terms.
cn: 科学家努力量化气候变化的影响。
该调查旨在量化客户满意度。
幸福很难用金钱量化。

en: The study uses both qualitative and quantitative methods.
Quantitative analysis revealed a significant increase in protein levels.
Investors rely on quantitative data to predict market trends.
cn: 这项研究同时采用了定性与定量的方法。
定量分析显示蛋白质水平显著上升。
投资者依赖量化数据预测市场趋势。

definitions.definition: 夸脱（液体或干量单位，约等于0.946升或1.101升）

en: She poured a quart of milk into the mixing bowl.
The engine requires two quarts of oil for a full change.
A quart of strawberries is enough for the recipe.
cn: 她将一夸脱牛奶倒入搅拌碗中。
这台发动机需要两夸脱机油进行彻底更换。
一夸脱草莓足够做这道甜点。

en: The magazine is published quarterly.
She receives quarterly reports from the finance team.
The company pays dividends quarterly.
cn: 这本杂志每季度出版一期。
她定期收到财务团队的季度报告。
该公司按季度支付股息。

definitions.definition: 石英（一种坚硬、透明的矿物，化学成分为二氧化硅）

en: The watch uses quartz to keep precise time.
Quartz crystals are often found in granite.
Her necklace was made of polished rose quartz.
cn: 这款手表利用石英来保持精确时间。
石英晶体常见于花岗岩中。
她的项链由抛光的粉晶制成。

en: The old house had a queer atmosphere, as if time stood still.
Don’t queer the deal by mentioning the budget too early.
cn: 这座老房子有一种怪异的气氛，仿佛时间静止了。
别过早提预算，搞砸了这笔交易。

definitions.definition: 熄灭（火、光等）；解渴；抑制（欲望等）

en: The firefighters worked tirelessly to quench the raging wildfire.
She drank a glass of water to quench her thirst after the long run.
His enthusiasm for the project was quenched by constant setbacks.
cn: 消防员奋力扑灭肆虐的山火。
长跑后，她喝了一杯水解渴。
接连的挫折浇灭了他对项目的热情。

en: The knight embarked on a quest to find the holy grail.
Scientists continue their quest for a cure to the disease.
Her lifelong quest for knowledge inspired many students.
cn: 骑士踏上寻找圣杯的征程。
科学家们持续寻找这种疾病的治疗方法。
她毕生对知识的追求激励了许多学生。

en: The researcher designed a detailed questionnaire to collect data.
Please complete the online questionnaire by Friday.
The questionnaire results revealed surprising trends.
cn: 研究者设计了一份详细的问卷来收集数据。
请在周五前完成在线问卷调查。
问卷结果揭示了出人意料的趋势。

en: The archer drew an arrow from his quiver.
Her voice began to quiver with emotion.
The leaves quiver in the breeze.
cn: 弓箭手从箭袋中抽出一支箭。
她的声音因情绪激动而开始颤抖。
树叶在微风中轻轻颤动。

en: The government imposed a strict quota on imported goods.
Each team member must meet their weekly sales quota.
The university increased the quota for international students.
cn: 政府对进口商品实施了严格的配额限制。
每位团队成员必须完成每周销售定额。
该大学提高了国际学生的招生限额。

en: The study examines racial disparities in healthcare access.
Racial equality remains a global challenge.
Her artwork explores racial identity in multicultural societies.
cn: 这项研究探讨了医疗资源获取中的种族差异。
种族平等仍是全球性挑战。
她的艺术作品探讨多元文化社会中的种族身份认同。

definitions.definition: 球拍（网球、羽毛球等运动器材）

en: She swung the tennis racket with perfect form.
The children made a terrible racket while playing upstairs.
He was arrested for running a drug racket.
cn: 她以标准的姿势挥动网球拍。
孩子们在楼上玩耍时吵闹不堪。
他因经营毒品非法交易被捕。

en: The radiant sun warmed the frozen lake.
Her face was radiant with joy at the news.
The diamond’s radiant sparkle caught everyone’s attention.
cn: 耀眼的阳光融化了结冰的湖面。
听到消息后，她脸上洋溢着喜悦的光芒。
钻石璀璨的光芒吸引了所有人的注意。

en: The sun radiates heat and light to the planets.
Her smile radiated confidence and warmth.
The city's design makes streets radiate from a central square.
cn: 太阳向行星辐射热和光。
她的笑容散发着自信与温暖。
城市设计使街道从中央广场向外辐射延伸。

en: She proposed a radical solution to the problem.
His political views are considered radical by many.
cn: 她提出了一个彻底解决问题的方案。
他的政治观点被许多人视为激进。

definitions.definition: 放射性的；由放射性物质引起的

en: Uranium is a highly radioactive element.
The lab stored radioactive waste in shielded containers.
Marie Curie's research pioneered the study of radioactive materials.
cn: 铀是一种强放射性元素。
实验室将放射性废料存放在屏蔽容器中。
居里夫人的研究开创了放射性物质研究的先河。

definitions.definition: 半径（几何学中从圆心到圆周的直线距离）
桡骨（解剖学中前臂的两根骨头之一）

en: The radius of the circle is 5 centimeters.
He fractured his radius while skating.
The explosion affected everything within a 10-mile radius.
cn: 这个圆的半径是5厘米。
他滑冰时摔断了桡骨。
爆炸波及方圆10英里内的所有事物。

en: The selection process was completely random.
She picked a random number between 1 and 100.
His answer seemed random and unrelated to the question.
cn: 选择过程完全是随机的。
她从1到100中随机选了一个数字。
他的回答看似随意，与问题无关。

en: He holds a high rank in the military.
The garden was rank with weeds after the rain.
The judge ranked the contestants by skill.
cn: 他在军队中拥有高级军衔。
雨后花园里杂草丛生。
裁判按技能为参赛者划分等级。

en: He gave a sharp rap on the door with his knuckles.
The senator faced rap for his controversial statement.
She learned to rap in freestyle battles.
cn: 他用指节在门上清脆地敲了一下。
参议员因争议言论遭到严厉批评。
她通过在即兴对抗赛中练习说唱。

en: The novel depicts the rape of a village during the war.
Survivors of sexual violence often face long-term trauma.
Ancient texts describe how invading armies would rape and pillage.
cn: 这部小说描绘了战争中村庄遭洗劫的惨状。
性暴力幸存者常面临长期心理创伤。
古代文献记载了侵略军队如何烧杀掳掠。

en: She rarely eats fast food because she prefers home-cooked meals.
Such historical artifacts are rarely found in such good condition.
He rarely speaks during meetings, but his ideas are always insightful.
cn: 她很少吃快餐，因为她更喜欢家常菜。
这类历史文物很少能以如此完好的状态被发现。
他在会议上很少发言，但他的想法总是很有见地。

en: Don't make rash decisions without thinking.
She developed a rash after touching the plant.
His rash driving caused the accident.
cn: 不要在未思考的情况下轻率做决定。
她接触那株植物后出现了皮疹。
他的鲁莽驾驶导致了事故。

definitions.definition: （电视节目的）收视率；（音乐的）排行榜名次

en: The movie has an 8.5/10 rating on IMDb.
TV networks closely monitor audience ratings.
Her credit rating improved after paying off the loan.
cn: 这部电影在IMDb上的评分为8.5/10。
电视台密切关注观众收视率。
还清贷款后，她的信用评级提高了。

en: She made a rational decision after carefully analyzing the data.
His argument sounded rational but lacked emotional appeal.
cn: 她在仔细分析数据后做出了理性决定。
他的论点听起来合理，但缺乏情感共鸣。

definitions.definition: 反应（对刺激或事件的回应）

en: Her reaction to the news was surprisingly calm.
The chemical reaction produced a bright blue light.
Every action has an equal and opposite reaction.
cn: 她对这消息的反应出奇地平静。
该化学反应产生了明亮的蓝光。
每个作用力都有大小相等、方向相反的反作用力。

en: She readily agreed to help with the project.
The information is readily available online.
The chemical dissolves readily in water.
cn: 她欣然同意协助这个项目。
这些信息可轻松在网上获取。
这种化学物质易溶于水。

definitions.definition: （艺术或文学）现实主义的，逼真的

en: She has a realistic chance of winning the competition.
The novel is praised for its realistic portrayal of rural life.
We need to set realistic goals for the project.
cn: 她很有希望赢得比赛。
这部小说因对乡村生活的真实刻画而备受赞誉。
我们需要为项目设定切实可行的目标。

en: Farmers reap wheat in autumn.
She reaped the benefits of years of hard work.
You will reap what you sow.
cn: 农民在秋季收割小麦。
她收获了多年辛勤工作的成果。
种瓜得瓜，种豆得豆。

definitions.definition: 再次保证（强调重复动作）

en: The doctor reassured her that the surgery was routine.
He quickly reassured his team after the unexpected setback.
A warm smile can often reassure a nervous child.
cn: 医生安慰她，这只是个常规手术。
意外受挫后，他迅速给团队吃了定心丸。
一个温暖的微笑常能安抚紧张的孩子。

en: The rebel group fought against the government for years.
Teenagers often rebel against their parents' rules.
She was labeled a rebel for challenging traditional norms.
cn: 反叛组织与政府对抗多年。
青少年常抵触父母的管束。
她因挑战传统规范被称为叛逆者。

definitions.definition: 叛乱，反抗（针对权威或统治的公开抵抗）
叛逆行为（对常规或约束的抵制）

en: The peasant rebellion was brutally suppressed by the king’s army.
Her punk hairstyle was a quiet act of rebellion against school rules.
The colony’s rebellion led to its independence after decades of struggle.
cn: 农民起义被国王的军队残酷镇压。
她的朋克发型是对校规的无声反抗。
殖民地的叛乱经过数十年斗争后赢得了独立。

en: She couldn't recall where she left her keys.
The company issued a recall of defective products.
The mayor recalled his earlier statement after public criticism.
cn: 她记不起钥匙放在哪里了。
公司发布了缺陷产品的召回令。
市长在公众批评后撤回了先前的声明。

en: The floodwaters began to recede after three days.
His hairline is receding as he ages.
Memories of the event receded into the background over time.
cn: 洪水在三天后开始退去。
随着年龄增长，他的发际线逐渐后移。
关于这件事的记忆随时间推移逐渐淡去。

en: The store emailed me a digital receipt after the purchase.
Please sign this form to acknowledge receipt of the package.
The waiter forgot to receipt our payment, so we requested a copy.
cn: 商店在购买后给我发送了电子收据。
请签署这份表格以确认收到包裹。
服务员忘记给我们收据，因此我们索要了一份副本。

en: The hotel reception is open 24 hours a day.
Her speech got a warm reception from the audience.
My phone has poor reception in the basement.
cn: 酒店前台24小时开放。
她的演讲受到观众热烈欢迎。
我的手机在地下室信号很差。

definitions.definition: 经济衰退（经济活动显著下降的时期）
后退，撤回（空间或动作上的退离）

en: The country entered a severe recession after the financial crisis.
Glaciers' recession due to climate change is alarming.
The slow recession of floodwaters prolonged the recovery efforts.
cn: 该国在金融危机后陷入严重的经济衰退。
冰川因气候变化而后退的现象令人担忧。
洪水缓慢退去，延长了灾后恢复的时间。

en: She followed the recipe carefully to bake a perfect cake.
Hard work is the basic recipe for success.
The doctor wrote a recipe for herbal medicine.
cn: 她严格按照食谱烤出了一个完美的蛋糕。
努力是成功的基本诀窍。
医生开了一副草药处方。

definitions.definition: 接受的；容纳的（罕见用法）

en: The recipient of the award thanked the committee in her speech.
Ensure the email reaches the intended recipient.
This plant is a recipient of nutrients from the surrounding soil.
cn: 获奖者在演讲中感谢了评审委员会。
确保邮件送达目标收件人。
这种植物从周围土壤中吸收养分。

en: The two countries have a reciprocal agreement on visa exemptions.
Kindness is often reciprocal; when you give it, you receive it.
In math, the reciprocal of 5 is 1/5.
cn: 两国签署了互免签证的协议。
善意常是相互的：付出即会得到。
数学中，5的倒数是1/5。

en: She can recite all the poems from memory.
The lawyer recited the facts of the case.
Students were asked to recite the alphabet backwards.
cn: 她能背诵所有诗歌。
律师详细陈述了案件事实。
学生被要求倒背字母表。

en: His reckless driving caused a serious accident.
She regretted her reckless decision to quit the job.
The fire was started by a reckless camper.
cn: 他的鲁莽驾驶导致了一场严重事故。
她后悔自己草率决定辞职。
火灾是由一名粗心的露营者引发的。

definitions.definition: 依赖；指望（与 on/upon 连用）

en: She reckoned the total cost before making a decision.
I reckon it will rain tomorrow.
You can reckon on his support.
cn: 她在做决定前计算了总成本。
我认为明天会下雨。
你可以指望他的支持。

definitions.definition: 要求归还；开垦（土地）；改造（不良行为）

en: The government plans to reclaim land from the sea for urban development.
She reclaimed her stolen bicycle with the help of the police.
This program helps reclaim troubled youth through education.
cn: 政府计划填海造地以用于城市发展。
她在警方帮助下找回了被盗的自行车。
该项目通过教育帮助问题青少年改过自新。

definitions.definition: 承认；认可（如成就或地位）
识别；辨认（如面孔或声音）

en: Her work finally gained international recognition.
Facial recognition technology is widely used in security systems.
He nodded in recognition when he saw his old friend.
cn: 她的工作最终获得了国际认可。
人脸识别技术被广泛应用于安防系统。
他看到老朋友时点头示意认出了对方。

en: I barely recognized her after ten years.
The government refused to recognize the new regime.
He was recognized for his contributions to science.
cn: 十年后我几乎认不出她了。
政府拒绝承认新政权。
他因科学贡献受到表彰。

en: The mediator helped them reconcile their differences.
It's hard to reconcile his actions with his words.
She reconciled herself to the new circumstances.
cn: 调解员帮助他们化解了分歧。
他的言行难以自圆其说。
她让自己适应了新的环境。

en: The reconciliation between the two nations took decades of diplomacy.
Monthly bank reconciliation helps detect accounting errors.
Her art explores the reconciliation of tradition and modernity.
cn: 两国的和解经历了数十年的外交努力。
每月银行对账有助于发现会计错误。
她的作品探讨传统与现代的调和。

definitions.definition: 恢复（健康、意识等）；重新获得

en: She needed time to recover from the surgery.
The team recovered the stolen artifacts.
The economy is slowly recovering.
cn: 她需要时间从手术中恢复。
团队找回了被盗的文物。
经济正在缓慢复苏。

en: She made a full recovery after the surgery.
The police announced the recovery of the stolen artwork.
Economic recovery depends on consumer confidence.
cn: 她在手术后完全康复了。
警方宣布追回了被盗的艺术品。
经济复苏取决于消费者信心。

en: Hiking is my favorite form of recreation.
The park offers various recreational facilities.
Reading provides both knowledge and recreation.
cn: 徒步是我最喜爱的休闲方式。
这个公园提供多种娱乐设施。
阅读既能获取知识，也是一种消遣。

definitions.definition: 招募，征募（新成员或员工）

en: The company plans to recruit 50 engineers this year.
Army recruits undergo rigorous training.
She was recruited straight from university.
cn: 该公司计划今年招募50名工程师。
新兵需要接受严格训练。
她刚从大学毕业后就被招募。

en: The room has a rectangular shape.
She drew a rectangular box on the paper.
The table is perfectly rectangular with sharp corners.
cn: 这个房间呈长方形。
她在纸上画了一个长方形盒子。
这张桌子是标准的长方形，棱角分明。

en: The government promised to rectify the economic imbalance.
This device can rectify alternating current to direct current.
She took steps to rectify the mistake in the report.
cn: 政府承诺纠正经济失衡。
该装置可将交流电整流为直流电。
她采取措施修正了报告中的错误。

en: The same issue may recur if not properly addressed.
Memories of her childhood often recur in her dreams.
This error pattern recurs every few months.
cn: 若不妥善解决，同样的问题可能再次出现。
童年的记忆常在她的梦中反复浮现。
这种错误模式每隔几个月就会重现一次。

definitions.definition: 回收利用的过程或系统

en: We should recycle paper to save trees.
The city has improved its recycling program.
This symbol means the product is recyclable.
cn: 我们应该回收纸张以保护树木。
该市改进了垃圾回收计划。
这个标志表示产品可回收利用。

en: The report was full of redundant information.
Many workers were made redundant after the factory automation.
Avoid using redundant words in your essay.
cn: 这份报告充斥着冗余信息。
工厂自动化后，许多工人被裁员。
写作时应避免赘词。

en: She wound the thread onto the reel carefully.
The boxer reeled from the heavy blow.
The room seemed to reel after he stood up too quickly.
cn: 她小心地把线绕到卷轴上。
拳击手因重击而踉跄后退。
他起身太快后，房间仿佛在旋转。

en: The referee blew the whistle to stop the game.
She was asked to referee the academic dispute.
All complaints will be referred to our customer service referee.
cn: 裁判吹哨中止了比赛。
她被邀请为学术争端担任仲裁。
所有投诉将提交至客户服务仲裁员处理。

en: She included a reference to the latest research in her paper.
The librarian helped me find reference materials.
He made a vague reference to his past achievements.
cn: 她在论文中引用了最新研究。
图书管理员帮我找到了参考资料。
他含糊地提到了过去的成就。

definitions.definition: 反射（光、热、声音等）；反映，体现

en: The lake reflects the surrounding mountains.
Her actions reflect her values.
He took a moment to reflect on his decisions.
cn: 湖面倒映着周围的群山。
她的行为体现了她的价值观。
他花时间反思了自己的决定。

en: The government plans to reform the education system.
He reformed his lifestyle after the health warning.
Social reforms often face resistance from conservative groups.
cn: 政府计划改革教育体系。
健康警告后，他彻底改变了生活方式。
社会改革常遭遇保守群体的阻力。

en: She refrained from commenting on the controversial topic.
The choir sang the refrain with great enthusiasm.
Please refrain from smoking in this area.
cn: 她克制自己不去评论这个有争议的话题。
合唱团热情地演唱了副歌部分。
请勿在此区域吸烟。

definitions.definition: 使恢复精力；刷新（页面/数据）

en: She drank lemonade to refresh herself after the long walk.
Press F5 to refresh the webpage for updated results.
The rain refreshed the dry soil overnight.
cn: 长途步行后，她喝了柠檬水恢复精神。
按 F5 刷新网页以获取更新结果。
雨水一夜之间让干涸的土壤恢复了生机。

definitions.definition: 茶点；点心（尤指休息时的小食或饮料）

en: The hotel offers free refreshments in the lobby every afternoon.
A short walk in nature is the perfect refreshment for a tired mind.
Volunteers served refreshments to the marathon runners at the checkpoint.
cn: 酒店每天下午在大堂提供免费茶点。
在自然中短暂散步是疲惫心灵的完美恢复。
志愿者在检查站为马拉松选手提供点心。

en: The mountain village became a refuge for war survivors.
Books were her refuge from loneliness.
Wildlife refuges protect endangered species.
cn: 这座山村成了战争幸存者的避难所。
书籍是她逃离孤独的慰藉。
野生动物保护区保护濒危物种。

en: The store promised to refund the full amount if the product was defective.
She requested a refund after canceling her flight ticket.
The company refunded all customers affected by the pricing error.
cn: 商店承诺若商品有瑕疵将全额退款。
取消机票后，她申请了退款。
公司向受定价错误影响的所有顾客退款。

en: His refusal to cooperate surprised everyone.
She has the first refusal on the apartment if the sale falls through.
The refusal of the proposal led to further negotiations.
cn: 他拒绝合作让所有人感到意外。
如果交易失败，她拥有这套公寓的优先购买权。
提案被拒后，双方展开了进一步谈判。

en: The scientist refuted the theory with solid experimental data.
He refuted the accusation by presenting an alibi.
Her essay effectively refutes common misconceptions about climate change.
cn: 科学家用扎实的实验数据驳斥了这一理论。
他通过提供不在场证明否认了指控。
她的文章有力反驳了关于气候变化的常见误解。

en: The new regime imposed strict economic reforms.
She follows a strict skincare regime every morning.
The athlete’s training regime includes two hours of cardio daily.
cn: 新政权实施了严格的经济改革。
她每天早晨遵循严格的护肤流程。
这位运动员的训练计划包括每天两小时的有氧运动。

en: He served in a cavalry regiment during the war.
Schools should not regiment children's creativity.
The daily routine was rigidly regimented.
cn: 他在战争中服役于一个骑兵团。
学校不应扼杀孩子的创造力。
每日作息被严格规定。

definitions.definition: 地区，区域（指地理或行政划分）

en: The Amazon rainforest is a vital region for biodiversity.
She felt pain in the abdominal region after the surgery.
His research focuses on the region of artificial intelligence ethics.
cn: 亚马逊雨林是生物多样性的关键区域。
手术后她的腹部区域感到疼痛。
他的研究专注于人工智能伦理领域。

en: Please register your details at the front desk.
The thermometer registered a sudden drop in temperature.
Her name was struck off the electoral register.
cn: 请在前台登记您的信息。
温度计显示温度骤降。
她的名字被从选民名册中删除。

definitions.definition: 规则，规章（官方制定的管理条款）
调节，控制（保持系统稳定的过程）

en: The new regulation prohibits smoking in public areas.
Automatic temperature regulation ensures energy efficiency.
Financial regulations aim to prevent market manipulation.
cn: 新规禁止在公共场所吸烟。
自动温度调节能确保能源效率。
金融法规旨在防止市场操纵。

definitions.definition: 排练，彩排（戏剧、音乐等表演前的练习）
复述，重复（事件或陈述的详细叙述）

en: The cast had a final rehearsal before the opening night.
Her rehearsal of the accident details helped the police.
Life is not a rehearsal—every moment counts.
cn: 剧组在首演前进行了最后一次彩排。
她对事故细节的复述帮助了警方调查。
人生不是彩排，每一刻都至关重要。

en: The king's reign lasted for over 50 years.
Chaos reigned in the city after the earthquake.
Her reign as CEO transformed the company.
cn: 这位国王的统治持续了50多年。
地震后，城市陷入混乱。
她担任CEO期间彻底改变了公司。

en: She pulled gently on the reins to slow the horse.
The government tightened the reins on public spending.
He gave free rein to his imagination while writing the novel.
cn: 她轻轻拉动缰绳让马减速。
政府加强了对公共开支的控制。
他在写小说时放任自己的想象力自由驰骋。

definitions.definition: 加强；增强（结构、力量或效果）

en: The walls were reinforced with steel beams.
The general decided to reinforce the troops at the frontline.
Positive feedback can reinforce good behavior in children.
cn: 墙壁用钢梁加固。
将军决定增援前线的部队。
正面反馈能强化孩子的良好行为。

en: The committee rejected his proposal due to insufficient evidence.
Her body rejected the transplanted kidney.
These shoes are factory rejects with minor flaws.
cn: 委员会因证据不足驳回他的提案。
她的身体排斥了移植的肾脏。
这些鞋是带有微小瑕疵的工厂淘汰品。

en: The whole city rejoiced when the war ended.
She rejoiced at her son's success.
"Rejoice!" shouted the priest to the crowd.
cn: 战争结束时，整座城市欢欣鼓舞。
她为儿子的成功感到欣喜。
“欢呼吧！”牧师向人群喊道。

en: She is a close relative of mine.
The speed is relative to the observer's position.
Happiness is a relative concept.
cn: 她是我的近亲。
速度与观察者的位置相对。
幸福是一个相对的概念。

definitions.definition: 接力赛；中继设备；轮换班次

en: The team won the 4x100m relay with a record time.
Satellite systems relay TV signals to remote areas.
She relayed the urgent message to the manager.
cn: 队伍以创纪录的成绩赢得了4x100米接力赛。
卫星系统向偏远地区转播电视信号。
她将紧急信息传达给了经理。

en: The government decided to release the political prisoners.
The band's new album will be released next month.
She sighed with release after finishing the final exam.
cn: 政府决定释放政治犯。
乐队的新专辑将于下月发行。
期末考试结束后，她如释重负地叹了口气。

en: The judge ruled the evidence was not relevant to the case.
Her research focuses on issues relevant to climate change.
Keep your comments relevant to the topic of discussion.
cn: 法官裁定该证据与案件无关。
她的研究聚焦于与气候变化相关的议题。
请让你的评论紧扣讨论主题。

en: She is a reliable colleague who always meets deadlines.
This old car is surprisingly reliable despite its age.
For accurate data, choose a reliable source.
cn: 她是一位可靠的同事，总能按时完成任务。
这辆旧车虽然年头久，但出人意料地可靠。
要获取准确数据，请选择可信的来源。

en: His reliance on technology made him helpless during the blackout.
The project's success was a heavy reliance on teamwork.
Blind reliance on authority can hinder critical thinking.
cn: 他对科技的依赖使他在停电时束手无策。
该项目的成功极大依赖于团队合作。
对权威的盲目信赖会阻碍批判性思维。

definitions.definition: （痛苦、压力等的）缓解；救济；浮雕

en: The medicine brought immediate relief from pain.
The government provided relief to flood victims.
The sculptor carved the figures in high relief.
cn: 药物迅速缓解了疼痛。
政府向洪水灾民提供了救济。
雕刻家用高浮雕技法塑造了人像。

definitions.definition: 接替（某人职责）；解除（职务）

en: The medicine helped relieve her headache.
The guard will be relieved at midnight.
His apology relieved my anger.
cn: 药物缓解了她的头痛。
卫兵将在午夜换岗。
他的道歉平息了我的怒火。

definitions.definition: 宗教（一种对超自然力量或神灵的信仰与崇拜体系）
宗教信仰（个人或群体的精神实践与价值观）

en: She studies comparative religion to understand different cultural beliefs.
Freedom of religion is a fundamental human right.
Ancient Egyptians practiced a polytheistic religion.
cn: 她研究比较宗教学以理解不同的文化信仰。
宗教信仰自由是一项基本人权。
古埃及人信奉多神教。

definitions.definition: 严谨的，一丝不苟的（引申义）

en: She has a deeply religious faith.
He follows the schedule with religious precision.
The festival is important to many religious communities.
cn: 她有着虔诚的宗教信仰。
他以一丝不苟的精确性遵循日程。
这个节日对许多宗教群体至关重要。

en: She added a spoonful of relish to the hot dog.
He relished the challenge of climbing the mountain.
The story was told with great relish.
cn: 她在热狗上加了一勺调味酱。
他享受攀登这座山的挑战。
这个故事被津津有味地讲述着。

en: She gave a reluctant nod when asked to help.
The cat was reluctant to leave its warm spot by the fireplace.
He was reluctant to admit his mistake in front of the team.
cn: 当她被要求帮忙时，勉强点了点头。
那只猫不情愿离开壁炉旁温暖的角落。
他勉强在团队面前承认了自己的错误。

en: You can rely on her to keep your secrets.
The project relies heavily on government funding.
Don't rely solely on luck to succeed.
cn: 你可以信赖她保守你的秘密。
该项目极大依赖政府资金。
别仅靠运气成功。

definitions.definition: 剩余；停留；保持（某种状态）
(常用复数 remains) 残余；遗迹

en: Only a few apples remain on the tree.
She chose to remain silent during the meeting.
The remains of the ancient temple attract many tourists.
cn: 树上只剩几个苹果了。
会议期间她选择保持沉默。
古庙的遗迹吸引了许多游客。

en: The remainder of the cake was saved for later.
After dividing 10 by 3, the remainder is 1.
The bookstore remaindered unsold copies of the novel.
cn: 蛋糕的剩余部分被留到稍后食用。
10除以3的余数是1。
书店将未售出的小说降价处理。

en: Honey is a natural remedy for sore throats.
The new policy aims to remedy social inequality.
Time alone will not remedy the situation.
cn: 蜂蜜是治疗喉咙痛的自然疗法。
新政策旨在纠正社会不平等。
仅靠时间无法扭转局面。

en: The archaeologists found a remnant of an ancient wall.
She used a remnant of silk to make a hair ribbon.
Only a remnant of the original forest remains today.
cn: 考古学家发现了一段古墙的残骸。
她用一块丝绸零料做了条发带。
如今仅存原始森林的一小部分。

en: The village is so remote that it has no internet access.
There's a remote chance of rain tomorrow.
She pressed a button on the remote to turn off the TV.
cn: 这个村庄非常偏远，甚至没有网络。
明天下雨的可能性很小。
她按下遥控器的按钮关闭了电视。

definitions.definition: 复兴；文艺复兴（欧洲14-17世纪的文化艺术运动）

en: The city experienced a cultural renaissance in the 1990s.
Renaissance art is characterized by its focus on humanism.
Her latest album marks a renaissance in jazz music.
cn: 这座城市在20世纪90年代经历了文化复兴。
文艺复兴艺术以人文主义为核心特征。
她的最新专辑标志着爵士乐的复兴。

definitions.definition: 使成为；提供（服务等）；递交

en: The artist rendered the landscape in vivid colors.
The jury rendered a verdict of not guilty.
The software renders 3D models in real time.
cn: 艺术家用鲜艳的色彩描绘了这片风景。
陪审团作出了无罪判决。
该软件能实时渲染3D模型。

en: She promised to repay the loan within a year.
How can I repay you for your kindness?
The company repaid its investors with generous dividends.
cn: 她承诺一年内还清贷款。
我该如何报答你的好意？
公司以丰厚的股息回报投资者。

en: The waterproof coating repels rainwater effectively.
