His arrogant attitude repelled potential collaborators.
Like magnetic poles repel each other.
cn: 防水涂层能有效阻隔雨水。
他的傲慢态度让潜在合作者望而却步。
同磁极相互排斥。

definitions.definition: （演员、艺术家等的）全部作品；常备剧目

en: The actor's repertoire includes both classical and modern plays.
She has a wide repertoire of teaching methods.
Jazz musicians often expand their repertoire by improvising.
cn: 这位演员的常备剧目涵盖古典与现代戏剧。
她掌握多种教学方法。
爵士乐手常通过即兴演奏扩充曲目库。

en: The dove represents peace in many cultures.
She was chosen to represent the company at the conference.
The graph represents the data clearly.
cn: 鸽子在许多文化中象征和平。
她被选为代表公司出席会议。
图表清晰地呈现了数据。

definitions.definition: 压制，镇压（尤指通过武力或权威）
（心理学）压抑（将痛苦记忆或冲动抑制到潜意识中）

en: The government used violent repression against the protest.
Childhood trauma often leads to emotional repression.
His repression of anger eventually caused health problems.
cn: 政府对抗议活动进行了暴力镇压。
童年创伤常导致情感压抑。
他对愤怒的压抑最终引发了健康问题。

en: She reproached him for forgetting their anniversary.
His failure was a reproach to the family.
The teacher’s gentle reproach made the student reflect.
cn: 她责备他忘记了他们的纪念日。
他的失败是家族的耻辱。
老师温和的批评让学生开始反思。

en: His reputation as a fair judge is well deserved.
The company’s reputation suffered after the scandal.
She has a reputation for being strict but kind.
cn: 他作为公正法官的名声实至名归。
丑闻发生后，公司的声誉受损。
她以严格但善良著称。

definitions.definition: 相似性；外表或特征的相似

en: The resemblance between the twins is striking.
There’s a faint resemblance of this painting to Picasso’s style.
His mannerisms bear no resemblance to his father’s.
cn: 这对双胞胎的相似度惊人。
这幅画与毕加索的风格有微弱的相似。
他的举止与他父亲毫无相似之处。

en: She resented his arrogant attitude.
He resents being treated like a child.
They secretly resented the new rules.
cn: 她对他的傲慢态度感到愤懑。
他厌恶被当作小孩对待。
他们暗中对新规心怀不满。

en: She accepted the job offer with some reservations about the workload.
I made a dinner reservation for two at 7 PM.
The Navajo Nation is the largest Native American reservation in the U.S.
cn: 她接受了工作邀请，但对工作量有所保留。
我预订了晚上7点的双人晚餐。
纳瓦霍族保留地是美国最大的原住民保留地。

en: The hotel requires guests to reserve rooms in advance.
She spoke with reserve, carefully choosing her words.
The country's oil reserves are running low.
cn: 酒店要求客人提前预订房间。
她说话克制，措辞谨慎。
该国的石油储备正在减少。

en: She resides in a small village near the coast.
The power to make decisions resides with the board.
The charm of the city resides in its ancient architecture.
cn: 她居住在海边的一个小村庄里。
决策权掌握在董事会手中。
这座城市的魅力在于其古老的建筑。

en: The city has over a million residents.
She is the resident expert on climate change.
The hospital’s residents work long shifts.
cn: 这座城市有一百多万居民。
她是常驻的气候变化专家。
这家医院的住院医生轮班时间很长。

en: This area is primarily residential, with few commercial buildings.
The job requires residential training for the first month.
The university offers both residential and online courses.
cn: 该区域主要是住宅区，商业建筑很少。
这份工作需要第一个月进行驻场培训。
该大学提供住宿制和在线两种课程。

definitions.definition: 使顺从；听任（常与 to 连用）

en: She decided to resign from her position after ten years of service.
He resigned himself to the fact that he couldn’t change the outcome.
The CEO resigned amid the company’s financial scandal.
cn: 她决定在任职十年后辞去职务。
他无奈接受了无法改变结果的事实。
首席执行官在公司财务丑闻中辞职。

definitions.definition: 抵抗者；防染剂（化学术语）

en: This fabric is resistant to water and stains.
Some bacteria have become resistant to antibiotics.
She remained resistant to his persuasive arguments.
cn: 这种面料防水防污。
某些细菌对抗生素产生了耐药性。
她始终抵制他的说服性论点。

en: The committee met to resolve the dispute.
Light can be resolved into a spectrum of colors.
She faced the challenge with unwavering resolve.
cn: 委员会召开会议以解决争端。
光可被分解为一系列颜色光谱。
她以坚定的决心应对挑战。

en: The island is a popular resort for honeymooners.
He resorted to stealing when he ran out of money.
Violence should never be the first resort in a conflict.
cn: 这座岛是蜜月旅行者的热门度假胜地。
他没钱时选择了偷窃。
暴力绝不应该是冲突中的首选手段。

en: The team members returned to their respective offices after the meeting.
The scholarships were awarded based on the students' respective achievements.
The two groups discussed their respective plans for the project.
cn: 会议结束后，团队成员回到了各自的办公室。
奖学金根据学生各自的成就颁发。
两组分别讨论了各自的项目计划。

en: She didn't respond to my email.
The patient is responding well to the treatment.
Firefighters responded immediately to the emergency call.
cn: 她没有回复我的邮件。
患者对治疗反应良好。
消防员立即响应了紧急呼叫。

en: She nodded in response to his question.
The vaccine triggers an immune response.
The machine’s response time is under 0.1 seconds.
cn: 她点头回应了他的问题。
疫苗会引发免疫反应。
该机器的响应时间低于0.1秒。

definitions.definition: 需承担责任的；有责任感的
（职位或角色）重要的，责任重大的

en: She is responsible for managing the team.
A responsible citizen follows traffic rules.
This is a highly responsible position in the company.
cn: 她负责管理团队。
有责任感的公民会遵守交通规则。
这是公司里一个责任重大的职位。

en: The government plans to restore the historic monument.
A good night's sleep can restore your energy.
The software can restore deleted files.
cn: 政府计划修复这座历史纪念碑。
充足的睡眠能恢复体力。
该软件可恢复被删除的文件。

en: She had to restrain her laughter during the serious meeting.
The police used handcuffs to restrain the suspect.
His strict upbringing restrained him from taking risks.
cn: 在严肃的会议中，她不得不忍住笑声。
警察用手铐制服了嫌疑人。
严格的成长环境使他不敢冒险。

en: She exercised great restraint in not responding to the insult.
The new safety restraints in cars have reduced injuries.
His artistic restraint gives the painting a minimalist elegance.
cn: 她表现出极大克制，没有回应侮辱。
汽车的新型安全约束装置降低了伤害率。
他的艺术克制赋予画作极简的优雅。

en: The law restricts smoking in public places.
Her visa restricts her to working only 20 hours per week.
The tight deadline restricted our creativity.
cn: 法律限制在公共场所吸烟。
她的签证限定她每周只能工作20小时。
紧迫的截止日期限制了我们的创造力。

definitions.definition: 合力；合成量（物理学/数学术语）

en: The resultant force of the two vectors was calculated precisely.
The noise was the resultant effect of poor insulation.
In chemistry, a resultant compound often has new properties.
cn: 这两个向量的合力被精确计算出来。
噪音是隔音不良的直接结果。
在化学中，合成化合物通常具有新特性。

definitions.definition: 简历（美式用法，源自法语 résumé）

en: She decided to resume her studies after a year off.
Please submit your resume by email.
The meeting will resume at 2 PM.
cn: 她决定休息一年后继续学业。
请通过邮件提交你的简历。
会议将于下午两点继续。

en: The jar can retain freshness for up to six months.
She struggled to retain the information before the exam.
The company aims to retain its best employees.
cn: 这个罐子能保持新鲜度长达六个月。
她考前拼命记住这些信息。
公司致力于留住最优秀的员工。

definitions.definition: 保留；保持（如记忆、液体等）

en: The sponge's water retention ability is impressive.
Employee retention strategies are crucial for company growth.
His retention of details amazed the detectives.
cn: 海绵的保水能力令人惊叹。
员工留任策略对公司发展至关重要。
他对细节的记忆力令侦探们震惊。

definitions.definition: 反驳的话；蒸馏器（化学器具）

en: She retorted sharply, "That's not true!"
The chemist heated the liquid in a glass retort.
His retort left the audience laughing.
cn: 她尖锐地反驳：“那不是真的！”
化学家在玻璃蒸馏器中加热液体。
他的回嘴引得观众大笑。

en: The dog was trained to retrieve the ball.
The system can retrieve data in seconds.
She managed to retrieve her lost passport.
cn: 这只狗受过训练，能衔回球。
该系统可在几秒内检索数据。
她成功找回了丢失的护照。

en: In retrospect, I should have taken her advice.
The book offers a retrospect of 20th-century art.
He paused to retrospect his career achievements.
cn: 回想起来，我本该听她的建议。
这本书对20世纪艺术进行了回顾。
他停下来反思自己的职业成就。

en: The family held a joyful reunion after ten years apart.
The university organizes an annual reunion for alumni.
The reunion of the band delighted fans worldwide.
cn: 这个家庭在分离十年后举行了一次欢乐的团聚。
这所大学每年为校友组织一次重聚活动。
乐队的重聚让全球乐迷欣喜不已。

en: The documentary reveals the truth behind the event.
Her smile revealed a hint of nervousness.
The report accidentally revealed confidential data.
cn: 这部纪录片揭示了事件背后的真相。
她的笑容透出一丝紧张。
报告意外泄露了机密数据。

definitions.definition: 揭示；揭露（指真相或秘密的突然显现）
（宗教）天启，神示（特指上帝的启示）

en: The documentary was a revelation about climate change.
Her sudden kindness came as a complete revelation to him.
The Book of Revelation contains apocalyptic visions.
cn: 这部纪录片揭示了气候变化的真相。
她突如其来的善意对他而言如同天启。
《启示录》记载了末世异象。

en: He swore to take revenge on his enemies.
The movie explores the theme of revenge and redemption.
She revenged her brother's death by exposing the truth.
cn: 他发誓要向敌人复仇。
这部电影探讨了复仇与救赎的主题。
她通过揭露真相为弟弟的死报仇。

en: The government's revenue increased by 10% this year.
Advertising accounts for most of the company's revenue.
Tourism is a major source of revenue for the island.
cn: 今年政府财政收入增长了10%。
广告收入占该公司总收入的绝大部分。
旅游业是该岛的主要收入来源。

en: She reversed the car into the parking space.
The experiment produced the reverse effect of what we expected.
The court reversed its earlier decision due to new evidence.
cn: 她将车倒进停车位。
实验产生了与我们预期相反的效果。
因新证据出现，法院撤销了先前的判决。

definitions.definition: 使复活；使复苏；恢复活力

en: The rain revived the withered plants.
This old song always revives my childhood memories.
The government plans to revive the local economy.
cn: 雨水使枯萎的植物恢复了生机。
这首老歌总能唤起我的童年回忆。
政府计划振兴当地经济。

en: The invention of the internet was a revolutionary breakthrough.
She joined a group of revolutionaries fighting for independence.
His revolutionary ideas challenged traditional education systems.
cn: 互联网的发明是一项革命性突破。
她加入了一群为独立而战的革命者。
他的革新理念挑战了传统教育体系。

en: The Earth revolves around the Sun.
She kept revolving the problem in her mind.
The exhibition revolves around themes of identity and migration.
cn: 地球围绕太阳旋转。
她一直在脑海中反复思考这个问题。
展览以身份与移民为主题展开。

en: She received a cash reward for her outstanding performance.
Kindness is its own reward.
The company rewards employees who propose innovative ideas.
cn: 她因表现优异获得一笔现金奖励。
善意本身就是回报。
公司奖励提出创新想法的员工。

en: The drummer kept a steady rhythm throughout the song.
She has a natural sense of rhythm when dancing.
The rhythm of the seasons influences agricultural practices.
cn: 鼓手在整个歌曲中保持着稳定的节奏。
她跳舞时有一种天生的节奏感。
四季的规律循环影响着农业活动。

en: The idea that pigs can fly is absolutely ridiculous.
She looked ridiculous in that oversized hat.
His excuse for being late was so ridiculous that no one believed it.
cn: 认为猪会飞的想法简直荒谬至极。
她戴着那顶过大的帽子，看起来滑稽可笑。
他迟到的借口太离谱，没人相信。

definitions.definition: 钻井架；成套设备；操纵（尤指欺诈性）

en: The oil rig was visible on the horizon.
They rigged the game to ensure their team would win.
The sailboat's rig needed repairs after the storm.
cn: 海上钻井平台在地平线上清晰可见。
他们操纵比赛以确保自己的队伍获胜。
风暴过后，帆船的索具需要修理。

definitions.definition: 严格的，严厉的（指规则、标准等）
严密的，精确的（指方法、思维等）

en: The training program is rigorous but highly effective.
She conducted a rigorous analysis of the data.
The professor has a rigorous approach to academic writing.
cn: 这个训练计划严格但非常高效。
她对数据进行了严密的分析。
这位教授对学术写作持严谨态度。

definitions.definition: 边缘，边框（如容器、圆形物体的外缘）

en: The glass was filled to the rim with water.
Mountains rimmed the horizon in the distance.
She carefully painted a gold rim around the plate.
cn: 玻璃杯中的水满到了边缘。
远方的群山在地平线上形成了一道轮廓。
她在盘子边缘仔细描了一圈金边。

en: She accidentally ripped her dress on a nail.
The wind ripped through the trees during the storm.
There’s a big rip in the old map.
cn: 她的裙子不小心被钉子钩破了。
暴风雨中，风猛烈地穿过树林。
这张旧地图上有一道很大的裂口。

en: The tea ceremony is a traditional Japanese ritual.
Morning coffee became a comforting daily ritual for her.
The ritual of lighting candles symbolizes hope.
cn: 茶道是日本的一种传统仪式。
早晨喝咖啡成了她令人安心的日常习惯。
点燃蜡烛的仪式象征着希望。

en: The two companies are fierce rivals in the tech industry.
Her talent rivals that of a professional musician.
The siblings have always been rivals for their parents' attention.
cn: 这两家公司在科技行业是激烈的竞争对手。
她的才华堪比专业音乐家。
这对兄妹一直为争夺父母的关注而竞争。

en: The rivalry between the two teams has lasted for decades.
Sibling rivalry is common in many families.
Their professional rivalry pushed both to innovate.
cn: 两支队伍间的竞争已持续数十年。
兄弟姐妹间的较劲在许多家庭中很常见。
他们的职业竞争促使双方不断创新。

definitions.definition: （系统或组织） robust 稳健的；耐用的

en: The robust athlete lifted the weight effortlessly.
A robust economy can withstand global shocks.
This software has a robust security framework.
cn: 这位强健的运动员轻松举起了重物。
稳健的经济能抵御全球冲击。
该软件拥有坚固的安全框架。

definitions.definition: 浪漫；爱情故事；传奇色彩

en: Their love story was like a fairy-tale romance.
She enjoys reading historical romances set in medieval Europe.
Don’t romance the facts—just tell the truth.
cn: 他们的爱情故事如同童话般浪漫。
她喜欢阅读以中世纪欧洲为背景的爱情小说。
别渲染事实，实话实说。

en: The wood began to rot after years of rain.
Don't talk such rot!
Without proper care, teeth can rot.
cn: 木材在多年雨水侵蚀后开始腐烂。
别说这种废话！
缺乏适当护理，牙齿会蛀坏。

definitions.definition: 旋转式机器；环形交叉路（英式英语中称 roundabout）

en: The rotary blade of the fan cuts through the air smoothly.
She works for a rotary printing press company.
Take the third exit at the rotary.
cn: 风扇的旋转叶片平稳地切割空气。
她在一家轮转印刷机公司工作。
在环形交叉路口走第三个出口。

definitions.definition: 常规；例行公事；固定程序

en: Morning exercise is part of her daily routine.
The audit revealed no issues with routine procedures.
He longed to escape the routine of office life.
cn: 晨练是她日常惯例的一部分。
审计显示常规流程没有问题。
他渴望逃离办公室生活的单调。

en: The crown jewels symbolize British royalty.
Authors receive royalties from book sales.
Oil companies pay royalties for drilling rights.
cn: 皇冠珠宝象征着英国王室。
作者从图书销售中获取版税。
石油公司为开采权支付特许使用费。

en: The earthquake left the city in ruins.
Gambling ruined his financial stability.
The castle is now a picturesque ruin.
cn: 地震使城市沦为废墟。
赌博毁了他的经济稳定。
这座城堡如今是一片风景如画的废墟。

en: The pipeline ruptured due to extreme pressure.
A sudden rupture in diplomatic relations shocked the world.
He suffered an abdominal rupture after lifting heavy weights.
cn: 管道因压力过大而破裂。
外交关系的突然破裂震惊了世界。
他在举重后出现了腹部疝气。

definitions.definition: 神圣的（与宗教或神相关，不可侵犯的）
庄严的（因神圣性而受敬畏的）

en: The temple is a sacred place for worship.
She made a sacred promise to protect the secret.
In many cultures, cows are considered sacred animals.
cn: 这座寺庙是神圣的礼拜场所。
她庄严承诺会保守这个秘密。
在许多文化中，牛被视为神圣的动物。

en: She made many sacrifices to send her children to college.
The ancient ritual involved the sacrifice of a goat.
He sacrificed his career to care for his family.
cn: 她为送孩子上大学做出了许多牺牲。
这一古老仪式包含献祭一只山羊。
他牺牲事业来照顾家庭。

en: The new law serves as a safeguard against data breaches.
Vaccination safeguards children from preventable diseases.
Always wear a helmet to safeguard your head while cycling.
cn: 这项新法律是防止数据泄露的保护措施。
疫苗接种保护儿童免受可预防疾病的侵害。
骑车时务必戴头盔以保护头部。

en: She quit her job for the sake of her mental health.
He enjoys drinking warm sake in winter.
Do it for my sake, if not for your own.
cn: 她为了心理健康辞去了工作。
他喜欢在冬天喝温热的清酒。
就算不为你自己，也看在我的份上做这件事吧。

en: The soldier raised his hand to salute the officer.
We salute the brave healthcare workers during the pandemic.
In some cultures, a bow is used to salute instead of a hand gesture.
cn: 士兵举手向军官敬礼。
我们向疫情期间勇敢的医护人员致敬。
在某些文化中，人们用鞠躬代替手势致意。

definitions.definition: 救赎，拯救（宗教或世俗意义上的解脱或救助）

en: Many people find salvation through faith.
The new policy was the salvation of the failing economy.
She viewed education as her salvation from poverty.
cn: 许多人通过信仰获得救赎。
这项新政策挽救了衰退的经济。
她将教育视为摆脱贫穷的出路。

en: The doctor took a blood sample for testing.
This free cookie is a sample of our new product.
She sampled several courses before choosing her major.
cn: 医生采集了血液样本进行检测。
这块免费饼干是我们新产品的试吃样品。
她体验了几门课程后才选定专业。

en: The UN imposed economic sanctions on the country.
The law received royal sanction in 1689.
Many critics argue that sanctions often harm civilians more than governments.
cn: 联合国对该国实施经济制裁。
这项法律于1689年获得王室批准。
许多批评者认为，制裁对平民的伤害往往大于对政府的打击。

en: The heavy rain saturated the soil, causing local flooding.
This solution is saturated with salt at room temperature.
The market is saturated with similar products, making competition fierce.
cn: 大雨浸透了土壤，导致局部积水。
该溶液在室温下已达到盐的饱和状态。
市场上同类产品已趋饱和，竞争十分激烈。

definitions.definition: 野蛮的；未开化的；凶猛的

en: The explorers encountered a savage tribe deep in the jungle.
His savage criticism left her in tears.
The lion made a savage attack on its prey.
cn: 探险者在丛林深处遇到了一个野蛮部落。
他尖锐的批评让她泪流满面。
狮子对猎物发起了凶猛的攻击。

en: The map has a scale of 1:50,000.
Salmon lose their scales when they swim upstream.
She scaled the mountain in record time.
cn: 这张地图的比例尺是1:5万。
鲑鱼溯流而上时会脱落鳞片。
她以破纪录的速度登上了山顶。

en: The doctor will scan your brain for abnormalities.
She quickly scanned the newspaper for weather updates.
The radar scan detected an unknown object.
cn: 医生将扫描你的大脑以检查异常。
她快速浏览报纸寻找天气信息。
雷达扫描发现了一个未知物体。

en: The politician resigned after the financial scandal was exposed.
The tabloids love to spread scandals about celebrities.
Her actions caused a scandal in the conservative community.
cn: 这位政治家在财务丑闻曝光后辞职。
小报热衷于传播名人的绯闻。
她的行为在保守社区引发了公愤。

definitions.definition: 疤痕；伤痕；（精神上的）创伤

en: The surgery left a small scar on her knee.
Childhood trauma can scar a person for life.
The volcanic eruption scarred the landscape permanently.
cn: 手术在她的膝盖上留下了一道小疤痕。
童年创伤可能给人留下终身的心理阴影。
火山喷发永久性地改变了地貌的样貌。

en: The wind will scatter the leaves across the yard.
Birds scattered as the dog ran toward them.
She scattered rose petals along the aisle.
cn: 风会把树叶吹散到院子里。
狗跑向鸟群时，鸟儿四散飞走。
她将玫瑰花瓣撒在过道上。

en: The scent of roses filled the garden.
The dog quickly picked up the scent of the fox.
She scented trouble when he avoided her questions.
cn: 玫瑰的香气弥漫花园。
狗迅速捕捉到狐狸的气味。
当他回避问题时，她察觉到了麻烦。

en: The project is behind schedule due to unexpected delays.
Please schedule a meeting for next Monday.
Check the train schedule before you leave.
cn: 该项目因意外延误而落后于计划进度。
请为下周一安排一次会议。
出发前查好火车时刻表。

en: The government launched a new housing scheme.
He was accused of scheming to overthrow the management.
Her scheme to avoid taxes was eventually discovered.
cn: 政府推出了一项新的住房计划。
他被指控密谋推翻管理层。
她避税的阴谋最终被揭露。

en: The investigation widened the scope of the research.
This telescope has a narrow field of scope.
She scoped the room before entering.
cn: 这次调查扩大了研究的范围。
这台望远镜的视野较窄。
她在进入前仔细查看了房间。

en: The final score was 3-2.
He scored a goal in the last minute.
She made a score on the tree to mark the trail.
cn: 最终比分为3比2。
他在最后一分钟进了一球。
她在树上刻了一道痕迹以标记路线。

en: She looked at him with cold scorn.
He scorned all offers of help.
Their scorn for the proposal was evident.
cn: 她以冰冷的轻蔑目光看着他。
他不屑地拒绝了所有帮助提议。
他们对这一提议的鄙夷显而易见。

en: The hikers scrambled up the rocky slope.
Journalists scrambled to get the latest news.
She scrambled the eggs with some fresh herbs.
cn: 登山者们手脚并用地爬上了岩石斜坡。
记者们争先恐后地获取最新消息。
她用新鲜香草炒了鸡蛋。

definitions.definition: 废弃；报废；将…作为废料处理

en: She collected scraps of paper to make a collage.
The old car was finally scrapped after years of use.
They got into a silly scrap over who should wash the dishes.
cn: 她收集纸片制作拼贴画。
这辆旧车在使用多年后最终被报废。
他们为谁该洗碗吵了一架。

en: She fell and scraped her knee on the pavement.
The branches scraped against the window in the wind.
He managed to scrape together enough money for the trip.
cn: 她摔倒时膝盖在人行道上擦伤了。
树枝在风中刮擦着窗户。
他勉强凑够了旅行的钱。

en: The cat will scratch you if you pull its tail.
He heard a scratch on the window and turned around.
I’ll just jot down a few scratch notes before the meeting.
cn: 如果你拉猫的尾巴，它会抓你。
他听到窗户上有刮擦声，于是转过身。
我会在会议前草草记下几条笔记。

definitions.definition: 用螺丝固定；拧紧；扭曲（比喻义）

en: Tighten the screw with a screwdriver.
He screwed the lid onto the jar.
The scandal screwed up his reputation.
cn: 用螺丝刀拧紧螺丝。
他把盖子拧到罐子上。
丑闻彻底毁了他的名声。

definitions.definition: 灌木丛；矮小植物；擦洗动作

en: She scrubbed the floor until it shone.
The pilot scrubbed the flight due to bad weather.
We hiked through dense scrub to reach the coast.
cn: 她用力擦洗地板，直到它发亮。
因天气恶劣，飞行员取消了航班。
我们穿过茂密的灌木丛抵达海岸。

en: The contract underwent close scrutiny before signing.
Public figures live under constant media scrutiny.
Her theory cannot withstand scientific scrutiny.
cn: 合同在签署前经过了仔细审查。
公众人物长期处于媒体的严密监督下。
她的理论经不起科学检验。

en: The museum exhibits ancient Greek sculptures.
She sculptured a lion out of marble.
His poetry sculptures vivid images in the reader's mind.
cn: 博物馆展出了古希腊雕塑。
她用大理石雕刻了一头狮子。
他的诗歌在读者脑海中塑造出生动的意象。

en: The tailor stitched the seam with invisible thread.
A seam of coal was discovered beneath the mountains.
Her speech revealed the cultural seams in the community.
cn: 裁缝用隐形线缝合了接缝。
山脉下发现了一条煤层。
她的演讲暴露了社区中的文化裂痕。

en: The new software enhances data security.
She works in airport security.
Government bonds are considered low-risk securities.
cn: 新软件提升了数据安全性。
她在机场安保部门工作。
国债被视为低风险证券。

en: He was seemingly unaware of the chaos around him.
The plan is seemingly simple, but full of hidden complexities.
She smiled seemingly without effort, though her eyes were tired.
cn: 他看似没有注意到周围的混乱。
这个计划表面上简单，实则暗藏复杂。
她看似轻松地微笑着，尽管眼神疲惫。

en: The orange was divided into several segments.
The report analyzed each market segment in detail.
Researchers segmented the data by age groups.
cn: 橘子被分成了几瓣。
报告详细分析了每个细分市场。
研究人员按年龄组对数据进行了划分。

en: The school was criticized for segregating students by ability.
Birds often segregate into flocks during migration.
The law once segregated public facilities by race.
cn: 这所学校因按能力分班而受到批评。
鸟类迁徙时常分群飞行。
该法律曾按种族隔离公共设施。

definitions.definition: 学期（通常指大学或学校一年中分为两部分的半学年）

en: The fall semester starts in September.
She took five courses last semester.
The final exams mark the end of the semester.
cn: 秋季学期从九月开始。
她上学期修了五门课。
期末考试标志着学期结束。

definitions.definition: 参议员（立法机构成员，尤指美国参议院或古罗马元老院成员）

en: The senator proposed a new environmental bill.
In ancient Rome, senators wore distinctive purple stripes.
She became the youngest state senator in history.
cn: 这位参议员提出了一项新的环境法案。
古罗马元老院成员身着特殊的紫色条纹长袍。
她成为历史上最年轻的州参议员。

definitions.definition: 感觉，知觉（如触觉、听觉等）

en: The cold water caused a sharp sensation on her skin.
The new art exhibit became a sensation in the city.
He lost all sensation in his legs after the accident.
cn: 冷水在她的皮肤上引起刺痛感。
这场新艺术展览在城里引起了轰动。
事故后，他的双腿完全失去了知觉。

en: It's sensible to save money for emergencies.
She gave me some sensible advice.
The patient was sensible of a sharp pain.
cn: 为紧急情况存钱是明智之举。
她给了我一些合理的建议。
病人感觉到一阵剧痛。（古义用法）

en: She is very sensitive to criticism.
The device is highly sensitive to temperature changes.
He gave a sensitive performance as the grieving father.
cn: 她对批评非常敏感。
该设备对温度变化高度灵敏。
他饰演悲恸的父亲，表演细腻动人。

definitions.definition: 情感，情绪（尤指基于个人观点的感性态度）
观点，意见（常带主观色彩）

en: Her speech appealed to the patriotic sentiments of the crowd.
Market sentiment has turned pessimistic due to recent economic data.
He expressed a sentiment shared by many in the room.
cn: 她的演讲唤起了人群的爱国情绪。
由于近期经济数据，市场情绪转向悲观。
他表达了房间里许多人的共同观点。

definitions.definition: 按顺序排列；测定（DNA等的）序列

en: The teacher asked us to arrange the events in chronological sequence.
Scientists sequenced the genome of the rare plant.
A sudden sequence of loud noises startled the crowd.
cn: 老师让我们按时间顺序排列这些事件。
科学家们对这种稀有植物的基因组进行了测序。
一连串突然的巨响吓到了人群。

definitions.definition: 军士，中士（军队中低级军官）
警官（某些国家警察职级）

en: The sergeant drilled the new recruits every morning.
She was promoted to sergeant after five years of service.
The sergeant major inspected the barracks with strict attention to detail.
cn: 中士每天早晨训练新兵。
服役五年后，她晋升为警司。
军士长以极其严格的标准检查了营房。

en: The novel was published in serial form over six months.
She owns a rare serial number on the vintage watch.
The police are investigating a serial offender.
cn: 这部小说以连载形式分六个月发表。
她拥有一块古董表上的稀有序列号。
警方正在调查一名连环罪犯。

definitions.definition: 系列（按顺序排列的相似事物）

en: The lecture series covers topics from ancient to modern art.
She owns the complete series of detective novels.
A series of errors led to the system failure.
cn: 该系列讲座涵盖从古代到现代的艺术主题。
她拥有这套侦探小说的完整系列。
一连串错误导致了系统故障。

definitions.definition: 挫折；阻碍（指计划或进展中的困难或倒退）

en: The team faced a major setback when their funding was cut.
Despite the setback, she continued working toward her goal.
The project’s delay was only a temporary setback.
cn: 团队因资金削减遭遇重大挫折。
尽管遇到阻碍，她仍坚持向目标努力。
项目延误只是暂时的挫折。

en: They decided to settle the dispute peacefully.
Dust particles will settle at the bottom of the container.
After years of traveling, she finally settled in a small village.
cn: 他们决定和平解决争端。
尘埃颗粒会沉淀在容器底部。
多年漂泊后，她最终在一个小村庄定居。

en: The Vikings established a settlement in Greenland.
The two companies reached a settlement out of court.
The bank requires immediate settlement of the debt.
cn: 维京人在格陵兰建立了定居点。
两家公司达成了庭外和解。
银行要求立即结清债务。

en: The judge imposed a severe sentence on the criminal.
She suffered from severe headaches after the accident.
The building's design is severe, with no unnecessary decorations.
cn: 法官对罪犯判处了严厉的刑罚。
事故后她患上了严重的头痛。
这座建筑的设计非常朴素，没有任何多余的装饰。

en: He lived in a shabby apartment with peeling wallpaper.
It was a shabby trick to blame the new employee for the mistake.
Her shabby coat barely kept her warm in the winter wind.
cn: 他住在一间墙纸剥落的破旧公寓里。
把错误归咎于新员工是卑鄙的手段。
她那件破旧的外套几乎无法在寒风中保暖。

en: The arrow's shaft was made of lightweight cedar.
The elevator got stuck in the shaft between floors.
He felt shafted by the unfair contract terms.
cn: 箭杆由轻质的雪松木制成。
电梯卡在楼层间的竖井里。
他因不公平的合同条款感到被坑了。

definitions.definition: 鲨鱼（海洋大型掠食性鱼类）

en: The great white shark is an apex predator of the ocean.
He was accused of sharking vulnerable investors.
Don’t trust that guy—he’s a loan shark.
cn: 大白鲨是海洋中的顶级掠食者。
他被指控诈骗弱势投资者。
别相信那个人，他是个放高利贷的。

definitions.definition: 粉碎；彻底破坏（物理或抽象）

en: The vase shattered into a thousand pieces when it hit the floor.
His dreams were shattered by the financial crisis.
The loud explosion shattered the calm of the night.
cn: 花瓶摔在地上，粉碎成无数碎片。
金融危机彻底粉碎了他的梦想。
巨大的爆炸声打破了夜晚的宁静。

definitions.definition: 脱落（毛发、皮肤等）；流出（眼泪）；摆脱（负担）

en: The gardener stored tools in the wooden shed.
Snakes shed their skin as they grow.
She shed tears of joy at the news.
cn: 园丁把工具存放在木棚里。
蛇在生长过程中会蜕皮。
听到消息后，她流下了喜悦的泪水。

definitions.definition: 完全的，纯粹的（强调程度）
陡峭的，垂直的（形容坡度）
急转，偏离（尤指船只航行）

en: The cliff dropped in a sheer descent of 100 meters.
Her success was due to sheer determination.
The ship sheered away to avoid the iceberg.
cn: 悬崖垂直陡降100米。
她的成功纯粹源于决心。
船只急转以避开冰山。

en: The shepherd led his flock through the valley.
Teachers often shepherd students toward critical thinking.
The pastor is seen as a spiritual shepherd in the community.
cn: 牧羊人带领羊群穿过山谷。
教师常引导学生培养批判性思维。
这位牧师被视为社区的精神指引者。

en: The knight raised his shield to block the arrow.
Sunglasses shield your eyes from UV rays.
She acted as a shield between the protesters and the police.
cn: 骑士举起盾牌挡住了箭。
太阳镜能保护眼睛免受紫外线伤害。
她在抗议者和警察之间充当了保护者的角色。

en: The shipment of goods was delayed due to bad weather.
We received a large shipment of books yesterday.
Track your shipment online with the provided tracking number.
cn: 货物运输因恶劣天气延误。
我们昨天收到一大批书籍的货运。
用提供的运单号在线追踪您的货物。

en: He shoved the papers into his bag angrily.
The crowd shoved forward to see the performer.
She gave him a shove to wake him up.
cn: 他怒气冲冲地把文件塞进包里。
人群推挤着向前去看表演者。
她推了他一把把他弄醒。

definitions.definition: 精明的，敏锐的（尤指判断或决策）

en: She made a shrewd investment and doubled her profits.
His shrewd observation skills helped him solve the mystery.
The politician’s shrewd tactics earned both admiration and criticism.
cn: 她做了一笔精明的投资，利润翻了一番。
他敏锐的观察力帮助他解开了谜团。
这位政客狡猾的策略既赢得了赞赏，也招致批评。

en: The wool sweater shrank in the wash.
He shrank back in fear when he saw the snake.
She visits her shrink every Thursday.
cn: 这件羊毛衫洗后缩水了。
他看到蛇时害怕地退缩了。
她每周四去看心理医生。

definitions.definition: 果汁甜酒（由果汁、糖和烈酒混合的饮料）

en: The garden was bordered by flowering shrubs.
She ordered a rum shrub at the colonial-themed bar.
Ants built nests under the dense shrub.
cn: 花园边缘种着开花的灌木。
她在殖民风格酒吧点了一杯朗姆果汁甜酒。
蚂蚁在茂密的灌木下筑巢。

definitions.definition: 耸肩（表示不确定、冷漠或无奈）

en: She shrugged when asked about the missing files.
His shrug indicated he didn't care.
The politician gave a vague shrug to avoid answering.
cn: 当被问及丢失的文件时，她耸了耸肩。
他的耸肩表明他不在乎。
政客含糊地耸了耸肩以回避回答。

en: She closed the wooden shutters to block out the sunlight.
The camera’s shutter speed affects the exposure of the photo.
They decided to shutter the business after years of losses.
cn: 她关上木制百叶窗以遮挡阳光。
相机的快门速度影响照片的曝光。
在多年亏损后，他们决定关闭这家企业。

definitions.definition: 梭子（织布工具）；短程往返交通工具（如航天飞机、班车）

en: The weaver's shuttle flies across the loom.
A shuttle bus runs between the airport and downtown every 30 minutes.
NASA retired its space shuttle program in 2011.
cn: 织布机的梭子在织机上飞速穿梭。
班车每30分钟在机场和市中心之间往返一次。
美国宇航局于2011年退役了航天飞机项目。

en: The city endured a brutal siege for six months.
The team faced a siege of criticism after their defeat.
Medieval castles were designed to withstand sieges.
cn: 这座城市经历了长达六个月的残酷围困。
球队在失败后遭到连番批评。
中世纪城堡的设计旨在抵御围攻。

en: Pass the sauce through a sieve to remove lumps.
The investigation aims to sieve facts from rumors.
Sand sieves are essential tools for archaeologists.
cn: 将酱汁过筛以去除结块。
调查旨在从谣言中筛选事实。
砂筛是考古学家的必备工具。

en: The lighthouse sends a bright signal to guide ships at night.
Her sudden silence was a signal that something was wrong.
The treaty is seen as a signal achievement in diplomatic history.
cn: 灯塔在夜间发出明亮的信号引导船只。
她突然的沉默预示着出了问题。
该条约被视为外交史上的显著成就。

en: The discovery of penicillin was a significant breakthrough in medicine.
There is a significant difference between the two experimental results.
She made significant contributions to the project.
cn: 青霉素的发现是医学领域的重大突破。
两组实验结果存在显著差异。
她为该项目作出了相当大的贡献。

en: A red traffic light signifies that you must stop.
Dark clouds often signify an approaching storm.
His silence signified disapproval of the plan.
cn: 红色交通灯表示你必须停下。
乌云常预示着暴风雨来临。
他的沉默意味着不赞同该计划。

definitions.definition: 硅材料（用于电子工业等）

en: Silicon is widely used in computer chips and solar panels.
The valley's economy thrives on silicon-based industries.
Pure silicon reacts with oxygen to form silicon dioxide.
cn: 硅广泛应用于计算机芯片和太阳能电池板。
该山谷的经济依赖硅基产业。
纯硅与氧气反应生成二氧化硅。

en: The two paintings are strikingly similar in style.
Her opinion is similar to mine on this issue.
The experiment yielded results similar to previous studies.
cn: 这两幅画的风格惊人地相似。
在这个问题上，她的观点与我的类似。
实验得出的结果与先前研究相似。

en: The flight simulator can simulate extreme weather conditions.
He tried to simulate enthusiasm, but his tone betrayed him.
Scientists use models to simulate climate change effects.
cn: 飞行模拟器能模拟极端天气条件。
他试图假装热情，但语气出卖了他。
科学家用模型模拟气候变化的影响。

en: The two explosions were nearly simultaneous.
We need to achieve simultaneous translation for the conference.
The dancers moved in simultaneous precision.
cn: 两次爆炸几乎同时发生。
我们需要为会议实现同声传译。
舞者们以同步的精准度动作。

en: She sipped her tea slowly, enjoying the warmth.
He took a sip of water before continuing his speech.
The cocktail was so strong that one sip made her cough.
cn: 她小口啜饮着茶，享受那份温暖。
他喝了一小口水，然后继续演讲。
这杯鸡尾酒太烈了，她喝了一小口就咳嗽起来。

en: The hotel is beautifully situated on a quiet bay.
Having young children places parents in a uniquely situated position of responsibility.
The factory is situated close to the highway for easy transport.
cn: 这家酒店坐落在一個宁静的海湾，位置极佳。
家有幼童使父母处于一种负有特殊责任的境地。
工厂坐落于高速公路附近，便于运输。

en: The museum displays a dinosaur skeleton.
The steel skeleton of the building is now complete.
She outlined the skeleton of her new novel.
cn: 博物馆展出了一具恐龙骨架。
建筑的钢骨架现已完工。
她简述了新小说的框架。

en: She gave him a skeptical look when he claimed to have seen a UFO.
Scientists remain skeptical about the new theory until more evidence is provided.
His skeptical nature makes him a sharp critic of conspiracy theories.
cn: 当他声称看到UFO时，她投以怀疑的目光。
科学家们对新理论持保留态度，除非提供更多证据。
他生性多疑，因此能犀利地批判阴谋论。

definitions.definition: 跳跃；省略；集装箱（英式英语）

en: The children skipped happily across the meadow.
She decided to skip the boring chapter of the book.
cn: 孩子们欢快地跳过草地。
她决定跳过书中无聊的章节。

en: The archaeologist carefully examined the ancient skull.
He has a thick skull and never listens to advice.
The impact fractured his skull but he survived.
cn: 考古学家仔细检查了那个古老的头骨。
他脑子不开窍，从不听劝。
撞击使他的颅骨骨折，但他活了下来。

en: The rope went slack when the weight was removed.
Don’t slack off during the final project.
Business is usually slack in January.
cn: 移除重物后，绳子变松了。
不要在最终项目上懈怠。
一月份通常是生意淡季。

en: She gave him a sharp slap across the cheek.
The waves slapped against the side of the boat.
He slapped the documents down on the table angrily.
cn: 她狠狠地扇了他一耳光。
浪花拍打着船身。
他生气地把文件啪的一声摔在桌上。

en: He slashed the rope with a knife.
The company slashed prices by 50%.
Use a slash to separate options (e.g., and/or).
cn: 他用刀砍断了绳子。
公司大幅降价50%。
用斜线分隔选项（如“和/或”）。

en: The battle resulted in a terrible slaughter of innocent civilians.
The government banned the slaughter of endangered species.
The documentary exposed the cruel conditions of industrial animal slaughter.
cn: 这场战斗导致无辜平民惨遭屠杀。
政府明令禁止屠宰濒危物种。
纪录片揭露了工业化屠宰动物的残酷条件。

en: She cut a thin slice of bread for the sandwich.
The pizza was divided into eight equal slices.
He sliced the apple with a sharp knife.
cn: 她为三明治切了一片薄面包。
披萨被均分成八块。
他用锋利的刀把苹果切成片。

en: The road was slick after the rain.
He gave a slick presentation with polished slides.
The oil spill created a slick on the water's surface.
cn: 雨后路面很滑。
他用精美的幻灯片做了一场娴熟的演讲。
泄漏的石油在水面形成了一层油膜。

en: The children love to slide down the snowy hill.
She slid the document across the table silently.
The professor showed a slide of ancient artifacts.
cn: 孩子们喜欢从雪坡上滑下来。
她悄悄把文件滑过桌面。
教授展示了一张古代文物的幻灯片。

definitions.definition: 轻微的；纤细的；不重要的

en: She felt a slight breeze on her face.
He slighted her by ignoring her question.
The difference between the two versions is very slight.
cn: 她感到脸上有一丝微风。
他无视她的问题，以示轻蔑。
两个版本之间的差异微乎其微。

en: She slipped on the icy pavement and fell.
Don’t let the opportunity slip through your fingers.
He wrote his phone number on a slip of paper.
cn: 她在结冰的路面上滑倒了。
别让机会从指间溜走。
他把电话号码写在一张纸条上。

en: The floor was slippery after the rain.
He gave a slippery answer to avoid responsibility.
Be careful—the rocks near the river are slippery.
cn: 雨后地板很滑。
他给出一个狡猾的回答以逃避责任。
小心，河边的岩石很滑。

en: The protesters chanted slogans demanding justice.
"Just Do It" is one of the most famous advertising slogans.
The campaign slogan resonated with young voters.
cn: 抗议者高呼要求正义的口号。
“Just Do It”是最著名的广告标语之一。
这场竞选口号引起了年轻选民的共鸣。

en: The skiers raced down the steep slope.
The roof slopes at a 30-degree angle.
Her handwriting slopes slightly to the right.
cn: 滑雪者们沿着陡坡疾驰而下。
屋顶以30度角倾斜。
她的笔迹微微向右倾斜。

definitions.definition: 狭缝；投币口；时间段；职位

en: She inserted a coin into the slot.
The show has a 30-minute time slot.
He was slotted into the new team.
cn: 她将硬币投入投币口。
该节目有30分钟的播放时段。
他被安排进了新团队。

definitions.definition: 贫民窟（指城市中拥挤、破败的贫困区域）
访问或探访贫民窟（旧用法）

en: The documentary exposed the harsh living conditions in the urban slum.
Victorian writers often slummed to gather material for their novels.
Efforts to renovate the slum faced resistance from local residents.
cn: 这部纪录片揭露了城市贫民窟的恶劣生活条件。
维多利亚时代的作家常探访贫民窟为小说搜集素材。
贫民窟改造计划遭到了当地居民的抵制。

definitions.definition: 经济衰退；暴跌；（情绪或状态的）低迷
大幅下降；突然倒下；萎靡不振

en: The economy slumped after the financial crisis.
She slumped onto the sofa, exhausted.
His performance slumped in the second half of the game.
cn: 金融危机后经济急剧衰退。
她筋疲力尽地瘫倒在沙发上。
他的表现在比赛下半场大幅下滑。

definitions.definition: 破碎声；猛烈撞击；大成功

en: He smashed the window with a hammer.
The tennis player smashed the ball out of the court.
Their new album was a smash hit worldwide.
cn: 他用锤子砸碎了窗户。
网球选手将球猛击出界。
他们的新专辑在全球大获成功。

en: He was arrested for trying to smuggle drugs across the border.
The refugees smuggled themselves into the country in a cargo truck.
She smuggled a note into his pocket without anyone noticing.
cn: 他因试图走私毒品过境而被捕。
难民们藏在一辆货车里偷渡入境。
她悄悄把一张纸条塞进他的口袋，无人察觉。

en: She grabbed a quick snack between meetings.
Healthy snacks can boost your energy.
We snacked on popcorn while watching the movie.
cn: 她在会议间隙匆匆吃了点心。
健康零食能补充能量。
我们看电影时吃了爆米花当零食。

en: The thief snatched her purse and ran away.
He managed to snatch a few hours of sleep.
Her speech included a snatch of an old song.
cn: 小偷抢了她的钱包就跑。
他设法抓紧时间睡了几小时。
她的演讲中穿插了一段老歌。

en: He tried to sneak past the guard unnoticed.
She sneaked a look at the answers during the test.
Don’t trust him—he’s a sneak who spreads rumors.
cn: 他试图悄悄溜过警卫不被发现。
考试时她偷瞄了一眼答案。
别信他，他是个爱传谣言的鬼祟之人。

definitions.definition: 用鼻子吸气（尤指短促有声地闻或嗅）

en: The dog sniffed the ground eagerly.
She gave a disapproving sniff when she saw the mess.
He caught a sniff of fresh bread from the bakery.
cn: 狗急切地嗅着地面。
看到混乱的场面，她轻蔑地哼了一声。
他闻到面包店飘来的新鲜面包香气。

definitions.definition: 高飞，翱翔（指鸟类或飞行器）
急剧上升（指价格、数量等）
高涨，昂扬（指情绪或抱负）

en: The eagle soared above the mountains.
Housing prices have soared in the past decade.
Her spirits soared when she received the acceptance letter.
cn: 鹰群在山巅之上翱翔。
过去十年房价急剧上涨。
收到录取通知书时，她的情绪高涨。

en: He stayed sober despite the party's temptations.
Her sober analysis of the crisis impressed everyone.
The bad news sobered him instantly.
cn: 他在聚会上抵住诱惑，保持清醒。
她对危机的冷静分析令众人印象深刻。
这个坏消息立刻让他清醒过来。

definitions.definition: 社会学（研究社会结构、关系及发展的学科）

en: She majored in sociology to understand urban poverty dynamics.
Sociology examines how cultures shape individual behaviors.
His research bridges sociology and political science.
cn: 她主修社会学以理解城市贫困的动态。
社会学研究文化如何塑造个体行为。
他的研究连接了社会学与政治学。

en: The judge entered the courtroom with a solemn expression.
They exchanged solemn vows at the wedding.
The memorial service was a solemn occasion.
cn: 法官神情严肃地走进法庭。
他们在婚礼上交换了庄严的誓言。
这场纪念仪式氛围庄重。

definitions.definition: （英国）初级律师（负责法律咨询、文件准备等非诉讼事务）

en: The solicitor prepared the contract for the property purchase.
She consulted a solicitor about her inheritance rights.
In some states, door-to-door salesmen are called solicitors.
cn: 这位初级律师为房产交易准备了合同。
她就继承权问题咨询了一位律师。
在某些州，上门推销员被称为 solicitors。

definitions.definition: 团结（基于共同利益或目标的联合支持）

en: The strike demonstrated the workers' solidarity.
Global solidarity is crucial in fighting pandemics.
Their solidarity during the crisis inspired the nation.
cn: 这次罢工展现了工人们的团结。
全球团结对抗击流行病至关重要。
他们在危机中的团结激励了整个国家。

en: He led a solitary life in the mountains after retirement.
The lighthouse stood solitary on the rocky cliff.
The prisoner was kept in solitary confinement for weeks.
cn: 退休后，他在山中过着独居生活。
灯塔孤零零地矗立在岩石峭壁上。
这名囚犯被单独监禁了数周。

en: She performed a violin solo at the concert.
He prefers solo travel to group tours.
The pilot flew solo across the Atlantic for the first time.
cn: 她在音乐会上表演了一段小提琴独奏。
相比跟团游，他更喜欢独自旅行。
这位飞行员首次独自飞越大西洋。

en: Sugar is soluble in water.
The conflict proved to be soluble through diplomacy.
This chemical compound is only soluble under high pressure.
cn: 糖可溶于水。
这场冲突可通过外交手段解决。
这种化合物仅在高压下可溶解。

en: The solution to this math problem requires creative thinking.
Salt forms a clear solution in water.
Both parties are working toward a peaceful solution.
cn: 这道数学题的解答需要创造性思维。
盐在水中形成透明的溶液。
双方正在寻求和平解决方案。

definitions.definition: 复杂的；精密的（指技术、系统等）
老练的；见多识广的（指人）

en: The lab uses sophisticated equipment to analyze DNA.
She has a sophisticated taste in art.
His argument was too sophisticated for the audience to follow.
cn: 实验室使用精密设备分析DNA。
她对艺术有着老练的鉴赏力。
他的论点过于复杂，听众难以理解。

en: The milk turned sour after being left out overnight.
She gave him a sour look when he interrupted her.
The economic situation has soured relations between the two countries.
cn: 牛奶放置一夜后变酸了。
他打断她时，她投来一个不悦的眼神。
经济状况恶化了两国关系。

definitions.definition: 至高无上的；拥有主权的

en: The sovereign power of the nation resides in its people.
Queen Elizabeth II was the sovereign of the United Kingdom for over 70 years.
A sovereign state has full control over its own laws.
cn: 国家的最高权力属于人民。
伊丽莎白二世女王是英国长达70余年的君主。
主权国家对其法律拥有完全掌控权。

en: The living room is spacious enough for a grand piano.
She admired the spacious skies of the countryside.
The new office building features spacious corridors and open-plan areas.
cn: 客厅宽敞得足以放下一架三角钢琴。
她赞叹乡村辽阔的天空。
新办公楼以宽敞的走廊和开放式区域为特色。

en: The bridge spans the river with a single arch.
Her career spanned three decades.
The eagle's wingspan measured over two meters.
cn: 这座桥以单拱结构横跨河流。
她的职业生涯跨越了三十年。
这只鹰的翼展超过两米。

en: Her eyes sparkled with excitement.
The diamond sparkled under the spotlight.
He always adds sparkle to our meetings with his humor.
cn: 她的双眼因兴奋而闪闪发亮。
钻石在聚光灯下熠熠生辉。
他的幽默总为我们的会议注入活力。

en: She is a specialist in ancient Greek history.
You should consult a heart specialist for this condition.
The company hired a cybersecurity specialist to protect its data.
cn: 她是古希腊历史领域的专家。
这种情况你应该咨询心脏专科医生。
公司聘请了一位网络安全专家来保护数据。

definitions.definition: （某地或某人的）特色产品/服务

en: Her specialty is medieval European history.
This restaurant’s specialty is handmade pasta.
The doctor chose cardiology as his specialty.
cn: 她的专业领域是中世纪欧洲史。
这家餐厅的特色菜是手工意大利面。
这位医生选择心脏病学作为他的专业。

en: This forest is home to over 200 species of birds.
The scientist discovered a new species of deep-sea fish.
We need to protect endangered species from extinction.
cn: 这片森林是200多种鸟类的栖息地。
科学家发现了一种新的深海鱼类物种。
我们需要保护濒危物种免于灭绝。

en: The doctor gave specific instructions for the medication.
This tool is specific to woodworking.
Can you be more specific about your requirements?
cn: 医生给出了具体的用药说明。
这种工具专用于木工。
你能更明确地说明你的需求吗？

en: The contract includes detailed specifications for the materials.
The software specification was approved by the development team.
Always check the product specifications before purchasing.
cn: 合同中包含材料的详细规格说明。
开发团队通过了该软件的技术要求文档。
购买前务必核对产品规格参数。

en: The sunset over the mountains was a breathtaking spectacle.
He adjusted his spectacles before reading the newspaper.
The parade turned the city streets into a vibrant spectacle.
cn: 山间的日落是一场令人屏息的奇观。
他戴上眼镜调整位置，开始读报。
游行将城市街道变成了活力四射的盛景。

en: The stadium was packed with excited spectators.
As a mere spectator, he avoided getting involved in the debate.
The art exhibition attracted thousands of spectators daily.
cn: 体育场挤满了兴奋的观众。
作为纯粹的旁观者，他避免卷入争论。
艺术展每天吸引数千名参观者。

en: The prism separated sunlight into a spectrum of colors.
The study covers a broad spectrum of opinions.
Autism exists on a spectrum of severity.
cn: 棱镜将阳光分离成一系列色彩。
这项研究涵盖了广泛的观点范围。
自闭症存在于一个严重程度不一的谱系中。

en: Scientists can only speculate about the origins of the universe.
He made his fortune by speculating in the stock market.
It’s useless to speculate without concrete evidence.
cn: 科学家只能推测宇宙的起源。
他通过股市投机积累了财富。
没有具体证据的猜测是无用的。

en: Cinnamon and nutmeg are common spices in baking.
She spiced the soup with a pinch of cumin.
His jokes added spice to the dull meeting.
cn: 肉桂和肉豆蔻是烘焙中常用的香料。
她往汤里加了一撮孜然调味。
他的笑话为枯燥的会议增添了趣味。

en: She injured her spine in a car accident.
Cacti have sharp spines to protect themselves.
The title was printed in gold on the spine of the book.
cn: 她在车祸中伤到了脊柱。
仙人掌用尖刺保护自己。
书名用金色印在书的书脊上。

definitions.definition: 螺旋；螺旋形物体；持续恶化/增长的过程
盘旋上升/下降；持续恶化/增长

en: The staircase winds in a tight spiral to the tower.
Inflation caused prices to spiral out of control.
A spiral notebook lies on her desk.
cn: 楼梯以紧密的螺旋形盘旋至塔顶。
通货膨胀导致物价失控性上涨。
她的桌上放着一本螺旋装订笔记本。

en: She broke the vase out of spite.
He refused the offer just to spite his rival.
Their actions were fueled by pure spite.
cn: 她出于恶意打碎了花瓶。
他拒绝提议只是为了刁难对手。
他们的行为完全出于怨恨。

en: The kids laughed as they splashed in the puddles.
A splash of milk lightened the color of her coffee.
We heard the splash of a fish jumping in the lake.
cn: 孩子们踩水坑嬉戏，水花四溅，笑声不断。
几滴牛奶让她的咖啡颜色变浅了。
我们听见湖里有鱼跃出水面的扑通声。

en: The rain spoiled our picnic plans.
Too much sugar can spoil your appetite.
The archaeologists found spoils from ancient battles.
cn: 雨水破坏了我们的野餐计划。
过量糖分会败坏你的食欲。
考古学家发现了古代战争的战利品。

definitions.definition: 海绵（动物或材料）；vt. 用海绵擦拭；vi. 寄生，揩油

en: She used a sponge to clean the spilled juice.
The coral reef is home to various sponges and fish.
He always sponges off his friends instead of getting a job.
cn: 她用海绵擦拭洒出的果汁。
珊瑚礁是多种海绵和鱼类的栖息地。
他总靠朋友接济，而不是找份工作。

definitions.definition: 自发的；自然的；无意识的

en: The audience burst into spontaneous applause.
Many wildflowers grow in spontaneous clusters.
Her laughter was completely spontaneous.
cn: 观众自发地鼓起掌来。
许多野花自然成簇生长。
她的笑声全然发自内心。

en: She introduced him as her spouse at the party.
The legal rights of a spouse vary by country.
He became the primary caregiver for his ailing spouse.
cn: 她在聚会上介绍他是她的配偶。
配偶的法律权利因国家而异。
他成为患病配偶的主要照护者。

en: She sprinkled sugar over the cake.
A sprinkle of rain cooled the air.
Sprinkle the seeds evenly in the soil.
cn: 她在蛋糕上撒了糖。
零星小雨让空气凉爽起来。
将种子均匀地撒在土壤里。

en: The spy infiltrated the enemy base undetected.
She likes to spy on her neighbors through the curtains.
The device can spy on conversations from 50 meters away.
cn: 这名间谍未被发现地潜入了敌方基地。
她喜欢透过窗帘暗中观察邻居。
这个装置能窃听50米外的对话。

definitions.definition: 小队；小组（尤指军队、警察或体育团队中的小型单位）

en: The police squad quickly surrounded the building.
She joined the cheerleading squad in high school.
A squad of volunteers cleaned up the park.
cn: 警方小队迅速包围了大楼。
她在高中加入了啦啦队。
一支志愿者小队清理了公园。

en: He stabbed the knife into the table angrily.
Her betrayal felt like a stab in the heart.
The victim suffered multiple stab wounds.
cn: 他愤怒地将刀刺进桌子。
她的背叛如同一把刺入心脏的刀。
受害者身中多刀。

definitions.definition: （化学/物理）结构或性质的持久性

en: The political stability of the country attracted foreign investors.
Engineers tested the bridge's stability under extreme weather conditions.
Emotional stability is crucial for long-term mental health.
cn: 该国的政治稳定性吸引了外国投资者。
工程师测试了桥梁在极端天气下的稳定性。
情绪稳定对长期心理健康至关重要。

en: The government implemented policies to stabilize the economy.
Her condition began to stabilize after the treatment.
Engineers added supports to stabilize the bridge.
cn: 政府实施政策以稳定经济。
治疗后，她的状况开始稳定。
工程师增加支撑结构以加固桥梁。

en: The economy remained stable despite global crises.
She keeps her horse in a wooden stable behind the farmhouse.
His calm personality provides a stable influence on the team.
cn: 尽管全球危机，经济仍保持稳定。
她把马养在农舍后的木制马厩里。
他沉稳的性格为团队提供了稳定的影响。

en: She stacked the books neatly on the shelf.
A stack of papers awaited his signature.
The server crashed due to a stack overflow.
cn: 她把书整齐地堆放在书架上。
一摞文件等着他签字。
服务器因堆栈溢出而崩溃。

en: The drunk man staggered down the street.
The news of his resignation staggered the entire team.
The trees were staggered along the path to create a natural screen.
cn: 醉酒男子踉踉跄跄地走在街上。
他辞职的消息让整个团队震惊不已。
树木沿小路交错排列，形成天然屏障。

en: The spiral staircase led to a hidden tower.
She tripped on the marble staircase and dropped her books.
The fire escape includes an external metal staircase.
cn: 螺旋楼梯通向一座隐秘的塔楼。
她在大理石楼梯上绊倒，书散落一地。
紧急逃生通道包含一部外部金属楼梯。

definitions.definition: 茎；秆；梗（植物的支撑部分）
偷偷跟踪；潜近（猎物或人）

en: The sunflower's stalk was thick and sturdy.
The photographer stalked the tiger silently through the jungle.
She stalked out of the room after the argument.
cn: 向日葵的茎秆粗壮结实。
摄影师在丛林中悄无声息地跟踪老虎。
争吵后，她昂首阔步地离开了房间。

en: The flower stall at the corner sells fresh roses daily.
The car engine stalled in the middle of the intersection.
Stop stalling and answer the question directly!
cn: 角落的花摊每天售卖新鲜玫瑰。
汽车引擎在十字路口中央熄火了。
别拖延，直接回答问题！

en: From a scientific standpoint, the theory lacks empirical evidence.
Her feminist standpoint shapes her analysis of the novel.
The report examines the issue from multiple standpoints.
cn: 从科学角度来看，该理论缺乏实证依据。
她的女性主义立场影响了她对这部小说的分析。
报告从多个角度审视了这一问题。

en: Rice is a staple food in many Asian countries.
She stapled the documents together.
Tourism is a staple of the local economy.
cn: 大米是许多亚洲国家的主食。
她用订书钉将文件钉在一起。
旅游业是当地经济的支柱产业。

en: The loud noise startled the sleeping cat.
She startled at the sight of a shadow in the dark.
His sudden appearance startled everyone in the room.
cn: 巨大的声响惊醒了睡梦中的猫。
她被黑暗中的人影吓了一跳。
他的突然出现让房间里所有人都大吃一惊。

definitions.definition: 陈述；声明（正式的口头或书面表达）
财务报表（银行或商业记录）

en: The witness gave a detailed statement to the police.
Please check your bank statement for any errors.
Her bold statement sparked a heated debate.
cn: 目击者向警方提供了详细陈述。
请核对银行账单是否有误。
她大胆的声明引发了激烈争论。

definitions.definition: 政治家（尤指睿智、公正的领导者）

en: Abraham Lincoln is remembered as a great statesman who preserved the Union.
The conference brought together statesmen from over 50 countries.
True statesmen prioritize long-term public good over short-term gains.
cn: 亚伯拉罕·林肯被誉为维护联邦统一的伟大政治家。
此次会议汇聚了来自50多个国家的政治家。
真正的政治家会将长远公共利益置于短期利益之上。

en: The car remained stationary at the traffic light.
Her mood was unusually stationary throughout the day.
Stationary objects are easier to photograph than moving ones.
cn: 那辆车在红绿灯前保持静止。
她一整天情绪异常平稳。
静止的物体比移动的物体更容易拍摄。

en: Her status as a CEO gives her significant influence in the industry.
The project’s current status is under review.
Social media often reflects one’s perceived status in society.
cn: 她作为首席执行官的身份使她在行业中具有重要影响力。
该项目目前的状态正在审核中。
社交媒体常反映一个人在社会中的 perceived 地位。

en: The concert was recorded in stereo.
She bought a new stereo system for her car.
The stereo effect makes the movie more immersive.
cn: 这场音乐会用立体声录制。
她为车购置了新的立体声音响。
立体声效果让电影更具沉浸感。

en: The movie challenges gender stereotypes.
Avoid stereotyping people based on appearance.
His humor relies on cultural stereotypes.
cn: 这部电影挑战了性别刻板印象。
避免根据外表对人形成刻板印象。
他的幽默依赖于文化刻板印象。

en: The teacher gave us a stern warning about cheating.
His stern expression made everyone nervous.
Waves crashed against the stern of the ship.
cn: 老师就作弊问题给了我们严厉的警告。
他严峻的表情让所有人都紧张起来。
海浪猛烈拍打着船尾。

en: The tape is too sticky to remove cleanly.
The weather was hot and sticky all week.
They found themselves in a sticky situation.
cn: 胶带太黏，无法干净地撕下。
整个星期天气又热又闷。
他们陷入了棘手的境地。

en: The tax cut acted as a stimulus to economic growth.
Light is a stimulus for plant photosynthesis.
Praise can be a powerful stimulus for children’s learning.
cn: 减税措施对经济增长起到了刺激作用。
光是植物光合作用的刺激源。
表扬能有效激励儿童学习。

definitions.definition: 库存；存货；股票；家畜；血统

en: The store has a large stock of winter coats.
She invested in tech stocks last year.
This joke is a stock example of British humor.
cn: 商店有大量冬季外套的库存。
她去年投资了科技股。
这个笑话是英式幽默的典型例子。

en: His answer was straightforward and honest.
The instructions are straightforward for beginners.
She prefers a straightforward approach to problem-solving.
cn: 他的回答直截了当且诚实。
这些说明对初学者来说简单易懂。
她更喜欢用直截了当的方式解决问题。

en: The rope snapped under the strain.
She strained her voice by shouting too much.
He strained to hear the distant conversation.
cn: 绳子在拉力下断裂了。
她因过度喊叫而伤了嗓子。
他努力去听远处的谈话。

en: She twisted a strand of hair around her finger.
The ship was stranded on a desert island.
He found himself stranded without money in a foreign city.
cn: 她将一缕头发绕在手指上。
船只搁浅在一座荒岛上。
他身无分文，被困在异国他乡。

definitions.definition: 策略，战略（为实现目标制定的长期计划）

en: The company's marketing strategy focuses on social media engagement.
Sun Tzu's The Art of War is a classic text on military strategy.
She devised a clever strategy to win the chess game.
cn: 这家公司的营销策略侧重于社交媒体互动。
孙武的《孙子兵法》是军事战略的经典著作。
她设计了一个聪明的策略来赢得棋局。

en: The cat might stray if you leave the door open.
Her eyes strayed to the clock during the meeting.
The report included a few stray remarks about politics.
cn: 如果你开着门，猫可能会走丢。
开会时，她的目光不自觉地瞟向时钟。
报告中夹杂了几句无关的政治评论。

definitions.definition: 条纹；条痕；短暂的一段经历（如连胜或连败）

en: The comet left a bright streak across the night sky.
She's on a winning streak after five consecutive victories.
Rain streaked the windows as the car sped down the highway.
cn: 彗星在夜空中划出一道明亮的痕迹。
她连续五场获胜，正处于连胜状态。
雨水在车窗上留下条纹，汽车在高速公路上飞驰。

definitions.definition: 溪流；流动的液体或气体；连续的数据流

en: The children played by the babbling stream.
Tears began to stream down her face.
The concert was streamed live to millions of viewers.
cn: 孩子们在潺潺的小溪边玩耍。
泪水开始顺着她的脸颊流下。
音乐会向数百万观众实时直播。

definitions.definition: 流线型；高效的设计或流程

en: The car's streamlined design reduces wind resistance.
We need to streamline our production process to cut costs.
The company streamlined its operations by removing redundant steps.
cn: 这辆车的流线型设计降低了风阻。
我们需要优化生产流程以降低成本。
公司通过去除冗余步骤简化了运营。

en: She strode confidently into the meeting room.
The company has made significant strides in renewable energy.
He took two strides to cross the small stream.
cn: 她自信地大步走进会议室。
该公司在可再生能源领域取得了重大进展。
他跨了两步越过小溪。

en: She tied the package with a piece of string.
The necklace was strung with tiny pearls.
A string of accidents disrupted the event.
cn: 她用一根细绳捆扎包裹。
这条项链串着小珍珠。
一连串意外事件扰乱了活动。

definitions.definition: 抗争，斗争（与 against/with 连用）

en: She strives for excellence in every project she undertakes.
cn: 她力求在每个项目中追求卓越。

definitions.definition: 击打；中风；（游泳的）划水动作；（书写或绘画的）一笔

en: She painted the final stroke with a steady hand.
The cat purred when he stroked its fur.
A stroke can cause sudden paralysis.
cn: 她稳稳地画下最后一笔。
他抚摸猫咪的毛时，它发出呼噜声。
中风可能导致突发性瘫痪。

en: They decided to stroll along the beach at sunset.
A morning stroll in the park clears my mind.
The old couple enjoys their daily stroll through the village.
cn: 他们决定在日落时沿着海滩散步。
早晨在公园散步能让我的头脑清醒。
这对老夫妇喜欢每天在村子里散步。

definitions.definition: 难处理的，难克服的（如顽固污渍）

en: He was too stubborn to admit his mistake.
The stubborn stain wouldn’t come out even after washing.
Her stubborn determination helped her succeed.
cn: 他固执得不肯承认错误。
这个顽固污渍洗也洗不掉。
她固执的决心助她成功。

en: He stumbled over a rock and fell.
She stumbled through her speech nervously.
The team's stumble in the final round cost them the victory.
cn: 他被石头绊倒了。
她紧张地结结巴巴完成了演讲。
团队在最后一轮的失误使他们输掉了比赛。

definitions.definition: 树桩；残余部分；政治演说的讲台
使困惑；砍伐（树木）留桩；巡回演说

en: The hiker tripped over a hidden stump in the forest.
The math problem completely stumped the students.
The candidate spent weeks stumping across rural counties.
cn: 徒步者在森林里被隐藏的树桩绊倒。
这道数学题彻底难倒了学生。
候选人花了数周时间在乡村地区巡回演说。

definitions.definition: 使昏迷（尤指通过击打头部）

en: The news of his sudden death stunned the entire community.
A blow to the head can stun a person temporarily.
She was stunned by the beauty of the northern lights.
cn: 他突然去世的消息震惊了整个社区。
头部受到重击会让人暂时昏迷。
北极光的美丽让她目瞪口呆。

definitions.definition: 强壮的，结实的（指人或物体）
坚定的，顽强的（指性格或态度）

en: The sturdy oak tree withstood the storm.
She has a sturdy belief in justice.
The table is made of sturdy metal.
cn: 这棵结实的橡树经受住了暴风雨。
她对正义有着坚定的信念。
这张桌子由坚固的金属制成。

definitions.definition: 主观的（基于个人感受或观点）

en: Her opinion is highly subjective and influenced by personal experience.
In grammar, "I" is a subjective pronoun.
Art criticism can never be entirely objective; it's inherently subjective.
cn: 她的观点非常主观，受个人经历影响。
在语法中，“I”是主语代词。
艺术评论永远无法完全客观，它本质上是主观的。

en: The submarine descended to explore the ocean floor.
Marine biologists study submarine ecosystems.
Submarine cables connect continents for internet communication.
cn: 潜水艇下潜以探索海底。
海洋生物学家研究海底生态系统。
海底电缆连接各大洲以实现互联网通信。

en: Please submit your report by Friday.
He refused to submit to their demands.
The warrior chose death rather than submit.
cn: 请于周五前提交你的报告。
他拒绝屈服于他们的要求。
这名战士宁死不屈。

en: She is subordinate to the manager in the company hierarchy.
The clause is subordinate to the main contract.
He refused to subordinate his own ideas to the team’s plan.
cn: 她在公司层级中隶属于经理之下。
该条款附属于主合同。
他拒绝让自己的想法服从团队计划。

definitions.definition: 订阅（服务、刊物等）；签署（文件）
同意；捐款（常与 to 连用）

en: She subscribes to three scientific journals.
Many citizens subscribed to the petition against the new law.
I don’t subscribe to the idea that success requires constant hustle.
cn: 她订阅了三本科学期刊。
许多市民签署了反对新法律的请愿书。
我不认同“成功必须不停拼搏”的观点。

en: The first round of talks failed, but subsequent negotiations succeeded.
Subsequent events proved her theory correct.
Each subsequent chapter builds on the previous one.
cn: 首轮谈判失败，但随后的协商取得了成功。
后续事件证明了她的理论是正确的。
每一章都承接前一章的内容展开。

en: The company operates as a subsidiary of a multinational corporation.
She plays a subsidiary role in the research project.
The subsidiary products generate 20% of total revenue.
cn: 这家公司是一家跨国企业的子公司。
她在这个研究项目中担任辅助角色。
附属产品贡献了总收入的20%。

definitions.definition: 补贴（政府或机构提供的财政援助）
补助金（特定用途的经济支持）

en: The government offers a subsidy to farmers during droughts.
Renewable energy projects often rely on public subsidies.
The subsidy helped small businesses survive the crisis.
cn: 干旱期间政府向农民提供补贴。
可再生能源项目通常依赖公共补助。
这项补助金帮助小企业渡过了危机。

en: The substance of his argument was convincing, though his delivery was poor.
Water is a substance essential for all known forms of life.
Her research lacks substance and relies too heavily on speculation.
cn: 他的论点实质很有说服力，尽管表达方式欠佳。
水是所有已知生命形式必需的物质。
她的研究缺乏实质性内容，过度依赖推测。

en: The project requires a substantial amount of funding.
She made substantial contributions to scientific research.
The house is built with substantial materials to withstand storms.
cn: 该项目需要大量资金支持。
她对科学研究作出了重要贡献。
房屋采用坚固材料建造，以抵御风暴。

en: Honey can substitute sugar in some recipes.
The coach sent a substitute player onto the field.
No artificial flavoring can substitute for real vanilla.
cn: 蜂蜜在某些食谱中可以替代糖。
教练派了一名替补球员上场。
任何人工香料都无法替代真正的香草。

en: The painting uses subtle shades of blue to create a calming effect.
She noticed a subtle change in his tone that hinted at disapproval.
The joke was too subtle for the audience to understand.
cn: 这幅画运用微妙的蓝色调营造出宁静的氛围。
她察觉到他语气中一丝暗示不满的微妙变化。
这个笑话过于隐晦，观众没能领会。

en: Subtract 5 from 10 to get 5.
The bank will subtract the fee automatically.
Children learn to add before they learn to subtract.
cn: 从10中减去5，得到5。
银行将自动扣除手续费。
儿童先学加法，再学减法。

definitions.definition: 郊区，城郊（城市边缘的住宅区）

en: They moved to a quiet suburb to escape the noise of downtown.
The school serves children from both the city and its suburbs.
Suburb life often involves longer commutes but more space.
cn: 他们搬到了安静的郊区，以躲避市中心的喧嚣。
这所学校接收来自城市和郊区的孩子。
郊区生活通常意味着更长的通勤时间，但更宽敞的居住空间。

en: The team celebrated three successive victories.
Successive governments failed to solve the issue.
Her successive attempts finally led to a breakthrough.
cn: 该队庆祝了连续三场胜利。
历届政府均未能解决该问题。
她接连的尝试最终带来了突破。

en: She was named as the successor to the current CEO.
The successor of this ancient tradition faces modern challenges.
In biology, a successor species often fills the ecological niche of its ancestor.
cn: 她被指定为现任首席执行官继任者。
这一古老传统的继承者面临现代挑战。
在生物学中，后继物种常填补其祖先的生态位。

definitions.definition: 提出诉讼（常与 for 连用）

en: The company decided to sue for breach of contract.
Victims may sue for damages in civil court.
He threatened to sue if the agreement was not honored.
cn: 该公司决定以违约提起诉讼。
受害者可在民事法庭起诉要求赔偿。
他威胁称若不履行协议将提起诉讼。

en: A simple apology will suffice.
The evidence did not suffice to prove his guilt.
Two bottles of water may suffice for the hike.
cn: 一句简单的道歉就足够了。
这些证据不足以证明他有罪。
两瓶水或许足够这次徒步。

en: The food supplies are sufficient for the entire winter.
Her explanation was not sufficient to convince the committee.
A light jacket is sufficient for this mild weather.
cn: 食物储备足够支撑整个冬季。
她的解释不足以说服委员会。
这种温和天气，一件薄外套就足够了。

definitions.definition: 套房（酒店或住宅中的一组房间）
系列（相关物品或事件的组合）

en: The presidential suite has a panoramic view of the city.
She bought a matching suite of furniture for her new apartment.
Tchaikovsky's "Nutcracker Suite" is popular during Christmas.
cn: 总统套房可俯瞰城市全景。
她为新公寓购置了一套配套家具。
柴可夫斯基的《胡桃夹子组曲》在圣诞节期间广受欢迎。

definitions.definition: 硫（一种黄色非金属化学元素，符号为 S）

en: Sulfur is used in the production of sulfuric acid.
The volcanic gases smelled strongly of sulfur.
Organic chemistry often involves sulfur-containing compounds.
cn: 硫被用于生产硫酸。
火山气体带有强烈的硫磺味。
有机化学常涉及含硫化合物。

en: They reached the summit of Mount Everest at dawn.
The G7 summit will address climate change.
After years of effort, she finally summited her career goals.
cn: 他们在黎明时分登上了珠穆朗玛峰顶峰。
七国集团峰会将讨论气候变化问题。
经过多年努力，她终于达成了职业目标的巅峰。

definitions.definition: 召唤；召集（正式或权威性要求）
鼓起（勇气等）；唤起（记忆等）

en: The king summoned his council to discuss the crisis.
She summoned all her strength to finish the marathon.
The smell of lavender summoned memories of her childhood.
cn: 国王召集议会商讨危机。
她竭尽全力完成马拉松。
薰衣草的气味唤起了她的童年回忆。

en: His knowledge of the subject is purely superficial.
The wound is only superficial and doesn’t require stitches.
She smiled, but it was a superficial gesture hiding her frustration.
cn: 他对这门学科的了解非常肤浅。
伤口只是表皮伤，无需缝合。
她笑了，但这只是掩饰沮丧的表面姿态。

definitions.definition: 监督人；主管；负责人（尤指公共事务或机构的管理者）
（美国）警察局长；（英国）高级警官

en: The school superintendent announced new safety policies.
He was appointed superintendent of the national park.
The police superintendent coordinated the citywide operation.
cn: 学区总监宣布了新的安全政策。
他被任命为国家公园的管理负责人。
警察局长统筹了全市的执法行动。

en: This product is clearly superior to its competitors in terms of durability.
She reported the issue to her superior immediately.
His superior attitude often alienates his colleagues.
cn: 这款产品在耐用性上明显优于竞争对手。
她立即向她的上级汇报了该问题。
他高高在上的态度常常疏远同事。

en: Her superiority in chess is undeniable.
He spoke with an air of superiority.
The team's technical superiority secured their victory.
cn: 她在国际象棋上的优势无可否认。
他说话时带着一种傲慢的态度。
该团队的技术优势确保了他们的胜利。

definitions.definition: 超音速的（速度超过声速）
超声的（频率高于人耳听觉范围）

en: The fighter jet reached supersonic speed within seconds.
Bats use supersonic waves to navigate in the dark.
Scientists study supersonic flow to improve aerodynamics.
cn: 这架战斗机在几秒内达到超音速。
蝙蝠利用超声波在黑暗中导航。
科学家研究超音速气流以优化空气动力学。

en: The manager will supervise the new project to ensure quality.
Teachers supervise students during exams to prevent cheating.
He was hired to supervise the construction of the bridge.
cn: 经理将监督新项目以确保质量。
考试期间，教师监督学生以防作弊。
他被雇来监督桥梁的建造。

en: The magazine includes a free supplement on travel tips.
She takes vitamin D to supplement her diet.
The data was used to supplement the research findings.
cn: 这本杂志附赠一份旅游指南增刊。
她服用维生素D来补充饮食营养。
这些数据被用来补充研究结果。

en: The teacher provided supplementary materials for advanced students.
Vitamin D is often taken as a dietary supplementary.
The report includes a supplementary section with updated data.
cn: 老师为进阶学生提供了补充材料。
维生素D常作为膳食补充剂服用。
报告附有包含最新数据的增补部分。

definitions.definition: 压制；镇压（如情感、反抗等）
抑制；阻止（如生长、传播等）

en: The government suppressed the rebellion with force.
She tried to suppress her laughter during the meeting.
This medication can suppress the growth of bacteria.
cn: 政府以武力镇压了叛乱。
她在会议上努力忍住笑声。
这种药物能抑制细菌生长。

en: The Supreme Court has the final authority on constitutional matters.
She handled the crisis with supreme calmness.
This dish requires supreme skill to prepare.
cn: 美国最高法院对宪法事务拥有最终裁决权。
她以极度冷静的态度处理了危机。
这道菜需要极高的技巧来烹制。

en: A surge of water flooded the streets after the heavy rain.
The stock market experienced a sudden surge in trading volume.
She felt a surge of anger when she heard the news.
cn: 暴雨后涌出的洪水淹没了街道。
股市交易量突然激增。
听到消息时，她感到一阵愤怒涌上心头。

en: The surgeon performed a life-saving operation.
He trained for years to become a skilled surgeon.
Military surgeons often work in challenging conditions.
cn: 这位外科医生完成了一场挽救生命的手术。
他经过多年训练成为了一名技术娴熟的外科医生。
军医常在充满挑战的环境中工作。

en: The patient underwent surgery to remove the tumor.
She works in the surgery at the local hospital.
The doctor’s surgery is closed on weekends.
cn: 患者接受了肿瘤切除手术。
她在当地医院的手术室工作。
这位医生的诊所周六日休息。

en: Her talent surpasses all expectations.
The new model surpasses its competitors in efficiency.
He strove to surpass his own previous achievements.
cn: 她的才华超越了所有人的预期。
新款模型在效率上胜过竞争对手。
他努力超越自己先前的成就。

en: The government sold the grain surplus to other countries.
Her surplus energy made her the perfect candidate for the marathon.
Remove any surplus paint with a clean cloth.
cn: 政府将过剩的粮食出售给其他国家。
她充沛的体力使她成为马拉松的理想人选。
用干净的布擦去多余的油漆。

en: The survival rate of the species has increased due to conservation efforts.
This ancient ritual is a survival from pre-Christian times.
Basic survival skills include finding clean water and building shelter.
cn: 由于保护措施，该物种的存活率有所提升。
这一古老仪式是基督教化之前的遗俗。
基本生存技能包括寻找干净水源和搭建庇护所。

en: Few animals can survive in the desert without water.
She survived the accident but lost her memory.
This tradition has survived for centuries.
cn: 没有水，很少有动物能在沙漠中生存。
她在事故中幸存，但失去了记忆。
这一传统已延续了数百年。

en: Children are more susceptible to advertising messages.
This plant is highly susceptible to frost damage.
His argument was susceptible to multiple interpretations.
cn: 儿童更容易受到广告信息的影响。
这种植物极易受霜冻损害。
他的论点容易引发多种解读。

en: The athlete received a two-game suspension for violating the rules.
This car's advanced suspension provides a smooth ride on rough roads.
Stir the mixture well to prevent the solid particles from settling out of suspension.
cn: 该运动员因违规被禁赛两场。
这款车的先进悬挂系统能在崎岖路面平稳行驶。
充分搅拌混合物以防止固体颗粒从悬浮液中沉淀。

definitions.definition: 少许，微量（如 a suspicion of salt）

en: She regarded his offer with suspicion.
There was a suspicion of sadness in her voice.
His actions aroused no suspicion among the guards.
cn: 她对他的提议心存怀疑。
她的声音里有一丝悲伤。
他的行为没有引起守卫的怀疑。

en: The police found his behavior highly suspicious.
She gave him a suspicious glance but didn’t say anything.
The package looked suspicious, so they called the bomb squad.
cn: 警方认为他的行为非常可疑。
她怀疑地瞥了他一眼，但什么也没说。
这个包裹看起来很可疑，于是他们叫来了拆弹小组。

definitions.definition: 维持；支撑（如生命、系统等）
遭受；经受（如损伤、压力等）
确认；支持（如理论、主张等）

en: The pillars are designed to sustain the weight of the roof.
She sustained a serious injury during the match.
The evidence is insufficient to sustain his argument.
cn: 这些柱子用于支撑屋顶的重量。
她在比赛中受了重伤。
证据不足以支持他的论点。

definitions.definition: 沼泽（低洼潮湿的软土地）

en: The explorers got lost in the dense swamp.
Heavy rain swamped the coastal town.
She felt swamped by work deadlines.
cn: 探险者在茂密的沼泽中迷路了。
暴雨淹没了沿海小镇。
她被工作截止日期压得喘不过气。

en: Let's swap seats so you can see the screen better.
They made a swap: her guitar for his camera.
I'll swap my lunch for your dessert.
cn: 我们换座位吧，这样你能更清楚看到屏幕。
他们做了笔交易：用她的吉他换他的相机。
我用午餐换你的甜点。

en: The dove is a symbol of peace.
The chemical symbol for gold is Au.
Her red scarf became a symbol of rebellion.
cn: 鸽子是和平的象征。
金的化学符号是Au。
她的红围巾成了反抗的标志。

definitions.definition: 对称（指形状、排列或比例的均衡）
相似性；协调性（抽象概念）

en: The butterfly's wings exhibit perfect symmetry.
The symmetry of the ancient temple reflects harmony in design.
His argument lacked symmetry, with weak evidence on one side.
cn: 蝴蝶的翅膀呈现出完美的对称。
这座古老神庙的对称性体现了设计的和谐。
他的论点缺乏平衡，其中一方的证据薄弱。

en: She gave me a sympathetic smile when I told her about my loss.
The government is sympathetic to environmental concerns.
The sympathetic nervous system prepares the body for stress responses.
cn: 当我讲述我的损失时，她向我投以同情的微笑。
政府对环境问题表示支持。
交感神经系统使身体为应激反应做好准备。

definitions.definition: 同情（对他人的痛苦或困境的理解与共鸣）
赞同（对观点或行动的支持）

en: She expressed deep sympathy for the victims of the earthquake.
His ideas are in sympathy with the environmental movement.
A good leader should have the ability to show sympathy.
cn: 她对地震受害者表达了深切的同情。
他的观点与环保运动的理念一致。
优秀的领导者应具备共情能力。

definitions.definition: 交响乐（大型管弦乐作品）

en: Beethoven's Ninth Symphony is a masterpiece of classical music.
The sunset was a symphony of reds and oranges.
The symphony orchestra will perform tonight at the concert hall.
cn: 贝多芬的第九交响曲是古典音乐的杰作。
夕阳呈现出一片红与橙的和谐交融。
交响乐团今晚将在音乐厅演出。

definitions.definition: 专题研讨会（学术或专业主题的正式会议）
（古希腊的）酒会（附有哲学讨论的社交宴会）

en: The university hosted a symposium on climate change.
Plato's "Symposium" explores the nature of love through dialogues.
She presented her research at an international symposium.
cn: 这所大学举办了一场关于气候变化的研讨会。
柏拉图的《会饮篇》通过对话探讨爱的本质。
她在一次国际研讨会上发表了研究成果。

definitions.definition: 综合征（一组同时出现的症状或特征）

en: The patient exhibits a rare genetic syndrome.
Burnout syndrome is common among high-pressure workers.
The novel captures the syndrome of urban loneliness.
cn: 患者表现出一种罕见的遗传综合征。
倦怠综合征在高压工作者中很常见。
这部小说捕捉了都市孤独的典型表现。

en: The synthesis of art and technology is key to modern design.
Photosynthesis is the process by which plants synthesize carbohydrates.
His theory offers a synthesis of Eastern and Western philosophies.
cn: 艺术与技术的结合是现代设计的关键。
光合作用是植物合成碳水化合物的过程。
他的理论融合了东西方哲学。

definitions.definition: 平头钉；粗缝针脚；行动方向
用平头钉固定；粗缝；改变航向

en: He used a tack to pin the poster to the wall.
The ship decided to tack to avoid the storm.
She quickly tacked the hem of her dress before the party.
cn: 他用图钉将海报固定在墙上。
船只改变航向以避开风暴。
她在聚会前匆忙粗缝了裙边。

definitions.definition: 装备；用具（尤指渔具或运动器材）
处理；解决；擒抱（橄榄球动作）

en: The fisherman packed his tackle before heading to the lake.
We need to tackle this problem systematically.
The player made a perfect tackle to stop the opponent.
cn: 渔民出发去湖边前整理好了渔具。
我们需要系统性地解决这个问题。
球员完成了一次完美的擒抱，阻止了对手进攻。

en: The lion was born in captivity and is quite tame.
It took years to tame the wild horse.
Her adventurous spirit could never be tamed.
cn: 这只狮子在圈养环境中出生，非常温顺。
驯服这匹野马花了数年时间。
她冒险的精神永远无法被束缚。

en: She got a deep tan after her vacation in Spain.
The leather is tanned using natural vegetable extracts.
His arms were tanned from working outdoors all summer.
cn: 她在西班牙度假后晒得黝黑。
这种皮革用天然植物提取物鞣制。
他整个夏天在户外工作，手臂晒黑了。

en: The kitten played with the yarn until it became a complete tangle.
Their argument over finances left their relationship in a tangle.
Be careful not to tangle the fishing line when casting.
cn: 小猫玩毛线，最后把它弄得一团乱。
他们因财务问题争吵，导致关系陷入僵局。
抛线时注意别让鱼线缠住。

en: The oil tanker spilled thousands of gallons into the ocean.
He served as a tanker during World War II.
The brewery uses a tanker to deliver beer.
cn: 油轮泄漏了数千加仑石油到海洋中。
他在二战期间是一名坦克手。
啤酒厂用罐车运送啤酒。

en: The arrow hit the center of the target.
The campaign targets young voters.
Set realistic targets for your project.
cn: 箭射中了靶心。
该活动以年轻选民为目标群体。
为你的项目设定现实的目标。

en: The government imposed a 10% tariff on imported electronics.
Check the hotel tariff before booking your stay.
Critics argue that high tariffs harm free trade.
cn: 政府对进口电子产品征收10%的关税。
预订前请查看酒店价目表。
批评者认为高关税损害自由贸易。

en: Don't tease the dog, or it might bite you.
She used a comb to tease the wool fibers apart.
His classmates called him a tease because he loved playing pranks.
cn: 别逗那只狗，它可能会咬你。
她用梳子把羊毛纤维梳理开。
同学们叫他“捣蛋鬼”，因为他总爱恶作剧。

definitions.definition: 冗长乏味的；令人厌倦的

en: The lecture was so tedious that half the audience fell asleep.
Filling out these forms is a tedious but necessary task.
She found the repetitive data entry work incredibly tedious.
cn: 这场讲座冗长乏味，半数听众都睡着了。
填写这些表格是项枯燥但必要的工作。
她认为重复的数据录入工作极其无聊。

en: She struggled to control her temper during the argument.
The blacksmith tempers steel to make it stronger.
A good leader knows how to temper justice with mercy.
cn: 她在争论中努力控制脾气。
铁匠锻钢以增强其硬度。
优秀的领袖懂得刚柔并济。

definitions.definition: 气质，性情（人的性格或情绪特征）
（音乐）调律（乐器音高的调整体系）

en: Her artistic temperament makes her sensitive to criticism.
The piano uses equal temperament to ensure harmony across all keys.
Dogs and cats have very different temperaments.
cn: 她的艺术气质使她对他人的批评格外敏感。
这架钢琴采用平均律调音，确保所有音调和谐。
狗和猫的性情截然不同。

en: The conductor adjusted the tempo to make the piece more dramatic.
The tempo of urban life can be overwhelming for newcomers.
In tennis, controlling the tempo of the game is crucial.
cn: 指挥调整了速度，使乐曲更具戏剧性。
城市生活的快节奏可能让新来者无所适从。
在网球比赛中，掌控比赛节奏至关重要。

en: The smell of fresh bread tempted him to break his diet.
She was tempted by the job offer but decided to stay loyal to her current company.
Don’t tempt fate by ignoring safety rules.
cn: 新鲜面包的香气诱使他打破了节食计划。
她虽被那份工作邀请吸引，但最终决定忠于现在的公司。
别无视安全规则去冒险试探命运。

en: The tenant pays rent to the landlord on the first of each month.
This law protects the rights of both tenants and property owners.
She decided to tenant the apartment for another year.
cn: 每月1日，租户向房东支付租金。
该法律保护租户和房产主的权利。
她决定续租这套公寓一年。

en: There is a growing tendency to work remotely.
His tendency to procrastinate caused problems.
The market shows a downward tendency this quarter.
cn: 远程工作的趋势日益增长。
他拖延的癖好引发了问题。
本季度市场呈现下行趋势。

en: They reached a tentative agreement after hours of negotiation.
Her smile was tentative, as if unsure of the reaction.
The scientist made a tentative conclusion based on preliminary data.
cn: 经过数小时谈判，他们达成了暂定协议。
她的笑容带着犹豫，仿佛不确定会得到什么回应。
科学家根据初步数据得出了试探性结论。

en: The contract will terminate automatically after three years.
The trail terminates at a scenic overlook.
The software prompts you to terminate the process.
cn: 合同将在三年后自动终止。
小径的尽头是一处观景台。
软件会提示你结束该进程。

en: The villa has a beautiful terrace overlooking the sea.
Farmers cultivated rice on mountain terraces.
They decided to terrace the slope to prevent soil erosion.
cn: 这座别墅有一个俯瞰大海的美丽露台。
农民们在梯田上种植水稻。
他们决定将斜坡改造成梯田以防止水土流失。

en: The military studied the rugged terrain before advancing.
This software simulates different types of terrain for game design.
His research covers unfamiliar terrain in quantum physics.
cn: 军队在推进前研究了崎岖的地形。
该软件为游戏设计模拟多种地形。
他的研究涉及量子物理学中鲜为人知的领域。

definitions.definition: 极好的，惊人的（现代常用义）
可怕的，令人恐惧的（古旧义）

en: The view from the mountaintop was terrific.
She gave a terrific performance in the play.
cn: 山顶的景色美得惊人。
她在剧中表现极为出色。

en: The sudden explosion terrified the crowd.
Horror movies are designed to terrify audiences.
She was terrified by the thought of failing the exam.
cn: 突然的爆炸声吓坏了人群。
恐怖电影旨在惊吓观众。
想到考试失败，她感到极度恐惧。

en: The wolves marked their territory by howling at the full moon.
Neuroscience is uncharted territory for many biologists.
The dispute over the maritime territory lasted for decades.
cn: 狼群通过对着满月嚎叫来标记领地。
神经科学对许多生物学家来说是未知领域。
这片海域领土的争端持续了数十年。

definitions.definition: 作证，证明（尤指在法庭上）

en: The witness refused to testify in court.
Her actions testify to her generosity.
Ancient artifacts testify to the civilization’s advanced technology.
cn: 证人拒绝在法庭上作证。
她的行为证明了她的慷慨。
古代文物证实了该文明先进的技术。

definitions.definition: 证词（尤指法庭上的正式陈述）
证明，证据（支持某主张的事实或陈述）

en: The witness gave a compelling testimony in court.
His success is a testimony to years of hard work.
Archaeologists found ancient testimonies of early human settlements.
cn: 证人在法庭上提供了令人信服的证词。
他的成功证明了多年努力的价值。
考古学家发现了早期人类聚居的古老证据。

en: The rough texture of the wall scraped her fingers.
This fabric has a silky texture.
The composer layered sounds to create a rich musical texture.
cn: 墙壁粗糙的质地刮伤了她的手指。
这种面料有丝滑的触感。
作曲家叠加音效以营造丰富的音乐层次感。

en: We celebrate Thanksgiving with a feast of turkey and pumpkin pie.
She expressed her thanksgiving by volunteering at the shelter.
The holiday originated from a thanksgiving ceremony for the harvest.
cn: 我们以火鸡和南瓜馅饼的盛宴庆祝感恩节。
她通过在收容所做义工来表达感恩。
这个节日起源于一场庆祝丰收的感恩仪式。

en: The museum reported the theft of a priceless painting.
Identity theft has become a major concern in the digital age.
He was charged with theft after stealing groceries from the store.
cn: 博物馆报告了一幅无价画作被盗。
数字时代，身份盗窃已成为重要问题。
他因从商店偷窃食品而被控盗窃罪。

en: The theme of the novel is the struggle for freedom.
The composer developed a beautiful theme in the symphony.
Each room in the hotel has a different cultural theme.
cn: 这部小说的主题是对自由的追求。
作曲家在交响乐中展开了一段优美的主题旋律。
酒店的每个房间都有不同的文化主题。

en: He graduated in 2010 and found a job shortly thereafter.
The treaty was signed, and peace was restored thereafter.
She moved to New York and thereafter focused on her writing career.
cn: 他于2010年毕业，此后不久便找到了工作。
条约签署后，和平得以恢复。
她搬到纽约，此后专注于写作事业。

definitions.definition: 因此，所以（表示因果逻辑）

en: The experiment failed; therefore, we need to revise the hypothesis.
He was late, therefore he missed the keynote speech.
The data shows a clear trend, therefore further analysis is justified.
cn: 实验失败了，因此我们需要修改假设。
他迟到了，所以错过了主题演讲。
数据显示明确趋势，因此进一步分析是合理的。

en: The thermal springs are popular for their healing properties.
Wear thermal underwear to stay warm in winter.
Eagles ride the thermals to soar high without flapping their wings.
cn: 这些温泉因其疗愈特性而备受青睐。
冬天穿保暖内衣以保持温暖。
鹰借助上升暖气流无需拍打翅膀即可高飞。

en: She is writing her master's thesis on renewable energy.
His thesis that art reflects society sparked a lively debate.
The professor asked us to defend our theses with solid evidence.
cn: 她正在撰写关于可再生能源的硕士论文。
他关于“艺术反映社会”的论点引发了激烈讨论。
教授要求我们用扎实的证据论证自己的命题。

definitions.definition: 大腿（人体部位，位于髋与膝之间）

en: He pulled a muscle in his thigh while running.
The arrow struck her thigh, just above the knee.
Thigh exercises are important for overall leg strength.
cn: 他在跑步时拉伤了大腿肌肉。
箭射中了她膝盖上方的大腿。
大腿锻炼对腿部整体力量至关重要。

en: The rose bush is covered with sharp thorns.
He pricked his finger on a hawthorn thorn.
In folklore, the thorn symbolizes both protection and pain.
cn: 玫瑰丛长满了尖刺。
他的手指被山楂刺扎伤了。
在民间传说中，荆棘既象征保护，也代表痛苦。

en: The storm clouds threaten to ruin our picnic.
He threatened to call the police if they didn't leave.
Rising sea levels threaten coastal cities worldwide.
cn: 乌云密布，可能要毁了我们的野餐。
他威胁说如果他们不离开就报警。
海平面上升威胁着全球沿海城市。

definitions.definition: （心理或生理的）临界点；起始点

en: She paused at the threshold, taking a deep breath before entering.
The noise reached a threshold where it became unbearable.
This discovery crosses the threshold into a new era of science.
cn: 她停在门槛处，深吸一口气才走进去。
噪音达到了令人难以忍受的临界点。
这一发现跨越了门槛，进入科学的新纪元。

en: The roller coaster gave her an adrenaline thrill.
His voice thrilled the audience with its raw emotion.
She felt a thrill of excitement when she saw her name on the list.
cn: 过山车带给她一阵肾上腺素的刺激。
他嗓音中原始的情感让听众为之震颤。
看到名单上的名字时，她感到一阵兴奋的颤栗。

en: Plants thrive in this fertile soil.
The tech industry continues to thrive despite economic challenges.
Children thrive when given encouragement.
cn: 植物在这片肥沃的土壤中茁壮成长。
尽管经济形势严峻，科技行业依然蓬勃发展。
孩子在鼓励中茁壮成长。

en: The king ascended the throne at the age of fifteen.
The ancient throne was carved from a single block of marble.
She was throned as the leader of the council.
cn: 国王十五岁时登基。
这座古老的王座由一整块大理石雕刻而成。
她被推举为议会领袖。

definitions.definition: 滴答声（钟表等发出的声音）；勾号（✓）；蜱虫

en: The clock ticked loudly in the silent room.
Please tick the box if you agree with the terms.
He found a tick on his dog’s fur after hiking.
cn: 寂静的房间里，时钟滴答作响。
若同意条款，请在方框内打勾。
徒步后，他在狗的毛发上发现了一只蜱虫。

en: The baby giggled when I tickled her feet.
Grass tickles my bare legs as I walk through the field.
His joke didn't just amuse me—it tickled me pink!
cn: 当我轻挠宝宝的脚时，她咯咯笑了。
走过草地时，草叶轻拂我的光腿，痒痒的。
他的笑话不仅逗乐了我，简直让我笑翻了！

en: The bathroom floor is covered with white ceramic tiles.
They hired a professional to tile the kitchen backsplash.
Ancient Roman roofs often used curved terracotta tiles.
cn: 浴室地面铺着白色陶瓷瓷砖。
他们雇了专业人士为厨房防溅墙贴瓷砖。
古罗马屋顶常使用弯曲的赤陶瓦片。

en: The tower tilted slightly during the earthquake.
She tilted her head to listen more carefully.
The debate tilted in favor of the new policy.
cn: 地震时塔楼微微倾斜。
她歪着头以便更仔细地听。
辩论倾向于支持新政策。

en: The timely intervention of the doctor saved the patient's life.
Her report provided timely insights into the market trends.
A timely rain ensured a good harvest this year.
cn: 医生的及时干预挽救了病人的生命。
她的报告为市场趋势提供了适时的洞察。
一场及时的雨确保了今年的丰收。

en: The timid kitten hid under the sofa when guests arrived.
His timid response revealed a lack of confidence in public speaking.
She gave a timid smile before stepping onto the stage.
cn: 客人到来时，那只胆怯的小猫躲到了沙发底下。
他怯懦的回答暴露出对公开演讲缺乏信心。
登上舞台前，她露出一个羞涩的微笑。

en: The doctor examined the muscle tissue under a microscope.
She handed me a tissue to wipe my tears.
The artist used tissue paper to create layered effects in the collage.
cn: 医生在显微镜下检查肌肉组织。
她递给我一张纸巾擦眼泪。
艺术家用薄纸在拼贴画中营造层次感。

en: She gave him a rose as a token of her affection.
The old coin was a token of their family history.
His apology seemed like a token gesture.
cn: 她送他一朵玫瑰作为爱意的象征。
这枚旧硬币是他们家族历史的纪念物。
他的道歉像是装装样子。

en: She is very tolerant of different opinions.
Some plants are more tolerant of drought than others.
His tolerant attitude made him popular among colleagues.
cn: 她对不同意见非常宽容。
某些植物比其他植物更耐旱。
他宽容的态度使他在同事中很受欢迎。

definitions.definition: （道路、桥梁的）通行费；代价；伤亡人数

en: The highway toll increased by 10% this year.
The church bell tolled solemnly at midnight.
The war took a heavy toll on civilians.
cn: 今年高速公路通行费上涨了10%。
午夜的教堂钟声庄严鸣响。
战争给平民造成了惨重伤亡。

en: She tossed the ball to her dog.
The boat tossed violently in the storm.
Let's toss a coin to decide who goes first.
cn: 她把球轻抛给她的狗。
小船在暴风雨中剧烈颠簸。
我们掷硬币决定谁先开始吧。

en: The truck towed the broken car to the garage.
A barge in tow moved slowly down the river.
Roadside assistance includes free towing within 10 miles.
cn: 卡车将故障车辆拖到了修理厂。
被拖曳的驳船缓缓沿河而下。
道路救援服务包含10英里内免费拖车。

definitions.definition: （人际关系或环境）恶毒的，充满敌意的

en: The factory was fined for dumping toxic waste into the river.
She left the job due to a toxic work environment.
Some plants become toxic when ingested by pets.
cn: 工厂因向河流倾倒有毒废物被罚款。
由于工作环境充满敌意，她离职了。
某些植物被宠物误食后会释放毒素。

definitions.definition: 大片土地；道；束（如神经或肌肉的纤维束）
短文；传单（尤指宗教或政治宣传）

en: The farmer owned a vast tract of land in the valley.
The optic tract carries visual information to the brain.
She distributed religious tracts at the train station.
cn: 农夫在山谷中拥有一大片土地。
视神经束将视觉信息传递到大脑。
她在火车站分发宗教宣传册。

definitions.definition: 商标（用于区分商品或服务的标志）

en: The company registered its logo as a trademark.
Her bright red hair became her trademark.
They trademarked the phrase to prevent imitation.
cn: 该公司将其标志注册为商标。
她鲜艳的红发成了她的标志性特征。
他们为这句标语注册商标以防止仿冒。

en: The play's tragic ending left the audience in tears.
It was tragic to see such potential wasted.
His life took a tragic turn after the accident.
cn: 这部戏剧的悲剧结局让观众潸然泪下。
看到如此潜力被浪费，真是可悲。
事故后，他的人生走向了悲惨的转折。

definitions.definition: 特征，特点（指人或事物的显著属性）

en: Her kindness is a defining trait of her personality.
The study focused on genetic traits passed through generations.
Attention to detail is a crucial trait for a surgeon.
cn: 她的善良是她性格的显著特征。
这项研究关注世代遗传的基因特征。
注重细节是外科医生的关键特质。

en: The bank charges a fee for each transaction.
Online transactions require secure payment methods.
The database ensures atomicity in every transaction.
cn: 银行对每笔交易收取手续费。
在线交易需要安全的支付方式。
该数据库确保每项事务处理的原子性。

definitions.definition: 超出普通经验或理解范围

en: Great art transcends cultural barriers.
His wisdom transcended mere book knowledge.
The mountain’s peak seems to transcend the clouds.
cn: 伟大艺术能超越文化隔阂。
他的智慧远超书本知识。
山峰之巅仿佛凌驾于云层之上。

en: She transferred the files to a new folder.
The player requested a transfer to another club.
The course credits are not transferable to other universities.
cn: 她将文件转移到了新文件夹。
这名球员要求转会到另一家俱乐部。
这些课程学分不能转到其他大学。

definitions.definition: 使完全改变（形态、性质或功能）

en: The caterpillar transforms into a butterfly.
Technology has transformed how we communicate.
The old factory was transformed into a modern art gallery.
cn: 毛毛虫会蜕变成蝴蝶。
科技彻底改变了我们的交流方式。
这座旧工厂被改造成了一座现代艺术画廊。

en: The beauty of cherry blossoms is transient, lasting only a few days.
The city has a large transient population due to its tourism industry.
Her feeling of sadness was transient, replaced by joy soon after.
cn: 樱花的美丽转瞬即逝，仅持续几天。
由于旅游业，这座城市有大量短期停留的人口。
她的悲伤是短暂的，很快被快乐取代。
