definitions.definition: 晶体管（一种半导体器件，用于放大或切换电子信号）

en: The invention of the transistor revolutionized modern electronics.
This amplifier uses silicon transistors for better performance.
Early computers relied on vacuum tubes before transistors were developed.
cn: 晶体管的发明彻底改变了现代电子技术。
该放大器使用硅晶体管以获得更佳性能。
在晶体管发明前，早期计算机依赖真空管运作。

en: The goods are in transit from the warehouse to the store.
Venus will transit the sun next month.
The city improved its public transit system.
cn: 货物正从仓库运输到商店。
金星将于下个月凌日。
该市改进了公共交通系统。

en: The transition from childhood to adulthood can be challenging.
The company is transitioning to renewable energy sources.
Spring is a season of transition between winter and summer.
cn: 从童年到成年的过渡可能充满挑战。
这家公司正在向可再生能源转型。
春天是冬季和夏季之间的过渡季节。

definitions.definition: 传输（如能量、信号、疾病等）

en: The transmission of data through fiber optics is extremely fast.
The car's automatic transmission makes driving smoother.
Mosquitoes are vectors for the transmission of malaria.
cn: 通过光纤传输数据速度极快。
这辆车的自动变速器让驾驶更顺畅。
蚊子是疟疾传播的媒介。

definitions.definition: 传输（信号、信息等）；传送（热量、疾病等）

en: Fiber optics can transmit data at the speed of light.
Mosquitoes are known to transmit diseases like malaria.
The radio station will transmit the concert live tonight.
cn: 光纤能以光速传输数据。
蚊子以传播疟疾等疾病而闻名。
电台将于今晚直播这场音乐会。

definitions.definition: 移植（器官、植物等）；使迁移
移植的器官/组织；移植物；迁移者

en: The surgeon will transplant a healthy kidney to the patient.
These seedlings were transplanted from the nursery to the field.
Cultural transplant sometimes leads to unexpected conflicts.
cn: 外科医生将为患者移植一颗健康的肾脏。
这些幼苗从苗圃移栽到了田间。
文化移植有时会引发意想不到的冲突。

en: The goods will be transported by train.
Public transport is essential in urban areas.
The virus can be transported through water.
cn: 货物将通过火车运输。
公共交通在城市中至关重要。
病毒可能通过水源传播。

en: The hikers traversed the dense forest in two days.
The bridge traverses the river, connecting the two villages.
His research traverses multiple disciplines.
cn: 徒步者用两天时间穿越了茂密的森林。
这座桥横跨河流，连接了两个村庄。
他的研究横跨多个学科。

en: The two nations signed a peace treaty after years of conflict.
The treaty aims to reduce carbon emissions globally.
Medieval treaties often involved complex diplomatic rituals.
cn: 两国在多年冲突后签署了和平条约。
该条约旨在全球范围内减少碳排放。
中世纪的条约常涉及复杂的外交仪式。

definitions.definition: 巨大的，极大的（指规模或程度）
极好的，惊人的（口语化褒义）

en: The earthquake caused tremendous damage to the city.
She has a tremendous talent for music.
We had a tremendous time at the concert last night.
cn: 地震对城市造成了巨大的破坏。
她在音乐方面有惊人的天赋。
昨晚我们在音乐会上玩得极其尽兴。

en: The soldiers dug a trench to protect themselves from enemy fire.
The river trenched a deep valley through the mountains.
The new policy may trench on individual freedoms.
cn: 士兵们挖了一条战壕以躲避敌方火力。
河流在山间切割出一道深邃的峡谷。
新政策可能侵犯个人自由。

en: The trend towards remote work is accelerating globally.
Her designs always follow the latest fashion trends.
Interest rates are trending downward this quarter.
cn: 全球远程办公的趋势正在加速。
她的设计总是紧跟最新时尚潮流。
本季度利率呈下降趋势。

en: The new drug is undergoing clinical trials.
He faced trial for theft last year.
The trial version of the software has limited features.
cn: 这种新药正在进行临床试验。
他去年因盗窃罪受审。
该软件的试用版功能有限。

en: The Maasai tribe is known for its distinctive customs and red clothing.
Biologists classify lions and tigers under the same feline tribe.
She felt a strong connection to her tribe during the cultural festival.
cn: 马赛部落以其独特的习俗和红色服饰闻名。
生物学家将狮子和老虎归为同一猫科族。
在文化节期间，她感受到与族群的强烈联结。

definitions.definition: 贡品；礼物（尤指表示敬意或感谢）

en: The conquered nations paid tribute to the emperor annually.
Her speech was a touching tribute to her mentor.
The film ends with a tribute to the firefighters.
cn: 被征服的国家每年向皇帝进贡。
她的演讲是对导师的感人致敬。
影片以对消防员的致敬结尾。

definitions.definition: 琐事；少量；甜点（一种英式蛋糕）

en: Don’t waste time on such trifles.
She trifled with her food, barely eating a bite.
The dessert menu featured a classic English trifle.
cn: 别把时间浪费在这种琐事上。
她拨弄着食物，几乎一口没吃。
甜点菜单上有一道经典的英式水果蛋糕。

definitions.definition: 扳机；触发器；引发事件的原因

en: The sound of fireworks can trigger anxiety in some war veterans.
The new policy acted as a trigger for economic reform.
He carefully pulled the trigger of the antique pistol.
cn: 烟花声可能触发部分退伍军人的焦虑。
新政策成为经济改革的触发器。
他小心扣动了那把古董手枪的扳机。

en: The company aims to triple its profits by 2025.
She ordered a triple espresso to stay awake.
In baseball, a triple is a hit that allows the batter to reach third base.
cn: 该公司计划到2025年将利润增长至三倍。
她点了一杯三份浓缩咖啡来提神。
在棒球中，“三垒打”是击球员能跑至三垒的安打。

en: The team's triumph was celebrated by fans worldwide.
Good will always triumph over evil in the end.
Her face lit up with triumph as she crossed the finish line.
cn: 球队的胜利赢得了全球粉丝的庆祝。
善良终将战胜邪恶。
她冲过终点线时，脸上洋溢着胜利的喜悦。

en: Don’t waste time on trivial details.
The book covers both profound theories and trivial facts.
She dismissed his complaint as trivial.
cn: 别把时间浪费在琐碎的细节上。
这本书既涵盖深奥的理论，也涉及平凡的事实。
她认为他的抱怨无关紧要，不予理会。

en: She soaked her feet in a plastic tub of warm water.
The old fisherman rowed his tub across the lake.
The baby splashed happily in the tub during bath time.
cn: 她将双脚浸泡在装满温水的塑料盆中。
老渔夫划着他那艘笨拙的小船穿过湖泊。
洗澡时，婴儿在浴缸里开心地拍水嬉戏。

definitions.definition: （衣服的）褶；食物（尤指糖果或蛋糕）

en: She tucked the letter under her pillow.
The dress has elegant tucks at the waist.
He bought a bag of tuck for the school trip.
cn: 她把信塞到了枕头下面。
这条裙子的腰部有精致的褶裥。
他为学校郊游买了一袋糖果。

en: The child tugged at her sleeve to get attention.
The tugboat guided the ship into the harbor.
A tug of war broke out between the two departments.
cn: 孩子拽了拽她的袖子以引起注意。
拖船将轮船引入港口。
两个部门之间爆发了一场争夺战。

en: The university raised tuition fees by 5% this year.
Private tuition helped her improve her math skills.
Tuition includes access to all campus facilities.
cn: 这所大学今年学费上涨了5%。
私人辅导帮助她提升了数学能力。
学费包含使用所有校园设施的费用。

en: The child tripped and tumbled down the hill.
Stock prices tumbled after the news broke.
She tumbled the clothes into the washing machine.
cn: 孩子绊了一跤，滚下了山坡。
消息传出后，股价暴跌。
她把衣服胡乱塞进洗衣机。

en: The train sped through the mountain tunnel.
Workers tunneled under the river to lay cables.
The rabbit escaped into a narrow tunnel.
cn: 火车飞速穿过山体隧道。
工人们在河底挖掘隧道铺设电缆。
兔子钻进了狭窄的地道。

definitions.definition: 动荡的，混乱的（形容局势、气流等）
狂暴的，汹涌的（形容液体或气体运动）

en: The plane encountered turbulent air over the mountains.
His turbulent emotions made it hard to think clearly.
The 1960s were a turbulent period in American history.
cn: 飞机在山区遭遇了湍流。
他混乱的情绪让人难以清醒思考。
20世纪60年代是美国历史上动荡的时期。

en: The company's annual turnover reached $5 million.
High employee turnover affects team stability.
She baked an apple turnover for dessert.
cn: 该公司年营业额达到500万美元。
高人员流动率影响团队稳定性。
她烤了一个苹果馅饼作为甜点。

en: She works as a private tutor for high school students.
He tutored me in math during the summer break.
The university offers free tutor sessions for freshmen.
cn: 她是一名为高中生服务的私人教师。
他在暑假期间辅导我数学。
这所大学为新生提供免费辅导课程。

definitions.definition: 扭转；螺旋状；意想不到的转折

en: She twisted the scarf around her neck.
The movie’s plot had an unexpected twist.
Don’t twist my words—I meant the opposite!
cn: 她把围巾绕在脖子上。
这部电影的情节出现了意想不到的转折。
别曲解我的话，我的意思完全相反！

definitions.definition: 终极；极限；最好（或最伟大）的事物

en: The ultimate goal of this project is to achieve zero carbon emissions.
This diamond represents the ultimate in luxury.
He pushed himself to the ultimate limits of endurance.
cn: 该项目的最终目标是实现零碳排放。
这颗钻石是奢侈品的极致代表。
他将自己的耐力推向了极限。

definitions.definition: 紫外线的（指波长比可见光短的电磁辐射）

en: Ultraviolet rays can cause skin damage.
Bees can see ultraviolet light invisible to humans.
The lab uses ultraviolet lamps to sterilize equipment.
cn: 紫外线可能导致皮肤损伤。
蜜蜂能看见人类不可见的紫外光。
实验室用紫外线灯消毒设备。

en: The jury reached a unanimous verdict after hours of deliberation.
The proposal was passed with unanimous approval.
Despite their differences, the team was unanimous in supporting the new strategy.
cn: 陪审团经过数小时商议后达成一致裁决。
该提案获得全票通过。
尽管存在分歧，团队一致支持新策略。

en: Never underestimate the power of teamwork.
The project failed because they underestimated the costs.
His calm appearance made others underestimate his determination.
cn: 切勿低估团队合作的力量。
项目失败是因为他们低估了成本。
他平静的外表让人低估了他的决心。

en: The company will undergo major restructuring next year.
Patients must undergo a series of tests before the treatment.
The bridge has undergone significant wear and tear over decades.
cn: 该公司明年将经历重大重组。
患者在接受治疗前必须进行一系列检查。
这座桥历经数十年已严重磨损。

en: The underlying problem is lack of communication.
She studied the underlying principles of quantum mechanics.
The contract reveals underlying risks in the investment.
cn: 根本问题在于缺乏沟通。
她研究了量子力学的基本原理。
合同揭示了投资中的潜在风险。

en: Constant criticism can undermine a person's confidence.
The river undermined the foundations of the old bridge.
Fake news is designed to undermine public trust in institutions.
cn: 持续的批评会削弱一个人的自信心。
河水侵蚀了老桥的地基。
假新闻旨在破坏公众对机构的信任。

en: Long-term unemployment can lead to severe financial hardship.
The government released new data on regional unemployment rates.
She volunteers at a charity helping youth overcome unemployment.
cn: 长期失业可能导致严重的经济困难。
政府发布了关于地区失业率的新数据。
她在一家帮助青年克服失业问题的慈善机构做志愿者。

en: She carefully unfolded the ancient map.
The story unfolds through a series of flashbacks.
As the meeting progressed, his plan began to unfold.
cn: 她小心翼翼地展开那张古老的地图。
故事通过一系列倒叙逐渐展开。
随着会议进行，他的计划逐渐显露。

en: The speech emphasized the importance of national unity.
The design achieves a perfect unity of form and function.
In algebra, the number 1 is the unity for multiplication.
cn: 演讲强调了国家统一的重要性。
该设计实现了形式与功能的完美统一。
在代数中，数字1是乘法的单位元。

en: Each snowflake is unique in its pattern.
Her perspective on the issue was truly unique.
The museum houses a unique collection of ancient artifacts.
cn: 每一片雪花的图案都是独一无二的。
她对这一问题的看法确实独树一帜。
该博物馆藏有一批独一无二的古代文物。

en: The telescope revealed new galaxies in the universe.
His research spans the universe of quantum physics.
Ancient myths often explain the origin of the universe.
cn: 望远镜揭示了宇宙中的新星系。
他的研究涵盖量子物理学的整个领域。
古代神话常解释宇宙的起源。

en: The app will automatically update to the latest version.
She gave me a quick update on the project progress.
The database needs to be updated weekly for accuracy.
cn: 该应用将自动更新至最新版本。
她向我简要更新了项目进展。
为确保准确性，数据库需每周更新。

en: The company plans to upgrade its software next month.
She received an upgrade to business class on her flight.
Regular skills upgrades are essential in this industry.
cn: 公司计划下个月升级其软件。
她的航班座位被升到了商务舱。
在这个行业中，定期技能提升至关重要。

en: The court upheld the original decision.
We must uphold the values of fairness and justice.
His family's support upheld him during difficult times.
cn: 法院维持了原判。
我们必须维护公平与正义的价值观。
家人的支持让他在困境中坚持下去。

en: The old oak tree stood upright despite the strong winds.
She is known for her upright character and honesty.
Adjust the monitor to an upright position for better ergonomics.
cn: 那棵老橡树在狂风中依然挺立。
她以正直的品格和诚实著称。
将显示器调整至垂直位置以获得更佳的人体工学效果。

en: She prefers urban life to rural solitude.
Urban development must consider sustainability.
The mural reflects vibrant urban culture.
cn: 相较于乡村的独居，她更偏爱都市生活。
城市发展必须考虑可持续性。
这幅壁画展现了充满活力的都市文化。

en: She urged him to reconsider his decision.
I felt an irresistible urge to laugh during the serious meeting.
The government is urging citizens to conserve water during the drought.
cn: 她敦促他重新考虑决定。
在那场严肃的会议中，我突然有种抑制不住想笑的冲动。
政府正呼吁市民在干旱期间节约用水。

definitions.definition: 利用，使用（尤指有效或实用地）

en: The team found a way to utilize solar energy more efficiently.
Many apps utilize AI to personalize user experiences.
We must utilize every opportunity to reduce waste.
cn: 团队找到了更高效利用太阳能的方法。
许多应用利用人工智能为用户提供个性化体验。
我们必须利用一切机会减少浪费。

en: She pushed herself to the utmost to finish the marathon.
This matter is of the utmost importance.
The hikers reached the utmost edge of the cliff.
cn: 她竭尽全力完成了马拉松。
这件事至关重要。
徒步者抵达了悬崖的最边缘。

definitions.definition: 空着的，未被占用的（如房间、座位）
（表情或眼神）茫然的，无思想的

en: The hotel has several vacant rooms this weekend.
Her vacant expression suggested she wasn’t listening.
The position has been vacant for three months.
cn: 本周末这家酒店有几间空房。
她茫然的表情表明她没在听。
该职位已空缺三个月。

en: He made a vain attempt to fix the broken engine.
She was too vain to wear glasses in public.
Their promises proved vain when no changes occurred.
cn: 他徒劳地尝试修理坏掉的发动机。
她太虚荣，不愿在公共场合戴眼镜。
当毫无变化时，他们的承诺被证明是空谈。

definitions.definition: 有效的；具有法律效力的

en: The contract is valid for three years.
Her argument was based on valid evidence.
A passport must be valid to travel internationally.
cn: 这份合同有效期为三年。
她的论点基于可靠的证据。
护照必须在有效期内才能用于国际旅行。

definitions.definition: 阀门；瓣膜；（管乐器的）活塞

en: The plumber replaced the faulty valve to stop the water leak.
The heart's mitral valve ensures blood flows in one direction.
He adjusted the valve on his trumpet to change the pitch.
cn: 水管工更换了故障阀门以阻止漏水。
心脏的二尖瓣确保血液单向流动。
他调节了小号上的活塞以改变音高。

en: The delivery van was parked outside the supermarket.
He is considered a van of modern art movements.
The luggage van is at the end of the train.
cn: 送货的厢式货车停在超市外。
他被视为现代艺术运动的先驱。
行李车厢位于列车末端。

en: The genetic variation among individuals is crucial for species survival.
This melody has a beautiful variation in the second movement.
Seasonal variations in temperature affect crop growth.
cn: 个体间的遗传变异对物种生存至关重要。
这段旋律在第二乐章有一个优美的变奏。
温度的季节性变化影响作物生长。

en: The store offers various sizes and colors of T-shirts.
She cited various reasons for her decision.
Various artists will perform at the festival.
cn: 这家商店提供多种尺寸和颜色的T恤。
她为自己的决定列举了多方面的理由。
多位艺术家将在音乐节上表演。

en: Prices vary depending on the season.
She varies her teaching methods to engage students.
The landscape varies from rolling hills to steep cliffs.
cn: 价格随季节变化。
她变换教学方法以吸引学生。
地貌从起伏的丘陵到陡峭的悬崖各不相同。

en: The vast desert stretched endlessly under the scorching sun.
She inherited a vast fortune from her grandfather.
The internet provides vast opportunities for learning.
cn: 灼热的阳光下，广阔的沙漠无边无际地延伸。
她从祖父那里继承了一笔巨额财富。
互联网为学习提供了海量机会。

definitions.definition: 植被（指某一地区的植物总体）
（因缺乏活动而导致的）呆板生活状态

en: The dense vegetation of the rainforest shelters countless species.
After retirement, he sank into a state of mental vegetation.
Satellite images show changes in vegetation patterns due to climate shifts.
cn: 热带雨林的茂密植被庇护着无数物种。
退休后，他陷入了精神呆滞的状态。
卫星图像显示气候变化导致的植被分布变化。

definitions.definition: 交通工具（如汽车、飞机等）
传播媒介；载体（如艺术、思想的表达手段）

en: Electric vehicles are becoming more popular worldwide.
Language is a vehicle for cultural exchange.
The rocket was the vehicle that carried the satellite into orbit.
cn: 电动汽车在全球越来越普及。
语言是文化交流的媒介。
这枚火箭是将卫星送入轨道的运载工具。

en: She wore a delicate lace veil on her wedding day.
The mountains were veiled in mist at dawn.
His polite words veiled a sharp criticism.
cn: 婚礼当天，她戴着一顶精致的蕾丝面纱。
黎明时分，群山被薄雾笼罩。
他礼貌的言辞掩饰了尖锐的批评。

definitions.definition: 风格、气质（比喻义，如 "a vein of humor"）

en: The nurse drew blood from a vein in his arm.
Maple leaves have prominent veins.
The novel has a dark vein of satire.
cn: 护士从他手臂的静脉中抽取血液。
枫叶的叶脉清晰可见。
这部小说带有一种犀利的讽刺风格。

definitions.definition: 速度（物理量，描述物体运动的快慢和方向）

en: The rocket reached a velocity of 25,000 miles per hour.
She typed with astonishing velocity, finishing the report in minutes.
In fluid dynamics, velocity is a vector quantity.
cn: 火箭达到了每小时25,000英里的速度。
她以惊人的速度打字，几分钟内完成了报告。
在流体动力学中，速度是一个矢量。

en: She wore a dress made of deep blue velvet.
The kitten's paws felt like velvet.
Velvet curtains blocked out the sunlight.
cn: 她穿了一条深蓝色天鹅绒连衣裙。
小猫的爪子摸起来像天鹅绒一样柔软。
天鹅绒窗帘挡住了阳光。

definitions.definition: 通风口；出口；（情感的）发泄

en: The room has a small vent near the ceiling.
She vented her anger by writing a letter.
Volcanic vents release gases into the atmosphere.
cn: 房间天花板附近有一个小通风口。
她通过写信来发泄愤怒。
火山口将气体排放到大气中。

definitions.definition: 公开表达，公开讨论（问题或意见）

en: It is important to ventilate the kitchen to remove cooking odors.
The meeting was a good opportunity to ventilate our grievances.
The lungs ventilate blood by removing carbon dioxide and adding oxygen.
cn: 给厨房通风以去除烹饪气味很重要。
这次会议是公开表达我们不满的好机会。
肺部通过排出二氧化碳和吸入氧气来使血液通风换气。

en: They embarked on a daring venture into the Amazon rainforest.
He decided to venture his savings in the startup.
Few people ventured to criticize the new policy openly.
cn: 他们开始了深入亚马逊雨林的大胆冒险。
他决定将积蓄投入这家初创企业。
几乎没人敢公开批评这项新政策。

en: She gave a verbal agreement to the proposal.
The test includes both written and verbal sections.
"Run" is a verbal action in this sentence.
cn: 她口头同意了这项提议。
测试包含书面和口语部分。
在这个句子中，“跑”是一个动词动作。

en: The jury reached a unanimous verdict of "not guilty".
Her book offers a bold verdict on modern education.
The judge will deliver the final verdict tomorrow.
cn: 陪审团一致作出了“无罪”裁决。
她的书对现代教育提出了大胆的论断。
法官将于明日宣布最终判决。

definitions.definition: 濒临；接近（常与 on 连用）

en: The country is on the verge of economic collapse.
Her artistic style verges on surrealism.
A narrow path ran along the verge of the cliff.
cn: 该国濒临经济崩溃的边缘。
她的艺术风格接近超现实主义。
一条狭窄的小路沿着悬崖边缘延伸。

definitions.definition: 核对（数据、陈述等的真实性）

en: The lab will verify the authenticity of the ancient manuscript.
Please verify your email address by clicking the link.
Astronomers used multiple telescopes to verify the new planet's existence.
cn: 实验室将验证这份古代手稿的真伪。
请点击链接以验证您的邮箱地址。
天文学家通过多台望远镜验证了这颗新行星的存在。

en: She is a versatile artist who paints, sings, and writes poetry.
This tool is versatile enough for both drilling and sanding.
His versatile mind allowed him to adapt quickly to new challenges.
cn: 她是一位多才多艺的艺术家，擅长绘画、唱歌和写诗。
这种工具功能多样，既能钻孔又能打磨。
他思维灵活，能迅速适应新挑战。

en: She quoted a verse from Shakespeare.
The song has a catchy verse and chorus.
He versed himself in ancient philosophy.
cn: 她引用了莎士比亚的一节诗。
这首歌的副歌和主歌都很朗朗上口。
他潜心钻研古代哲学。

definitions.definition: 版本（同一事物的不同形式或变体）
说法，描述（对事件的不同解释）

en: The software's latest version includes bug fixes.
She gave her version of the incident to the police.
The director's cut is a darker version of the film.
cn: 该软件的最新版本修复了漏洞。
她向警方陈述了自己对事件的描述。
导演剪辑版是这部电影的更黑暗版本。

en: The final match was Brazil versus Argentina.
The debate centered on economic growth versus environmental protection.
In the case of Smith versus Jones, the court ruled in favor of the plaintiff.
cn: 决赛是巴西队对阿根廷队。
辩论围绕经济增长与环境保护的对立展开。
在史密斯诉琼斯案中，法庭判决原告胜诉。

en: The cliff rose in a vertical wall from the sea.
Draw a vertical line to divide the page in half.
The drone ascended vertically into the sky.
cn: 悬崖从海面拔地而起，形成一道垂直的峭壁。
画一条垂直线将页面分成两半。
无人机垂直升入空中。

en: The president exercised his veto to block the bill.
The committee vetoed the proposal due to budget concerns.
Her parents vetoed the idea of a late-night party.
cn: 总统行使否决权阻止该法案通过。
委员会因预算问题否决了该提案。
她的父母否决了深夜派对的提议。

en: Greed is a vice that can destroy relationships.
She was promoted to vice president of the company.
The sculpture’s only vice is a small crack at the base.
cn: 贪婪是一种可能摧毁人际关系的恶习。
她晋升为公司副总裁。
这座雕塑唯一的瑕疵是底部有一道小裂缝。

en: There are several good schools in the vicinity.
The noise alarmed everyone in the vicinity.
His theories are in the vicinity of modern physics.
cn: 附近有几所好学校。
噪音惊动了附近的每个人。
他的理论接近现代物理学范畴。

en: The vicious rumors destroyed her reputation.
He suffered from a vicious headache after the accident.
The farmer warned us about the vicious dog guarding the barn.
cn: 恶毒的谣言毁了她的声誉。
事故后他头痛剧烈。
农夫警告我们谷仓旁有只凶猛的狗。

en: The charity provides support for victims of domestic violence.
He fell victim to an online scam and lost his savings.
In ancient times, a lamb was often chosen as the ritual victim.
cn: 该慈善机构为家庭暴力受害者提供支持。
他成为网络诈骗的受害者，失去了积蓄。
古时，羔羊常被选作仪式祭品。

en: The vigorous young athlete completed the marathon with ease.
After the rain, the garden became a vigorous jungle of greenery.
Her vigorous defense of human rights inspired many.
cn: 这位精力充沛的年轻运动员轻松跑完了马拉松。
雨后，花园变成了茂盛的绿色丛林。
她对人权强有力的捍卫激励了许多人。

en: The company was fined for violating environmental regulations.
Hacking into someone's email violates their privacy.
The soldiers were accused of violating the ancient temple.
cn: 该公司因违反环保法规被罚款。
入侵他人邮箱侵犯了其隐私权。
士兵们被指控亵渎了这座古庙。

en: The violent storm destroyed several houses.
He has a violent temper when provoked.
The movie contains violent scenes unsuitable for children.
cn: 猛烈的风暴摧毁了几栋房屋。
他被激怒时会脾气暴躁。
这部电影含有不适合儿童的暴力场景。

definitions.definition: 纯洁的；未使用的；初次的

en: She remained a virgin until marriage.
The virgin forest was untouched by humans.
This is the virgin voyage of the spaceship.
cn: 她婚前一直保持贞洁。
这片原始森林未被人类涉足。
这是该太空船的首次航行。

definitions.definition: 虚拟的（通过计算机技术模拟的）
实质上的，事实上的（虽未正式命名但功能相同）

en: The game creates a virtual world where players can interact.
She is the virtual leader of the team, though not officially appointed.
Virtual meetings have become essential for remote work.
cn: 这款游戏创造了一个玩家可互动的虚拟世界。
她是团队实质上的领导者，尽管未被正式任命。
虚拟会议已成为远程工作的必备工具。

en: Patience is a virtue that leads to inner peace.
The virtue of this material is its durability.
She was praised for her virtue and integrity.
cn: 耐心是通向内心平静的美德。
这种材料的优点是耐用性。
她因贞洁与正直受到赞扬。

en: She applied for a student visa to study abroad.
The embassy took two weeks to process his visa.
Your passport must be valid for at least six months to get a visa.
cn: 她申请了学生签证以出国留学。
大使馆花了两周时间处理他的签证。
你的护照有效期必须至少六个月才能获得签证。

en: Her vision deteriorated after years of working in dim light.
The leader shared a bold vision for the company's future.
The mystic claimed to have visions of ancient spirits.
cn: 多年在昏暗光线下工作后，她的视力下降了。
这位领导者分享了对公司未来的大胆展望。
那位神秘主义者自称能看到古代灵魂的幻象。

en: The software helps users visualize complex data in 3D graphs.
She closed her eyes to visualize the perfect sunset.
Athletes often visualize success before competitions.
cn: 该软件帮助用户以三维图表形式可视化复杂数据。
她闭上眼睛想象完美的日落景象。
运动员常在赛前通过想象预演成功场景。

definitions.definition: 至关重要的；维持生命所必需的

en: Water is vital for all living organisms.
She played a vital role in the project's success.
His vital energy impressed everyone at the meeting.
cn: 水对所有生物都至关重要。
她在项目成功中发挥了关键作用。
他旺盛的精力给与会者留下了深刻印象。

en: She gave a vivid description of her journey through the rainforest.
The artist used vivid colors to capture the sunset.
My childhood memories are still vivid in my mind.
cn: 她生动地描述了穿越雨林的旅程。
艺术家用鲜艳的色彩捕捉日落。
童年的记忆在我脑海中依然鲜活。

definitions.definition: 声音的；发声的；直言不讳的

en: She has a powerful vocal range.
The committee needs more vocal members to advocate for change.
The song features minimal instrumentation, highlighting the vocal track.
cn: 她的音域宽广有力。
委员会需要更多直言不讳的成员来推动变革。
这首歌编曲极简，突出人声部分。

en: She enrolled in a vocational school to study nursing.
Vocational training is essential for skilled labor.
His vocational interests leaned toward engineering.
cn: 她进入职业学校学习护理。
职业培训对技术劳动力至关重要。
他的职业兴趣偏向工程领域。

en: The contract was declared void due to fraud.
She stared into the void of the night sky.
The machine voids all air from the chamber.
cn: 因欺诈行为，该合同被宣告无效。
她凝视着夜空的虚无。
这台机器将腔室内的空气全部抽空。

en: The volume of this box is 2 cubic meters.
Please turn down the volume of the TV.
She published a new volume of poetry last year.
cn: 这个箱子的体积是2立方米。
请调低电视的音量。
她去年出版了一卷新诗集。

definitions.definition: （生理活动）随意的（与“不随意”相对）

en: She made a voluntary decision to donate her salary to charity.
Breathing is usually involuntary, but can become voluntary under conscious control.
The choir performed a beautiful voluntary during the wedding ceremony.
cn: 她自愿决定将工资捐给慈善机构。
呼吸通常是非自主的，但在意识控制下可变为随意行为。
合唱团在婚礼上演奏了一首优美的自愿奉献曲。

en: She works as a volunteer at the local animal shelter.
He volunteered to organize the charity event.
Many students volunteer during summer vacations.
cn: 她在当地动物收容所做志愿者。
他主动提出组织这次慈善活动。
许多学生在暑假期间自愿服务。

definitions.definition: 通俗的，大众化的（古义或中性用法）

en: His vulgar jokes made everyone uncomfortable.
The vulgar language in the film was criticized by parents.
"Vulgar Latin" refers to the colloquial speech of ancient Romans.
cn: 他的粗俗笑话让所有人感到不适。
电影中的粗俗语言受到了家长的批评。
“通俗拉丁语”指古罗马人的日常口语。

en: The turtle's soft shell makes it vulnerable to predators.
She felt vulnerable after sharing her personal story.
Older systems are vulnerable to cyberattacks.
cn: 海龟柔软的壳使其易受捕食者攻击。
分享个人经历后，她感到情感上脆弱。
旧系统容易受到网络攻击。

en: He pulled a business card from his leather wallet.
Cryptocurrency wallets store private keys securely.
She lost her wallet on the subway yesterday.
cn: 他从皮夹里抽出一张名片。
加密货币钱包用于安全存储私钥。
她昨天在地铁上丢了钱包。

definitions.definition: 病房；监房；选区；受监护人

en: The patient was moved to the isolation ward.
She was appointed legal ward of her orphaned nephew.
He raised his arm to ward off the blow.
cn: 病人被转移到了隔离病房。
她被指定为孤侄的法定监护人。
他抬起手臂挡开这一击。

definitions.definition: （剧院或影视剧的）戏装保管室；全部戏装

en: She hung her dress in the oak wardrobe.
The film's wardrobe team won an Oscar for costume design.
His wardrobe consists mostly of black and white clothes.
cn: 她把连衣裙挂进了橡木衣柜里。
这部电影的服装团队获得了奥斯卡最佳服装设计奖。
他的衣橱里大多是黑白两色的衣服。

en: The company rented a large warehouse to store its inventory.
Agricultural products are often warehoused before distribution.
The old warehouse was converted into trendy loft apartments.
cn: 该公司租用了一个大型仓库来存放库存。
农产品在分销前常被存入仓库。
这座旧仓库被改造成了时尚的阁楼公寓。

en: Modern warfare relies heavily on technology and intelligence.
The company engaged in price warfare with its competitors.
Biological warfare is prohibited under international law.
cn: 现代战争高度依赖科技与情报。
该公司与竞争对手展开了价格战。
国际法禁止生物武器战争。

en: The judge issued a search warrant for the suspect's apartment.
His actions were serious enough to warrant an investigation.
There's no warrant for such rude behavior.
cn: 法官签发了对嫌疑人公寓的搜查令。
他的行为严重到需要启动调查。
这种粗鲁行为毫无正当理由。

definitions.definition: （论点、计划等）严密的，无懈可击的

en: The electronic components are housed in a watertight compartment.
The contract was watertight, leaving no room for legal challenges.
Ensure the lid is watertight to prevent any leaks during transport.
cn: 电子元件被安置在一个防水的隔间里。
这份合同非常严密，没有留下任何法律挑战的空间。
确保盖子是不透水的，以防止运输过程中发生任何泄漏。

definitions.definition: 瓦特（国际单位制中的功率单位，符号为 W）

en: A typical LED bulb consumes about 10 watts of power.
The solar panel generates 200 watts under full sunlight.
His invention increased the engine's efficiency by 20 watts per hour.
cn: 一颗普通LED灯泡的功耗约为10瓦。
这块太阳能电池板在阳光充足时可产生200瓦电力。
他的发明将发动机效率每小时提高了20瓦。

en: She used beeswax to polish the wooden table.
The moon waxes to its full size in about two weeks.
His confidence began to wax as he gained experience.
cn: 她用蜂蜡给木桌抛光。
月亮约两周内渐盈至满月。
随着经验积累，他的信心逐渐增强。

en: His wealth comes from decades of wise investments.
The library offers a wealth of historical documents.
True wealth includes health and happiness.
cn: 他的财富源于数十年的明智投资。
这座图书馆提供大量历史文献。
真正的财富包含健康与快乐。

en: She grew up in a wealthy family but chose a simple lifestyle.
The region is wealthy in natural resources.
His wealthy vocabulary impressed the audience.
cn: 她出身富裕家庭，却选择了朴素的生活方式。
该地区自然资源丰富。
他丰富的词汇量令听众印象深刻。

en: The soldier cleaned his weapon carefully.
Words can be a powerful weapon in debates.
The treaty banned biological weapons.
cn: 士兵仔细擦拭他的武器。
语言在辩论中能成为强大的武器。
该条约禁止生物武器。

en: She gave a weary sigh after the long meeting.
His eyes grew weary from staring at the screen.
The endless paperwork wearied the entire team.
cn: 漫长会议后，她疲惫地叹了口气。
他的双眼因长时间盯着屏幕而变得疲倦。
没完没了的文书工作让整个团队感到厌烦。

definitions.definition: 网状物；蜘蛛网；错综复杂的事物
用网覆盖；使陷入错综复杂的局面

en: The spider spun a delicate web between the branches.
He was trapped in a web of lies.
Tim Berners-Lee invented the World Wide Web in 1989.
cn: 蜘蛛在树枝间织了一张精致的网。
他陷入谎言的罗网。
蒂姆·伯纳斯-李于1989年发明了万维网。

definitions.definition: 楔子；楔形物；导致分裂的事物

en: He used a wooden wedge to keep the door open.
The new policy drove a wedge between the two communities.
She wedged her foot in the crack to stop the box from sliding.
cn: 他用木楔卡住门，让它保持敞开。
新政策在两个社群间制造了分裂。
她把脚挤进缝隙，防止箱子滑动。

en: The old house had a weird atmosphere.
She always wears weird clothes to stand out.
It's weird how cats always land on their feet.
cn: 这座老房子有种诡异的气氛。
她总穿奇装异服来引人注目。
猫总能四脚着地，这很不可思议。

definitions.definition: 鉴于；然而（用于对比或引出相反情况）

en: The first experiment succeeded, whereas the second failed.
Whereas the policy benefits urban areas, rural regions remain neglected.
He prefers tea, whereas his brother drinks only coffee.
cn: 首次实验成功了，然而第二次却失败了。
尽管该政策惠及城市地区，农村仍被忽视。
他喜欢喝茶，而他弟弟只喝咖啡。

definitions.definition: 凭借；由此（正式用语，表示方式或条件）

en: The contract includes a clause whereby both parties agree to arbitration.
He devised a system whereby students could learn at their own pace.
Whereby shall we know the truth?
cn: 合同包含一项条款，双方由此同意仲裁。
他设计了一套系统，学生可由此按自己的节奏学习。
我们由此何以知晓真相？（古语残留，现代罕见）

en: The leaves began to whirl in the autumn wind.
Her mind was in a whirl after the shocking news.
The dancer whirled across the stage effortlessly.
cn: 落叶开始在秋风中旋转。
那个令人震惊的消息让她思绪纷乱。
舞者轻松地旋转着穿过舞台。

en: She decided to withdraw her application.
The army had to withdraw from the battlefield.
You can withdraw cash at any ATM.
cn: 她决定撤回申请。
军队不得不从战场撤退。
你可以在任何ATM机上取现。

en: The company may withhold taxes from your paycheck.
She couldn't withhold her laughter during the serious meeting.
The government has the right to withhold sensitive information.
cn: 公司可能会从你的薪水中扣税。
她在严肃的会议上忍不住笑了出来。
政府有权保留敏感信息。

en: She was the only witness to the accident.
Thousands witnessed the historic event.
His smile witnessed his joy.
cn: 她是事故的唯一目击者。
数千人见证了这一历史性事件。
他的笑容证明了他的喜悦。

definitions.definition: 值得花时间（或努力）的；有价值的

en: The research project was worthwhile despite its challenges.
Learning a new language is always worthwhile.
She felt the long hours were worthwhile when she saw the results.
cn: 这项研究项目尽管有挑战，但很有价值。
学习一门新语言总是值得的。
当她看到成果时，觉得长时间的付出是值得的。

definitions.definition: 值得的；配得上的（常接 of 或不定式）

en: She proved herself worthy of the team's trust.
This museum houses many worthy historical artifacts.
His actions were not worthy of a leader.
cn: 她证明了自己配得上团队的信任。
该博物馆收藏了许多有价值的历史文物。
他的行为与领导者的身份不相称。

en: The storm left a trail of wreck along the coast.
Drinking too much alcohol can wreck your health.
Archaeologists found a Viking wreck buried in the mud.
cn: 风暴在海岸线上留下一片残骸。
过量饮酒会严重损害健康。
考古学家发现了一艘埋在淤泥中的维京沉船残骸。

en: He used a wrench to tighten the bolt.
The fall wrenched her ankle painfully.
Her sudden departure wrenched my heart.
cn: 他用扳手拧紧了螺栓。
这一跤扭伤了她的脚踝，疼得厉害。
她的突然离开让我心如刀绞。

en: The wretched refugees had no shelter from the rain.
He felt wretched after losing his job.
The hotel room was in a wretched condition.
cn: 那些可怜的难民无处避雨。
失业后，他感到无比痛苦。
酒店房间的状况糟糕透顶。

en: Sun exposure can cause premature wrinkles.
She wrinkled her nose at the strange smell.
The old map was full of wrinkles from years of folding.
cn: 阳光照射会导致皮肤过早出现皱纹。
她闻到怪味后皱起了鼻子。
这张旧地图因常年折叠而布满褶皱。

definitions.definition: 游艇；帆船（尤指用于比赛或休闲的轻型船只）

en: He spent the weekend sailing his yacht in the Mediterranean.
The billionaire owns a 50-meter luxury yacht.
They raced their yachts across the bay.
cn: 他在地中海驾驶游艇度过了周末。
这位亿万富翁拥有一艘50米的豪华游艇。
他们驾驶帆船横跨海湾比赛。

en: The coach yelled instructions to the players during the match.
She let out a yell when she saw the spider.
Protesters yelled slogans outside the government building.
cn: 比赛中教练向球员大声喊出指令。
她看到蜘蛛时发出一声尖叫。
抗议者在政府大楼外高喊口号。

definitions.definition: 生产（作物、利润等）；屈服，让步

en: The orchard yields a ton of apples annually.
She refused to yield to his demands.
The bond has a high yield of 5%.
cn: 这片果园每年产出一吨苹果。
她拒绝向他的要求让步。
这只债券的收益率高达5%。

definitions.definition: 轭（连接两头牛的木质工具）；束缚，枷锁
给…套上轭；使结合，使联合

en: The farmer fitted the yoke onto the oxen.
They yoked their efforts to complete the project.
The people broke free from the yoke of tyranny.
cn: 农夫给牛套上了轭。
他们合力完成了项目。
人民挣脱了暴政的枷锁。

definitions.definition: 锌（一种蓝白色金属元素，符号 Zn）

en: Brass is an alloy of copper and zinc.
The steel pipes were galvanized by coating them with zinc.
Zinc deficiency can impair immune function.
cn: 黄铜是铜和锌的合金。
钢管通过镀锌工艺防锈。
缺锌可能损害免疫功能。
